meaning: adj.合理的, 合乎科学的 · scientific

examples.example_chinese: 这种做法不太科学。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ bú tài kēxué.
examples.example_translation: This approach is not very scientific.

examples.example_chinese: 公司实行了科学的管理办法，提高了效率。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī shíxíngle kēxué de guǎnlǐ bànfǎ, tígāole xiàolǜ.
examples.example_translation: The company implemented scientific management methods and improved efficiency.

examples.example_chinese: 要学会科学地安排时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào xuéhuì kēxué de ānpái shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: You should learn to arrange your time scientifically.

examples.example_chinese: 这种说法不够科学。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuōfǎ bú gòu kēxué.
examples.example_translation: This statement is not scientific enough.

meaning: n.身体所做的活动 · motion, action

examples.example_chinese: 他这个动作谁也学不会。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhège dòngzuò shéi yě xué bu huì.
examples.example_translation: No one can learn this movement of his.

examples.example_chinese: 这个动作代表请求帮助。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dòngzuò dàibiǎo qǐngqiú bāngzhù.
examples.example_translation: This gesture means asking for help.

examples.example_chinese: 她跳舞的时候，动作很好看。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tiàowǔ de shíhou, dòngzuò hěn hǎokàn.
examples.example_translation: Her movements are beautiful when she dances.

examples.example_chinese: 你的动作真快，我还没准备呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de dòngzuò zhēn kuài, wǒ hái méi zhǔnbèi ne.
examples.example_translation: You move so fast, I’m not ready yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他做了一个打电话的动作，表示正忙着呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuòle yí ge dǎ diànhuà de dòngzuò, biǎoshì zhèng mángzhe ne.
examples.example_translation: He made a gesture of making a phone call, indicating he was busy.

meaning: n.靠工资收入为生的体力劳动者 · worker, laborer making a living by selling his labor for wages

examples.example_chinese: 这个工厂有3000多名工人。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè gè gōngchǎng yǒu sānqiān duō míng gōngrén.
examples.example_translation: This factory has more than 3,000 workers.

examples.example_chinese: 工厂每三年从工人中选拔一批干部。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngchǎng měi sān nián cóng gōngrén zhōng xuǎnbá yī pī gànbù.
examples.example_translation: Every three years, the factory selects a group of cadres from the workers.

examples.example_chinese: 我是一名普通工人，喜欢唱歌。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shì yì míng pǔtōng gōngrén, xǐhuan chànggē.
examples.example_translation: I am an ordinary worker and I like singing.

examples.example_chinese: 这些产品都是工人们的劳动成果。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē chǎnpǐn dōu shì gōngrénmen de láodòng chéngguǒ.
examples.example_translation: All these products are the result of the workers' labor.

examples.example_chinese: 累死无数的工人
examples.example_pinyin: lèi sǐ wúshù de gōng ren

meaning: phr.用语言或行为戏弄人 · crack a joke, joke, make fun of

examples.example_chinese: 你别生气，他是开玩笑呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bié shēngqì, tā shì kāi wánxiào ne.
examples.example_translation: Don’t be angry, he’s just joking.

examples.example_chinese: 他喜欢跟人开玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan gēn rén kāi wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: He likes to joke with people.

examples.example_chinese: 他们俩经常开玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen liǎ jīngcháng kāi wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: The two of them often joke around.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚才跟他开了一个玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái gēn tā kāile yí ge wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: I just cracked a joke with him.

examples.example_chinese: 他很严肃，大家都不敢开他的玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn yánsù, dàjiā dōu bù gǎn kāi tā de wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: He is very serious, so no one dares to joke with him.

meaning: n.某一事情发生的确定的日子或时期 · date

examples.example_chinese: 弟弟结婚的日期是9月20号。
examples.example_pinyin: dìdi jiéhūn de rìqī shì 9 yuè 20 hào.
examples.example_translation: The date of my younger brother's wedding is September 20th.

examples.example_chinese: 他出国的日期已经确定了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā chūguó de rìqī yǐjīng quèdìng le.
examples.example_translation: The date of his departure abroad has been confirmed.

examples.example_chinese: 会议的日期有所变动，请大家注意通知。
examples.example_pinyin: huìyì de rìqī yǒu suǒ biàndòng, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì tōngzhī.
examples.example_translation: The date of the meeting has changed, please pay attention to the notice.

examples.example_chinese: 你看看这瓶饮料的生产日期。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ kànkan zhè píng yǐnliào de shēngchǎn rìqī.
examples.example_translation: Please check the production date of this bottle of beverage.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要在规定的日期内完成这个计划。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen yào zài guīdìng de rìqī nèi wánchéng zhège jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We must complete this plan within the specified date.

meaning: n.人在社会实践中所获得的认识和经验的总和 · knowledge

examples.example_chinese: 老李知识非常丰富，什么问题都难不倒他。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎo Lǐ zhīshi fēicháng fēngfù, shénme wèntí dōu nán bù dǎo tā.
examples.example_translation: Old Li's knowledge is very rich, no problem can stump him.

examples.example_chinese: 青年正是努力学习知识的时候，不要浪费时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Qīngnián zhèng shì nǔlì xuéxí zhīshi de shíhou, bùyào làngfèi shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: Youth is the time to work hard to learn knowledge, don't waste time.

examples.example_chinese: 全社会都要尊重知识，尊重人才。
examples.example_pinyin: Quán shèhuì dōu yào zūnzhòng zhīshi, zūnzhòng réncái.
examples.example_translation: The whole society should respect knowledge and talent.

examples.example_chinese: 法律知识是人人都要懂一些的。
examples.example_pinyin: Fǎlǜ zhīshi shì rénrén dōu yào dǒng yìxiē de.
examples.example_translation: Everyone should know some legal knowledge.

examples.example_chinese: 知识的力量是什么也代替不了的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhīshi de lìliang shì shénme yě dàitì bù liǎo de.
examples.example_translation: The power of knowledge cannot be replaced by anything.

meaning: adj.重量大(跟"轻"相对) · heavy in weight (as opposed to "轻" light)

examples.example_chinese: 这么重的东西,我拿不动。
examples.example_pinyin: zhème zhòng de dōngxi, wǒ ná bùdòng.
examples.example_translation: This heavy thing, I can't lift it.

examples.example_chinese: 你的行李太重了,咱们两个人抬吧。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ de xíngli tài zhòng le, zánmen liǎng gè rén tái ba.
examples.example_translation: Your luggage is too heavy, let's both carry it.

examples.example_chinese: 她能吃苦,干活儿从来不怕重。
examples.example_pinyin: tā néng chīkǔ, gànhuór cónglái bù pà zhòng.
examples.example_translation: She can endure hardship, and is never afraid of heavy work.

examples.example_chinese: 那张桌子重极了,谁也搬不动。
examples.example_pinyin: nà zhāng zhuōzi zhòng jí le, shéi yě bān bùdòng.
examples.example_translation: That table is extremely heavy, no one can move it.

examples.example_chinese: 而是不知道我还重不重要
examples.example_pinyin: ér shì bù zhī dao wǒ hái zhòng bù zhòng yào

meaning: n.男女之间的爱情 · love between a man and a woman

examples.example_chinese: 姑娘和小伙子之间产生了爱情。
examples.example_pinyin: Gūniang hé xiǎohuǒzi zhī jiān chǎnshēngle àiqíng.
examples.example_translation: Love between a man and a woman developed between the girl and the young man.

examples.example_chinese: 他与妻子的爱情故事感动了身边所有的人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi de àiqíng gùshì gǎndòngle shēnbiān suǒyǒu de rén.
examples.example_translation: His love story with his wife moved everyone around them.

examples.example_chinese: 经历过两次离婚后，他不再相信爱情。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglì guò liǎng cì líhūn hòu, tā bù zài xiāngxìn àiqíng.
examples.example_translation: After going through two divorces, he no longer believes in love.

examples.example_chinese: 爱情的力量是伟大的。
examples.example_pinyin: Àiqíng de lìliàng shì wèi dà de.
examples.example_translation: The power of love is great.

examples.example_chinese: 这个大学生收获了事业，也收获了爱情。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dàxuéshēng shōuhuòle shìyè, yě shōuhuòle àiqíng.
examples.example_translation: This university student gained a career and also gained love.

meaning: n.演出活动 · performance

examples.example_chinese: 我今天晚上要去看演出。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù kàn yǎnchū.
examples.example_translation: I'm going to watch a performance tonight.

examples.example_chinese: 演出在晚上八点钟开始。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǎnchū zài wǎnshang bā diǎnzhōng kāishǐ.
examples.example_translation: The performance starts at 8 p.m.

examples.example_chinese: 今天的演出非常成功，很受欢迎。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān de yǎnchū fēicháng chénggōng, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.example_translation: Today's performance was very successful and well received.

examples.example_chinese: 应该说，这场演出的效果是不错的。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnggāi shuō, zhè chǎng yǎnchū de xiàoguǒ shì bùcuò de.
examples.example_translation: It should be said that the effect of this performance was quite good.

examples.example_chinese: 演出获得了成功，演员们都很兴奋。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǎnchū huòdéle chénggōng, yǎnyuánmen dōu hěn xīngfèn.
examples.example_translation: The performance was a success, and the actors were all very excited.

meaning: v.把自己的名字报告给主管的人或单位等，表示愿意参加某种活动或组织 · give one's name to the person, organization or institute in charge, sign up

examples.example_chinese: 我已经报名参加汉语学习班了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bàomíng cānjiā Hànyǔ xuébàn le.
examples.example_translation: I have already signed up for the Chinese language class.

examples.example_chinese: 这次比赛请大家在网上报名。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài qǐng dàjiā zài wǎng shàng bàomíng.
examples.example_translation: Please sign up online for this competition.

examples.example_chinese: 我想参加五月份的HSK考试，不过还没有报名。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā wǔ yuèfèn de HSK kǎoshì, bùguò hái méiyǒu bàomíng.
examples.example_translation: I want to take the HSK exam in May, but I haven’t signed up yet.

examples.example_chinese: 你填一张报名表，就可以加入篮球队。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ tián yì zhāng bàomíngbiǎo, jiù kěyǐ jiārù lánqiúduì.
examples.example_translation: Fill out a registration form, and you can join the basketball team.

examples.example_chinese: 我们都报名，准备参加演出。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen dōu bàole míng, zhǔnbèi cānjiā yǎnchū.
examples.example_translation: We all signed up and are preparing to participate in the performance.

meaning: adj.专业的, 非业余的 · professional, technical

examples.example_chinese: 哥哥是一名职业作家，常常去各地体验生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Gēge shì yì míng zhíyè zuòjiā, chángcháng qù gè dì tǐyàn shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: My older brother is a professional writer, he often goes to different places to experience life.

examples.example_chinese: 他是职业运动员，还在国际大赛中获过奖呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì zhíyè yùndòngyuán, hái zài guójì dàsài zhōng huòguò jiǎng ne.
examples.example_translation: He is a professional athlete and has even won awards in international competitions.

examples.example_chinese: 我们都是业余演员，不是职业的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì yèyú yǎnyuán, bú shì zhíyè de.
examples.example_translation: We are all amateur actors, not professionals.

examples.example_chinese: 截然不同的职业
examples.example_pinyin: jiérán-bùtóng de zhí yè

examples.example_chinese: 连个正经职业都没有
examples.example_pinyin: lián gè zhèng jing zhí yè dōu méiyou

meaning: n.躯干的一部分，跟胸部和腹部相对 · back (part of one’s body opposite the chest and the stomach)

examples.example_chinese: 我的背有点儿疼。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de bèi yǒudiǎnr téng.

examples.example_chinese: 长期干苦活儿，他把背都熏黑了。
examples.example_pinyin: Chángqī gàn kǔhuó er, tā bǎ bèi dōu nòng hēi le.

examples.example_chinese: 他骑在牛背上，任凭牛随意地往前走。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qí zài niú bèi shàng, rèntiāo niú suíyì de wǎng qián zǒu.

meaning: n.事物发生的明显变化 · change

examples.example_chinese: 他的想法有了很大改变。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒule hěn dà gǎibiàn.
examples.example_translation: His ideas have changed a lot.

examples.example_chinese: 我们应当看到他的改变，承认他的进步。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yīngdāng kàndào tā de gǎibiàn, chéngrèn tā de jìnbù.
examples.example_translation: We should see his change and acknowledge his progress.

examples.example_chinese: 我们没看到他最近有任何改变。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen méi kàndào tā zuìjìn yǒu rènhé gǎibiàn.
examples.example_translation: We haven't seen any changes in him recently.

examples.example_chinese: 十年来，他的家乡发生了巨大的改变。
examples.example_pinyin: Shí nián lái, tā de jiāxiāng fāshēngle jùdà gǎibiàn.
examples.example_translation: In the past ten years, his hometown has undergone tremendous changes.

meaning: adv.表示程度上达到一定标准 · used to indicate a high degree is reached

examples.example_chinese: 你今天够累的了，早点儿休息吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān gòu lèi de le, zǎo diǎnr xiūxi ba.
examples.example_translation: You are tired enough today, go rest early.

examples.example_chinese: 他对你够好的了，你还想怎么样？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì nǐ gòu hǎo de le, nǐ hái xiǎng zěnmeyàng?
examples.example_translation: He is good enough to you, what more do you want?

examples.example_chinese: 他够难过的了，你就别再批评他了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gòu nánguò de le, nǐ jiù bié zài pīpíng tā le.
examples.example_translation: He is sad enough, so stop criticizing him.

examples.example_chinese: 今天真够热的，得有40度吧？
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān gòu rè de, děi yǒu sìshí dù ba?
examples.example_translation: It’s really hot today, it must be 40 degrees, right?

examples.example_chinese: 这房子不够大，放不下这些家具。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fángzi bú gòu dà, fàng bu xià zhèxiē jiājù.
examples.example_translation: This house is not big enough to fit all this furniture.

meaning: conj.用在下半句的开头，表示转折 · however, but

examples.example_chinese: 他有女朋友，不过是最近认识的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒu nǚpéngyou, búguò shì zuìjìn rènshi de.
examples.example_translation: He has a girlfriend, but he just met her recently.

examples.example_chinese: 我去过北京，不过时间不长。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qùguo Běijīng, búguò shíjiān bù cháng.
examples.example_translation: I have been to Beijing, but not for long.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服好是好，不过有点儿贵。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎo shì hǎo, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing is good, but it's a bit expensive.

examples.example_chinese: 我会抽烟，不过抽得很少。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huì chōu yān, búguò chōu de hěn shǎo.
examples.example_translation: I smoke, but very little.

examples.example_chinese: 外面很冷，不过屋子里挺暖和的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, búguò wūzi lǐ tǐng nuǎnhuo de.
examples.example_translation: It's very cold outside, but it's quite warm inside the house.

meaning: n.研究工作的结果, 学问 · research, study

examples.example_chinese: 他对历史很有研究。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì lìshǐ hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.example_translation: He has done a lot of research on history.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一项新的科学研究。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yī xiàng xīn de kēxué yánjiū.
examples.example_translation: This is a new scientific research study.

examples.example_chinese: 他的最新研究发表在了著名的杂志上。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de zuìxīn yánjiū fābiǎo zàile zhumíng de zázhì shàng.
examples.example_translation: His latest research was published in a famous journal.

meaning: v.表示前边提到的人或事物比不上后面所说的 · not equal to, not as good as, inferior to

examples.example_chinese: 姐姐不如妹妹漂亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiějie bùrú mèimei piàoliang.

examples.example_chinese: 我英语不如你，还是你当翻译吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yīngyǔ bùrú nǐ, háishi nǐ dāng fānyì ba.

examples.example_chinese: 搭车的话，坐车还不如骑自行车快。
examples.example_pinyin: Dā chē de huà, zuòchē hái bùrú qí zìxíngchē kuài.

examples.example_chinese: 我这学期的成绩不如上学期好。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhè xuéqī de chéngjì bùrú shàng xuéqī hǎo.

examples.example_chinese: 你这几句话还不如不说。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhè jǐ jù huà hái bùrú bù shuō.

meaning: v.指这样做有意义，有好处 · be worth, merit, deserve

examples.example_chinese: 自然博物馆内容很丰富，值得参观。
examples.example_pinyin: Zìrán bówùguǎn nèiróng hěn fēngfù, zhíde cānguān.
examples.example_translation: The natural history museum is very rich in content, it's worth visiting.

examples.example_chinese: 他乐于助人的精神，非常值得我们学习。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā lèyú zhùrén de jīngshén, fēicháng zhíde wǒmen xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: His spirit of helping others is very worthy of our learning.

examples.example_chinese: 为了公益事业，他认为牺牲些个人利益也值得。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile gōngyì shìyè, tā rènwéi xīshēng xiē gèrén lìyì yě zhíde.
examples.example_translation: For public welfare, he thinks it's worth sacrificing some personal interests.

examples.example_chinese: 要学好汉语，多花点儿时间也是值得的。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, duō huā diǎnr shíjiān yě shì zhíde de.
examples.example_translation: To learn Chinese well, it's also worth spending more time.

meaning: adv.表示发现或知道了以前不知道的新情况 · indicating discovery of the truth of a situation

examples.example_chinese: 原来他就是我们的新老师。
examples.example_pinyin: Yuánlái tā jiù shì wǒmen de xīn lǎoshī.
examples.example_translation: So he is our new teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 那些花原来是假的，我还以为是真的呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàxiē huā yuánlái shì jiǎ de, wǒ hái yǐwéi shì zhēn de ne.
examples.example_translation: Those flowers turned out to be fake, I thought they were real.

examples.example_chinese: 原来是你啊，我找你有什么事吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Yuánlái shì nǐ a, wǒ zhǎo nǐ yǒu shénme shì ma?
examples.example_translation: Oh, it was you! Is there something I need from you?

examples.example_chinese: 怪不得房间里这么冷，原来开着窗户呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Guàibùdé fángjiān lǐ zhème lěng, yuánlái kāizhe chuānghu ne.
examples.example_translation: No wonder the room is so cold, it turns out the window is open.

examples.example_chinese: 我到处找那本书，没想到原来早被你借去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dàochù zhǎo nà běn shū, méi xiǎngdào yuánlái zǎo bèi nǐ jiè qù le.
examples.example_translation: I looked everywhere for that book, but it turns out you had borrowed it long ago.

meaning: part.用于主谓之间，使其变成偏正关系 · used between the subject and the predicate in an S-P structure so as to nominalise

examples.example_chinese: 那里山势之险让你难以想象。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàlǐ shānshì zhī xiǎn ràng nǐ nányǐ xiǎngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: The steepness of the mountains there is beyond your imagination.

examples.example_chinese: 他朋友之多，是你们想象不到的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā péngyou zhī duō, shì nǐmen xiǎngxiàng bu dào de.
examples.example_translation: He has more friends than you can imagine.

examples.example_chinese: 他奔跑的速度之快，是一般人无法赶上的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bēnpǎo de sùdù zhī kuài, shì yìbān rén wúfǎ gǎnshàng de.
examples.example_translation: He runs so fast that ordinary people can't catch up with him.

meaning: n.整体中的局部, 整体里的一些个体 · part, section

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章包括三个部分。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng bāokuò sān ge bùfen.
examples.example_translation: This article includes three parts.

examples.example_chinese: 展览由两部分组成,先看哪一部分都可以。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn yóu liǎng bùfen zǔchéng, xiān kàn nǎ yí bùfen dōu kěyǐ.
examples.example_translation: The exhibition is composed of two parts, you can look at any part first.

examples.example_chinese: 我只去了中国一部分地方,很多地方还没去。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ qùle Zhōngguó yí bùfen dìfang, hěn duō dìfang hái méi qù.
examples.example_translation: I've only been to some parts of China, there are still many places I haven't been to.

examples.example_chinese: 这些苹果大部分是好的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ dà bùfen shì hǎo de.
examples.example_translation: Most of these apples are good.

examples.example_chinese: 一部分人同意这个意见,另一部分人反对。
examples.example_pinyin: Yí bùfen rén tóngyì zhège yìjiàn, lìng yí bùfen rén fǎnduì.
examples.example_translation: Some people agree with this opinion, and others disagree.

meaning: v.到某地观看或考察 · visit

examples.example_chinese: 他们去博物馆参观了一天。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen qù bówùguǎn cānguānle yì tiān.
examples.example_translation: They visited the museum for a whole day.

examples.example_chinese: 我们下午要到一家工厂参观。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào dào yì jiā gōngchǎng cānguān.
examples.example_translation: We are going to visit a factory this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 这次出国，我一共参观了六个城市。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì chūguó, wǒ yígòng cānguānle liù ge chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: On this trip abroad, I visited six cities in total.

examples.example_chinese: 每天都有很多人来这里参观。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō rén lái zhèli cānguān.
examples.example_translation: Many people come here to visit every day.

examples.example_chinese: 校长带我们参观了学校的图书馆、教学楼等。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàozhǎng dài wǒmen cānguānle xuéxiào de túshūguǎn, jiàoxuélóu děng.
examples.example_translation: The principal took us to visit the school's library, teaching buildings, etc.

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，本工厂谢绝参观。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, běn gōngchǎng xièjué cānguān.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, this factory does not accept visitors.

meaning: n.出问题，事故而应承担的过失 · responsibility for the fault, failure to fulfill an obligation

examples.example_chinese: 这次事故的责任由我一人承担。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù de zérèn yóu wǒ yī rén chéngdān.
examples.example_translation: I alone take responsibility for this accident.

examples.example_chinese: 这场车祸，司机负主要责任。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng chēhuò, sījī fù zhǔyào zérèn.
examples.example_translation: The driver bears the main responsibility for this car accident.

examples.example_chinese: 出了问题，领导勇敢地承担了责任。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūle wèntí, lǐngdǎo yǒnggǎn de chéngdānle zérèn.
examples.example_translation: When a problem occurred, the leader bravely took responsibility.

examples.example_chinese: 这次经济损失是领导的责任，跟别人无关。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì jīngjì kuīsǔn shì lǐngdǎo de zérèn, gēn biérén wúguān.
examples.example_translation: The economic loss this time is the leader's responsibility and has nothing to do with others.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一起严重的责任事故，需要严肃处理。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yīqǐ yánzhòng de zérèn shìgù, xūyào yánsù chǔlǐ.
examples.example_translation: This is a serious accident of responsibility and needs to be dealt with seriously.

meaning: cl.用于文娱体育活动 · used as an indefinite article or together with a quantity in entertainment and sports activities

examples.example_chinese: 我在北京看过两场京剧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng kànguo liǎng chǎng jīngjù.
examples.example_translation: I have seen two Peking operas in Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 晚上我们去看场电影吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen qù kàn chǎng diànyǐng ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's go watch a movie tonight.

examples.example_chinese: 星期日这个体育馆有一场篮球比赛。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīngqīrì zhège tǐyùguǎn yǒu yì chǎng lánqiú bǐsài.
examples.example_translation: There is a basketball game in this gym on Sunday.

examples.example_chinese: 我到现在也忘不了那场音乐会。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dào xiànzài yě wàng bu liǎo nà chǎng yīnyuèhuì.
examples.example_translation: I still can't forget that concert.

examples.example_chinese: 他画了一幅著名的画——《清明上河图》，画的是北宋都城汴京热闹的场面。
examples.example_pinyin: tā huà le yī fú zhù míng de huà qīng míng shàng hé tú huà de shì běi sòng dōu chéng biàn jīng rè nào de chǎng miàn

meaning: v.由人或事物的后面赶到前面 · surpass, overtake

examples.example_chinese: 我们的火车很快就超过了那辆汽车。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de huǒchē hěn kuài jiù chāoguòle nà liàng qìchē.
examples.example_translation: Our train soon overtook that car.

examples.example_chinese: 他超过了两名运动员，现在在第二的位置。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chāoguòle liǎng míng yùndòngyuán, xiànzài zài dì-èr de wèizhì.
examples.example_translation: He overtook two athletes and is now in second place.

examples.example_chinese: 他跑得快，一会儿就能超过你们。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā pǎo de kuài, yīhuìr jiù néng chāoguò nǐmen.
examples.example_translation: He runs fast and will soon overtake you.

examples.example_chinese: 他跑在最前面，谁也超过不了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā pǎo zài zuì qiánmiàn, shéi yě chāo bù guò tā.
examples.example_translation: He runs in the front, and no one can surpass him.

meaning: adv.再一次 · once again, once more

examples.example_chinese: 如果你没听清楚的话，我可以重新讲一遍。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ méi tīng qīngchu dehuà, wǒ kěyǐ chóngxīn jiǎng yí biàn.
examples.example_translation: If you didn't hear clearly, I can say it again.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书我又重新看了一遍。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ yòu chóngxīn kànle yí biàn.
examples.example_translation: I read this book again.

examples.example_chinese: 我们需要重新考虑旅行计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn kǎolǜ lǚxíng jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We need to reconsider our travel plans.

examples.example_chinese: 我重新写了一遍，应该不会有错误了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ chóngxīn xiěle yí biàn, yīnggāi bú huì yǒu cuòwù le.
examples.example_translation: I rewrote it, there shouldn't be any mistakes now.

examples.example_chinese: 三年后，他又重新开始了自己的事业。
examples.example_pinyin: Sān nián hòu, tā yòu chóngxīn kāishǐle zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.example_translation: Three years later, he started his own business again.

meaning: v.变成 · become, turn into

examples.example_chinese: 他已经成为了一名警察。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng chéngwéile yì míng jǐngchá.
examples.example_translation: He has already become a police officer.

examples.example_chinese: 我争取成为一个优秀学生。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhēngqǔ chéngwéi yí ge yōuxiù xuésheng.
examples.example_translation: I strive to become an excellent student.

examples.example_chinese: 他们现在成为了好朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài chéngwéile hǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: They have now become good friends.

examples.example_chinese: 不要让困难成为你前进的阻碍。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùyào ràng kùnnan chéngwéi nǐ qiánjìn de zǔ'ài.
examples.example_translation: Don't let difficulties become an obstacle to your progress.

examples.example_chinese: 他很快就从一名普通员工成为了领导者。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù cóng yì míng pǔtōng yuángōng chéngwéile lǐngdǎozhě.
examples.example_translation: He quickly became a leader from an ordinary employee.

meaning: v.显露出来 · emerge, occur

examples.example_chinese: 现在问题出现了，就要想办法解决。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài wèntí chūxiàn le, jiù yào xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué.
examples.example_translation: Since the problem has emerged now, we’d better find a solution.

examples.example_chinese: 以前从来没出现过这种情况。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǐqián cónglái méi chūxiànguo zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng.
examples.example_translation: This situation has never occurred.

examples.example_chinese: 这是近几年出现的新技术。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì jìn jǐ nián chūxiàn de xīn jìshù.
examples.example_translation: This is a new technology emerged in recent years.

examples.example_chinese: 他突然出现在我面前，让我吃了一惊。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tūrán chūxiàn zài wǒ miànqián, ràng wǒ chīle yì jīng.
examples.example_translation: His sudden appearance took me by surprise.

examples.example_chinese: 他们之间出现了很多问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zhījiān chūxiànle hěn duō wèntí.
examples.example_translation: Many problems arose between them.

examples.example_chinese: 两国的关系出现了危机。
examples.example_pinyin: Liǎng guó de guānxì chūxiànle wēijī.
examples.example_translation: The relationship between the two countries is facing a crisis.

meaning: v. （风、气流等）流动 (of wind, air current, etc.) blow, strike; 嘴用力出气 blow or puff with the mouth; 说大话, 夸口 exaggerate, boast

examples.example_chinese: 风一吹，树上的叶子都落了下来。
examples.example_pinyin: Fēng yì chuī, shù shàng de yèzi dōu luò le xiàlái.
examples.example_translation: When the wind blows, all the leaves on the tree fall down.

examples.example_chinese: 风轻轻地吹着湖面。
examples.example_pinyin: Fēng qīngqīng de chuī zhe húmiàn.
examples.example_translation: The wind gently blows over the lake.

examples.example_chinese: 一阵风吹来，她觉得舒服极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yí zhèn fēng chuī lái, tā juéde shūfu jí le.
examples.example_translation: A gust of wind blew by, and she felt extremely comfortable.

examples.example_chinese: 大风把那棵树吹倒了。
examples.example_pinyin: Dà fēng bǎ nà kē shù chuī dǎo le.
examples.example_translation: The strong wind blew that tree down.

examples.example_chinese: 他一下就把生日蜡烛都吹灭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yíxià jiù bǎ shēngrì làzhú dōu chuī miè le.
examples.example_translation: He blew out all the birthday candles at once.

examples.example_chinese: 他用力把气球吹得很大的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yònglì bǎ qìqiú chuī de hěn dà de.
examples.example_translation: He blew the balloon up very big with force.

examples.example_chinese: 他一边走，一边吹着歌曲。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yìbiān zǒu, yìbiān chuī zhe gēqǔ.
examples.example_translation: He walked while whistling a tune.

examples.example_chinese: 他用力吹走了桌子上的灰尘。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yònglì chuī zǒu le zhuōzi shàng de huīchén.
examples.example_translation: He blew the dust off the table with force.

examples.example_chinese: 他经常吹自己有学问。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng chuī zìjǐ yǒu xuéwèn.
examples.example_translation: He often boasts about his knowledge.

examples.example_chinese: 他把自己吹成了英雄。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ chuī chéng le yīngxióng.
examples.example_translation: He boasted himself into a hero.

examples.example_chinese: 我最讨厌那些爱吹的人了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn nàxiē ài chuī de rén le.
examples.example_translation: I dislike people who love to boast the most.

examples.example_chinese: 别看他没什么本事，都很能吹。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié kàn tā méi shénme běnshi, dōu hěn néng chuī.
examples.example_translation: Even though he is not very capable, he is good at boasting.

meaning: v.勉强维持, 支撑 · sustain, hold out

examples.example_chinese: 信心支持着我坚持到最后。
examples.example_pinyin: Xìnxīn zhīchí zhe wǒ jiānchí dào zuìhòu.
examples.example_translation: Confidence supported me to persist until the end.

examples.example_chinese: 她太累了，快支持不住了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tài lèi le, kuài zhīchí bu zhù le.
examples.example_translation: She is too tired, she can't hold out much longer.

examples.example_chinese: 他用全力支持着这个困难重重的工厂。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yòng quánlì zhīchí zhe zhège kùnnan chóngchóng de gōngchǎng.
examples.example_translation: He is doing his best to sustain this factory full of difficulties.

examples.example_chinese: 这些粮食支持不了半年了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē liángshi zhīchí bu liǎo bàn nián le.
examples.example_translation: This grain won't last for half a year.

examples.example_chinese: 家长在那里低头闭眼口中念念有词，孩子们很少不在那里做鬼脸的。
examples.example_pinyin: jiā cháng zài nà lǐ dī tóu bì yǎn kǒu niàn niàn yǒu cí hěn shǎo bù zài nà lǐ zuò guǐ liǎn de

meaning: n.词和短语 · word and phrase, expression

examples.example_chinese: 这个词语是什么意思？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cíyǔ shì shénme yìsi?
examples.example_translation: What’s the meaning of this word?

examples.example_chinese: 他已经掌握了两千多个汉语词语。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng zhǎngwòle liǎng qiān duō ge Hànyǔ cíyǔ.
examples.example_translation: He has learned more than 2000 Chinese words and expressions.

examples.example_chinese: 我不知道用什么词语来表达我的感谢。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào yòng shénme cíyǔ lái biǎodá wǒ de gǎnxiè.
examples.example_translation: I can hardly find the right words to express my gratitude.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书里我不懂的词语太多了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ wǒ bù dǒng de cíyǔ tài duō le.
examples.example_translation: There are too many new words in this book that I don’t know.

examples.example_chinese: 我写文章的时候总是觉得没什么词语可用。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiě wénzhāng de shíhou zǒngshì juéde méi shénme cíyǔ kě yòng.
examples.example_translation: I always find myself devoid of words when I write an article.

examples.example_chinese: 这个词语老师解释了半天，我才明白。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cíyǔ lǎoshī jiěshìle bàntiān, wǒ cái míngbai.
examples.example_translation: After the teacher explained this word to me for a long time, I finally understood it.

meaning: v. 听到呼叫后回答 answer, respond; 应允, 同意 agree, comply with

examples.example_chinese: 我叫了他三声，他都没答应。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiào le tā sān shēng, tā dōu méi dāyìng.
examples.example_translation: I called him three times, but he didn't respond.

examples.example_chinese: 听到老师叫他，他马上答应说“来了”。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngdào lǎoshī jiào tā, tā mǎshàng dāyìng shuō "lái le".
examples.example_translation: When he heard the teacher call him, he immediately responded, "Coming."

examples.example_chinese: 我没听见你叫我，怎么答应啊？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngjiàn nǐ jiào wǒ, zěnme dāyìng a?
examples.example_translation: I didn't hear you call me, how could I respond?

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈在哼你，你倒是答应一声啊。
examples.example_pinyin: Māmā zài hēng nǐ, nǐ dǎo shì dāyìng yī shēng a.
examples.example_translation: Mom is calling you, you should at least respond.

examples.example_chinese: 我请他帮忙，他答应了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qǐng tā bāngmáng, tā dāyìng le.
examples.example_translation: I asked him for help, and he agreed.

examples.example_chinese: 我已经答应去火车站接他了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng dāyìng qù huǒchē zhàn jiē tā le.
examples.example_translation: I have already agreed to pick him up at the train station.

examples.example_chinese: 他要借我的电脑，我还没答应。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yào jiè wǒ de diànnǎo, wǒ hái méi dāyìng.
examples.example_translation: He wants to borrow my computer, but I haven't agreed yet.

examples.example_chinese: 经理痛快地答应了我们的要求，给我们放了一天假。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ mǎnkuài de dāyìng le wǒmen de yāoqiú, gěi wǒmen fàng le yī tiān jià.
examples.example_translation: The manager readily agreed to our request and gave us a day off.

meaning: v.做工（多指临时的） · do manual work (usually temporarily)

examples.example_chinese: 放假的时候，我要去饭馆打工。
examples.example_pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ yào qù fàndiàn dǎgōng.
examples.example_translation: During the holidays, I am going to work at a restaurant.

examples.example_chinese: 他在一个商场打工，每天去三个小时。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài yí gè shāngchǎng dǎgōng, měitiān qù sān gè xiǎoshí.
examples.example_translation: He works part-time at a shopping mall, going there for three hours every day.

examples.example_chinese: 我们俩是打工的时候认识的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ dōu shì dǎgōng de shíhou rènshi de.
examples.example_translation: The two of us met while working part-time.

examples.example_chinese: 我以前在这个公司打过工。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián zài zhège gōngsī dǎguò gōng.
examples.example_translation: I used to work part-time at this company.

examples.example_chinese: 我打了两个月的工，挣够了明年的学费。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dǎ le liǎng gè yuè de gōng, zhèng gòu le míngnián de xuéfèi.
examples.example_translation: I worked for two months and earned enough for next year's tuition.

meaning: conj.和，连接并列的成分 · and

examples.example_chinese: 要学好汉语，说与写都很重要。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, shuō yǔ xiě dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.example_translation: To learn Chinese well, both speaking and writing are important.

examples.example_chinese: 教学与研究是密切相关的。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoxué yǔ yánjiū shì mìqiè xiāngguān de.
examples.example_translation: Teaching and research are closely related.

examples.example_chinese: 有时候好与不好是相对的。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu shíhou hǎo yǔ bù hǎo shì xiāngduì de.
examples.example_translation: Sometimes good and bad are relative.

examples.example_chinese: 父母与孩子之间的关系对孩子的成长很重要。

examples.example_translation: My current residence is much better than before.

examples.example_translation: He has already left his original organization and joined another company.

meaning: pron.全部的事物和东西 · all, everything

meaning: n.用来说明某人、某事真实性的材料 · certificate, identification, testimonial

examples.example_chinese: 要有单位的工资收入证明，才能办理贷款手续。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào yǒu dānwèi de gōngzī shōurù zhèngmíng, cái néng bànlǐ dàikuǎn shǒuxù.
examples.example_translation: You need a certificate of income from your employer to apply for a loan.

examples.example_chinese: 应聘时，我提供了多种证明材料。
examples.example_pinyin: Yìngpìn shí, wǒ tígōngle duō zhǒng zhèngmíng cáiliào.
examples.example_translation: When applying for a job, I provided various certificates.

examples.example_chinese: 饭店的服务员都要有健康证明。
examples.example_pinyin: Fàndiàn de fúwùyuán dōu yào yǒu jiànkāng zhèngmíng.
examples.example_translation: Waiters in restaurants must have a health certificate.

examples.example_chinese: 你来办手续时交证明的复印件就可以。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ lái bàn shǒuxù shí jiāo zhèngmíng de fùyìnjiàn jiù kěyǐ.
examples.example_translation: When you handle the procedures, just submit a copy of the certificate.

meaning: v.物体因失去支撑而下来 · fall, drop

examples.example_chinese: 树上的叶子都掉了。
examples.example_pinyin: Shù shang de yèzi dōu diào le.
examples.example_translation: The leaves on the tree have all fallen.

examples.example_chinese: 我的衣服上掉了一个扣子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de yīfu shang diàole yí ge kòuzi.
examples.example_translation: A button fell off my clothes.

examples.example_chinese: 钱包从他的口袋里掉出来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiánbāo cóng tā de kǒudài li diào chūlai le.
examples.example_translation: The wallet fell out of his pocket.

examples.example_chinese: 奶奶的牙都掉光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǎinai de yá dōu diàoguāng le.
examples.example_translation: Grandma has lost all her teeth.

examples.example_chinese: 我的书掉到地上了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de shū diàodào dìshang le.
examples.example_translation: My book fell to the ground.

meaning: n.精神或心理上的负担 · mental or psychological burden, pressure

examples.example_chinese: 他最近任务多，压力很大。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuìjìn rènwu duō, yālì hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: He has had many tasks recently and is under a lot of pressure.

examples.example_chinese: 工作的压力已经影响了他的身体健康。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò de yālì yǐjīng yǐngxiǎngle tā de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.example_translation: Work pressure has already affected his health.

examples.example_chinese: 这个电影明星受到了外界的巨大压力。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng míngxīng shòudàole wàijiè de jùdà yālì.
examples.example_translation: This movie star is under great pressure from the outside world.

examples.example_chinese: 父母的期望给孩子造成了学习上的压力。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùmǔ de qīwàng gěi háizi zàochéngle xuéxí shàng de yālì.
examples.example_translation: Parents' expectations put academic pressure on children.

meaning: n.用手机发送的简短信息 · short text message, SMS

examples.example_chinese: 有事情可以给我打电话或发短信。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu shìqing kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà huò fā duǎnxìn.
examples.example_translation: If you need anything, you can call me or send me a text message.

examples.example_chinese: 我给他发了一条祝他生日快乐的短信。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā fā le yì tiáo zhù tā shēngrì kuàilè de duǎnxìn.
examples.example_translation: I sent him a text message wishing him a happy birthday.

examples.example_chinese: 新年的时候，我收到了200多条短信。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīnnián de shíhou, wǒ shōudào le èr bǎi duō tiáo duǎnxìn.
examples.example_translation: During the New Year, I received more than 200 text messages.

examples.example_chinese: 我们打电话不多，经常短信联系。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen dǎ diànhuà bù duō, jīngcháng duǎnxìn liánxì.
examples.example_translation: We don't call much, we often keep in touch by text message.

examples.example_chinese: 这种手机卡每个月可以免费发100条短信。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shǒujī kǎ měi gè yuè kěyǐ miǎnfèi fā yì bǎi tiáo duǎnxìn.
examples.example_translation: With this SIM card, you can send 100 free text messages every month.

meaning: n.街道、河流等一边的另一边 · opposite

examples.example_chinese: 我家对面是个电影院。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiā duìmiàn shì ge diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.example_translation: There is a cinema opposite my house.

examples.example_chinese: 你坐错车了，应该在马路对面坐。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zuòcuò chē le, yīnggāi zài mǎlù duìmiàn zuò.
examples.example_translation: You took the wrong bus, you should have taken it on the opposite side of the road.

examples.example_chinese: 我们坐对面吧，这样说话更方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zuò duìmiàn ba, zhèyàng shuōhuà gèng fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: Let's sit opposite each other, it's easier to talk this way.

examples.example_chinese: 学校就在那条河的对面。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào jiù zài nà tiáo hé de duìmiàn.
examples.example_translation: The school is just across that river.

examples.example_chinese: 对面来了一辆汽车。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìmiàn láile yí liàng qìchē.
examples.example_translation: A car came from the opposite direction.

examples.example_chinese: 他从对面走过来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cóng duìmiàn zǒu guòlai le.
examples.example_translation: He walked over from the opposite side.

examples.example_chinese: 他就站在我对面，我看得清清楚楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiù zhàn zài wǒ duìmiàn, wǒ kàn de qīngqīngchǔchǔ.
examples.example_translation: He was standing right in front of me, I could see him clearly.

meaning: adv.用在感叹句里，表示程度很高 · (used in an exclamatory sentence to indicate a high degree) how

examples.example_chinese: 多么聪明的孩子啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Duōme cōngming de háizi a!
examples.example_translation: What a smart child!

examples.example_chinese: 我多么想找到一个好工作啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ duōme xiǎng zhǎodào yí ge hǎo gōngzuò a!
examples.example_translation: How I want to find a good job!

examples.example_chinese: 这地方多么漂亮啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè dìfang duōme piàoliang a!
examples.example_translation: How beautiful this place is!

examples.example_chinese: 多么好的天气啊，我们去踢足球吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Duōme hǎo de tiānqì a, wǒmen qù tī zúqiú ba.
examples.example_translation: What fine weather! Let’s play football.

examples.example_chinese: 多么难得的机会啊，你要把握住啊。
examples.example_pinyin: Duōme nándé de jīhuì a, nǐ yào bǎwò zhù a.
examples.example_translation: What a rare opportunity! Just don’t miss it.

examples.example_chinese: 看，他多么快乐啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn, tā duōme kuàilè a!
examples.example_translation: Look, how happy he is!

meaning: n.能引人发笑的谈话、故事或事情 · joke, jest

examples.example_chinese: 这个笑话太有意思了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xiàohua tài yǒu yìsi le.
examples.example_translation: This joke is so funny.

examples.example_chinese: 他很会讲笑话，走到哪里就把笑声带到哪里。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn huì jiǎng xiàohua, zǒudào nǎli jiù bǎ xiàoshēng dàidào nǎli.
examples.example_translation: He is very good at telling jokes, and wherever he goes, he brings laughter with him.

examples.example_chinese: 他似乎有一肚子的笑话，几天几夜也讲不完。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā sìhu yǒu yí dùzi de xiàohua, jǐ tiān jǐ yè yě jiǎng bu wán.
examples.example_translation: He seems to have a belly full of jokes and could tell them for days and nights without finishing.

examples.example_chinese: 我学汉语，曾经闹过不少笑话。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xué Hànyǔ, céngjīng nàoguò bù shǎo xiàohua.
examples.example_translation: When I was learning Chinese, I made quite a few jokes (mistakes).

examples.example_chinese: 他讲完笑话以后，大家都没笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiǎngwán xiàohua yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu méi xiào.
examples.example_translation: After he finished telling the joke, nobody laughed.

meaning: n.对对方的误解 · misunderstanding

examples.example_chinese: 两人交流太少，难免产生一些误会。
examples.example_pinyin: Liǎng rén jiāoliú tài shǎo, nánmiǎn chǎnshēng yìxiē wùhuì.
examples.example_translation: The two communicate too little, so some misunderstandings are inevitable.

examples.example_chinese: 这完全是误会，我已经解释清楚了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè wánquán shì wùhuì, wǒ yǐjīng jiěshì qīngchu le.
examples.example_translation: This is a complete misunderstanding, I have already explained it clearly.

examples.example_chinese: 双方都把话说清楚，这样可以避免误会。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuāng fāng dōu bǎ huà shuō qīngchu, zhèyàng kěyǐ bìmiǎn wùhuì.
examples.example_translation: If both sides make things clear, misunderstandings can be avoided.

examples.example_chinese: 误会消除了，大家又高高兴兴地玩儿了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Wùhuì xiāochú le, dàjiā yòu gāogāoxìngxìng de wánrle qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: The misunderstanding was cleared up, and everyone happily played together again.

examples.example_chinese: 那次误会的原因主要是他没说清楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà cì wùhuì de yuányīn zhǔyào shì tā méi shuō qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: The main reason for that misunderstanding was that he didn't make himself clear.

meaning: n.相对或并列的几个人或几种事物的一方 · side, in the area of ...

examples.example_chinese: 城市交通方面还存在不少问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Chéngshì jiāotōng fāngmiàn hái cúnzài bù shǎo wèntí.
examples.example_translation: There are still many problems in the area of urban transportation.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要解决好学生生活方面的困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiějué hǎo xuéshēng shēnghuó fāngmiàn de kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: We need to solve the difficulties in students' daily life.

examples.example_chinese: 中国在经济方面已经取得了很大成绩。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó zài jīngjì fāngmiàn yǐjīng qǔdéle hěn dà chéngjì.
examples.example_translation: China has already made great achievements in the area of economy.

examples.example_chinese: 他成绩不好，可能有很多方面的原因。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chéngjì bù hǎo, kěnéng yǒu hěn duō fāngmiàn de yuányīn.
examples.example_translation: His poor grades may have many reasons in different aspects.

examples.example_chinese: 我们一方面要多看，另一方面还要多问。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yī fāngmiàn yào duō kàn, lìng yī fāngmiàn hái yào duō wèn.
examples.example_translation: On one hand, we should observe more; on the other hand, we should ask more questions.

meaning: cl.用于搭配成组的东西 · set

examples.example_chinese: 他把蛋糕分成了五份。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ dàngāo fēnchéngle wǔ fèn.
examples.example_translation: He divided the cake into five pieces.

examples.example_chinese: 我给大家带了礼物，每人一份。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gěi dàjiā dàile lǐwù, měi rén yí fèn.
examples.example_translation: I brought gifts for everyone, one for each person.

examples.example_chinese: 他把菜肴分为两份，一份倒在一张饼上，把饼一卷，比拳头要粗，两手扶着矗立在盘子上，张开血盆巨口，左一口，右一口，中间一口！
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ cài fēn wèi liǎng fèn yī fèn dào zài yī zhāng bǐng shàng bǎ bǐng yī juǎn bǐ quán tóu yào cū liǎng shǒu fú zhe lì zài pán shàng zhāng kāi xiě pén kǒu zuǒ yī kǒu yī kǒu jiān yī kǒu

examples.example_chinese: 他把菜肴分为两份，一份倒在一张饼上，把饼一卷，比拳头要粗，两手扶着矗立在盘子上，张开血盆巨口，左一口，右一口，中间一口！
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ cài fēn wèi liǎng fèn yī fèn dào zài yī zhāng bǐng shàng bǎ bǐng yī juǎn bǐ quán tóu yào cū liǎng shǒu fú zhe lì zài pán shàng zhāng kāi xiě pén kǒu zuǒ yī kǒu yī kǒu jiān yī kǒu

examples.example_chinese: 他把菜肴分为两份，一份倒在一张饼上，把饼一卷，比拳头要粗，两手扶着矗立在盘子上，张开血盆巨口，左一口，右一口，中间一口！
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ cài fēn wèi liǎng fèn yī fèn dào zài yī zhāng bǐng shàng bǎ bǐng yī juǎn bǐ quán tóu yào cū liǎng shǒu fú zhe lì zài pán shàng zhāng kāi xiě pén kǒu zuǒ yī kǒu yī kǒu jiān yī kǒu

meaning: v.用于求人做事 · ask somebody to do something

examples.example_chinese: 能不能辛苦你一下，帮我订一张火车票？
examples.example_pinyin: Néng bu néng xīnkǔ nǐ yíxià, bāng wǒ dìng yì zhāng huǒchēpiào?
examples.example_translation: Could I trouble you to help me book a train ticket?

examples.example_chinese: 这件事辛苦你了，谢谢。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xīnkǔ nǐ le, xièxie.
examples.example_translation: Thank you for your hard work on this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 现在只能辛苦大家一下，再加一会儿班。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài zhǐ néng xīnkǔ dàjiā yíxià, zài jiā yìhuǐr bān.
examples.example_translation: Now we can only trouble everyone to work overtime for a while.

examples.example_chinese: 辛苦各位了，我代表公司表示感谢！
examples.example_pinyin: Xīnkǔ gèwèi le, wǒ dàibiǎo gōngsī biǎoshì gǎnxiè!
examples.example_translation: Thank you all for your hard work, I express my gratitude on behalf of the company!

meaning: v.使事物发生明显变化 · to change, alter

examples.example_chinese: 我们改变了原来的计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen gǎibiànle yuánlái de jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We changed the original plan.

examples.example_chinese: 他已经改变了对这个问题的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng gǎibiànle duì zhège wèntí de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: He has already changed his view on this issue.

examples.example_chinese: 谁也改变不了他的态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Shéi yě gǎibiàn bù liǎo tā de tàidu.
examples.example_translation: No one can change his attitude.

examples.example_chinese: 多年的习惯已经很难改变了。
examples.example_pinyin: Duō nián de xíguàn yǐjīng hěn nán gǎibiàn le.
examples.example_translation: Habits of many years are already hard to change.

examples.example_chinese: 开会的时间改变过两次了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kāihuì de shíjiān gǎibiàn guò liǎng cì le.
examples.example_translation: The meeting time has been changed twice.

meaning: v.思想感情受到影响而激动 · be moved by external events, be touched

examples.example_chinese: 她的经历感动了很多人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jīnglì gǎndòngle hěn duō rén.
examples.example_translation: Her experiences moved many people.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影深深感动了每一位观众。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shēnshēn gǎndòngle měi yí wèi guānzhòng.
examples.example_translation: This movie deeply touched every audience member.

examples.example_chinese: 大家为他唱生日歌的时候，他感动得哭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā wèi tā chàng shēngrìgē de shíhou, tā gǎndòng de kū le.
examples.example_translation: When everyone sang the birthday song for him, he was so moved that he cried.

examples.example_chinese: 同事们的关心让我非常感动。
examples.example_pinyin: Tóngshìmen de guānxīn ràng wǒ fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.example_translation: The care from my colleagues made me very touched.

examples.example_chinese: 看到这样的场面，我非常感动。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàndào zhèyàng de chǎngmiàn, wǒ fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.example_translation: Seeing such a scene, I was very moved.

meaning: v.喝完杯中的酒（用于劝别人喝酒或表示庆祝的场合） · cheers, bottoms up (used when urging somebody to drink, or for a special toast)

examples.example_chinese: 为我们的友谊，干杯！
examples.example_pinyin: Wèi wǒmen de yǒuyì, gānbēi!
examples.example_translation: To our friendship, cheers!

examples.example_chinese: 为了大家的健康，我们干杯！
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile dàjiā de jiànkāng, wǒmen gānbēi!
examples.example_translation: For everyone's health, cheers!

examples.example_chinese: 老师，我们一起干杯吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒmen yìqǐ gānbēi ba.
examples.example_translation: Teacher, let's drink a toast together.

examples.example_chinese: 我们俩干一杯吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ gàn yì bēi ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's have a drink together.

examples.example_chinese: 他们干过好几杯了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen gànguo hǎojǐ bēi le.
examples.example_translation: They have already had several drinks.

meaning: v.心里觉得，内心认为（语气较不肯定） · think, feel (used in an unassured tone)

examples.example_chinese: 我感觉他不是很喜欢我们。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué tā bú shì hěn xǐhuan wǒmen.
examples.example_translation: I feel like he doesn't really like us.

examples.example_chinese: 你感觉这件事能不能成功？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ gǎnjué zhè jiàn shìqíng néng bù néng chénggōng?
examples.example_translation: Do you think this matter can succeed?

examples.example_chinese: 我感觉他说的不一定是真的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué tā shuō de bù yídìng shì zhēn de.
examples.example_translation: I feel what he said may not be true.

examples.example_chinese: 大家都感觉到了问题的严重性。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā dōu gǎnjué dào le wèntí de yánzhòngxìng.
examples.example_translation: Everyone felt the seriousness of the problem.

examples.example_chinese: 他那种不礼貌的态度你一点儿没有感觉出来吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng bù lǐmào de tàidu nǐ yìdiǎnr méiyǒu gǎnjué chūlái ma?
examples.example_translation: Didn’t you notice his impolite attitude at all?

meaning: phr.从事劳动, 工作 · work, do manual labor

examples.example_chinese: 下班回家以后，他就不干活儿了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàbān huíjiā yǐhòu, tā jiù bù gàn huór le.
examples.example_translation: After coming home from work, he doesn't do any more work.

examples.example_chinese: 我们在农村的时候，常常一起下地干活儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zài nóngcūn de shíhou, chángcháng yīqǐ xiàdì gàn huór.
examples.example_translation: When we were in the countryside, we often worked in the fields together.

examples.example_chinese: 他经常帮我们干活儿，是个不错的小伙子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng bāng wǒmen gàn huór, shì gè búcuò de xiǎohuǒzi.
examples.example_translation: He often helps us with work, he is a good young man.

examples.example_chinese: 我干不了这活儿，没那么大力气。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gàn bù liǎo zhè huór, méi nàme dà lìqi.
examples.example_translation: I can't do this work, I don't have that much strength.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天干了不少活儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān gàn le bù shǎo huór.
examples.example_translation: He did quite a lot of work today.

meaning: v.用言语行动表示感激 · thank, express one’s gratitude through language or action

examples.example_chinese: 我很感谢他们的帮助。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn gǎnxiè tāmen de bāngzhù.
examples.example_translation: I am very grateful for their help.

examples.example_chinese: 我代表大家感谢经理的热情招待。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dàibiǎo dàjiā gǎnxiè jīnglǐ de rèqíng zhāodài.
examples.example_translation: On behalf of everyone, I thank the manager for the warm reception.

examples.example_chinese: 你们来看我，真是太感谢了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen lái kàn wǒ, zhēn shì tài gǎnxiè le.
examples.example_translation: Thank you so much for coming to see me.

examples.example_chinese: 对你们的支持，我表示感谢。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì nǐmen de zhīchí, wǒ biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
examples.example_translation: I express my thanks for your support.

examples.example_chinese: 这点儿小事，用不着感谢。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè diǎnr xiǎo shì, yòng bu zhāo gǎnxiè.
examples.example_translation: This little thing is not worth thanking for.

meaning: adj.睡得踏实 · (of sleep) sound

examples.example_chinese: 他昨晚睡得很香，打雷都没听见。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuówǎn shuì de hěn xiāng, dǎléi dōu méi tīngjiàn.
examples.example_translation: He slept so soundly last night that he didn't even hear the thunder.

examples.example_chinese: 刚才你睡得可真香啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Gāngcái nǐ shuì de kě zhēn xiāng a!
examples.example_translation: You were sleeping so soundly just now!

examples.example_chinese: 我睡得正香的时候，电话把我吵醒了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shuì de zhèng xiāng de shíhou, diànhuà bǎ wǒ chǎoxǐng le.
examples.example_translation: When I was sleeping soundly, the phone woke me up.

examples.example_chinese: 这几天，他吃不好，睡不香。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān, tā chī bù hǎo, shuì bù xiāng.
examples.example_translation: These days, he can't eat well or sleep soundly.

meaning: n.市区以外的可以通行各种车辆的宽阔平坦的道路 · trunk road, calzada, route, main road, highroad, highway, road, thoroughfare, causeway, chaussee

examples.example_chinese: 年轻的男女们把装在筐里的桃子一担担地挑到院子里、公路旁，在那里早已站满了前来购买桃子的顾客，到处是一片忙碌又欢乐的景象。

examples.example_translation: Young men and women carried baskets of peaches on shoulder poles to the courtyards and roadsides, where customers were already waiting to buy them; it was a busy and joyful scene everywhere.

examples.example_chinese: 这条公路连接两个城市,很宽阔。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù liánjiē liǎng gè chéngshì, hěn kuānkuò.
examples.example_translation: This highway connects two cities and is very wide.

examples.example_chinese: 公路两边种了很多树,空气很清新。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōnglù liǎng biān zhòng le hěn duō shù, kōngqì hěn qīngxīn.
examples.example_translation: Many trees are planted on both sides of the road, and the air is very fresh.

examples.example_chinese: 年轻的男女们把装在筐里的桃子一担担地挑到院子里、公路旁，在那里早已站满了前来购买桃子的顾客，到处是一片忙碌又欢乐的景象。

examples.example_chinese: 年轻的男女们把装在筐里的桃子一担担地挑到院子里、公路旁，在那里早已站满了前来购买桃子的顾客，到处是一片忙碌又欢乐的景象。
