meaning: cl.千米 · kilometer

examples.example_chinese: 我家离学校有20公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào yǒu èrshí gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: My home is 20 kilometers from the school.

examples.example_chinese: 在高速路上，我们一个小时开100公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài gāosùlù shàng, wǒmen yí ge xiǎoshí kāi yìbǎi gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: On the highway, we drive 100 kilometers in one hour.

examples.example_chinese: 他每天跑五公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān pǎo wǔ gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: He runs five kilometers every day.

examples.example_chinese: 从这里到火车站有多少公里？
examples.example_pinyin: Cóng zhèli dào huǒchēzhàn yǒu duōshao gōnglǐ?
examples.example_translation: How many kilometers is it from here to the train station?

examples.example_chinese: 机场离市区大约40公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīchǎng lí shìqū dàyuē sìshí gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: The airport is about 40 kilometers from downtown.

meaning: v.数量上可以满足 · enough, sufficient

examples.example_chinese: 不用太多人，来三个人就够了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùyòng tài duō rén, lái sān ge jiù gòu le.
examples.example_translation: We don’t need too many people, three will be enough.

examples.example_chinese: 你带1000块钱肯定够。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dài yìqiān kuài qián kěndìng gòu.
examples.example_translation: If you bring 1000 yuan, it will definitely be enough.

examples.example_chinese: 我们买十瓶啤酒够不够？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi shí píng píjiǔ gòu bu gòu?
examples.example_translation: Is it enough if we buy ten bottles of beer?

examples.example_chinese: 时间不够了，你快点儿吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Shíjiān bú gòu le, nǐ kuài diǎnr ba.
examples.example_translation: There’s not enough time, hurry up.

examples.example_chinese: 这位外国朋友问我这是不是国内各地普遍的风俗，我告诉他我走过十几省还不曾遇见过这样的场面，而且当场若无壁板设备，或是顾客嘴部筋肉不够发达，此种盛况即不易发生。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè wèi wài guó péng you wèn wǒ zhè shì bù shì nèi gè de pǔbiàn de fēngsú wǒ gàosu tā wǒ zǒu guo shí jǐ shěng huán bù céng yù jian guo zhè yàng de chǎng miàn érqiě dāng chǎng ruò wú bǎn shèbèi huò shì gùkè zuǐ bù jīn ròu bù gòu fā cǐ zhòng chéng jí bù fāshēng

meaning: adv.有意识地（那样做） · consciously, intentionally, on purpose

examples.example_chinese: 他故意碰了我一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gùyì pèngle wǒ yíxià.
examples.example_translation: He bumped into me on purpose.

examples.example_chinese: 他故意站在那里，不让别人过去。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gùyì zhàn zài nàli, bù ràng biérén guòqù.
examples.example_translation: He stood there on purpose, not letting others pass.

examples.example_chinese: 他故意不给我开门。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gùyì bù gěi wǒ kāi mén.
examples.example_translation: He intentionally didn’t open the door for me.

examples.example_chinese: 他总是故意惹我生气。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒngshì gùyì rě wǒ shēngqì.
examples.example_translation: He always tries to make me angry on purpose.

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，我不是故意的。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú shì gùyì de.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, I didn’t do it on purpose.

examples.example_chinese: 谁知道他是不是故意这么做的？
examples.example_pinyin: Shéi zhīdào tā shì bú shì gùyì zhème zuò de?
examples.example_translation: Who knows if he did it on purpose?

meaning: n.来买东西或要求服务的人 · customer, shopper, client

examples.example_chinese: 商店的生意很好，顾客非常多。
examples.example_pinyin: Shāngdiàn de shēngyi hěn hǎo, gùkè fēicháng duō.
examples.example_translation: The store is doing very well, and there are many customers.

examples.example_chinese: 让顾客满意，是我们服务的宗旨。
examples.example_pinyin: Ràng gùkè mǎnyì, shì wǒmen fúwù de zōngzhǐ.
examples.example_translation: Making customers satisfied is the aim of our service.

examples.example_chinese: 顾客就是我们的上帝。
examples.example_pinyin: Gùkè jiù shì wǒmen de Shàngdì.
examples.example_translation: The customer is our God.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要照顾好每一位顾客。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhàogù hǎo měi yí wèi gùkè.
examples.example_translation: We must take good care of every customer.

examples.example_chinese: 对于顾客提出的意见，一定要认真对待。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú gùkè tíchū de yìjiàn, yídìng yào rènzhēn duìdài.
examples.example_translation: We must take customers’ suggestions seriously.

meaning: adj.最关键的 · the most crucial

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章里，有一句话最关键。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng lǐ, yǒu yí jù huà zuì guānjiàn.
examples.example_translation: In this article, there is one sentence that is the most crucial.

examples.example_chinese: 这个进球很关键，帮助我们赢了三分。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège jìnqiú hěn guānjiàn, bāngzhù wǒmen yíngle sān fēn.
examples.example_translation: This goal was crucial, it helped us win three points.

examples.example_chinese: 现在是关键时刻，大家一定要坚持。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài shì guānjiàn shíkè, dàjiā yídìng yào jiānchí.
examples.example_translation: Now is the crucial moment, everyone must persevere.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经解决了技术上的关键问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng jiějuéle jìshù shàng de guānjiàn wèntí.
examples.example_translation: We have already solved the key technical problem.

meaning: n.一种向公众介绍商品、节目等的宣传方式 · advertisement

examples.example_chinese: 这个广告设计得很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào shèjì de hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This advertisement is well designed.

examples.example_chinese: 这个电影明星经常拍广告。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng míngxīng jīngcháng pāi guǎnggào.
examples.example_translation: This movie star often shoots advertisements.

examples.example_chinese: 报纸上的广告太多了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng de guǎnggào tài duō le.
examples.example_translation: There are too many advertisements in the newspaper.

examples.example_chinese: 我们准备做个广告，推销这个产品。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi zuò ge guǎnggào, tuīxiāo zhège chǎnpǐn.
examples.example_translation: We are preparing to make an advertisement to promote this product.

examples.example_chinese: 我弟弟在一家广告公司工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dìdi zài yì jiā guǎnggào gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: My younger brother works at an advertising company.

examples.example_chinese: 现代社会，广告已无处不在。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì, guǎnggào yǐ wú chù bù zài.
examples.example_translation: In modern society, advertisements are everywhere.

meaning: v.意思上针对 · refer to

examples.example_chinese: 我说你不符合条件，是指你年龄还太小。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shuō nǐ bù fúhé tiáojiàn, shì zhǐ nǐ niánlíng hái tài xiǎo.
examples.example_translation: When I said you don't meet the requirements, I meant your age is still too young.

examples.example_chinese: 我指的是昨天那件事，不是今天的事。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ de shì zuótiān nà jiàn shì, bù shì jīntiān de shì.
examples.example_translation: I was referring to what happened yesterday, not today.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天的话不是指着你们说的，你们别在意。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān de huà bù shì zhǐzhe nǐmen shuō de, nǐmen bié zàiyì.
examples.example_translation: What he said today was not directed at you, don't mind it.

examples.example_chinese: 他的意见已经指得很明白了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de yìjiàn yǐjīng zhǐ de hěn míngbai le.
examples.example_translation: His opinion has already been made very clear.

meaning: adj.国与国之间, 世界各国之间 · international

examples.example_chinese: 这次国际会议影响很大。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì guójì huìyì yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: This international conference has a great impact.

examples.example_chinese: 本着互相尊重的原则，处理国际事务。
examples.example_pinyin: Běnzhe hùxiāng zūnzhòng de yuánzé, chǔlǐ guójì shìwù.
examples.example_translation: Handle international affairs based on the principle of mutual respect.

examples.example_chinese: 国家的国际地位在日益提高。
examples.example_pinyin: Guójiā de guójì dìwèi zài rìyì tígāo.
examples.example_translation: The country's international status is rising day by day.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一场具有国际影响的活动。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yí cì jùyǒu guójì yǐngxiǎng de huódòng.
examples.example_translation: This is an event with international influence.

examples.example_chinese: 在一些国际问题上，他们发挥了重要作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài yìxiē guójì wèntí shang, tāmen fāhuīle zhòngyào zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: They played an important role in some international issues.

meaning: v. 大声叫 shout, cry out, yell; 叫（人） call (sb.)

examples.example_chinese: 他疼得喊了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: tā téng de hǎn le qǐlái。
examples.example_translation: He cried out in pain.

examples.example_chinese: 他大喊一声：“不许动！”
examples.example_pinyin: tā dà hǎn yī shēng: “bù xǔ dòng!”
examples.example_translation: He shouted loudly: "Don't move!"

examples.example_chinese: 因为太远，他们只能大声喊。
examples.example_pinyin: yīnwèi tài yuǎn, tāmen zhǐ néng dà shēng hǎn。
examples.example_translation: Because it was too far, they could only shout loudly.

examples.example_chinese: 我听到有人喊“救命”，就跑了过去。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ tīngdào yǒurén hǎn “jiùmìng”, jiù pǎo le guòqù。
examples.example_translation: I heard someone shout "Help!" and ran over.

examples.example_chinese: 无论我怎么喊，也没人答应。
examples.example_pinyin: wúlùn wǒ zěnme hǎn, yě méi rén dāyìng。
examples.example_translation: No matter how loudly I shouted, no one responded.

examples.example_chinese: 有人在楼下喊你。
examples.example_pinyin: yǒurén zài lóu xià hǎn nǐ。
examples.example_translation: Someone is calling you downstairs.

examples.example_chinese: 老师喊你过去一下。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī hǎn nǐ guòqù yīxià。
examples.example_translation: The teacher is calling you over.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈喊孩子回家吃饭。
examples.example_pinyin: māmā hǎn háizi huí jiā chīfàn。
examples.example_translation: Mom calls the children home for dinner.

examples.example_chinese: 你喊一下老王，叫他到办公室来。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ hǎn yīxià lǎo wáng, jiào tā dào bàngōngshì lái。
examples.example_translation: Call Lao Wang and ask him to come to the office.

meaning: n.对人或事物好的、有利的因素 · good, benefit, advantage

examples.example_chinese: 骑自行车的好处很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Qí zìxíngchē de hǎochu hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: There are many benefits to riding a bicycle.

examples.example_chinese: 经常运动，对你的身体有好处。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngcháng yùndòng duì nǐ de shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.
examples.example_translation: Exercising regularly is good for your health.

examples.example_chinese: 吸烟对健康没有任何好处。
examples.example_pinyin: Xī yān duì jiànkāng méiyǒu rènhé hǎochu.
examples.example_translation: Smoking has no benefits for health.

examples.example_chinese: 我会永远记着他们的好处。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huì yǒngyuǎn jìzhe tāmen de hǎochu.
examples.example_translation: I will always remember their kindness.

examples.example_chinese: 愿我们都能保持好处
examples.example_pinyin: yuàn wǒ men dōu néng bǎochí hǎo chu

meaning: adv.恰好, 刚巧 · happen to, just right

examples.example_chinese: 那年我来北京时正好赶上国庆节。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà nián wǒ lái Běijīng shí zhènghǎo gǎnshàng Guóqìng Jié.
examples.example_translation: That year when I came to Beijing, it happened to be National Day.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚出门，正好开过来一辆出租车。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāng chūmén, zhènghǎo kāi guòlai yì liàng chūzūchē.
examples.example_translation: I had just gone out when a taxi happened to drive by.

examples.example_chinese: 说实话，这件事跟我想的正好相反。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuō shí huà, zhè jiàn shì gēn wǒ xiǎng de zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.example_translation: To be honest, this matter is exactly the opposite of what I thought.

examples.example_chinese: 在公园里正好遇上了老同学，就聊了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài gōngyuán lǐ zhènghǎo yùshàng le lǎo tóngxué, jiù liáo qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: I happened to meet an old classmate in the park, so we started chatting.

examples.example_chinese: 轻轻地推门进去，什么声息也没有，妻已睡熟好久了。
examples.example_pinyin: qīng qīng de tuī mén jìn qù shēng xī yě méi yǒu yǐ shuì shú hǎojiǔ le

meaning: adv.表示情况来得迅速又出乎意料，突然 · suddenly, all of a sudden

examples.example_chinese: 刚才还是晴天，现在忽然下起雨来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Gāngcái háishi qíngtiān, xiànzài hūrán xiàqǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.example_translation: It was sunny just now, but suddenly it started to rain.

examples.example_chinese: 他说着说着忽然笑了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuōzhe shuōzhe hūrán xiàole qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: As he was talking, he suddenly started to laugh.

examples.example_chinese: 看到这个情景，我忽然想起了小时候的一件事。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàndào zhège qíngjǐng, wǒ hūrán xiǎngqǐle xiǎoshíhou de yí jiàn shì.
examples.example_translation: Seeing this scene, I suddenly remembered something from my childhood.

examples.example_chinese: 我正要睡觉的时候，忽然电话响了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào shuìjiào de shíhou, hūrán diànhuà xiǎng le.
examples.example_translation: Just as I was about to sleep, the phone suddenly rang.

examples.example_chinese: 他忽然大叫一声，吓了我一跳。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hūrán dà jiào yì shēng, xiàle wǒ yí tiào.
examples.example_translation: He suddenly shouted loudly, which startled me.

meaning: n.有可能遭到的损失或失败 · danger

examples.example_chinese: 万一发生了危险，你们也不要害怕。
examples.example_pinyin: Wànyī fāshēngle wēixiǎn, nǐmen yě bùyào hàipà.
examples.example_translation: If danger occurs, don't be afraid.

examples.example_chinese: 哪里有危险，他就出现在那里。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǎlǐ yǒu wēixiǎn, tā jiù chūxiàn zài nàlǐ.
examples.example_translation: Wherever there is danger, he appears there.

examples.example_chinese: 任何困难和危险都吓不倒我们。
examples.example_pinyin: Rènhé kùnnan hé wēixiǎn dōu xià bù dǎo wǒmen.
examples.example_translation: No difficulty or danger can scare us.

examples.example_chinese: 这里随时有可能出现危险。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ suíshí yǒu kěnéng chūxiàn wēixiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Danger may appear here at any time.

examples.example_chinese: 他冒着生命危险，把孩子救了上来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā màozhe shēngmìng wēixiǎn, bǎ háizi jiùle shànglái.
examples.example_translation: He risked his life to save the child.

meaning: interj.表示疑问 · hmm?

examples.example_chinese: 嗯？他是哪国人？
examples.example_pinyin: ńg? tā shì nǎ guórén?
examples.example_translation: Hmm? What is his nationality?

examples.example_chinese: 嗯？他刚才说什么？
examples.example_pinyin: ńg? tā gāngcái shuō shénme?
examples.example_translation: Hmm? What did he just say?

examples.example_chinese: 嗯？这是为什么？
examples.example_pinyin: ńg? zhè shì wèishéme?
examples.example_translation: Hmm? Why is that?

meaning: n.用在数目后表示概数 · about, around

examples.example_chinese: 他大概三十岁左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā dàgài sānshí suì zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: He is about thirty years old.

examples.example_chinese: 我们等了半个小时左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen děngle bàn ge xiǎoshí zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: We waited for about half an hour.

examples.example_chinese: 从这里到车站需要十分钟左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào chēzhàn xūyào shí fēnzhōng zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: It takes about ten minutes to get to the station from here.

examples.example_chinese: 他 50 岁左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wǔshí suì zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: He is about 50 years old.

examples.example_chinese: 他身高一米七左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shēngāo yī mǐ qī zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: He is about 1.7 meters tall.

examples.example_chinese: 这项任务要两天左右才能完成。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè xiàng rènwù yào liǎng tiān zuǒyòu cáinéng wánchéng.
examples.example_translation: This task will take about two days to complete.

examples.example_chinese: 这个班的学生在 30 名左右。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège bān de xuéshēng zài sānshí míng zuǒyòu.
examples.example_translation: There are about 30 students in this class.

meaning: n.指聚在一起的活动 · party

examples.example_chinese: 今天晚上的聚会你一定要来。
examples.example_pinyin: jīntiān wǎnshàng de jùhuì nǐ yīdìng yào lái.
examples.example_translation: You must come to tonight's party.

examples.example_chinese: 我们该搞一次聚会了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen gāi gǎo yī cì jùhuì le.
examples.example_translation: We should have a party.

examples.example_chinese: 上次聚会我记得是一年前。
examples.example_pinyin: shàng cì jùhuì wǒ jìde shì yī nián qián.
examples.example_translation: I remember the last party was a year ago.

examples.example_chinese: 等聚会的时候，我再拿出这些相片来。
examples.example_pinyin: děng jùhuì de shíhòu, wǒ zài ná chū zhèxiē xiàngpiàn lái.
examples.example_translation: When it's time for the party, I'll take out these photos.

meaning: v.（人或物体）运动 · (of limbs) move about, exercise

examples.example_chinese: 老人们每天都在操场活动。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎorénmen měi tiān dōu zài cāochǎng huódòng.
examples.example_translation: The elderly exercise on the playground every day.

examples.example_chinese: 别学习了，我们出去活动一下吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié xuéxí le, wǒmen chūqù huódòng yíxià ba.
examples.example_translation: Stop studying, let's go out and move around a bit.

examples.example_chinese: 坐累了，你可以站起来活动活动腰。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuò lèi le, nǐ kěyǐ zhàn qǐlai huódòng huódòng yāo.
examples.example_translation: If you're tired of sitting, you can stand up and stretch your waist.

examples.example_chinese: 他的脚受伤了，活动不了了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jiǎo shòushāng le, huódòng bù liǎo le.
examples.example_translation: His foot is injured, so he can't move about.

examples.example_chinese: 要想保持身体健康，就要经常活动。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào xiǎng bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng, jiù yào jīngcháng huódòng.
examples.example_translation: To stay healthy, you need to exercise regularly.

meaning: interj.表示没有想到 · indicates surprise

examples.example_chinese: 嗯！你怎么来了？
examples.example_pinyin: ňg! nǐ zěnme láile?
examples.example_translation: Huh! What are you doing here?

examples.example_chinese: 嗯！没那么严重吧？
examples.example_pinyin: ňg! méi nàme yánzhòng ba?
examples.example_translation: Huh! It's not that serious, is it?

examples.example_chinese: 嗯！怎么回事？
examples.example_pinyin: ňg! zěnme huí shì?
examples.example_translation: Huh! What's going on?

meaning: n.工作或行动以前拟定的内容和步骤 · plan, program or scheme for making, doing, arranging something

examples.example_chinese: 这是我们明年的工作计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen míngnián de gōngzuò jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: This is our work plan for next year.

examples.example_chinese: 能说说你的旅行计划吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Néng shuōshuo nǐ de lǚxíng jìhuà ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you talk about your travel plan?

examples.example_chinese: 我在写一个产品推广的计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài xiě yí ge chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng de jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: I am writing a plan for product promotion.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经提前完成了计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng tíqián wánchéngle jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We have completed the plan ahead of schedule.

examples.example_chinese: 这个计划还有很多需要完善的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hái yǒu hěn duō xūyào wánshàn de dìfang.
examples.example_translation: This plan still has many areas that need improvement.

meaning: interj.表示答应或同意 · indicates agreement or consent

examples.example_chinese: A：回来啦？ B：嗯，回来了。
examples.example_pinyin: A: huílái la? B: ǹg, huíláile.
examples.example_translation: A: You're back? B: Uh-huh, I'm back.

examples.example_chinese: 嗯，我马上就来。
examples.example_pinyin: ǹg, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.example_translation: Okay, I'll be right there.

examples.example_chinese: A：好吃吗？ B：嗯，非常好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: A: hǎochī ma? B: ǹg, fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: A: Is it delicious? B: Yeah, it's very delicious.

examples.example_chinese: 嗯,奴才大胆。
examples.example_pinyin: ǹg nú cái dàdǎn

examples.example_chinese: 嗯,先甭着急,我给你记一下这笔账。
examples.example_pinyin: ǹg xiān béng zháo jí wǒ gěi nǐ jì yī xià zhè bǐ zhàng

meaning: n.以婚姻和血统关系为基础的社会单位 · family, household

examples.example_chinese: 我的家庭一共有五口人。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de jiātíng yígòng yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
examples.example_translation: There are five people in my family.

examples.example_chinese: 他结婚后，建立了自己的小家庭。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiéhūn hòu, jiànlì le zìjǐ de xiǎo jiātíng.
examples.example_translation: After getting married, he established his own small family.

examples.example_chinese: 我生活在一个大家庭里。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shēnghuó zài yí gè dà jiātíng lǐ.
examples.example_translation: I live in a big family.

examples.example_chinese: 家庭成员之间关系很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiātíng chéngyuán zhījiān guānxì hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: The relationships among family members are very good.

examples.example_chinese: 这个电视剧演的是一些家庭矛盾。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège diànshìjù yǎn de shì yìxiē jiātíng máodùn.
examples.example_translation: This TV drama is about some family conflicts.

meaning: adj.虚伪的, 不真实的（跟“真”相对） · false, fake (as opposed to "true")

examples.example_chinese: 这些花儿都是假的，是用塑料做的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē huār dōu shì jiǎ de, shì yòng sùliào zuò de.
examples.example_translation: These flowers are fake, they are made of plastic.

examples.example_chinese: 警察发现他用的是假护照。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐngchá fāxiàn tā yòng de shì jiǎ hùzhào.
examples.example_translation: The police found that he was using a fake passport.

examples.example_chinese: 请相信我，我从来不说假话。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng xiāngxìn wǒ, wǒ cónglái bù shuō jiǎ huà.
examples.example_translation: Please believe me, I never tell lies.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一条假的金项链。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì tiáo jiǎ de jīn xiàngliàn.
examples.example_translation: This is a fake gold necklace.

examples.example_chinese: 你放心，大商场不会卖假货。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, dà shāngchǎng bú huì mài jiǎ huò.
examples.example_translation: Don't worry, big shopping malls won't sell fake goods.

meaning: adj.感觉微痛而无力的 · tingle, ache

examples.example_chinese: 我坐的时间太长了，腰都酸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuò de shíjiān tài cháng le, yāo dōu suān le.
examples.example_translation: I've been sitting too long, my waist aches.

examples.example_chinese: 看书时间太长了，眼睛很酸。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn shū shíjiān tài cháng le, yǎnjīng hěn suān.
examples.example_translation: Reading for too long makes my eyes ache.

examples.example_chinese: 我胳膊酸得受不了了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bāzi suān de shòubuliǎo le.
examples.example_translation: My arm aches so much I can't stand it.

examples.example_chinese: 我胳膊感觉有点儿酸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gēbo gǎnjué yǒudiǎnr suān le.
examples.example_translation: My arm feels a bit sore.

examples.example_chinese: 他怎么还不来？我腿都站酸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zěnme hái bù lái? Wǒ tuǐ dōu zhànsuān le.
examples.example_translation: Why hasn't he come yet? My legs are sore from standing.

meaning: v.把某事或某物转移给有关方面 · hand over something to somebody, deliver, hand in

examples.example_chinese: 把钱交给我就行了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǎ qián jiāogěi wǒ jiù xíng le.
examples.example_translation: Just hand the money to me.

examples.example_chinese: 下周开学又要交学费了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xià zhōu kāixué yòu yào jiāo xuéfèi le.
examples.example_translation: School starts next week, and we have to pay the tuition again.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事情交给你去办，我很放心。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing jiāogěi nǐ qù bàn, wǒ hěn fàngxīn.
examples.example_translation: I feel at ease leaving this matter to you.

meaning: n.各种运输事业的总称，也指行人和车辆的往来等 · a general term for transportation and postal services

examples.example_chinese: 这里交通发达，经济繁荣。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli jiāotōng fādá, jīngjì fánróng.
examples.example_translation: Transportation is well developed here, and the economy is prosperous.

examples.example_chinese: 这些年，城市交通问题越来越突出。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē nián, chéngshì jiāotōng wèntí yuè lái yuè túchū.
examples.example_translation: In recent years, urban transportation problems have become increasingly prominent.

examples.example_chinese: 这里离火车站很近，交通很方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli lí huǒchēzhàn hěn jìn, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: It's close to the train station here, and transportation is very convenient.

examples.example_chinese: 昨天这儿发生了一起交通事故。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān zhèr fāshēngle yì qǐ jiāotōng shìgù.
examples.example_translation: There was a traffic accident here yesterday.

examples.example_chinese: 这些车停在这里，阻碍了交通。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē chē tíng zài zhèlǐ, zǔ ài le jiāotōng.
examples.example_translation: These cars parked here are blocking the traffic.

meaning: n.租用所付或出租所得的金钱或实物 · rent

examples.example_chinese: 这里的房租很贵。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli de fángzū hěn guì.
examples.example_translation: The rent here is very expensive.

examples.example_chinese: 这辆车每月租三千。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liàng chē měi yuè zū sānqiān.
examples.example_translation: This car rents for three thousand a month.

examples.example_chinese: 这些书的日租价格是每天三毛钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē shū de rì zū jiàgé shì měi tiān sān máo qián.
examples.example_translation: The daily rental price of these books is thirty cents per day.

meaning: conj.表示并列关系,常含有进一层的意味 · moreover, besides, furthermore

examples.example_chinese: 他是个好丈夫，同时也是个好爸爸。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shì ge hǎo zhàngfu, tóngshí yěshì ge hǎo bàba.
examples.example_translation: He is a good husband, and moreover, he is also a good father.

examples.example_chinese: 学习汉语不但能了解中国，同时还能交很多中国朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéxí hànyǔ bùdàn néng liǎojiě Zhōngguó, tóngshí hái néng jiāo hěn duō Zhōngguó péngyou.
examples.example_translation: Learning Chinese not only helps understand China, but also enables making many Chinese friends.

examples.example_chinese: 这不仅是一项艰巨的任务，同时也是一项光荣的任务。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè bùjǐn shì yī xiàng jiānjù de rènwu, tóngshí yěshì yī xiàng guāngróng de rènwu.
examples.example_translation: This is not only a difficult task, but also a glorious one.

examples.example_chinese: 他是教授，同时还是一个画家。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shì jiàoshòu, tóngshí hái shì yī ge huàjiā.
examples.example_translation: He is a professor, and moreover, he is also a painter.

meaning: n.主要指学校培养人的工作 · education, schooling

examples.example_chinese: 父亲在教育行业工作了30年。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùqīn zài jiàoyù hángyè gōngzuòle sānshí nián.
examples.example_translation: My father has worked in the education industry for 30 years.

examples.example_chinese: 他受过良好的高等教育。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shòuguo liánghǎo de gāoděng jiàoyù.
examples.example_translation: He has received a good higher education.

examples.example_chinese: 国家的发展主要依靠教育。
examples.example_pinyin: Guójiā de fāzhǎn zhǔyào yīkào jiàoyù.
examples.example_translation: The development of a country mainly depends on education.

examples.example_chinese: 这些年，各级政府都增加了教育投资。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē nián, gè jí zhèngfǔ dōu zēngjiāle jiàoyù tóuzī.
examples.example_translation: In recent years, governments at all levels have increased investment in education.

examples.example_chinese: 我们主张学校教育和家庭教育要结合起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔzhāng xuéxiào jiàoyù hé jiātíng jiàoyù yào jiéhé qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: We advocate combining school education with family education.

meaning: v.收取, 对事物不拒绝 · accept, take on, undertake

examples.example_chinese: 他接受了我们的礼物。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiēshòule wǒmen de lǐwù.
examples.example_translation: He accepted our gift.

examples.example_chinese: 他最近接受了一个重要任务。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuìjìn jiēshòule yí ge zhòngyào rènwu.
examples.example_translation: He recently took on an important task.

examples.example_chinese: 我接受大家的批评。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiēshòu dàjiā de pīpíng.
examples.example_translation: I accept everyone's criticism.

examples.example_chinese: 我们请他做个讲座，他愉快地接受了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen qǐng tā zuò ge jiǎngzuò, tā yúkuài de jiēshòu le.
examples.example_translation: We invited him to give a lecture, and he gladly accepted.

examples.example_chinese: 你的意见和看法我很难接受。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de yìjiàn hé kànfǎ wǒ hěn nán jiēshòu.
examples.example_translation: I find it hard to accept your opinions and views.

meaning: v.连着（上面的话）, 紧跟着（前面的动作） · follow (a speech, action), carry on

examples.example_chinese: 我洗完澡，接着就睡觉了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐ wán zǎo, jiēzhe jiù shuìjiào le.
examples.example_translation: After I took a shower, I went to sleep right after.

examples.example_chinese: 他看了我一下，接着就笑了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kàn le wǒ yīxià, jiēzhe jiù xiào le.
examples.example_translation: He glanced at me and then immediately laughed.

examples.example_chinese: 我们先到楼下休息一下，接着一起去吃饭。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xiān dào lóuxià xiūxi yīxià, jiēzhe yīqǐ qù chīfàn.
examples.example_translation: We first went downstairs to rest for a while, and then went to eat together.

examples.example_chinese: 一阵风过后，接着就下起雨来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yī zhèn fēng guòhòu, jiēzhe jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.example_translation: After a gust of wind, it started to rain right after.

examples.example_chinese: 接着往下观阵。
examples.example_pinyin: jiē zhe wǎng xià guān zhèn

meaning: n.事物发展所达到的最后状态 · result, outcome of development

examples.example_chinese: 他还不知道考试结果。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hái bù zhīdào kǎoshì jiéguǒ.
examples.example_translation: He still doesn't know the exam result.

examples.example_chinese: 他们正在商量这个问题，还没有结果。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài shāngliang zhège wèntí, hái méiyǒu jiéguǒ.
examples.example_translation: They are still discussing this issue, and there is no result yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他能得到第一名是长期努力的结果。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā néng dédào dì-yī míng shì chángqī nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
examples.example_translation: Getting first place is the result of his long-term effort.

examples.example_chinese: 我们调查的结果是，他没有错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen diàochá de jiéguǒ shì, tā méiyǒu cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: The result of our investigation is that he made no mistake.

examples.example_chinese: 教练对比赛的结果感到很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoliàn duì bǐsài de jiéguǒ gǎndào hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: The coach is very satisfied with the result of the match.

meaning: adj.对自己充满信心的 · self-confident

examples.example_chinese: 这是一位自信的小伙子,我们再鼓励鼓励他。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè shì yī wèi zìxìn de xiǎohuǒzi, wǒmen zài gǔlì gǔlì tā.
examples.example_translation: This is a self-confident young man, let's encourage him more.

examples.example_chinese: 能否成功,他非常自信。
examples.example_pinyin: néngfǒu chénggōng, tā fēicháng zìxìn.
examples.example_translation: Whether he can succeed, he is very confident.

examples.example_chinese: 我觉得你过于自信了,万一出现问题怎么办?
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ juéde nǐ guòyú zìxìn le, wànyī chūxiàn wèntí zěnme bàn?
examples.example_translation: I think you are too self-confident, what if problems arise?

examples.example_chinese: 她自信地微笑着,仿佛一切尽在掌握之中。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zìxìn de wēixiàozhe, fǎngfú yīqiè jìn zài zhǎngwò zhī zhōng.
examples.example_translation: She smiled confidently, as if everything was under control.

examples.example_chinese: 她眼睛里充满自信的目光,从容地走向赛场。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yǎnjīng lǐ chōngmǎn zìxìn de mùguāng, cóngróng de zǒuxiàng sàichǎng.
examples.example_translation: Her eyes were full of confident gaze, and she walked calmly towards the arena.

meaning: adj.程度深 · deep, serious

examples.example_chinese: 病得太重了,得住院治疗。
examples.example_pinyin: bìng de tài zhòng le, děi zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
examples.example_translation: He is too seriously ill, he needs to be hospitalized for treatment.

examples.example_chinese: 这份礼物太重了,我不能收。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè fèn lǐwù tài zhòng le, wǒ bùnéng shōu.
examples.example_translation: This gift is too significant, I cannot accept it.

examples.example_chinese: 对于帮助过我的人,我要重重感谢。
examples.example_pinyin: duìyú bāngzhù guò wǒ de rén, wǒ yào zhòngzhòng gǎnxiè.
examples.example_translation: For those who have helped me, I want to express my profound gratitude.

examples.example_chinese: 对孩子的批评应该避免过重。
examples.example_pinyin: duì háizi de pīpíng yīnggāi bìmiǎn guòzhòng.
examples.example_translation: Criticism of children should avoid being too harsh.

examples.example_chinese: 他从马上摔了下来,伤得很重。
examples.example_pinyin: tā cóng mǎshàng shuāi le xiàlái, shāng de hěn zhòng.
examples.example_translation: He fell off the horse and was seriously injured.

meaning: v.开始并一直做（某种活动、工作等） · carry out, execute, conduct

examples.example_chinese: 比赛正在进行，结果很难预料。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài zhèngzài jìnxíng, jiéguǒ hěn nán yùliào.
examples.example_translation: The competition is in progress, and the result is hard to predict.

examples.example_chinese: 这次谈判进行得很顺利。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn jìnxíng de hěn shùnlì.
examples.example_translation: This negotiation went very smoothly.

examples.example_chinese: 我对这种现象进行了研究，发现了一些规律。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng jìnxíngle yánjiū, fāxiànle yìxiē guīlǜ.
examples.example_translation: I conducted research on this phenomenon and discovered some patterns.

examples.example_chinese: 关于这个问题，我们进行过几次讨论。
examples.example_pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒmen jìnxíngguo jǐ cì tǎolùn.
examples.example_translation: We have had several discussions about this issue.

examples.example_chinese: 我们进行了比较，发现了它们的相同点。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jìnxíngle bǐjiào, fāxiànle tāmen de xiāngtóngdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: We made a comparison and found their similarities.

meaning: v.把东西供别人使用并收费, 出租 · rent out, let out

examples.example_chinese: 这房子暂时用不着，我想租出去。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fángzi zhànshí yòng bu zháo, wǒ xiǎng zū chūqù.
examples.example_translation: I don't need this house for now, so I want to rent it out.

examples.example_chinese: 节日的时候来租车的人多，汽车租赁公司就没车租了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiérì de shíhou lái zū chē de rén duō, qìchē zūlìn gōngsī jiù méi chē zū le.
examples.example_translation: During holidays, many people come to rent cars, so the car rental company runs out of cars.

examples.example_chinese: 您这房子一个月打算租多少钱？
examples.example_pinyin: Nín zhè fángzi yí ge yuè dǎsuàn zū duōshao qián?
examples.example_translation: How much do you plan to rent this house for per month?

meaning: v.进行（集会、比赛等） · hold (a meeting, ceremony, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 游泳比赛明天举行。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóuyǒng bǐsài míngtiān jǔxíng.
examples.example_translation: The swimming race will be held tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 我打算举行一个生日晚会。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn jǔxíng yí ge shēngrì wǎnhuì.
examples.example_translation: I’m going to have a birthday party in the evening.

examples.example_chinese: 我们学校已经多次举行过这种会议了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǐjīng duō cì jǔxíngguo zhè zhǒng huìyì le.
examples.example_translation: Conferences like this have been held many times at our school.

examples.example_chinese: 他们的婚礼什么时候举行？
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen de hūnlǐ shénme shíhou jǔxíng?
examples.example_translation: When will their wedding ceremony be held?

examples.example_chinese: 因为下雨，运动会可能举行不了了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, yùndònghuì kěnéng jǔxíng bù liǎo le.
examples.example_translation: The sports meeting may not be held because of the rain.

examples.example_chinese: 这次运动会要举行十四天。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì yùndònghuì yào jǔxíng shísì tiān.
examples.example_translation: The sports meeting will last 14 days.

meaning: v.往上托, 往上伸 · lift, raise, hold up

examples.example_chinese: 他把孩子举起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ háizi jǔ qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: He lifted the child.

examples.example_chinese: 他力气很大，能举起这块石头。
examples.example_pinyin: tā lìqi hěn dà, néng jǔ qǐ zhè kuài shítou.
examples.example_translation: He is very strong and can lift this rock.

examples.example_chinese: 他把手举得很高，等着被提问。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ shǒu jǔ dé hěn gāo, děngzhe bèi tíwèn.
examples.example_translation: He raised his hand very high, waiting to be asked a question.

examples.example_chinese: 他举起帽子，向远处挥动着。
examples.example_pinyin: tā jǔ qǐ màozi, xiàng yuǎnchù huīdòngzhe.
examples.example_translation: He raised his hat and waved it into the distance.

examples.example_chinese: 我们一起举杯，庆祝成功。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen yīqǐ jǔ bēi, qìngzhù chénggōng.
examples.example_translation: We raised our glasses together to celebrate success.

meaning: adj.正赶上时候，适合需要 · timely, in time

examples.example_chinese: 你来得很及时，我们正找你呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ lái de hěn jíshí, wǒmen zhèng zhǎo nǐ ne.
examples.example_translation: You came just in time, we were looking for you.

examples.example_chinese: 这场雨下得太及时了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ xià de tài jíshí le.
examples.example_translation: This rain came just in time.

examples.example_chinese: 于是又记起《西洲曲》里的句子：
examples.example_pinyin: yú shì yòu jì qǐ xī qū lǐ de jù

examples.example_chinese: 于是又记起《西洲曲》里的句子：
examples.example_pinyin: yú shì yòu jì qǐ xī qū lǐ de jù

examples.example_chinese: 于是又记起《西洲曲》里的句子：
examples.example_pinyin: yú shì yòu jì qǐ xī qū lǐ de jù

meaning: n.对人或事情的观点 · point of view

examples.example_chinese: 请大家谈谈对这件事情的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā tán tán duì zhè jiàn shìqíng de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Please share your views on this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 在这个问题上，我们的看法是一致的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shang, wǒmen de kànfǎ shì yízhì de.
examples.example_translation: On this issue, our views are the same.

examples.example_chinese: 我想听听你的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tīngting nǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: I would like to hear your opinion.

examples.example_chinese: 他始终坚持自己的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shízhōng jiānchí zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: He always sticks to his own point of view.

examples.example_chinese: 大家有不同的看法，这很正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā yǒu bù tóng de kànfǎ, zhè hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: It’s normal for everyone to have different opinions.

examples.example_chinese: 这只是我个人的看法，不代表大家的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì wǒ gèrén de kànfǎ, bú dàibiǎo dàjiā de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: This is just my personal opinion and does not represent everyone’s views.

meaning: adj.重要或主要的 · important, main

examples.example_chinese: 他主持的研究是国家的一个重点项目。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhǔchí de yánjiū shì guójiā de yí gè zhòngdiǎn xiàngmù.
examples.example_translation: The research he leads is a key national project.

examples.example_chinese: 我的孩子在西城区一所重点中学读书。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de háizi zài Xīchéng Qū yì suǒ zhòngdiǎn zhōngxué dúshū.
examples.example_translation: My child studies at a key middle school in Xicheng District.

examples.example_chinese: 市长重点描绘了本市未来五年的发展规划。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìzhǎng zhòngdiǎn miáohuìle běn shì wèilái wǔ nián de fāzhǎn guīhuà.
examples.example_translation: The mayor focused on describing the city's development plan for the next five years.

examples.example_chinese: 妻子怀孕了，成了全家的重点照顾对象。
examples.example_pinyin: Qīzi huáiyùn le, chéngle quán jiā de zhòngdiǎn zhàogù duìxiàng.
examples.example_translation: My wife is pregnant and has become the main focus of care for the whole family.

meaning: v.比喻生气或愤怒 · rage, fury

examples.example_chinese: 听到这句话，他就火了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngdào zhè jù huà, tā jiù huǒ le.
examples.example_translation: When he heard this sentence, he got angry.

examples.example_chinese: 你先别火，听我把话说完。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié huǒ, tīng wǒ bǎ huà shuōwán.
examples.example_translation: Don't get angry yet, let me finish what I have to say.

examples.example_chinese: 一看爸爸火了，他就不说话了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yí kàn bàba huǒ le, tā jiù bù shuōhuà le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as he saw his dad get angry, he stopped talking.

examples.example_chinese: 他刚才还好好儿的，怎么突然火了？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gāngcái hái hǎohāor de, zěnme túrán huǒ le?
examples.example_translation: He was fine just now, why did he suddenly get angry?

meaning: n.反映自然、社会等客观规律的知识体系 · science

examples.example_chinese: 我们要相信科学，相信事实。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiāngxìn kēxué, xiāngxìn shìshí.
examples.example_translation: We should believe in science and in facts.

examples.example_chinese: 他一生都在从事科学研究工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīshēng dōu zài cóngshì kēxué yánjiū gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: He has been engaged in scientific research all his life.

examples.example_chinese: 这种现象已经在科学上解释清楚了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng yǐjīng zài kēxué shang jiěshì qīngchu le.
examples.example_translation: This phenomenon has already been clearly explained by science.

examples.example_chinese: 数学是一门自然科学。
examples.example_pinyin: Shùxué shì yì mén zìrán kēxué.
examples.example_translation: Mathematics is a natural science.

examples.example_chinese: 我们国家的科学技术还不够先进，需要进一步提高。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā de kēxué jìshù hái bú gòu xiānjìn, xūyào jìnyībù tígāo.
examples.example_translation: Our country's science and technology are not advanced enough and need further improvement.

meaning: n. 一公斤的千分之一, gram

examples.example_chinese: 这个苹果重量是250克。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè gè píngguǒ zhòngliàng shì 250 kè.
examples.example_translation: This apple weighs 250 grams.

examples.example_chinese: 这条黄金项链有50克重。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè tiáo huángjīn xiàngliàn yǒu 50 kè zhòng.
examples.example_translation: This gold necklace weighs 50 grams.

examples.example_chinese: 一公斤等于一千克。
examples.example_pinyin: yī gōngjīn děngyú yīqiān kè.
examples.example_translation: One kilogram equals one thousand grams.

examples.example_chinese: 包装上写的是495克。
examples.example_pinyin: bāozhuāng shàng xiě de shì 495 kè.
examples.example_translation: It says 495 grams on the package.

examples.example_chinese: 名字叫做“汉堡格尔”（Hamburger），尚无什么所谓“麦克唐诺”。
examples.example_pinyin: zì jiào zuò gé wú suǒ kè

meaning: n.构成地球周围大气的气体 · air

examples.example_chinese: 他到外面呼吸新鲜空气了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā dào wàimiàn hūxī xīnxiān kōngqì le.
examples.example_translation: He went outside to breathe fresh air.

examples.example_chinese: 打开窗户，换换空气吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Dǎkāi chuānghu, huànhuan kōngqì ba.
examples.example_translation: Open the window and let in some fresh air.

examples.example_chinese: 屋子里人太多，空气不太好。
examples.example_pinyin: Wūzi lǐ rén tài duō, kōngqì bú tài hǎo.
examples.example_translation: There are too many people in the room, the air is not very good.

examples.example_chinese: 这里的空气被污染了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli de kōngqì bèi wūrǎn le.
examples.example_translation: The air here is polluted.

examples.example_chinese: 有一股冷空气进入了北京。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu yī gǔ lěng kōngqì jìnrùle Běijīng.
examples.example_translation: A cold air mass has entered Beijing.

meaning: v.保管和料理 · take care of, look after

examples.example_chinese: 他很小就学会了自己管理自己。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎo jiù xuéhuìle zìjǐ guǎnlǐ zìjǐ.
examples.example_translation: He learned to take care of himself at a young age.

examples.example_chinese: 这些书都要管理好，不要弄丢了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē shū dōu yào guǎnlǐ hǎo, bùyào nòngdiū le.
examples.example_translation: These books must be well taken care of, don’t lose them.

examples.example_chinese: 这些重要的资料有专门的人管理。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē zhòngyào de zīliào yǒu zhuānmén de rén guǎnlǐ.
examples.example_translation: These important materials are managed by specialized personnel.

examples.example_chinese: 有丢失钱包者，请到公园管理处领取。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu diūshī qiánbāo zhě, qǐng dào gōngyuán guǎnlǐchù lǐngqǔ.
examples.example_translation: Anyone who has lost a wallet, please go to the park management office to claim it.

meaning: v.用力使物体朝着自己所在的方向或跟着自己移动 · pull, draw

examples.example_chinese: 你把椅子拉过来一点儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bǎ yǐzi lā guòlai yìdiǎnr.
examples.example_translation: Pull the chair over here a bit.

examples.example_chinese: 他把我拉到一边，说了几句话。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ lādao yì biān, shuōle jǐ jù huà.
examples.example_translation: He pulled me aside and said a few words.

examples.example_chinese: 他上不来，你拉他一下吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shàng bu lái, nǐ lā tā yíxià ba.
examples.example_translation: He can't get up, give him a pull.

examples.example_chinese: 这个行李箱太重了，拉着走吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xínglixiāng tài zhòng le, lāzhe zǒu ba.
examples.example_translation: This suitcase is too heavy, pull it along.

meaning: n.通过总结概括出来的结论（多为书面的） · summary

examples.example_chinese: 我写了一份总结，您帮我看看。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiěle yí fèn zǒngjié, nín bāng wǒ kànkan.
examples.example_translation: I wrote a summary, could you help me take a look?

examples.example_chinese: 快到年底了，经理要求每个人写一份工作总结。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuài dào niándǐ le, jīnglǐ yāoqiú měi ge rén xiě yí fèn gōngzuò zǒngjié.
examples.example_translation: The end of the year is approaching, and the manager requires everyone to write a work summary.

examples.example_chinese: 大家互相看看你们的个人总结，也许能受到一些启发。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā hùxiāng kànkan nǐmen de gèrén zǒngjié, yěxǔ néng shòudào yìxiē qǐfā.
examples.example_translation: Everyone, take a look at each other's personal summaries, maybe you'll get some inspiration.

examples.example_chinese: 我还得改改这份总结，有些地方还不够全面。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái děi gǎigai zhè fèn zǒngjié, yǒuxiē dìfang hái bù gòu quánmiàn.
examples.example_translation: I still need to revise this summary, some parts are not comprehensive enough.

meaning: n.对含义, 原因等的说明 · explanations, implications, reasons or causes

examples.example_chinese: 老师的解释让我彻底明白了。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī de jiěshì ràng wǒ chèdǐ míngbai le.
examples.example_translation: The teacher's explanation made me completely understand.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不能相信他关于这件事的解释。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng xiāngxìn tā guānyú zhè jiàn shì de jiěshì.
examples.example_translation: We can't believe his explanation about this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 这种现象已经得到了科学上的解释。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng yǐjīng dédàole kēxué shàng de jiěshì.
examples.example_translation: This phenomenon has already received a scientific explanation.

examples.example_chinese: 他的解释很有说服力。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jiěshì hěn yǒu shuōfúlì.
examples.example_translation: His explanation is very convincing.

meaning: n.对未来事业合理的想象或希望 · ideal, aspiration

examples.example_chinese: 他的理想是一名科学家。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de lǐxiǎng shì dāng yì míng kēxuéjiā.
examples.example_translation: His ideal is to be a scientist.

examples.example_chinese: 我当老师的理想终于实现了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dāng lǎoshī de lǐxiǎng zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
examples.example_translation: My ideal of becoming a teacher has finally come true.

examples.example_chinese: 他为实现自己的理想奋斗了一生。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wèi shíxiàn zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng fèndòu le yìshēng.
examples.example_translation: He struggled all his life to realize his ideal.

examples.example_chinese: 他教育孩子从小要树立远大的理想。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiàoyù háizi cóngxiǎo yào shùlì yuǎndà de lǐxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: He teaches children to set great ideals from an early age.

examples.example_chinese: 有了理想，你就有了生活的方向。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒule lǐxiǎng, nǐ jiù yǒule shēnghuó de fāngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: With ideals, you have direction in life.

meaning: v.举例时所使用的词语，表示下面就是例子 · for example, for instance, indicating the examples are as follows

examples.example_chinese: 我喜欢中国文化，例如茶文化、酒文化等。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà, lìrú chá wénhuà, jiǔ wénhuà děng.
examples.example_translation: I like Chinese culture, for example, tea culture and wine culture.

examples.example_chinese: 他去过很多国家，例如法国、德国、美国等。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qùguo hěn duō guójiā, lìrú Fǎguó, Déguó, Měiguó děng.
examples.example_translation: He has been to many countries, for example, France, Germany, and the United States.

examples.example_chinese: 北京有很多名胜古迹，例如故宫、长城。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng yǒu hěn duō míngshèng gǔjì, lìrú Gù Gōng, Chángchéng.
examples.example_translation: There are many famous historical sites in Beijing, for example, the Forbidden City and the Great Wall.

examples.example_chinese: 这些题都很难，例如第八题就没人会做。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē tí dōu hěn nán, lìrú dì bā tí jiù méi rén huì zuò.
examples.example_translation: All these questions are difficult, for example, no one can do question eight.

examples.example_chinese: 例如吃了什么
examples.example_pinyin: lì rú chī le shén me

meaning: n.（对人或事）不满的想法或看法 · objection, differing opinion, complaint

examples.example_chinese: 道路没人修，居民意见很大。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàolù méi rén xiū, jūmín yìjiàn hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: No one is repairing the road, and the residents have a lot of complaints.

examples.example_chinese: 爸爸在客厅吸烟，女儿很有意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàba zài kètīng xī yān, nǚ'ér hěn yǒu yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: Dad smokes in the living room, and the daughter strongly objects.

examples.example_chinese: 既然大家意见很多，我们就取消这次活动吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā yìjiàn hěn duō, wǒmen jiù qǔxiāo zhè cì huódòng ba.
examples.example_translation: Since there are so many objections, let's cancel this event.

examples.example_chinese: 谁有意见就提出来好了，我们会考虑的。
examples.example_pinyin: Shéi yǒu yìjiàn jiù tí chūlái hǎo le, wǒmen huì kǎolǜ de.
examples.example_translation: If anyone has any objections, just bring them up, we will consider them.

meaning: adj. 光线强的，有光的 bright, shiny; v. 发光 light

examples.example_chinese: 灯太亮了，我睁不开眼。
examples.example_pinyin: Dēng tài liàng le, wǒ zhēng bu kāi yǎn.
examples.example_translation: The light is too bright, I can't open my eyes.

examples.example_chinese: 我们找个亮一点儿的地方看书吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhǎo ge liàng yìdiǎnr de dìfang kàn shū ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's find a brighter place to read.

examples.example_chinese: 教室四面都是玻璃，显得很亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoshì sì miàn dōu shì bōli, xiǎnde hěn liàng.
examples.example_translation: The classroom has glass on all sides, so it looks very bright.

examples.example_chinese: 今晚的月亮又圆又亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnwǎn de yuèliang yòu yuán yòu liàng.
examples.example_translation: Tonight the moon is both round and bright.

examples.example_chinese: 这间屋子不够亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiān wūzi bú gòu liàng.
examples.example_translation: This room is not bright enough.

examples.example_chinese: 天亮了，你该起床了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiān liàng le, nǐ gāi qǐchuáng le.
examples.example_translation: It's dawn, you should get up.

examples.example_chinese: 晚上十二点的时候，他的房间里还亮着灯。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn de shíhou, tā de fángjiān lǐ hái liàngzhe dēng.
examples.example_translation: At midnight, the light in his room was still on.

examples.example_chinese: 路灯突然不亮了。
examples.example_pinyin: Lùdēng tūrán bú liàng le.
examples.example_translation: The streetlight suddenly went out.

examples.example_chinese: 电灯亮了一会儿，就又灭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Diàndēng liàngle yíhuìr, jiù yòu miè le.
examples.example_translation: The light was on for a while, then went out again.

examples.example_chinese: 外面亮起来了，人越来越多。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàimiàn liàng qǐlai le, rén yuè lái yuè duō.
examples.example_translation: It became bright outside, and more and more people appeared.

meaning: v.指收进钱财 · take in, earn (as opposed to “支出 pay”)

examples.example_chinese: 今年他收入了十万块。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián tā shōurùle shí wàn kuài.
examples.example_translation: This year he earned one hundred thousand yuan.

examples.example_chinese: 这个月比上个月多收入了一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège yuè bǐ shàng ge yuè duō shōurùle yīxiē.
examples.example_translation: This month he earned more than last month.

examples.example_chinese: 他希望收入得越多越好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xīwàng shōurù de yuè duō yuè hǎo.
examples.example_translation: He hopes to earn as much as possible.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书中收入了20多篇论文。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhōng shōurùle èrshí duō piān lùnwén.
examples.example_translation: This book includes more than 20 papers.

meaning: v.停在某个地方或位置上不动，不离开 · stay, remain

examples.example_chinese: 他毕业以后留在学校工作了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bìyè yǐhòu liú zài xuéxiào gōngzuò le.
examples.example_translation: After graduation, he stayed at the school to work.

examples.example_chinese: 你留在这儿，我出去看看。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ liú zài zhèr, wǒ chūqù kànkan.
examples.example_translation: You stay here, I'll go out and have a look.

examples.example_chinese: 我在北京多留了两天。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng duō liú le liǎng tiān.
examples.example_translation: I stayed two more days in Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 你能不能留下来不走？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng liú xiàlai bù zǒu?
examples.example_translation: Can you stay and not leave?

examples.example_chinese: 只在小路一旁，漏着几段空隙，像是特为月光留下的。
examples.example_pinyin: zhī zài xiǎo lù yī páng lòu zhe jǐ duàn kōng xiàng shì tè wèi yuè guāng liú xià de

meaning: v.厌恶, 不喜欢 · dislike, loathe

examples.example_chinese: 我讨厌那些在公共场合抽烟的人。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn nàxiē zài gōnggòng chǎnghé chōuyān de rén.
examples.example_translation: I dislike people who smoke in public places.

examples.example_chinese: 说假话的人大家都讨厌。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuō jiǎ huà de rén dàjiā dōu tǎoyàn.
examples.example_translation: Everyone dislikes people who tell lies.

examples.example_chinese: 妻子讨厌丈夫每天喝酒。
examples.example_pinyin: Qīzi tǎoyàn zhàngfu měi tiān hējiǔ.
examples.example_translation: The wife dislikes her husband drinking every day.

examples.example_chinese: 你既然这么讨厌他，就别跟他在一起了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jìrán zhème tǎoyàn tā, jiù bié gēn tā zài yìqǐ le.
examples.example_translation: Since you dislike him so much, don't be with him anymore.

meaning: adj.话说得快而清楚，文章写得通畅而清楚 · fluent

examples.example_chinese: 他能说一口流利的普通话。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā néng shuō yì kǒu liúlì de pǔtōnghuà.
examples.example_translation: He can speak fluent Mandarin.

examples.example_chinese: 他可以用五种语言流利地进行交流。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kěyǐ yòng wǔ zhǒng yǔyán liúlì de jìnxíng jiāoliú.
examples.example_translation: He can communicate fluently in five languages.

examples.example_chinese: 她英语说得非常流利。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā Yīngyǔ shuō de fēicháng liúlì.
examples.example_translation: She speaks English very fluently.

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章的语言很流利。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de yǔyán hěn liúlì.
examples.example_translation: The language of this article is very fluent.

examples.example_chinese: 这个问题他回答得不够流利。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí tā huídá de bú gòu liúlì.
examples.example_translation: He didn't answer this question fluently enough.

meaning: v.广泛流传 · be popular, be in vogue

examples.example_chinese: 现在流行短一点儿的衣服。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài liúxíng duǎn yìdiǎnr de yīfu.
examples.example_translation: Shorter clothes are popular now.

examples.example_chinese: 这首歌曲很快就流行起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shǒu gēqǔ hěn kuài jiù liúxíng qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: This song became popular very quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 年轻人中流行在网上谈恋爱。
examples.example_pinyin: Niánqīngrén zhōng liúxíng zài wǎng shang tán liàn'ài.
examples.example_translation: Online dating is popular among young people.

examples.example_chinese: 这种音乐流行了很长一段时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīnyuè liúxíngle hěn cháng yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: This kind of music has been popular for a long time.

examples.example_chinese: 这种红皮鞋今年才开始流行。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng hóng píxié jīnnián cái kāishǐ liúxíng.
examples.example_translation: This kind of red shoes only started to be popular this year.

meaning: n.旅行的人 · journeyer, hotel guest, traveler, passenger

examples.example_chinese: 火车站里旅客很多,大家都在排队检票。
examples.example_pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn lǐ lǚkè hěn duō, dàjiā dōu zài páiduì jiǎnpiào.
examples.example_translation: There are many passengers in the train station, everyone is lining up to check tickets.

examples.example_chinese: 机场工作人员正在帮助旅客办理登机手续。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīchǎng gōngzuò rényuán zhèngzài bāngzhù lǚkè bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù.
examples.example_translation: Airport staff are helping passengers with check-in procedures.

meaning: v.为了办事或浏览从一个地方去到另一个地方 · to travel, to journey

examples.example_chinese: 我计划明年去欧洲旅行。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jìhuà míngnián qù Ōuzhōu lǚxíng.
examples.example_translation: I plan to travel to Europe next year.

examples.example_chinese: 他们正在进行一次环球旅行。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài jìnxíng yīcì huánqiú lǚxíng.
examples.example_translation: They are on a trip around the world.

examples.example_chinese: 独自旅行可以锻炼人的独立能力。
examples.example_pinyin: Dúzì lǚxíng kěyǐ duànliàn rén de dúlì nénglì.
examples.example_translation: Traveling alone can train one's independence.

examples.example_chinese: 这次旅行给我留下了深刻的印象。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhècì lǚxíng gěi wǒ liúxiàle shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
examples.example_translation: This trip left a deep impression on me.

examples.example_chinese: 一起出发去旅行
examples.example_pinyin: yì qǐ chū fā qù lǚ xíng

meaning: n.指事物发展变化的快慢程度 · speed, rate, pace

examples.example_chinese: 他的汉语进步速度非常快。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ jìnbù sùdù fēicháng kuài.
examples.example_translation: His progress in Chinese is very fast.

examples.example_chinese: 为按时完成任务，我们加快了生产速度。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile ànshí wánchéng rènwu, wǒmen jiākuàile shēngchǎn sùdù.
examples.example_translation: To finish the task on time, we sped up the production rate.

examples.example_chinese: 近几年，经济发展的速度很快。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìn jǐ nián, jīngjì fāzhǎn de sùdù hěn kuài.
examples.example_translation: In recent years, the speed of economic development has been very fast.

examples.example_chinese: 他看书的速度比我快很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kàn shū de sùdù bǐ wǒ kuài hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: He reads much faster than I do.

meaning: adj.深刻，深入 · in_front, in front of, in the front of, in the face of, front, presence, before

examples.example_chinese: 他的学问深，我们经常向他请教。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de xuéwèn shēn, wǒmen jīngcháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.example_translation: His knowledge is profound, we often consult him.

examples.example_chinese: 他把道理分析得很深，大家都服了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ dàolǐ fēnxī de hěn shēn, dàjiā dōu fú le.
examples.example_translation: He analyzed the reasoning very deeply, and everyone was convinced.

examples.example_chinese: 他给大家留下了很深的印象。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gěi dàjiā liúxiàle hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
examples.example_translation: He left a deep impression on everyone.

examples.example_chinese: 我对北京的生活记忆很深。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ duì Běijīng de shēnghuó jìyì hěn shēn.
examples.example_translation: My memories of life in Beijing are very deep.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事给了我非常深的教训。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì gěile wǒ fēicháng shēn de jiàoxùn.
examples.example_translation: This incident gave me a very profound lesson.

examples.example_chinese: 说到父母对我的影响，爸爸对我的影响更深一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuōdào fùmǔ duì wǒ de yǐngxiǎng, bàba duì wǒ de yǐngxiǎng gèng shēn yīxiē.
examples.example_translation: Speaking of my parents' influence on me, my father's influence is deeper.

meaning: adj.难理解，不容易懂 · difficult to understand

examples.example_chinese: 这么深的课本，不适合小学生。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème shēn de kèběn, bú shìhé xiǎo xuéshēng.
examples.example_translation: Such a difficult textbook is not suitable for primary school students.

examples.example_chinese: 文章写得太深了，很多人看不懂。
examples.example_pinyin: Wénzhāng xiě de tài shēn le, hěn duō rén kàn bù dǒng.
examples.example_translation: The article is written too deeply, many people can't understand it.

examples.example_chinese: 教材有些深，理解起来很困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàocái yǒuxiē shēn, lǐjiě qǐlái hěn kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: Some of the teaching materials are deep and difficult to understand.

meaning: n.做事耗费的时间和精力 · time and energy

examples.example_chinese: 想学好外语，得下功夫才可以。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiǎng xué hǎo wàiyǔ, děi xià gōngfu cái kěyǐ.
examples.example_translation: To learn a foreign language well, you have to put in effort.

examples.example_chinese: 为了能让女朋友开心，他费了很多功夫，想了很多办法。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile néng ràng nǚpéngyou kāixīn, tā fèi le hěn duō gōngfu, xiǎng le hěn duō bànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: To make his girlfriend happy, he put in a lot of effort and thought of many ways.

examples.example_chinese: 他是花了很大的功夫才搞到这张音乐会门票的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì huā le hěn dà de gōngfu cái gǎo dào zhè zhāng yīnyuèhuì ménpiào de.
examples.example_translation: He spent a lot of effort to get this concert ticket.

examples.example_chinese: 每个人的成功都是靠下苦功夫换来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi gè rén de chénggōng dōu shì kào xià kǔ gōngfu huàn lái de.
examples.example_translation: Everyone's success is achieved through hard work.

meaning: adj.容量已经到了极限 · full

examples.example_chinese: 杯子里的水满了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bēizi lǐ de shuǐ mǎn le.
examples.example_translation: The cup is full of water.

examples.example_chinese: 他喝了满满一杯水。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hēle mǎnmǎn yì bēi shuǐ.
examples.example_translation: He drank a full glass of water.

examples.example_chinese: 暖壶里的水还满着，不用再加了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nuǎnhú lǐ de shuǐ hái mǎnzhe, bùyòng zài jiā le.
examples.example_translation: The thermos is still full of water, no need to add more.

examples.example_chinese: 水库的水从来没满过。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuǐkù de shuǐ cónglái méi mǎnguò.
examples.example_translation: The reservoir has never been full.

examples.example_chinese: 车上挤满了回家过节的人。
examples.example_pinyin: Chē shang jǐmǎnle huí jiā guòjié de rén.
examples.example_translation: The bus is packed with people going home for the holidays.

meaning: n.想要去的地点，想要取得的结果 · motive, aim, goal

examples.example_chinese: 我来中国的目的是想学好汉语。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó de mùdì shì xiǎng xuéhǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.example_translation: My purpose in coming to China is to learn Chinese well.

examples.example_chinese: 他突然来这儿，一定有什么目的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tūrán lái zhèr, yídìng yǒu shénme mùdì.
examples.example_translation: He suddenly came here, he must have some purpose.

examples.example_chinese: 你到底想达到什么目的？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng dádào shénme mùdì?
examples.example_translation: What exactly do you want to achieve?

examples.example_chinese: 不同的目的决定不同的方法。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùtóng de mùdì juédìng bùtóng de fāngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Different aims determine different methods.

examples.example_chinese: 遇到心术不正的人，须远离，若与其为友，只会被他利用来达到自己的目的。
examples.example_pinyin: yù dào xīn shù bù zhèng de rén xū yuǎnlí ruò yǔqí wèi yǒu zhǐ huì bèi tā lìyòng lái dá dào zì jǐ de mù dì

meaning: adv.大家一起（做） · (work) together

examples.example_chinese: 我们共同想办法来解决这个问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen gòngtóng xiǎng bànfǎ lái jiějué zhège wèntí.
examples.example_translation: We are working together to find a way to solve this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 只有大家共同努力，才能完成这项工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhǐyǒu dàjiā gòngtóng nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng zhè xiàng gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: Only by working together can we complete this task.

examples.example_chinese: 让我们共同完成这个任务吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Ràng wǒmen gòngtóng wánchéng zhège rènwu ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's complete this task together.

examples.example_chinese: 我们互相帮助，共同提高了汉语水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen hùxiāng bāngzhù, gòngtóng tígāole Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: We helped each other and improved our Chinese together.

meaning: n.所规定的内容 · rules and regulations

examples.example_chinese: 我不知道公司的这个规定。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào gōngsī de zhège guīdìng.
examples.example_translation: I don't know this rule of the company.

examples.example_chinese: 他们最近发布了一些新规定。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zuìjìn fābùle yīxiē xīn guīdìng.
examples.example_translation: They have recently issued some new regulations.

examples.example_chinese: 对这些规定有什么意见，可以提出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì zhèxiē guīdìng yǒu shénme yìjiàn, kěyǐ tí chūlái.
examples.example_translation: If you have any opinions about these rules, you can bring them up.

examples.example_chinese: 商品可以退、换，这是法律的规定。
examples.example_pinyin: Shāngpǐn kěyǐ tuì, huàn, zhè shì fǎlǜ de guīdìng.
examples.example_translation: Goods can be returned or exchanged, this is a legal regulation.

meaning: n.对于事情的看法和采取的行动 · attitude, approach

examples.example_chinese: 对这个问题，每个人都表明了自己的态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì zhège wèntí, měi ge rén dōu biǎomíngle zìjǐ de tàidu.
examples.example_translation: Everyone has expressed their own attitude towards this issue.

examples.example_chinese: 他的态度非常坚决。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de tàidu fēicháng jiānjué.
examples.example_translation: His attitude is very determined.

examples.example_chinese: 他转变了原来的态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhuǎnbiànle yuánlái de tàidu.
examples.example_translation: He changed his original attitude.

examples.example_chinese: 大家的态度是严肃认真的。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā de tàidu shì yánsù rènzhēn de.
examples.example_translation: Everyone's attitude is serious and earnest.

examples.example_chinese: 只有很少的人的态度不够明确。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu hěn shǎo de rén tàidu bù gòu míngquè.
examples.example_translation: Only a few people have an unclear attitude.

meaning: n.可能的情况、形势 · tendency, likelihood

examples.example_chinese: 看样子，要下雨了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn yàngzi, yào xià yǔ le.
examples.example_translation: It looks like it’s going to rain.

examples.example_chinese: 看样子，他们今天不会来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn yàngzi, tāmen jīntiān bù huì lái le.
examples.example_translation: It seems they won’t come today.

examples.example_chinese: 天没有要晴的样子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiān méiyǒu yào qíng de yàngzi.
examples.example_translation: The sky doesn’t look like it’s going to clear up.

meaning: v.感到没有希望，失去信心 · lose hope, lose confidence

examples.example_chinese: 三次手术都没有成功，病人彻底失望了。
examples.example_pinyin: Sān cì shǒushù dōu méiyǒu chénggōng, bìngrén chèdǐ shīwàng le.
examples.example_translation: After three unsuccessful operations, the patient completely lost hope.

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，我让你们失望了。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ ràng nǐmen shīwàng le.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, I let you down.

examples.example_chinese: 这么一件小事你都没有办好，太让我失望了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème yí jiàn xiǎo shì nǐ dōu méiyǒu bànhǎo, tài ràng wǒ shīwàng le.
examples.example_translation: You couldn't even handle such a small matter, I am really disappointed in you.

meaning: adj.身体不舒服 · not feel good, feel uncomfortable

examples.example_pinyin: Tā húnshēn bù shūfu, nánshòu jí le.
examples.example_translation: He feels uncomfortable all over, it's unbearable.

examples.example_chinese: 看你难受的样子，是不是生病了？
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn nǐ nánshòu de yàngzi, shì bu shì shēngbìng le?
examples.example_translation: You look so uncomfortable, are you sick?

examples.example_chinese: 我这么站着，太难受了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhème zhànzhe, tài nánshòu le.
examples.example_translation: Standing like this is too uncomfortable for me.

meaning: v.免掉, 减少 · delete, omit, leave out

examples.example_chinese: 在这句话里，“的”字不能省。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhè jù huà lǐ, “de” zì bù néng shěng.
examples.example_translation: In this sentence, the word "de" cannot be omitted.

examples.example_chinese: 有你们在，我确实省了不少麻烦。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu tǎmen zài, wǒ quèshí shěngle bù shǎo máfan.
examples.example_translation: With you here, I have indeed saved myself a lot of trouble.

examples.example_chinese: 这孩子一点儿也不让父母省心。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè háizi yìdiǎnr yě bù ràng fùmǔ shěngxīn.
examples.example_translation: This child never lets his parents stop worrying.

examples.example_chinese: 我有一个更省事的办法。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí gè gèng shěngshì de bànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: I have a more convenient way.

examples.example_chinese: 按照他的方法，这道题省了好几步。
examples.example_pinyin: Ànzhào tā de bànfǎ, zhè dào tí shěngle hǎo jǐ bù.
examples.example_translation: According to his method, this problem saves several steps.

meaning: v.（手、工具等）尽量伸，去碰或拿东西 · reach something with one’s hand or a tool

examples.example_chinese: 桌子太大，我够不到那边的菜。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhuōzi tài dà, wǒ gòu bu dào nà biān de cài.
examples.example_translation: The table is too big, I can’t reach the dishes on the other side.

examples.example_pinyin: Shū zài zuì shàngmiàn, wǒ gòu bu zháo.
examples.example_translation: The book is on the top, I can’t reach it.

examples.example_chinese: 他一伸手，就够到屋顶了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yì shēn shǒu, jiù gòudào wūdǐng le.
examples.example_translation: He reached the ceiling as soon as he stretched out his hand.

examples.example_chinese: 他够了半天，也没够下来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gòule bàntiān, yě méi gòu xiàlái.
examples.example_translation: He tried to reach it for a long time but still couldn’t get it down.

examples.example_chinese: “这清闲的生活无忧无虑， 还有什么能够代替？
examples.example_pinyin: zhè qīng xián de shēng huó wú yōu wú lǜ hái yǒu shén me néng gòu dài tì

meaning: v.扔弃, 丢 · throw away

examples.example_chinese: 这双鞋穿坏了，扔了吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié chuānhuài le, rēng le ba.
examples.example_translation: These shoes are worn out, just throw them away.

examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu zǎo gāi rēng le.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing should have been thrown away long ago.

examples.example_chinese: 不要乱扔垃圾。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùyào luàn rēng lājī.
examples.example_translation: Don't litter.

examples.example_chinese: 他把该扔的东西都扔了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ gāi rēng de dōngxi dōu rēng le.
examples.example_translation: He threw away everything that should be thrown away.

examples.example_chinese: 我把那些坏苹果扔到垃圾桶里了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nàxiē huài píngguǒ rēng dào lājītǒng li le.
examples.example_translation: I threw those rotten apples into the trash can.

meaning: v.做，干，搞 · do, manage (usually with one’s hands)

examples.example_chinese: 你在弄什么啊？这么大声音。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zài nòng shénme a? Zhème dà shēngyīn.
examples.example_translation: What are you doing? So loud.

examples.example_chinese: 星期天来我家吧，我给你们弄鱼吃。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīngqītiān lái wǒ jiā ba, wǒ gěi nǐmen nòng yú chī.
examples.example_translation: Come to my house on Sunday, I’ll cook fish for you.

examples.example_chinese: 他们已经开始弄饭了，一会儿就好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen yǐjīng kāishǐ nòng fàn le, yīhuìr jiù hǎo.
examples.example_translation: They have already started cooking, it will be ready soon.

examples.example_chinese: 我的电脑坏了，你帮我弄一弄吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo huài le. Nǐ bāng wǒ nòng yī nòng ba.
examples.example_translation: My computer is broken, can you fix it for me?

examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de nèiróng wǒ hái méi nòng míngbai.
examples.example_translation: I still haven’t figured out what the teacher explained.

meaning: v.按顺序排列成行 · line up, queue up

examples.example_chinese: 在公共汽车站，大家都自觉排队。
examples.example_pinyin: zài gōnggòng qìchēzhàn, dàjiā dōu zìjué páiduì.
examples.example_translation: At the bus station, everyone queues up voluntarily.

examples.example_chinese: 这里人少，用不着排队。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèlǐ rén shǎo, yòng bù zháo páiduì.
examples.example_translation: There are few people here, no need to queue up.

examples.example_chinese: 小朋友们请排队进博物馆。
examples.example_pinyin: xiǎopéngyǒumen qǐng páiduì jìn bówùguǎn.
examples.example_translation: Children, please line up to enter the museum.

examples.example_chinese: 后边排队的人不要挤。
examples.example_pinyin: hòubian páiduì de rén bùyào jǐ.
examples.example_translation: People in the back of the queue, don't push.

examples.example_chinese: 学生们排着队走进学校的大门。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéshēngmen pái zhe duì zǒu jìn xuéxiào de dàmén.
examples.example_translation: The students walked through the school gate in a line.

meaning: adv.表示估计 · perhaps, probably, maybe

examples.example_chinese: 这些苹果恐怕有五斤吧？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ kǒngpà yǒu wǔ jīn ba?
examples.example_translation: These apples probably weigh about five jin?

examples.example_chinese: 他恐怕还是小学生吧？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kǒngpà hái shì xiǎoxuéshēng ba?
examples.example_translation: He is probably still a primary school student?

examples.example_chinese: 今天恐怕会下雨。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān kǒngpà huì xià yǔ.
examples.example_translation: It will probably rain today.

examples.example_chinese: 还有十分钟就八点了，今天恐怕又要迟到了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hái yǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù bà diǎn le, jīntiān kǒngpà yòu yào chídào le.
examples.example_translation: It’s ten minutes to eight, I’ll probably be late again today.

examples.example_translation: He has probably been in Beijing for more than half a year?

meaning: n.n. 一种球类运动项目，也指这种运动使用的球, volleyball · 一种球类运动项目，也指这种运动使用的球, volleyball

examples.example_translation: This is the volleyball used for the match.

examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de páiqiú gāi dǎ qì le.
examples.example_translation: My volleyball needs to be inflated.

meaning: v.使场面活跃，精神愉快（多指开展各种有趣的集体活动） · liven up, have a jolly time

examples.example_chinese: 周末咱们老同学在一起热闹一下吧。

examples.example_translation: Let's sing a song to liven things up.

examples.example_pinyin: Rènao bàntiān le, yě gāi xiūxi huìr le.
examples.example_translation: After all the excitement, it's time to take a break.

examples.example_translation: They come to my house to liven things up at least once a year.

examples.example_pinyin: Yí dào wǎnshang, zhè tiáo jiē jiù rènao qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as night falls, this street becomes lively.

meaning: cl.用于文章等 · piece of writing, section (of a book)

examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de hěn jīngcǎi.
examples.example_translation: This article is very well written.

examples.example_chinese: 本书中有我写的两篇论文。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhōng yǒu wǒ xiě de liǎng piān lùnwén.
examples.example_translation: There are two papers written by me in this book.

examples.example_chinese: 他的一篇篇散文写得很感人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de yì piānpiān sǎnwén xiě de hěn gǎnrén.
examples.example_translation: Each of his essays is very touching.

meaning: m. 用于薄而平的东西, a measure word for something thin and flat; 用于水面、地面等面积、范围较大的东西, a measure word for a piece of land, a stretch of water, etc.; 用于景象、声音、心意等, a measure word for scenes, sound, feelings, etc.; n. 平而薄的东西，体积一般不大（常儿化）, slice, flake

examples.example_translation: It's snowing, and outside is a vast expanse of white.

examples.example_pinyin: fángzi qiánhòu shì yī piànpiàn lǜ dì.
examples.example_translation: There are patches of green land in front of and behind the house.

examples.example_chinese: 秋天的时候，这里是一片丰收景象。
examples.example_pinyin: qiūtiān de shíhòu, zhèlǐ shì yī piàn fēngshōu jǐngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: In autumn, this place is a scene of harvest.

examples.example_translation: A clamor came from outside.

examples.example_translation: This is their kind intention, please accept it.

examples.example_chinese: 我是一片好心帮他，他却不高兴了。

examples.example_translation: He handed me a piece of paper.

meaning: adj. 普通，不特别, ordinary, common; n. 平时，通常的时候, usually

examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zhǐshì gè píngcháng rén, guò zhe píngcháng de shēnghuó.

examples.example_translation: He thinks this matter is very ordinary, nothing to make a fuss about.

examples.example_pinyin: tā píngcháng de biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo, méi shénme bùliáng xíguàn.
examples.example_translation: His usual performance is very good, and he has no bad habits.

examples.example_chinese: 平常这儿很冷清，只有过节的时候这么热闹。
examples.example_pinyin: píngcháng zhèr hěn lěngqīng, zhǐyǒu guòjié de shíhòu zhème rènao.
examples.example_translation: It's usually very quiet here, only getting lively during holidays.

examples.example_chinese: 他平常的成绩很不错，唯独这次考砸了。

examples.example_translation: There are more than 30 people on the school soccer team, and I am one of them.

meaning: v.采取，选取 · adopt, assume, choose

examples.example_chinese: 老师给我取了个中文名字。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒ qǔle ge Zhōngwén míngzi.
