examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhè cì kǎoshì zhǐ qǔ qián sān míng.
examples.example_translation: Only the top three will be selected in this exam.

examples.example_chinese: 祝你在考试中取得好成绩。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhù nǐ zài kǎoshì zhōng qǔdé hǎo chéngjì.
examples.example_translation: Wish you get good results in the exam.

examples.example_chinese: 报名的有300多人，他们只取20人。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàomíng de yǒu sānbǎi duō rén, tāmen zhǐ qǔ èrshí rén.
examples.example_translation: There are more than 300 applicants, but only 20 will be selected.

meaning: adv.表示虽然发生变化，但最后还是恢复了原来的状况 · once again

examples.example_chinese: 出国两年后，他仍然回到了这个公司。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūguó liǎng nián hòu, tā réngrán huídàole zhège gōngsī.
examples.example_translation: After two years abroad, he returned to this company again.

examples.example_chinese: 他吃完早饭后，仍然睡他的觉去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chīwán zǎofàn hòu, réngrán shuì tā de jiào qù le.
examples.example_translation: After breakfast, he went back to sleep as usual.

examples.example_chinese: 他看过之后，仍然放回了原来的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kànguo zhīhòu, réngrán fànghuíle yuánlái de dìfang.
examples.example_translation: After he looked at it, he put it back where it was.

examples.example_chinese: 我们俩不在一个班了，但仍然在一个学校。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ bù zài yí ge bān le, dàn réngrán zài yí ge xuéxiào.
examples.example_translation: We are no longer in the same class, but we are still in the same school.

meaning: adj.情况很急, 时间很紧, 难以应付 · in short supply, tight, hard to handle

examples.example_chinese: 还有半个小时就开车了，时间很紧张。
examples.example_pinyin: Hái yǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí jiù kāi chē le, shíjiān hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.example_translation: The car will leave in half an hour, time is very tight.

examples.example_chinese: 旅游的人多，宾馆显得有些紧张。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǚyóu de rén duō, bīnguǎn xiǎnde yǒuxiē jǐnzhāng.
examples.example_translation: There are many tourists, so the hotels seem a bit tight (in supply).

examples.example_chinese: 这些天机票很紧张，不容易买到。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē tiān jīpiào hěn jǐnzhāng, bù róngyì mǎidào.
examples.example_translation: Air tickets are in short supply these days and are not easy to get.

examples.example_chinese: 他工作很紧张，不能请假。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn jǐnzhāng, bù néng qǐngjià.
examples.example_translation: His work is very busy, so he can't take a leave.

examples.example_chinese: 公司最近经济上很紧张，拿不出太多资金。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn jīngjì shang hěn jǐnzhāng, ná bù chū tài duō zījīn.
examples.example_translation: The company is financially tight recently and can't provide much funding.

meaning: adj.重量小（跟“重”相对） · light in weight (as opposed to "重 heavy")

examples.example_chinese: 这个行李箱很轻，里面没什么东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xínglǐxiāng hěn qīng, lǐmiàn méi shénme dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: This suitcase is very light, there’s nothing much inside.

examples.example_chinese: 这台电脑又薄又轻。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo yòu báo yòu qīng.
examples.example_translation: This computer is both thin and light.

examples.example_chinese: 这么轻的包，我可以拿三个。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème qīng de bāo, wǒ kěyǐ ná sān ge.
examples.example_translation: I can carry three of such light bags.

examples.example_chinese: 我比原来轻了五公斤。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǐ yuánlái qīngle wǔ gōngjīn.
examples.example_translation: I am five kilograms lighter than before.

examples.example_chinese: 这些箱子可不轻，你一个人搬得动吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē xiāngzi kě bù qīng, nǐ yí ge rén bān de dòng ma?
examples.example_translation: These boxes are not light, can you move them by yourself?

meaning: v.突破，破除 · break, get rid of (outdated customs, ideas, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 他破了世界纪录，高兴极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā pòle shìjiè jìlù, gāoxìng jí le.
examples.example_translation: He broke the world record and was extremely happy.

examples.example_chinese: 咱们谁也不能破了规矩，还是要有一个人发言。
examples.example_pinyin: Zánmen shéi yě bù néng pòle guīju, háishi yào yǒu yí ge rén fāyán.
examples.example_translation: None of us can break the rules, someone still has to speak.

examples.example_chinese: 当地号召人们破掉那些旧风俗。
examples.example_pinyin: Dāngdì hàozhào rénmen pòdiào nàxiē jiù fēngsú.
examples.example_translation: The local authorities called on people to get rid of those old customs.

examples.example_chinese: 这些多年来留下的传统能破得了吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē duō nián lái liúxià de chuántǒng néng pò de liǎo ma?
examples.example_translation: Can the traditions left over from all these years be broken?

meaning: adj.专业的，专从某项工作的 · professional

examples.example_chinese: 他正在接受足球方面专门的训练。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jiēshòu zúqiú fāngmiàn zhuānmén de xùnliàn.
examples.example_translation: He is receiving professional training in football.

examples.example_chinese: 他是公司的专门人才，负责电脑的维修和维护。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī de zhuānmén réncái, fùzé diànnǎo de wéixiū hé wéihù.
examples.example_translation: He is a professional talent in the company, responsible for computer repair and maintenance.

examples.example_chinese: 这个图书馆有一个专门的阅览室，供老年人使用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège túshūguǎn yǒu yí ge zhuānmén de yuèlǎnshì, gōng lǎoniánrén shǐyòng.
examples.example_translation: This library has a special reading room for the elderly.

meaning: adj.用力小 · gently, not forceful

examples.example_chinese: 他轻轻地走了进来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de zǒule jìnlái.
examples.example_translation: He walked in gently.

examples.example_chinese: 他说话的声音很轻。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn qīng.
examples.example_translation: He speaks in a very soft voice.

examples.example_chinese: 你动作轻点儿，别吵醒了孩子。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dòngzuò qīng diǎnr, bié chǎoxǐngle háizi.
examples.example_translation: Move more gently, don’t wake the child.

examples.example_chinese: 他轻轻地把门关上了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de bǎ mén guānshangle.
examples.example_translation: He gently closed the door.

examples.example_chinese: 这些盘子要轻轻拿轻轻放，小心别摔坏了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē pánzi yào qīngqīng ná qīngqīng fàng, xiǎoxīn bié shuāihuài le.
examples.example_translation: These plates should be handled gently, be careful not to break them.

meaning: conj.用在下半句, 表示在某种条件或情况下产生某种结局 · result, ending

examples.example_chinese: 我们以为能赢得这场比赛，结果还是输了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐwéi néng yíngdé zhè chǎng bǐsài, jiéguǒ háishi shū le.
examples.example_translation: We thought we could win the match, but in the end we still lost.

examples.example_chinese: 今天陪她上街购物，本来她说要买很多东西的，结果一件也没买。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān péi tā shàng jiē gòuwù, běnlái tā shuō yào mǎi hěn duō dōngxi de, jiéguǒ yí jiàn yě méi mǎi.
examples.example_translation: I accompanied her shopping today. She said she would buy a lot, but in the end she didn't buy anything.

examples.example_chinese: 公司领导研究了这个计划，结果一致认为计划不符合实际。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī lǐngdǎo yánjiūle zhège jìhuà, jiéguǒ yīzhì rènwéi jìhuà bù fúhé shíjì.
examples.example_translation: The company leaders studied the plan and concluded that it did not fit the reality.

meaning: v.节约, 不浪费 · economize, save, be frugal

examples.example_chinese: 那段时间他为了省钱每天只吃一顿饭。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà duàn shíjiān tā wèile shěng qián měi tiān zhǐ chī yí dùn fàn.
examples.example_translation: During that time, he ate only one meal a day to save money.

examples.example_chinese: 他把省下来的钱都捐给了山区小朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ shěng xiàlái de qián dōu juān gěi le shānqū xiǎopéngyǒu.
examples.example_translation: He donated all the money he saved to children in the mountain areas.

examples.example_chinese: 坐飞机比较省时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuò fēijī bǐjiào shěng shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: Taking a plane saves time.

examples.example_chinese: 买这台电脑比买那台能省500多块钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Mǎi zhè tái diànnǎo bǐ mǎi nà tái néng shěng wǔbǎi duō kuài qián.
examples.example_translation: Buying this computer can save more than 500 yuan compared to buying that one.

examples.example_chinese: 他过日子非常省，不是必需的东西从来不买。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā guò rìzi fēicháng shěng, bú shì bìxū de dōngxi cónglái bù mǎi.
examples.example_translation: He lives very frugally and never buys anything unnecessary.

meaning: v.拿到手里 · get, fetch, collect, draw

examples.example_chinese: 我下午要到银行取钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào dào yínháng qǔ qián.
examples.example_translation: I need to go to the bank to withdraw money this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 我忘了带书，现在回去取。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wàngle dài shū, xiànzài huíqù qǔ.
examples.example_translation: I forgot to bring the book, so I’ll go back to get it now.

examples.example_chinese: 我托运的行李还没取出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tuōyùn de xíngli hái méi qǔ chūlái.
examples.example_translation: I haven’t collected my checked luggage yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他已经取走了他的电脑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng qǔzǒu le tā de diànnǎo.
examples.example_translation: He has already taken his computer.

examples.example_chinese: 我一会儿得去取我订的飞机票。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yīhuǐr děi qù qǔ wǒ dìng de fēijīpiào.
examples.example_translation: I have to go pick up my booked plane ticket in a while.

meaning: v.把两个以上的对象加以比较，认识它们的不同 · distinguish, differentiate

examples.example_chinese: 我区别不出中国人和日本人。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qūbié bu chū Zhōngguó rén hé Rìběn rén.
examples.example_translation: I can't distinguish between Chinese and Japanese people.

examples.example_chinese: 我不能区别这两瓶酒的真假。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù néng qūbié zhè liǎng píng jiǔ de zhēn jiǎ.
examples.example_translation: I can't tell whether these two bottles of wine are real or fake.

examples.example_chinese: 你仔细区别一下这两个手机有什么不同。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zǐxì qūbié yīxià zhè liǎng ge shǒujī yǒu shénme bù tóng.
examples.example_translation: Carefully distinguish what is different between these two phones.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要根据不同的情况进行区别对待。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào gēnjù bùtóng de qíngkuàng jìnxíng qūbié duìdài.
examples.example_translation: We should treat different situations differently.

examples.example_chinese: 我觉得这两个词用法很难区别。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè liǎng ge cí yòngfǎ hěn nán qūbié.
examples.example_translation: I think it's hard to distinguish the usage of these two words.

meaning: v.互相往来联系 · make friends with, contact

examples.example_chinese: 他交了很多好朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiāole hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: He made many good friends.

examples.example_chinese: 他这种人不可交。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhè zhǒng rén bù kě jiāo.
examples.example_translation: This kind of person is not worth making friends with.

examples.example_chinese: 交朋友要交真正的朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiāo péngyou yào jiāo zhēnzhèng de péngyou.
examples.example_translation: When making friends, make true friends.

examples.example_chinese: 不交不交就是不交
examples.example_pinyin: bù jiāo bù jiāo jiù shì bù jiāo

examples.example_chinese: 我没跟人家交过手
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ méi gēn rén jia jiāo guò shǒu

meaning: n.各个部分的总和，整个 · whole, complete, total

examples.example_chinese: 他的全部时间都用来学汉语了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de quánbù shíjiān dōu yònglái xué Hànyǔ le.
examples.example_translation: He spent all his time learning Chinese.

examples.example_chinese: 这些书全部是关于中国文化的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē shū quánbù shì guānyú Zhōngguó wénhuà de.
examples.example_translation: All these books are about Chinese culture.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈把全部精力都放在孩子身上了。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma bǎ quánbù jīnglì dōu fàng zài háizi shēnshang le.
examples.example_translation: Mom put all her energy into her child.

examples.example_chinese: 这些东西全部是中国生产的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi quánbù shì Zhōngguó shēngchǎn de.
examples.example_translation: All these things are made in China.

examples.example_chinese: 我会用全部的力量来帮助你。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huì yòng quánbù de lìliàng lái bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.example_translation: I will use all my strength to help you.

meaning: conj.连接两项或两项以上的成分，放在最后一项的前面，含有更进一步一层的意思 · (used to connect two or more components) even go so far as to

examples.example_chinese: 全中国甚至全世界的人都知道他。
examples.example_pinyin: Quán Zhōngguó shènzhì quán shìjiè de rén dōu zhīdào tā.
examples.example_translation: Everyone in China, even people all over the world, knows him.

examples.example_chinese: 不认真学习就会落后，倒退，甚至犯错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Bú rènzhēn xuéxí jiù huì luòhòu, dàotuì, shènzhì fàn cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: If you don't study hard, you will fall behind, regress, and even make mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 在这里，不但年轻人，甚至老人都那么爱唱歌。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ, bùdàn niánqīng rén, shènzhì lǎorén dōu nàme ài chànggē.
examples.example_translation: Here, not only young people, but even the elderly love singing so much.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事他连同学甚至父母都没告诉。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā lián tóngxué shènzhì fùmǔ dōu méi gàosu.
examples.example_translation: He didn't tell this matter to his classmates, not even to his parents.

meaning: adj.感情深，关系密切 · intimate, close

examples.example_chinese: 他在工作中建立了很深的友谊。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zài gōngzuò zhōng jiànlìle hěn shēn de yǒuyì.
examples.example_translation: He established a deep friendship at work.

examples.example_chinese: 他们关系很深，彼此都很关心对方。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen guānxì hěn shēn, bǐcǐ dōu hěn guānxīn duìfāng.
examples.example_translation: Their relationship is very close, and they care about each other a lot.

examples.example_chinese: 他们夫妻感情很深，从来没闹过矛盾。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen fūqī gǎnqíng hěn shēn, cónglái méi nàoguò máodùn.
examples.example_translation: Their marital relationship is very deep, and they have never had conflicts.

examples.example_chinese: 他们交往得比较深，也是多年的老朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen jiāowǎng de bǐjiào shēn, yě shì duō nián de lǎo péngyǒu.
examples.example_translation: They have a deep friendship and have been old friends for many years.

meaning: n.深度 · depth

examples.example_chinese: 这个游泳池深水区有两米深。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège yóuyǒngchí shēnshuǐqū yǒu liǎng mǐ shēn.
examples.example_translation: The deep end of this swimming pool is two meters deep.

examples.example_chinese: 这条河有三米深。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǒu sān mǐ shēn.
examples.example_translation: This river is three meters deep.

meaning: v.工作或学业没有达到自己的预定目标（跟“成功”相对） · fail, not achieve the planned target (as opposed to "success")

examples.example_chinese: 虽然这次实验又失败了，但我们不会灰心。
examples.example_pinyin: Suīrán zhè cì shíyàn yòu shībài le, dàn wǒmen bù huì huīxīn.
examples.example_translation: Although this experiment failed again, we will not lose heart.

examples.example_chinese: 哪个科学家没有失败过？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǎge kēxuéjiā méiyǒu shībàiguò?
examples.example_translation: Which scientist has never failed?

examples.example_chinese: 要想成功，就要不怕失败。
examples.example_pinyin: Yào xiǎng chénggōng, jiù yào bú pà shībài.
examples.example_translation: If you want to succeed, you must not be afraid of failure.

examples.example_chinese: 失败是成功之母。
examples.example_pinyin: Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ.
examples.example_translation: Failure is the mother of success.

examples.example_chinese: 我经历过很多失败，才有了今天的成功。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīnglìguò hěn duō shībài, cái yǒu jīntiān de chénggōng.
examples.example_translation: I have experienced many failures before achieving today's success.

examples.example_chinese: 失败的经验是我们一生的财富。
examples.example_pinyin: Shībài de jīngyàn shì wǒmen yīshēng de cáifù.
examples.example_translation: The experience of failure is a lifelong treasure for us.

meaning: v.身体露着 · bare

examples.example_chinese: 他没穿鞋，光着脚就出来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā méi chuān xié, guāngzhe jiǎo jiù chūlái le.
examples.example_translation: He came out barefoot, without wearing shoes.

examples.example_chinese: 这么冷，你怎么光着头？也不戴帽子。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème lěng, nǐ zěnme guāngzhe tóu? Yě bú dài màozi.
examples.example_translation: It’s so cold, why are you bareheaded? And not even wearing a hat.

examples.example_chinese: 别光着身，多不文明啊。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié guāngzhe shēn, duō bù wénmíng a.
examples.example_translation: Don’t go around naked, it’s so uncivilized.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子们光着身子在水里玩儿呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizimen guāngzhe shēnzi zài shuǐ lǐ wánr ne.
examples.example_translation: The children are playing in the water naked.

meaning: n.进入建筑物或场地所经过的门口 · entrance

examples.example_chinese: 这个超市的入口在东边。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège chāoshì de rùkǒu zài dōngbian.
examples.example_translation: The entrance to this supermarket is on the east side.

examples.example_chinese: 这个公园有三个入口。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán yǒu sān ge rùkǒu.
examples.example_translation: This park has three entrances.

examples.example_chinese: 体育场的入口处挤满了人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tǐyùchǎng de rùkǒuchù jǐmǎnle rén.
examples.example_translation: The entrance to the stadium was crowded with people.

examples.example_chinese: 你们是从哪个入口进来的？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen shì cóng nǎge rùkǒu jìnlái de?
examples.example_translation: Which entrance did you come in from?

examples.example_chinese: 我们约好在地铁入口处见面。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo zài dìtiě rùkǒuchù jiànmiàn.
examples.example_translation: We agreed to meet at the subway entrance.

examples.example_chinese: 这里是场馆的入口，安全出口在那边。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli shì chǎngguǎn de rùkǒu, ānquán chūkǒu zài nàbian.
examples.example_translation: This is the entrance to the venue, the emergency exit is over there.

meaning: v.为解决问题而交换意见 · consult, talk over

examples.example_chinese: 我们商量一个解决办法吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shāngliang yí ge jiějué bànfǎ ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's discuss a solution.

examples.example_chinese: 关于考大学的事，我要跟父母商量一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Guānyú kǎo dàxué de shì, wǒ yào gēn fùmǔ shāngliang yíxià.
examples.example_translation: I need to talk with my parents about taking the college entrance exam.

examples.example_chinese: 老王，跟你商量件事可以吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎo Wáng, gēn nǐ shāngliang jiàn shì kěyǐ ma?
examples.example_translation: Lao Wang, can I discuss something with you?

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经认真商量过了这个计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng rènzhēn shāngliangguo le zhège jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We have already seriously discussed this plan.

examples.example_chinese: 他们已经商量好了，明年就结婚。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen yǐjīng shāngliang hǎo le, míngnián jiù jiéhūn.
examples.example_translation: They have already agreed to get married next year.

examples.example_chinese: 你们先商量商量，不着急做决定。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen xiān shāngliang shāngliang, bù zhāojí zuò juédìng.
examples.example_translation: You discuss it first, no need to make a decision in a hurry.

meaning: v.表明, 证明 · prove, illustrate, show

examples.example_chinese: 事实说明我们是正确的。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìshí shuōmíng wǒmen shì zhèngquè de.
examples.example_translation: The facts show that we are right.

examples.example_chinese: 研究结果充分说明了这一点。
examples.example_pinyin: Yánjiū jiéguǒ chōngfèn shuōmíngle zhè yī diǎn.
examples.example_translation: The research results fully illustrate this point.

examples.example_chinese: 这张照片说明不了什么问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shuōmíng bu liǎo shénme wèntí.
examples.example_translation: This photo doesn't prove anything.

examples.example_chinese: 他不来，说明他可能害怕了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù lái, shuōmíng tā kěnéng hàipà le.
examples.example_translation: He didn't come, which shows he might be afraid.

meaning: v.打电话时结束通话 · hang up (the telephone)

examples.example_chinese: 刚说了两句话，他就挂了。
examples.example_pinyin: Gāng shuōle liǎng jù huà, tā jiù guà le.
examples.example_translation: He hung up after just saying a couple of sentences.

examples.example_chinese: 他竟然挂了我的电话。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jìngrán guàle wǒ de diànhuà.
examples.example_translation: He actually hung up on me.

examples.example_chinese: 没别的事情，我就挂了。
examples.example_pinyin: Méi bié de shìqing, wǒ jiù guà le.
examples.example_translation: If there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up now.

examples.example_chinese: 挂了电话吧，早点儿睡。
examples.example_pinyin: Guàle diànhuà ba, zǎo diǎnr shuì.
examples.example_translation: Hang up the phone and go to bed early.

examples.example_chinese: 他一听打错了，就赶紧挂了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yì tīng dǎ cuò le, jiù gǎnjǐn guà le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as he heard it was a wrong number, he hung up immediately.

meaning: v.点出来使人知道 · give directions or guidance

examples.example_chinese: 老师看完后，指出了文章中的不少错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī kànwán hòu, zhǐchūle wénzhāng zhōng de bù shǎo cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: After reading, the teacher pointed out many mistakes in the article.

examples.example_chinese: 他的这番话，给我指明了今后的方向。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de zhè fān huà, gěi wǒ zhǐmíngle jīnhòu de fāngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: His words pointed out the direction for my future.

examples.example_chinese: 她让我给她指指点点，我还真说不出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ gěi tā zhǐzhǐ diǎndiǎn, wǒ hái zhēn shuō bu chūlái.
examples.example_translation: She asked me to give her some guidance, but I really couldn't say anything.

examples.example_chinese: 一看指在自己头上
examples.example_pinyin: yī kàn zhǐ zài zì jǐ tóu shàng

examples.example_chinese: 鄂崇禹看罢多时，用枪点指
examples.example_pinyin: è chóng yǔ kàn bà duō shí yòng qiāng diǎn zhǐ

meaning: adj.一点儿不剩, 全没有了 · nothing left, all gone

examples.example_chinese: 他的头发全掉光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de tóufa quán diàoguāng le.
examples.example_translation: All his hair has fallen out.

examples.example_chinese: 那些菜他一个人就吃光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàxiē cài tā yí ge rén jiù chīguāng le.
examples.example_translation: He ate all those dishes by himself.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书已经卖光了，一本也没有了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǐjīng màiguāng le, yì běn yě méiyǒu le.
examples.example_translation: This book is already sold out, there isn’t a single copy left.

examples.example_chinese: 电影还没完，观众都走光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Diànyǐng hái méi wán, guānzhòng dōu zǒuguāng le.
examples.example_translation: The movie isn’t over yet, but all the audience has left.

examples.example_chinese: 我学过的汉语都忘光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xuéguò de Hànyǔ dōu wàngguāng le.
examples.example_translation: I have forgotten all the Chinese I learned.

meaning: v.修理 · repair, mend, fix

examples.example_chinese: 你帮我收拾一下这台电脑吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bāng wǒ shōushi yīxià zhè tái diànnǎo ba.
examples.example_translation: Please help me fix this computer.

examples.example_chinese: 他把自行车收拾好了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zìxíngchē shōushi hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: He has fixed his bicycle.

examples.example_chinese: 这种手机我收拾不了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shǒujī wǒ shōushi bù liǎo.
examples.example_translation: I can't fix this kind of phone.

examples.example_chinese: 这块手表收拾收拾要多少钱？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shōushi shōushi yào duōshǎo qián?
examples.example_translation: How much does it cost to repair this watch?

meaning: adv.表示程度很深 · very, extremely

examples.example_chinese: 我十分喜欢上汉语口语课。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shífēn xǐhuan shàng Hànyǔ kǒuyǔkè.
examples.example_translation: I like attending Chinese speaking classes very much.

examples.example_chinese: 她是个十分美丽的姑娘。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì gè shífēn měilì de gūniang.
examples.example_translation: She is a very beautiful girl.

examples.example_chinese: 锻炼身体对他说十分重要。
examples.example_pinyin: Duànliàn shēntǐ duì tā shuō shífēn zhòngyào.
examples.example_translation: Exercising is very important to him.

examples.example_chinese: 他们对我十分热情，我十分感动。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen duì wǒ shífēn rèqíng, wǒ shífēn gǎndòng.
examples.example_translation: They were very enthusiastic towards me, and I was very moved.

examples.example_chinese: 学好汉语不是件十分容易的事情。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéhǎo Hànyǔ bú shì jiàn shífēn róngyì de shìqing.
examples.example_translation: Learning Chinese well is not a very easy thing.

examples.example_chinese: 男朋友迟到了，这让她十分生气。
examples.example_pinyin: Nánpéngyou chídào le, zhè ràng tā shífēn shēngqì.
examples.example_translation: Her boyfriend was late, which made her very angry.

meaning: n.客观存在的事物或情况 · reality, fact, actuality

examples.example_chinese: 研究问题要注意理论联系实际。
examples.example_pinyin: Yánjiū wèntí yào zhùyì lǐlùn liánxì shíjì.
examples.example_translation: When studying a problem, you should pay attention to linking theory with reality.

examples.example_chinese: 人口多，经济基础差是中国的实际。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénkǒu duō, jīngjì jīchǔ chà shì Zhōngguó de shíjì.
examples.example_translation: A large population and a weak economic foundation are the realities of China.

examples.example_chinese: 你这样做违背了实际，肯定要失败的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò wéibèile shíjì, kěndìng yào shībài de.
examples.example_translation: Doing this goes against reality, you will definitely fail.

examples.example_chinese: 你的想法不符合实际，他根本不会答应的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ bù fúhé shíjì, tā gēnběn bù huì dāyìng de.
examples.example_translation: Your idea does not fit reality, he will never agree to it.

meaning: n.中国的行政区划单位 · province

examples.example_chinese: 我出生在河北省。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ chūshēng zài Héběi Shěng.
examples.example_translation: I was born in Hebei Province.

examples.example_chinese: 山西省是产煤大省。
examples.example_pinyin: Shānxī Shěng shì chǎn méi dà shěng.
examples.example_translation: Shanxi Province is a major coal-producing province.

examples.example_chinese: 明天南方有四个省会有大雨。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān nánfāng yǒu sì gè shěng huì yǒu dà yǔ.
examples.example_translation: Tomorrow, there will be heavy rain in four provincial capitals in the south.

examples.example_chinese: 南京是江苏省的省会城市。
examples.example_pinyin: Nánjīng shì Jiāngsū Shěng de shěnghuì chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: Nanjing is the capital city of Jiangsu Province.

examples.example_pinyin: hé běi shěng zhào xiàn de xiǎo hé shàng yǒu yī zuò shì jiè wén míng de shí gǒng qiáo jiào ān jì qiáo yòu jiào zhào zhōu qiáo

meaning: n. 可以用来充饥的东西, food

examples.example_chinese: 那只老虎正在到处寻找食物。
examples.example_pinyin: nà zhī lǎohǔ zhèngzài dào chù zhǎo shíwù.
examples.example_translation: The tiger is looking for food everywhere.

examples.example_chinese: 冰箱里一点儿食物也没有了。
examples.example_pinyin: bīngxiāng lǐ yīdiǎnr shíwù yě méiyǒu le.
examples.example_translation: There is no food left in the refrigerator.

examples.example_pinyin: tā è jí le, bùguǎn shénme shíwù zhuā qǐlái jiù chī.
examples.example_translation: He was extremely hungry and ate whatever food he could grab.

examples.example_chinese: 这些食物放的时间不短了，你看看过期没有。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē shíwù fàng de shíjiān bù duǎn le, nǐ kànkan guòqī méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: These foods have been stored for a long time, check if they are expired.

examples.example_chinese: 学校为每个运动员准备了充足的食物和水。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéxiào wèi měi gè yùndòngyuán zhǔnbèi le chōngzú de shíwù hé shuǐ.
examples.example_translation: The school prepared enough food and water for every athlete.

meaning: adj.真实的, 不虚假的 · true, honest

examples.example_chinese: 他对人很实在，不会说假话、骗人那一套。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn shízài, bù huì shuō jiǎ huà, piàn rén nà yí tào.
examples.example_translation: He is very honest with people and never lies or cheats.

examples.example_chinese: 我看他是个实在人，就告诉了他真实的价格。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kàn tā shì gè shízài rén, jiù gàosu le tā zhēnshí de jiàgé.
examples.example_translation: I saw that he was an honest person, so I told him the real price.

examples.example_chinese: 老王比小王实在很多，我宁可相信老王的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎo Wáng bǐ Xiǎo Wáng shízài hěn duō, wǒ nìngkě xiāngxìn Lǎo Wáng de huà.
examples.example_translation: Old Wang is much more honest than Little Wang, I would rather believe Old Wang.

examples.example_chinese: 那人说话特别实在，不像骗子。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà rén shuōhuà tèbié shízài, bù xiàng piànzi.
examples.example_translation: That person speaks very honestly, not like a swindler.

examples.example_chinese: 他做人实实在在的，因此得到了大家的尊敬。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuòrén shíshízàizài de, yīncǐ dédàole dàjiā de zūnjìng.
examples.example_translation: He is a truly honest person, so he has earned everyone's respect.

meaning: v.为了某个目的用（人员、财物等） · use, make use of, employ, (of personnel, utensils, etc.) serve some purpose

examples.example_chinese: 上课的时候，请不要使用手机。
examples.example_pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, qǐng búyào shǐyòng shǒujī.
examples.example_translation: Please do not use your mobile phone during class.

examples.example_chinese: 医生使用了最先进的方法，治好了他的病。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīshēng shǐyòng le zuì xiānjìn de fāngfǎ, zhìhǎole tā de bìng.
examples.example_translation: The doctor used the most advanced methods and cured his illness.

examples.example_chinese: 这支笔我使用了很多年。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ wǒ shǐyòngle hěn duō nián.
examples.example_translation: I have used this pen for many years.

examples.example_chinese: 电梯坏了，现在禁止使用。
examples.example_pinyin: Diàntī huài le, xiànzài jìnzhǐ shǐyòng.
examples.example_translation: The elevator is broken and is now out of use.

examples.example_chinese: 这本教材被广泛使用，受到了好评。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn jiàocái bèi guǎngfàn shǐyòng, shòudàole hǎo píng.
examples.example_translation: This textbook is widely used and has received good reviews.

examples.example_chinese: 他的电脑使用得很仔细，没出过什么问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de diànnǎo shǐyòng de hěn zǐxì, méi chūguò shénme wèntí.
examples.example_translation: He uses his computer very carefully and has never had any problems with it.

meaning: prep.以人或事物为媒介或手段而达到某种目的 · by means of, by way of, by, through

examples.example_chinese: 通过他的介绍，我们认识了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tōngguò tā de jièshào, wǒmen rènshi le.
examples.example_translation: We got to know each other through his introduction.

examples.example_chinese: 通过讨论，我们取得了一致的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Tōngguò tǎolùn, wǒmen qǔdéle yízhì de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Through discussion, we reached a consensus.

examples.example_chinese: 我每天通过电话跟父母联系。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān tōngguò diànhuà gēn fùmǔ liánxì.
examples.example_translation: I contact my parents every day by phone.

examples.example_chinese: 他们通过调查，找出了事故的原因。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen tōngguò diàochá, zhǎochūle shìgù de yuányīn.
examples.example_translation: They found out the cause of the accident through investigation.

examples.example_chinese: 通过大家的帮助，我已经战胜了困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Tōngguò dàjiā de bāngzhù, wǒ yǐjīng zhànshèngle kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: With everyone's help, I have already overcome the difficulties.

meaning: n.收进来的钱财, 物品等 · income, earnings

examples.example_chinese: 教师的收入比以前提高了不少。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoshī de shōurù bǐ yǐqián tígāole bù shǎo.
examples.example_translation: Teachers' income has increased a lot compared to before.

examples.example_chinese: 公司这个月有十几万的收入。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī zhège yuè yǒu shí jǐ wàn de shōurù.
examples.example_translation: The company has an income of over a hundred thousand this month.

examples.example_chinese: 工厂决定增加工人的收入。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngchǎng juédìng zēngjiā gōngrén de shōurù.
examples.example_translation: The factory decided to increase the workers' income.

examples.example_chinese: 收入提高了，他就想着怎么把日子过得更舒服一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Shōurù tígāo le, tā jiù xiǎngzhe zěnme bǎ rìzi guò de gèng shūfu yīxiē.
examples.example_translation: With higher income, he thought about how to live more comfortably.

examples.example_chinese: 他每个月的收入基本够自己花。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè de shōurù jīběn gòu zìjǐ huā.
examples.example_translation: His monthly income is basically enough for his own expenses.

meaning: v.用道理说服别人使按照规则, 要求做 · educate

examples.example_chinese: 我们要教育青少年，让他们懂得节约。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiàoyù qīngshàonián, ràng tāmen dǒngdé jiéyuē.

examples.example_pinyin: Jiāzhǎng jiàoyù háizi yào dòng lǐmào.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子不懂道理，就应该进行教育。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi bù dǒng dàolǐ, jiù yīnggāi jìnxíng jiàoyù.
examples.example_translation: If children do not understand reason, they should be educated.

examples.example_chinese: 轻轻地推门进去，什么声息也没有，妻已睡熟好久了。
examples.example_pinyin: qīng qīng de tuī mén jìn qù shēng xī yě méi yǒu yǐ shuì shú hǎojiǔ le

examples.example_translation: Can you tell me the exact number?

examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shàngmian de shùzì wǒ kàn bu qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: I can't see the numbers on this.

examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó rén yìbān bù xǐhuan “4” zhège shùzì, xīfāng rén yìbān bù xǐhuan “13” zhège shùzì.

examples.example_chinese: 他在每一张照片上都写上了数字。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài měi yì zhāng zhàopiàn shang dōu xiěshangle shùzì.
examples.example_translation: He wrote numbers on every photo.

meaning: adj.做事时没有阻碍或很少遇到困难 · smooth, without a hitch, successful

examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de chūguó shǒuxù bàn de hěn shùnlì.
examples.example_translation: My procedures for going abroad went very smoothly.

examples.example_chinese: 他最近几年的生意非常顺利。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuìjìn jǐ nián de shēngyì fēicháng shùnlì.
examples.example_translation: His business has been very successful in recent years.

examples.example_chinese: 他顺利地通过了汉语水平考试。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shùnlì de tōngguòle Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì.

examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shùnlì wánchéngle zhè xiàng gōngzuò.

examples.example_pinyin: Zhù nǐ lǚtú shùnlì! Yílù píng'ān!
examples.example_translation: Wish you a smooth journey! Safe travels!

meaning: v.解释清楚 · explain

examples.example_chinese: 妹妹向我说明了事情发生的原因。
examples.example_pinyin: Mèimei xiàng wǒ shuōmíngle shìqíng fāshēng de yuányīn.
examples.example_translation: My younger sister explained to me the reason why the incident happened.

examples.example_chinese: 你为什么不同意？请说明理由。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bù tóngyì? Qǐng shuōmíng lǐyóu.
examples.example_translation: Why do you disagree? Please explain the reason.

examples.example_chinese: 我来向大家说明事情的经过。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ lái xiàng dàjiā shuōmíng shìqíng de jīngguò.
examples.example_translation: Let me explain to everyone what happened.

examples.example_chinese: 工作上的要求已经向大家说明了。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò shang de yāoqiú yǐjīng xiàng dàjiā shuōmíng le.
examples.example_translation: The work requirements have already been explained to everyone.

examples.example_chinese: 你能说明一下它的使用方法吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng shuōmíng yīxià tā de shǐyòng fāngfǎ ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you explain how to use it?

meaning: v.一个一个地计算(数目) · to count

examples.example_chinese: 你数一下车上有多少人。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ shǔ yī shǔ chē shàng yǒu duōshǎo rén.
examples.example_translation: Count how many people are on the bus.

examples.example_chinese: 我数了两遍, 还是42个。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shǔle liǎng biàn, háishì 42 gè.
examples.example_translation: I counted twice, and it's still 42.

examples.example_chinese: 这是找你的钱, 你数数。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì zhǎo nǐ de qián, nǐ shǔ shǔ.
examples.example_translation: This is your change, please count it.

examples.example_chinese: 我数过了, 这篇文章还有六百个字。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shǔguòle, zhè piān wénzhāng háiyǒu liùbǎi gè zì.
examples.example_translation: I've counted, this article still has six hundred characters.

examples.example_chinese: 这么多人, 我一天也数不完。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème duō rén, wǒ yītiān yě shǔ bù wán.
examples.example_translation: With so many people, I can't finish counting in one day.

meaning: v. 计算数目, 解数学题等, calculate, figure; 计算进去, include, count; 认为, 当作, consider, regard as, count as

examples.example_chinese: 你算一下共需要多少钱？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ suàn yíxià yígòng xūyào duōshao qián?
examples.example_translation: Can you calculate how much money is needed in total?

examples.example_chinese: 这道数学题谁都不会算。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè dào shùxuétí shéi dōu bú huì suàn.
examples.example_translation: No one can solve this math problem.

examples.example_chinese: 我帮你算算该交多少钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ suànsuan gāi jiāo duōshao qián.
examples.example_translation: Let me help you figure out how much you should pay.

examples.example_chinese: 我仔细算过了，没错。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zǐxì suànguòle, méi cuò.
examples.example_translation: I calculated carefully, it's correct.

examples.example_chinese: 你再算一遍，看看这个数字对不对。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zài suàn yí biàn, kànkan zhège shùzì duì bu duì.
examples.example_translation: Calculate it again and see if this number is correct.

examples.example_chinese: 算老师，我们一共八个人。
examples.example_pinyin: Suàn lǎoshī, wǒmen yígòng bā ge rén.
examples.example_translation: Including the teacher, there are eight of us in total.

examples.example_chinese: 明天爬山算我一个。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān pá shān suàn wǒ yí ge.
examples.example_translation: Count me in for mountain climbing tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 你算上这个孩子了吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ suànshang zhège háizi le ma?
examples.example_translation: Did you include this child?

examples.example_chinese: 你统计队员的时候，不能把教练算进去。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ tǒngjì duìyuán de shíhou, bù néng bǎ jiàoliàn suàn jìnqù.
examples.example_translation: When counting the team members, don't include the coach.

examples.example_chinese: 他把你算到工作人员里了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ nǐ suàndào gōngzuò rényuán lǐ le.
examples.example_translation: He counted you as a staff member.

examples.example_chinese: 他算是个很好的老师。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā suàn shì ge hěn hǎo de lǎoshī.
examples.example_translation: He can be considered a very good teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 你喝的是饮料，怎么能算喝酒呢？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ hē de shì yǐnliào, zěnme néng suàn hē jiǔ le ne?
examples.example_translation: What you drank was a soft drink, how can that count as drinking alcohol?

examples.example_chinese: 这个房子不算太大。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège fángzi bù suàn tài dà.
examples.example_translation: This house is not considered very big.

examples.example_chinese: 这回算我输了，下次比赛。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè huí suàn wǒ shū le, xià cì zài bǐsài.
examples.example_translation: This time I admit defeat, let's compete again next time.

meaning: adj.不受限制, 不加约束的 · casual, random, informal

examples.example_chinese: 我还没想好买什么，只是随便看看。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo mǎi shénme, zhǐshì suíbiàn kànkan.
examples.example_translation: I haven't decided what to buy yet, I'm just looking around casually.

examples.example_chinese: 你随便坐，别客气。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ suíbiàn zuò, bié kèqi.
examples.example_translation: Sit anywhere you like, make yourself at home.

examples.example_chinese: A: 你想吃什么？B: 我随便。
examples.example_pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? B: Wǒ suíbiàn.
examples.example_translation: A: What do you want to eat? B: Anything is fine with me.

examples.example_chinese: 我们随便吃点儿什么就可以了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen suíbiàn chī diǎnr shénme jiù kěyǐ le.
examples.example_translation: We can just eat whatever, it's fine.

examples.example_chinese: 这里就像自己的家，我感到很随便。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli jiù xiàng zìjǐ de jiā, wǒ gǎndào hěn suíbiàn.
examples.example_translation: Here feels just like home, I feel very relaxed.

meaning: adj.全部 · all

examples.example_chinese: 所有的同学都参加了这次活动。
examples.example_pinyin: Suǒyǒu de tóngxué dōu cānjiāle zhè cì huódòng.
examples.example_translation: All the students participated in this activity.

examples.example_chinese: 我把所有的地方都找遍了，就是找不到他。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎ suǒyǒu de dìfang dōu zhǎobiàn le, jiù shì zhǎo bu dào tā.
examples.example_translation: I searched everywhere, but just couldn't find him.

examples.example_chinese: 他把所有的工作都做了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de gōngzuò dōu zuò le.
examples.example_translation: He did all the work.

examples.example_chinese: 父亲把自己所有的财产都给了儿子。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùqīn bǎ zìjǐ suǒyǒu de cáichǎn dōu gěile érzi.
examples.example_translation: The father gave all his property to his son.

examples.example_chinese: 所有这一切都说明，他说的都是谎话。
examples.example_pinyin: Suǒyǒu zhè yíqiè dōu shuōmíng, tā shuō de dōu shì huǎnghuà.
examples.example_translation: All this shows that what he said was all lies.

examples.example_chinese: 他回答了我所有的问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā huídále wǒ suǒyǒu de wèntí.
examples.example_translation: He answered all my questions.

meaning: adv.有耐心地, 尽力地 · painstakingly

examples.example_chinese: 学习任何一项技术都不容易，都需要勤学苦练。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxí rènhé yí xiàng jìshù dōu bù róngyì, dōu xūyào qín xué kǔ liàn.
examples.example_translation: Learning any skill is not easy, it requires diligent and painstaking practice.

examples.example_chinese: 运动员们每天都要苦练几个小时。
examples.example_pinyin: Yùndòngyuánměi tiān dōu yào kǔ liàn jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.example_translation: Athletes have to train hard for several hours every day.

meaning: v.就某一问题交换意见或进行辩论 · talk over, discuss

examples.example_chinese: 大家讨论了环境保护问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā tǎolùnle huánjìng bǎohù wèntí.
examples.example_translation: Everyone discussed the issue of environmental protection.

examples.example_chinese: 这个计划已经讨论过很多次了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège jìhuà yǐjīng tǎolùnguo hěn duō cì le.
examples.example_translation: This plan has already been discussed many times.

examples.example_chinese: 同学们讨论得非常热烈。
examples.example_pinyin: Tóngxuémen tǎolùn de fēicháng rèliè.
examples.example_translation: The students discussed very enthusiastically.

examples.example_chinese: 关于这个问题，我们还要讨论讨论才能决定。
examples.example_pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒmen hái yào tǎolùn tǎolùn cái néng juédìng.
examples.example_translation: We still need to discuss this issue before making a decision.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经讨论完了，意见也都统一了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng tǎolùn wán le, yìjiàn yě dōu tóngyì le.
examples.example_translation: We have finished the discussion and reached a consensus.

examples.example_chinese: 这次讨论我们没有形成一致的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì tǎolùn wǒmen méiyǒu xíngchéng yízhì de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: We did not reach a consensus in this discussion.

examples.example_chinese: 一次又一次的讨论，让我们对问题有了更深的认识。
examples.example_pinyin: Yì cì yòu yí cì de tǎolùn, ràng wǒmen duì wèntí yǒule gèng shēn de rènshi.
examples.example_translation: Repeated discussions have given us a deeper understanding of the issue.

meaning: n.人的举止神情 · bearing or manner

examples.example_chinese: 这些服务员的态度都很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē fúwùyuán de tàidu dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: The attitude of these waiters is very good.

examples.example_chinese: 老师们热情的态度让我感到很亲切。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshīmen rèqíng de tàidu ràng wǒ gǎndào hěn qīnqiè.
examples.example_translation: The teachers' enthusiastic attitude made me feel very warm.

examples.example_chinese: 我不太满意他们的服务态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bú tài mǎnyì tāmen de fúwù tàidu.
examples.example_translation: I'm not very satisfied with their service attitude.

examples.example_chinese: 你现在是跟经理讲话，请注意你的态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài shì gēn jīnglǐ jiǎnghuà, qǐng zhùyì nǐ de tàidu.
examples.example_translation: You are talking to the manager now, please pay attention to your attitude.

examples.example_chinese: 每一个人都会在意他人对自己的态度
examples.example_pinyin: měi yí gè rén dōu huì zài yì tārén duì zì jǐ de tài du

meaning: n.人或事物所具有的独特的地方 · characteristic, distinguishing feature, peculiarity

examples.example_chinese: 北京有个特点，就是名胜古迹特别多。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng yǒu ge tèdiǎn, jiù shì míngshèng gǔjì tèbié duō.
examples.example_translation: Beijing has a characteristic: it has especially many places of historic interest and scenic beauty.

examples.example_chinese: 他说话很有特点，一会儿慢一会儿快。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒu tèdiǎn, yíhuìr màn yíhuìr kuài.
examples.example_translation: He speaks in a very distinctive way, sometimes slow, sometimes fast.

examples.example_chinese: 我们生产的产品要有自己的特点。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shēngchǎn de chǎnpǐn yào yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: The products we produce should have their own characteristics.

examples.example_chinese: 请大家谈谈这篇文章的写作特点。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā tán tán zhè piān wénzhāng de xiězuò tèdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Please talk about the writing characteristics of this article.

examples.example_chinese: 给人物画像重要的是找准他的特点。
examples.example_pinyin: Gěi rénwù huà xiàng zhòngyào de shì zhǎozhǔn tā de tèdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: The important thing in drawing a portrait is to capture the person's characteristics accurately.

meaning: v.垂手拿着 · carry in one's hand with the arm down

examples.example_chinese: 他手里提着两条鱼。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shǒulǐ tí zhe liǎng tiáo yú.
examples.example_translation: He is carrying two fish in his hand.

examples.example_chinese: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège xínglǐxiāng tài zhòng le, wǒ tí bù qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: This suitcase is too heavy, I can't lift it.

examples.example_chinese: 我帮你提这些塑料袋吧。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ bāng nǐ tí zhèxiē sùliàodài ba.
examples.example_translation: Let me help you carry these plastic bags.

examples.example_chinese: 我没带包，只好提着这些东西了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ méi dài bāo, zhǐhǎo tí zhe zhèxiē dōngxi le.
examples.example_translation: I didn't bring a bag, so I have to carry these things.

examples.example_chinese: 他提着一桶油回家了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā tí zhe yī tǒng yóu huí jiā le.
examples.example_translation: He carried a bucket of oil home.

meaning: v.把整的换成零的 · change (money) into smaller denominations;

examples.example_chinese: 请将这张一百元的破成两张五十的。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng jiāng zhè zhāng yì bǎi yuán de pòchéng liǎng zhāng wǔshí de.
examples.example_translation: Please change this one-hundred-yuan bill into two fifties.

examples.example_chinese: 零钱我找不开，你能破成零钱吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhěng qián wǒ zhǎo bù kāi, nǐ néng pòchéng língqián ma?
examples.example_translation: I can’t make change for a large bill, can you break it into smaller bills?

examples.example_chinese: 你能帮我破一下这钱吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ pò yīxià zhè qián ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you help me break this money?

meaning: adv.表示不必考虑别的, 放心去做 · feel free to

examples.example_chinese: 你尽管说，不要怕出错。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jǐnguǎn shuō, bùyào pà chūcuò.
examples.example_translation: Feel free to speak, don't be afraid of making mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈尽管放心，我会照顾好自己的。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma jǐnguǎn fàngxīn, wǒ huì zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ de.
examples.example_translation: Mom, don't worry, I'll take good care of myself.

examples.example_chinese: 你尽管买，不用考虑钱的问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jǐnguǎn mǎi, bùyòng kǎolǜ qián de wèntí.
examples.example_translation: Just buy it, don't worry about the money.

examples.example_chinese: 你尽管在这里住，别的都不用操心。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jǐnguǎn zài zhèlǐ zhù, biéde dōu bùyòng cāoxīn.
examples.example_translation: Feel free to live here, don't worry about anything else.

examples.example_chinese: 有什么问题尽管提出来，大家会帮你想办法。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu shénme wèntí jǐnguǎn tí chulai, dàjiā huì bāng nǐ xiǎng bànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: If you have any questions, just bring them up, everyone will help you find a solution.

meaning: n.所具有的状况 · condition

examples.example_chinese: 我们学校的数学条件很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de shùxué tiáojiàn hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: The math conditions at our school are very good.

examples.example_chinese: 农村的生活条件很艰苦，你要做好思想准备。
examples.example_pinyin: Nóngcūn de shēnghuó tiáojiàn hěn jiānkǔ, nǐ yào zuòhǎo sīxiǎng zhǔnbèi.
examples.example_translation: Living conditions in the countryside are tough, you need to be mentally prepared.

examples.example_chinese: 他的家庭条件比我们都好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jiātíng tiáojiàn bǐ wǒmen dōu hǎo.
examples.example_translation: His family conditions are better than all of ours.

examples.example_chinese: 她的身体条件不错，可以培养成一个舞蹈演员。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ tiáojiàn bùcuò, kěyǐ péiyǎng chéng yí ge wǔdǎo yǎnyuán.
examples.example_translation: Her physical condition is good, she can be trained to be a dancer.

examples.example_chinese: 就得答应条件
examples.example_pinyin: jiù děi dāying tiáo jiàn

meaning: adj.数量小, 程度浅 · small in number, degree, etc. of intensity

examples.example_chinese: 他虽然年纪轻，可力气很大。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì qīng, kě lìqi hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: Although he is young, he is very strong.

examples.example_chinese: 你不舒服，就干点儿轻活儿吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bù shūfu, jiù gàn diǎnr qīng huór ba.
examples.example_translation: If you’re not feeling well, just do some light work.

examples.example_chinese: 这件礼物虽轻，可它代表了我的心意。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn lǐwù suī qīng, kě tā dàibiǎole wǒ de xīnyì.
examples.example_translation: Although this gift is light, it represents my feelings.

examples.example_chinese: 他受的伤比较轻，会很快好起来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shòu de shāng bǐjiào qīng, huì hěn kuài hǎo qǐlái de.
examples.example_translation: His injury is relatively minor and will heal quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 我们的任务可不轻，大家不能放松。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de rènwu kě bù qīng, dàjiā bù néng fàngsōng.
examples.example_translation: Our task is not easy, everyone must not relax.

meaning: v.停放(车辆等) · to park (a vehicle)

examples.example_chinese: 这里不能停车。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ bùnéng tíngchē.
examples.example_translation: You can't park here.

examples.example_chinese: 我把自行车停在门口了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zìxíngchē tíng zài ménkǒu le.
examples.example_translation: I parked my bicycle at the entrance.

meaning: adj.真实可靠的 · reliable, true

examples.example_chinese: 我们得到了确实的消息，试验获得了成功。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen dédàole quèshí de xiāoxi, shìyàn huòdéle chénggōng.
examples.example_translation: We received reliable news that the experiment was successful.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事情是否确实还需要进一步核实。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing shìfǒu quèshí hái xūyào jìnyībù héshí.
examples.example_translation: Whether this matter is true still needs further verification.

examples.example_chinese: 我得到了他确实的保证。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dédàole tā quèshí de bǎozhèng.
examples.example_translation: I received his reliable guarantee.

examples.example_chinese: 这个数字是确实的，也是可靠的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège shùzì shì quèshí de, yě shì kěkào de.
examples.example_translation: This number is true and also reliable.

meaning: v.停止 · to stop, to cease

examples.example_chinese: 雨终于停了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǔ zhōngyú tíng le.
examples.example_translation: The rain has finally stopped.

examples.example_chinese: 请在这里停一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ tíng yīxià.
examples.example_translation: Please stop here for a moment.

examples.example_chinese: 我的手表停了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de shǒubiǎo tíng le.
examples.example_translation: My watch has stopped.

examples.example_chinese: 刮风下雨不许停
examples.example_pinyin: guā fēng xià yǔ bùxǔ tíng

examples.example_chinese: 哥哥就停在后营
examples.example_pinyin: gē ge jiù tíng zài hòu yíng

meaning: v.停留 · to stay, to stop over

examples.example_chinese: 我们计划在这个城市停两天。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà zài zhège chéngshì tíng liǎng tiān.
examples.example_translation: We plan to stay in this city for two days.

examples.example_chinese: 他的目光在画上停了很久。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de mùguāng zài huà shàng tíng le hěn jiǔ.
