examples.example_translation: The temperature here in winter is very low, it's extremely cold.

examples.example_chinese: 这几天温度下降了，还常常刮风。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wēndù xiàjiàng le, hái chángcháng guā fēng.
examples.example_translation: The temperature has dropped these days, and it's often windy.

examples.example_chinese: 明天温度会升高一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān wēndù huì shēnggāo yìxiē.
examples.example_translation: The temperature will rise a bit tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 现在屋里的温度比外面还低。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài wūlǐ de wēndù bǐ wàimiàn hái dī.
examples.example_translation: The temperature inside the room is even lower than outside now.

examples.example_chinese: 你可能发烧了，量量身体的温度吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěnéng fāshāo le, liángliang shēntǐ de wēndù ba.
examples.example_translation: You may have a fever, check your body temperature.

meaning: n.热闹的景象或场面（常儿化） · a scene of bustle and excitement

examples.example_chinese: 我们上街看热闹儿去。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shàng jiē kàn rènaor qù.
examples.example_translation: We went out to see the excitement.

examples.example_chinese: 你们这地方热闹儿真不少。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen zhè dìfang rènaor zhēn bù shǎo.
examples.example_translation: There is a lot of excitement in your area.

examples.example_chinese: 哪儿有热闹儿他就往哪儿去。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǎr yǒu rènaor tā jiù wǎng nǎr qù.
examples.example_translation: Wherever there is excitement, he goes there.

examples.example_chinese: 你看到什么热闹儿了？快跟我说说。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kàndào shénme rènaor le? Kuài gēn wǒ shuōshuō.
examples.example_translation: What excitement did you see? Tell me quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 我没参加，一旁看热闹儿来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi cānjiā, zài yìpáng kàn rènaor láizhe.
examples.example_translation: I didn't take part, I just watched the excitement from the side.

meaning: v.谈(起,到) · mention, refer to

examples.example_chinese: 老王经常提起你。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎo Wáng jīngcháng tíqǐ nǐ.
examples.example_translation: Old Wang often mentions you.

examples.example_chinese: 提到这个问题，我想多说几句。
examples.example_pinyin: tídào zhège wèntí, wǒ xiǎng duō shuō jǐ jù.
examples.example_translation: Speaking of this issue, I want to say a few more words.

examples.example_chinese: 我不想再提过去那些事了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng zài tí guòqù nàxiē shì le.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to mention those past things anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 会上大家提了很多建议。
examples.example_pinyin: huì shàng dàjiā tí le hěn duō jiànyì.
examples.example_translation: At the meeting, everyone made many suggestions.

examples.example_chinese: 有什么意见请你直接提出来。
examples.example_pinyin: yǒu shénme yìjiàn qǐng nǐ zhíjiē tíchūlái.
examples.example_translation: If you have any opinions, please bring them up directly.

meaning: n.向上级或有关部门提出的请求或要求 · application

examples.example_chinese: 你的申请被批准了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de shēnqǐng bèi pīzhǔn le.
examples.example_translation: Your application has been approved.

examples.example_chinese: 你可以向公司提出你的申请。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiàng gōngsī tíchū nǐ de shēnqǐng.
examples.example_translation: You can submit your application to the company.

examples.example_chinese: 我写了一个工作调动的申请。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiěle yī gè gōngzuò diàodòng de shēnqǐng.
examples.example_translation: I wrote an application for a job transfer.

examples.example_chinese: 请领导考虑我的申请。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng lǐngdǎo kǎolǜ wǒ de shēnqǐng.
examples.example_translation: Please ask the leader to consider my application.

meaning: adj.彼此一样，没有区别 · same

examples.example_chinese: 我和他的爱好相同。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hé tā de àihào xiāngtóng.
examples.example_translation: I have the same hobby as his.

examples.example_chinese: 我们的想法完全相同。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ wánquán xiāngtóng.
examples.example_translation: We have exactly the same idea.

examples.example_chinese: 你能看出两张画儿有什么相同的地方吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng kànchū liǎng zhāng huàr yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfang ma?
examples.example_translation: Could you tell me the similarities between the two pictures?

examples.example_chinese: 对于这部电影，我们有相同的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú zhè bù diànyǐng, wǒmen yǒu xiāngtóng de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: We have the same opinion about this movie.

examples.example_chinese: 相同的爱好和相似的经历使他们走到了一起。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiāngtóng de àihào hé xiāngsì de jīnglì shǐ tāmen zǒudàole yīqǐ.
examples.example_translation: The same hobby and similar experience brought them together.

examples.example_chinese: 她们虽然是姐妹，可性格一点儿也不相同。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen suīrán shì jiěmèi, kě xìnggé yìdiǎnr yě bù xiāngtóng.
examples.example_translation: Although they are sisters, they have totally different personalities.

meaning: v.发出声音 · make a sound, ring

examples.example_chinese: 上课铃响了，学生们都走进了教室。
examples.example_pinyin: Shàngkè líng xiǎng le, xuéshēngmen dōu zǒujìnle jiàoshì.
examples.example_translation: The class bell rang, and the students all entered the classroom.

examples.example_chinese: 闹钟一响，我就起床了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàozhōng yī xiǎng, wǒ jiù qǐchuáng le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as the alarm clock rings, I get up.

examples.example_chinese: 演出结束时，观众响起了一片掌声。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǎnchū jiéshù shí, guānzhòng xiǎngqǐle yí piàn zhǎngshēng.
examples.example_translation: At the end of the performance, the audience burst into applause.

examples.example_chinese: 外边响起了广播的声音。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàibian xiǎngqǐle guǎngbō de shēngyīn.
examples.example_translation: The sound of a broadcast rang out outside.

examples.example_chinese: 不要以为我们一部分人把排骨吐得劈拍响便断定我们的吃相不佳。
examples.example_pinyin: bù yào yǐ wèi wǒ yī bù fēn rén bǎ pái ù děi pī pāi xiǎng biàn duàn dìng wǒ de chī bù

meaning: n.一种叙事性的文学体裁 · novel, fiction

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢读外国小说。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan dú wàiguó xiǎoshuō.
examples.example_translation: I really like reading foreign novels.

examples.example_chinese: 他一生写了大量的小说，有的流传很广。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yìshēng xiěle dàliàng de xiǎoshuō, yǒu de liúchuán hěn guǎng.
examples.example_translation: He wrote a large number of novels in his life, some of which became very popular.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影是根据长篇小说改编的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì gēnjù chángpiān xiǎoshuō gǎibiān de.
examples.example_translation: This film is adapted from a novel.

examples.example_chinese: 这篇小说内容深刻，很有教育意义。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān xiǎoshuō nèiróng shēnkè, hěn yǒu jiàoyù yìyì.
examples.example_translation: This novel has profound content and is very educational.

examples.example_chinese: 世界上大部分著名小说我都读过。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìjiè shàng dà bùfen zhùmíng xiǎoshuō wǒ dōu dúguo.
examples.example_translation: I have read most of the famous novels in the world.

meaning: v.皮肤、毛发等）脱落 · (of skin, hair, etc.) shed, drop, come or fall out

examples.example_chinese: 这种洗发水可以有效地防脱发。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xǐfàshuǐ kěyǐ yǒuxiào de fáng tuōfà.
examples.example_translation: This shampoo can effectively prevent hair loss.

examples.example_chinese: 这条狗有点儿脱毛。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo gǒu yǒudiǎn tuōmáo.
examples.example_translation: This dog is shedding a bit.

meaning: v.耻笑, 讥笑 · laugh at, ridicule

examples.example_chinese: 他总爱笑话人，其实很多方面还不如别人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒng ài xiàohua biéren, qíshí hěn duō fāngmiàn hái bùrú biéren.
examples.example_translation: He always laughs at others, but in many ways he is not as good as them.

examples.example_chinese: 我们俩水平差不多，谁也别笑话谁。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ shuǐpíng chàbuduō, shéi yě bié xiàohua shéi.
examples.example_translation: We are about the same level, so neither of us should laugh at the other.

examples.example_chinese: 你穿这身衣服，不怕被人笑话？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ chuān zhè shēn yīfu, bú pà bèi rén xiàohua?
examples.example_translation: Aren't you afraid people will laugh at you for wearing these clothes?

examples.example_chinese: 说出来不怕大家笑话，我身上一分钱也没有了。
examples.example_pinyin: Shuō chūlái bú pà dàjiā xiàohua, wǒ shēnshang yì fēn qián yě méiyǒu le.
examples.example_translation: I'm not afraid to say it, even if everyone laughs at me: I don't have a cent left.

examples.example_chinese: 因为想看你笑话的人
examples.example_pinyin: yīn wèi xiǎng kàn nǐ xiào hua de rén

meaning: n.感情状态 · state of mind, mood

examples.example_chinese: 他今天有说有笑的，心情特别好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān yǒu shuō yǒu xiào de, xīnqíng tèbié hǎo.
examples.example_translation: He was talking and laughing today, in a particularly good mood.

examples.example_chinese: 考试没考好，影响了我的心情。
examples.example_pinyin: Kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, yǐngxiǎng le wǒ de xīnqíng.
examples.example_translation: Not doing well on the exam affected my mood.

examples.example_chinese: 听到这个消息，他的心情特别沉重。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā de xīnqíng tèbié chénzhòng.
examples.example_translation: Hearing this news, his mood became especially heavy.

examples.example_chinese: 参加毕业典礼的时候，我们的心情都很激动。
examples.example_pinyin: Cānjiā bìyè diǎnlǐ de shíhou, wǒmen de xīnqíng dōu hěn jīdòng.
examples.example_translation: When attending the graduation ceremony, we were all very excited.

examples.example_chinese: 我很理解你现在的心情。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn lǐjiě nǐ xiànzài de xīnqíng.
examples.example_translation: I really understand your current mood.

examples.example_chinese: 我现在没心情出去玩儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài méi xīnqíng chūqù wánr.
examples.example_translation: I'm not in the mood to go out and have fun right now.

meaning: n.用来传递消息或命令的光、电波、声音、动作等 · signal, a sign given by light, electric wave, sound, gesture, etc. to convey information or a command

examples.example_chinese: 我的手机在这里没有信号。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de shǒujī zài zhèlǐ méiyǒu xìnhào.
examples.example_translation: My phone has no signal here.

examples.example_chinese: 他们发出了求救的信号。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen fāchū le qiújiù de xìnhào.
examples.example_translation: They sent out a distress signal.

examples.example_chinese: 开车时要主要观察交通信号。
examples.example_pinyin: kāichē shí yào zhǔyào guānchá jiāotōng xìnhào.
examples.example_translation: When driving, you should mainly observe traffic signals.

examples.example_chinese: 这个红信号灯不亮了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè ge hóng xìnhào dēng bù liàng le.
examples.example_translation: This red signal light is not working.

examples.example_chinese: 身体会发出各种信号。
examples.example_pinyin: shēn tǐ huì fā chū gèzhǒng xìnhào

meaning: n.相信自己的愿望一定能够实现的心理 · confidence, faith, belief

examples.example_chinese: 他对学好汉语很有信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì xuéhǎo Hànyǔ hěn yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: He is very confident about learning Chinese well.

examples.example_chinese: 大家的鼓励增强了他克服困难的信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā de gǔlì zēngqiángle tā kèfú kùnnán de xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: Everyone's encouragement strengthened his confidence to overcome difficulties.

examples.example_chinese: 大家树立了胜利的信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā shùlìle shènglì de xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: Everyone has built up confidence in victory.

examples.example_chinese: 他对自己的前途充满了信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de qiántú chōngmǎnle xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: He is full of confidence about his future.

examples.example_chinese: 无论什么时候都不要丧失信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Wúlùn shénme shíhòu dōu bùyào sàngshī xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: Never lose confidence at any time.

examples.example_chinese: 对于能否成功，他显得有些信心不足。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú néngfǒu chénggōng, tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē xìnxīn bù zú.
examples.example_translation: He seems to lack some confidence about whether he can succeed.

meaning: n.音信, 消息 · information

examples.example_chinese: 他们提供的信息很可靠。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen tígōng de xìnxī hěn kěkào.
examples.example_translation: The information they provided is very reliable.

examples.example_chinese: 我们现在很难得到外面的信息。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen xiànzài hěn nán dédào wàimiàn de xìnxī.
examples.example_translation: It's hard for us to get information from outside now.

examples.example_chinese: 他不了解市场信息,做生意赔了很多。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bù liǎojiě shìchǎng xìnxī, zuò shēngyi kuī le hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: He didn't understand market information and lost a lot in business.

examples.example_chinese: 我们了解到的信息是,他曾经是一名教师。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen liǎojiě dào de xìnxī shì, tā céng jīng shì yī míng jiàoshī.
examples.example_translation: The information we learned is that he was once a teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 现在是信息社会,信息就是财富。
examples.example_pinyin: xiànzài shì xìnxī shèhuì, xìnxī jiù shì cáifù.
examples.example_translation: Now is the information society, and information is wealth.

meaning: n.为某事提出的要求或者定出的标准 · requirement, prerequisite, qualification

examples.example_chinese: 两个人谈好了离婚的条件。
examples.example_pinyin: Liǎng ge rén tánhǎo le líhūn de tiáojiàn.
examples.example_translation: The two people have agreed on the conditions for divorce.

examples.example_chinese: 我可以原谅你，条件是你得承认错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yuánliàng nǐ, tiáojiàn shì nǐ děi chéngrèn cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: I can forgive you, on the condition that you admit your mistake.

examples.example_chinese: 对方没提什么条件，谈判很顺利。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìfāng méi tí shénme tiáojiàn, tánpàn hěn shùnlì.
examples.example_translation: The other party didn't set any conditions, so the negotiation went smoothly.

examples.example_chinese: 每个大学的招生条件都不一样。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi ge dàxué de zhāoshēng tiáojiàn dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.example_translation: Each university has different admission requirements.

examples.example_chinese: 我想读硕士，不知道要什么条件？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dú shuòshì, bù zhīdào yào shénme tiáojiàn?
examples.example_translation: I want to study for a master's degree, but I don't know what the requirements are.

meaning: num.很多 · many, much, a great many

examples.example_chinese: 我已经认识了许多中国朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng rènshi le xǔduō Zhōngguó péngyou.
examples.example_translation: I have already made many Chinese friends.

examples.example_chinese: 他桌子上放着许多东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhuōzi shang fàngzhe xǔduō dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: There are many things on his desk.

examples.example_chinese: 那天的聚会来了许多人。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà tiān de jùhuì láile xǔduō rén.
examples.example_translation: Many people came to the party that day.

examples.example_chinese: 街道两旁摆着许多鲜花。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiēdào liǎngpáng bǎizhe xǔduō xiānhuā.
examples.example_translation: There are many fresh flowers on both sides of the street.

examples.example_chinese: 他说的这些事情，许多是我不了解的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuō de zhèxiē shìqing, xǔduō shì wǒ bù liǎojiě de.
examples.example_translation: Many of the things he talked about are things I don't understand.

meaning: n.形状、样式 · appearance, shape

examples.example_chinese: 这个手机的样子很好看。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège shǒujī de yàngzi hěn hǎokàn.
examples.example_translation: This phone looks very nice.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢这件衣服的样子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè jiàn yīfu de yàngzi.
examples.example_translation: I really like the style of this piece of clothing.

examples.example_chinese: 他们穿的衣服都是一个样子的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen chuān de yīfu dōu shì yí ge yàngzi de.
examples.example_translation: The clothes they wear are all the same style.

examples.example_chinese: 我想买个样子特别一点儿的帽子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi ge yàngzi tèbié yìdiǎnr de màozi.
examples.example_translation: I want to buy a hat with a more unique style.

examples.example_chinese: 会爱你最真实的样子
examples.example_pinyin: huì ài nǐ zuì zhēnshí de yàng zi

meaning: v.让, 叫, 引起某种结果 · to make, to cause, to enable

examples.example_chinese: 他们的服务使大家很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen de fúwù shǐ dàjiā hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: Everyone was satisfied with their service.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事真使人生气。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhēn shì rén shēngqì.
examples.example_translation: This matter really made me mad.

examples.example_chinese: 跳舞能使人感到快乐，所以我很喜欢。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiàowǔ néng shǐ rén gǎndào kuàilè, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.example_translation: Dancing makes me happy, so I like it.

examples.example_chinese: 她的话使我很吃惊。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de huà shí wǒ hěn qíngtīng.
examples.example_translation: What she said surprised me.

examples.example_chinese: 她为我做的这些事，使我慢慢爱上了她。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wèi wǒ zuò de zhèxiē shì, shǐ wǒ mànmàn ài shàngle tā.
examples.example_translation: What she did for me made me fall in love with her gradually.

meaning: adv.表示不能肯定 · perhaps, maybe

examples.example_chinese: 他没来上课，也许是病了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā méi lái shàngkè, yěxǔ shì bìng le.
examples.example_translation: He didn't come to class, maybe he is sick.

examples.example_chinese: 下着这么大雨，她也许不会来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàzhe zhème dà yǔ, tā yěxǔ bú huì lái le.
examples.example_translation: It's raining so heavily, maybe she won't come.

examples.example_chinese: 明天我也许去，也许不去。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yěxǔ qù, yěxǔ bú qù.
examples.example_translation: Maybe I'll go tomorrow, maybe I won't.

examples.example_chinese: 也许他的回答是对的，我不敢肯定。
examples.example_pinyin: Yěxǔ tā de huídá shì duì de, wǒ bù gǎn kěndìng.
examples.example_translation: Maybe his answer is correct, but I'm not sure.

examples.example_chinese: 他也许会同意这个办法。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yěxǔ huì tóngyì zhège bànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Maybe he will agree with this solution.

meaning: adv.用来加强肯定的语气, 的确 · really, indeed

examples.example_chinese: 我实在没有时间，只好不去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shízài méiyǒu shíjiān, zhǐhǎo bú qù le.
examples.example_translation: I really don't have time, so I can't go.

examples.example_chinese: 你如果实在没钱，可以到银行贷款。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ rúguǒ shízài méi qián, kěyǐ dào yínháng dàikuǎn.
examples.example_translation: If you really have no money, you can get a loan from the bank.

examples.example_chinese: 我把你的书弄丢了，实在对不起。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nǐ de shū nòngdiū le, shízài duìbuqǐ.
examples.example_translation: I lost your book, I'm really sorry.

examples.example_chinese: 这个问题我实在想不明白。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ shízài xiǎng bù míngbai.
examples.example_translation: I really can't figure out this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 今天我实在太累了，不想工作了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ shízài tài lèi le, bù xiǎng gōngzuò le.
examples.example_translation: I'm really too tired today, I don't want to work anymore.

meaning: n.从天黑到天亮的一段时间 · night, the time from dusk to dawn

examples.example_chinese: 夜深了，他还在工作。
examples.example_pinyin: yè shēn le, tā hái zài gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: It's late at night, and he's still working.

examples.example_chinese: 他一直写到夜里两点才休息。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yīzhí xiě dào yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái xiūxi.
examples.example_translation: He kept writing until two in the morning before resting.

examples.example_chinese: 我昨天晚上睡到半夜就醒了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shuì dào bànyè jiù xǐng le.
examples.example_translation: I woke up in the middle of the night last night.

examples.example_chinese: 昨晚，我一夜没睡觉。
examples.example_pinyin: zuówǎn, wǒ yīyè méi shuìjiào.
examples.example_translation: Last night, I didn't sleep all night.

examples.example_chinese: 我坐了两天两夜的火车，很累。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zuò le liǎng tiān liǎng yè de huǒchē, hěn lèi.
examples.example_translation: I took a train for two days and two nights, and I'm very tired.

meaning: n.世界七大洲之一 · Asia

examples.example_chinese: 中国和日本同属于亚洲。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó hé Rìběn tóng shǔyú Yàzhōu.
examples.example_translation: China and Japan both belong to Asia.

examples.example_chinese: 2014年亚洲运动会将在韩国召开。
examples.example_pinyin: Èr líng yī sì nián Yàzhōu yùndònghuì jiāng zài Hánguó zhàokāi.
examples.example_translation: The 2014 Asian Games will be held in South Korea.

examples.example_chinese: 亚洲国家之间加强了经济合作。
examples.example_pinyin: Yàzhōu guójiā zhījiān jiāqiángle jīngjì hézuò.
examples.example_translation: Asian countries have strengthened economic cooperation.

examples.example_chinese: 最近几年亚洲的经济发展十分迅速。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuìjìn jǐ nián Yàzhōu de jīngjì fāzhǎn shífēn xùnsù.
examples.example_translation: In recent years, Asia's economic development has been very rapid.

meaning: adj.专门从事某种事业或某种职业的 · professional

examples.example_chinese: 他是专业运动员，水平很高。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì zhuānyè yùndòngyuán, shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
examples.example_translation: He is a professional athlete with a high level of skill.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不是专业演员，是业余的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bú shì zhuānyè yǎnyuán, shì yèyú de.
examples.example_translation: We are not professional actors, we are amateurs.

examples.example_chinese: 比赛分成专业组和业余组。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài fēnchéng zhuānyèzǔ hé yèyǔzǔ.
examples.example_translation: The competition is divided into professional and amateur groups.

meaning: n.对事情的看法或想法 · idea, view, opinion

examples.example_chinese: 我们俩的意见一致。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ de yìjiàn yízhì.
examples.example_translation: The two of us have the same opinion.

examples.example_chinese: 关于青少年吸烟问题，请你谈点儿意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Guānyú qīng-shàonián xī yān wèntí, qǐng nǐ tán diǎn yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: Please share your opinion on the issue of teenagers smoking.

examples.example_chinese: 去哪里旅游最好？请大家发表意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Qù nǎli lǚyóu zuì hǎo? Qǐng dàjiā fābiǎo yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: Where is the best place to travel? Please share your opinions.

examples.example_chinese: 在这个问题上，我没有不同意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shang, wǒ méiyǒu bù tóng yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: I have no different opinion on this issue.

examples.example_chinese: 合理的意见我们要采纳。
examples.example_pinyin: Hélǐ de yìjiàn wǒmen yào cǎinà.
examples.example_translation: We should adopt reasonable opinions.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经交换过意见了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng jiāohuàn guò yìjiàn le.
examples.example_translation: We have already exchanged opinions.

meaning: adv.表示时间很长，没有终止 · forever

examples.example_chinese: 我们永远都是好朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǒngyuǎn dōu shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: We will always be good friends.

examples.example_chinese: 我会永远记得那位老师。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huì yǒngyuǎn jìde nà wèi lǎoshī.
examples.example_translation: I will always remember that teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 我永远不会忘记在中国的生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì zài Zhōngguó de shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: I will never forget my life in China.

examples.example_chinese: 祝你们永远幸福、快乐。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhù nǐmen yǒngyuǎn xìngfú, kuàilè.
examples.example_translation: Wish you happiness and joy forever.

examples.example_chinese: 希望你永远年轻、漂亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ yǒngyuǎn niánqīng, piàoliang.
examples.example_translation: Hope you will always be young and beautiful.

examples.example_chinese: 我们会相爱到永远。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen huì xiāng’ài dào yǒngyuǎn.
examples.example_translation: We will love each other forever.

meaning: adj.像朋友一样亲近的 · friendly

examples.example_chinese: 他们态度很友好，热情大方。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen tàidu hěn yǒuhǎo, rèqíng dàfāng.
examples.example_translation: They are very friendly, warm and generous.

examples.example_chinese: 多年来，两国保持着十分友好的关系。
examples.example_pinyin: Duō nián lái, liǎng guó bǎochí zhe shífēn yǒuhǎo de guānxì.
examples.example_translation: For many years, the two countries have maintained a very friendly relationship.

examples.example_chinese: 目前，这两个城市已经成为友好城市。
examples.example_pinyin: Mùqián, zhè liǎng gè chéngshì yǐjīng chéngwéi yǒuhǎo chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: At present, these two cities have already become sister cities.

examples.example_chinese: 他们在友好的气氛中进行了会谈。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zài yǒuhǎo de qìfēn zhōng jìnxíngle huìtán.
examples.example_translation: They held talks in a friendly atmosphere.

examples.example_chinese: 两国人民要永远友好下去。
examples.example_pinyin: Liǎng guó rénmín yào yǒngyuǎn yǒuhǎo xiàqù.
examples.example_translation: The people of the two countries should remain friendly forever.

meaning: prep.表示起点或凭借 · starting point, depend

examples.example_chinese: 会议由八点一直开到十一点。
examples.example_pinyin: Huìyì yóu bā diǎn yīzhí kāi dào shíyī diǎn.
examples.example_translation: The meeting lasted from eight o'clock to eleven o'clock.

examples.example_chinese: 由此向东再走50米就到了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóu cǐ xiàng dōng zài zǒu wǔshí mǐ jiù dào le.
examples.example_translation: From here, walk 50 meters east and you will arrive.

examples.example_chinese: 由这条路走会近一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóu zhè tiáo lù zǒu huì jìn yīxiē.
examples.example_translation: It will be closer if you take this road.

examples.example_chinese: 学院一共由八个系组成。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéyuàn yīgòng yóu bā gè xì zǔchéng.
examples.example_translation: The college is composed of eight departments in total.

meaning: adj.颜色浓（跟“浅”相对） · dark; strong (color) (as opposed to "light")

examples.example_chinese: 他穿了件深颜色的衣服。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chuānle jiàn shēn yánsè de yīfu.
examples.example_translation: He wore clothes of a dark color.

examples.example_chinese: 大风过后，天空变成了深蓝色。
examples.example_pinyin: Dà fēng guò hòu, tiānkōng biànchéngle shēn lánsè.
examples.example_translation: After the strong wind, the sky turned deep blue.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服的颜色过深，显得太老了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè guò shēn, xiǎnde tài lǎo le.
examples.example_translation: The color of this clothing is too dark, making it look too old.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服已经洗掉色了，以前的颜色比现在深很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǐjīng xǐ diào shǎi le, yǐqián de yánsè bǐ xiànzài shēn hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing has faded, its color used to be much darker than now.

meaning: adj.最初的, 没有经过加工变化的; · original

examples.example_chinese: 他没什么变化，还是原来的样子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā méi shénme biànhuà, háishi yuánlái de yàngzi.
examples.example_translation: He hasn't changed much, he still looks the same as before.

examples.example_chinese: 我们还按原来的计划行动。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen hái àn yuánlái de jìhuà xíngdòng.
examples.example_translation: We are still acting according to the original plan.

examples.example_chinese: 大家都忘记了他原来的名字。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā dōu wàngjìle tā yuánlái de míngzi.
examples.example_translation: Everyone has forgotten his original name.

examples.example_chinese: 她还住在原来的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hái zhù zài yuánlái de dìfāng.
examples.example_translation: She still lives in the original place.

examples.example_chinese: 原来他喜欢的不是真龙。
examples.example_pinyin: yuán lái tā xǐ huan de bù shì zhēn lóng

meaning: n.引起某种结果的条件 · cause, reason

examples.example_chinese: 他生病的原因是吃了不干净的东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shēngbìng de yuányīn shì chīle bù gānjìng de dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: The reason he got sick was that he ate something unclean.

examples.example_chinese: 出现这个问题，原因很复杂。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūxiàn zhège wèntí, yuányīn hěn fùzá.
examples.example_translation: The reason for this problem is very complicated.

examples.example_chinese: 他向老师解释了没来考试的原因。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎoshī jiěshìle méi lái kǎoshì de yuányīn.
examples.example_translation: He explained to the teacher the reason why he didn't come to the exam.

examples.example_chinese: 我不清楚他们离婚的原因。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù qīngchu tāmen líhūn de yuányīn.
examples.example_translation: I don't know the reason for their divorce.

examples.example_chinese: 事故的原因还需要进一步调查。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìgù de yuányīn hái xūyào jìnyībù diàochá.
examples.example_translation: The cause of the accident still needs further investigation.

meaning: n.在天空中悬浮的由水滴、冰晶聚集形成的物体 · cloud

examples.example_chinese: 今天云不多，应该不会下雨。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān yún bù duō, yīnggāi bú huì xià yǔ.
examples.example_translation: There is not much cloud today, so it shouldn’t rain.

examples.example_chinese: 天上的云层很厚，看起来要下雨。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiānshàng de yúncéng hěn hòu, kàn qǐlái yào xià yǔ.
examples.example_translation: The sky is covered with thick clouds. It seems that it will rain.

examples.example_chinese: 阳光很足，天上几乎没有什么云。
examples.example_pinyin: Yángguāng hěn zú, tiānshàng jīhū méiyǒu shénme yún.
examples.example_translation: It’s a sunny day with almost no cloud in the sky.

examples.example_chinese: 今天是个多云的天气。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān shì gè duō yún de tiānqì.
examples.example_translation: It’s a cloudy day today.

examples.example_chinese: 天上的云一会儿就被风吹跑了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiānshàng de yún yíhuǐr jiù bèi fēng chuīpǎo le.
examples.example_translation: All the cloud in the sky was soon blown away by the wind.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢这蓝天白云的天气。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè lántiān báiyún de tiānqì.
examples.example_translation: I like the blue sky and white cloud weather very much.

meaning: n.解释的话 · explanation

examples.example_chinese: 这是手机的使用说明。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì shǒujī de shǐyòng shuōmíng.
examples.example_translation: This is the instruction manual for the phone.

examples.example_chinese: 你看看说明，就知道这药怎么吃了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kànkan shuōmíng, jiù zhīdào zhè yào zěnme chī le.
examples.example_translation: Read the instructions and you'll know how to take this medicine.

examples.example_chinese: 这份说明写得很详细。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fèn shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì.
examples.example_translation: This explanation is written in great detail.

examples.example_chinese: 每张照片后面都有一段说明。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi zhāng zhàopiàn hòumiàn dōu yǒu yí duàn shuōmíng.
examples.example_translation: There is an explanation on the back of every photo.

examples.example_chinese: 这个说明我实在看不懂。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège shuōmíng wǒ shízài kàn bu dǒng.
examples.example_translation: I really can't understand this explanation.

meaning: n.房屋前后用墙或栅栏围起来的空地 · patio, court, courtyard, yard, compound

examples.example_chinese: 师父,您不要捡了,我们明天就会把院子里的黄叶扫得干干净净。
examples.example_pinyin: shīfu nín bú yào jiǎn le wǒ men míng tiān jiù huì bǎ yuànzi lǐ de huáng yè sǎo dé gān gān jìng jìng
examples.example_translation: Master, please don't pick them up anymore. Tomorrow, we will sweep the yellow leaves in the courtyard completely clean.

examples.example_chinese: 一个孩子坐在院子里，靠着奶奶，仰起头，指着天数星星。
examples.example_pinyin: yī gè hái zi zuò zài yuànzi lǐ kào zhe nǎi nai yǎng qǐ tóu zhǐzhe tiān shǔ xīng xīng
examples.example_translation: A child sits in the courtyard, leaning against their grandmother, looking up and pointing at the sky to count the stars.

examples.example_chinese: 到了后半夜，祖逖听到鸡叫的声音，于是，他推醒刘琨，两个人起床到院子里练习武艺。
examples.example_pinyin: dào le hòu bàn yè zǔ tì tīng dào jī jiào de shēng yīn yú shì tā tuī xǐng liú kūn liǎng gè rén qǐ chuáng dào yuànzi lǐ liàn xí wǔ yì
examples.example_translation: In the middle of the night, Zu Ti heard a rooster crowing. So, he nudged Liu Kun awake, and the two of them got up and went to the courtyard to practice martial arts.

meaning: n.早饭 · breakfast

examples.example_chinese: 我每天早上七点吃早餐。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn chī zǎocān.
examples.example_translation: I eat breakfast at 7:00 AM every day.

examples.example_chinese: 酒店提供免费早餐。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiǔdiàn tígōng miǎnfèi zǎocān.
examples.example_translation: The hotel offers free breakfast.

meaning: adj.实质跟名义完全符合的, 确实的 · genuine, true, real

examples.example_chinese: 孔子是中国古代一位真正的教育家。
examples.example_pinyin: Kǒngzǐ shì Zhōngguó gǔdài yí wèi zhēnzhèng de jiàoyùjiā.
examples.example_translation: Confucius was a genuine educator in ancient China.

examples.example_chinese: 他是我们心目中真正的英雄。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen xīnmù zhōng zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng.
examples.example_translation: He is a true hero in our hearts.

examples.example_chinese: 他来这里的真正目的是要了解这里的风俗和文化。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā lái zhèli de zhēnzhèng mùdì shì yào liǎojiě zhèli de fēngsú hé wénhuà.
examples.example_translation: His real purpose in coming here is to understand the customs and culture here.

examples.example_chinese: 等我真正地学会了这门技术，我就可以帮助更多人了。
examples.example_pinyin: Děng wǒ zhēnzhèng de xuéhuìle zhè mén jìshù, wǒ jiù kěyǐ bāngzhù gèng duō rén le.
examples.example_translation: Once I truly master this skill, I will be able to help more people.

examples.example_chinese: 一个真正在乎你的人
examples.example_pinyin: yí gè zhēn zhèng zài hu nǐ de rén

meaning: adj.符合一般规律或情况的 · normal

examples.example_chinese: 病人目前的体征一切正常，没什么问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Bìngrén mùqián de tǐzhēng yīqiè zhèngcháng, méi shénme wèntí.
examples.example_translation: All the patient's vital signs are normal at present, there is no problem.

examples.example_chinese: 今年的气温偏低，不太正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de qìwēn piān dī, bú tài zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: The temperature is lower than normal this year, it's not quite normal.

examples.example_chinese: 各项工作都在按计划正常进行。
examples.example_pinyin: Gè xiàng gōngzuò dōu zài àn jìhuà zhèngcháng jìnxíng.
examples.example_translation: All tasks are proceeding normally according to the plan.

examples.example_chinese: 洪水过后，这里一切又恢复了正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Hóngshuǐ guò hòu, zhèli yīqiè yòu huīfùle zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: After the flood, everything here returned to normal.

examples.example_chinese: 这次考试我发挥得很正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ fāhuī de hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: I performed normally in this exam.

meaning: adj.符合事实、道理或标准 · correct, right

examples.example_chinese: 这本书后面有练习的正确答案。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū hòumiàn yǒu liànxí de zhèngquè dá'àn.
examples.example_translation: There are correct answers to the exercises at the back of this book.

examples.example_chinese: 你的意见很正确，我支持你。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de yìjiàn hěn zhèngquè, wǒ zhīchí nǐ.
examples.example_translation: Your opinion is very correct, I support you.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一种不正确的看法，所以没人同意。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhǒng bù zhèngquè de kànfǎ, suǒyǐ méi rén tóngyì.
examples.example_translation: This is an incorrect view, so no one agrees.

examples.example_chinese: 正确使用电器是非常重要的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèngquè shǐyòng diànqì shì fēicháng zhòngyào de.
examples.example_translation: It is very important to use electrical appliances correctly.

examples.example_chinese: 他对这个问题理解得很正确。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì zhège wèntí lǐjiě de hěn zhèngquè.
examples.example_translation: He understands this issue very correctly.

meaning: adj.不经过中间事物的（跟“间接”相对） · direct (as opposed to "indirect")

examples.example_chinese: 这起交通事故跟司机违章驾驶有直接的关系。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè qǐ jiāotōng shìgù gēn sījī wéizhāng jiàshǐ yǒu zhíjiē de guānxì.
examples.example_translation: This traffic accident is directly related to the driver's violation of driving regulations.

examples.example_chinese: 我直接跟经理说吧，你不用管了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhíjiē gēn jīnglǐ shuō ba, nǐ bùyòng guǎn le.
examples.example_translation: I'll talk directly to the manager, you don't need to worry about it.

examples.example_chinese: 经过三年的汉语学习，他已经能直接阅读中文小说了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de Hànyǔ xuéxí, tā yǐjīng néng zhíjiē yuèdú Zhōngwén xiǎoshuō le.
examples.example_translation: After three years of studying Chinese, he can already read Chinese novels directly.

examples.example_chinese: 下班后我们就直接去电影院，不用回家了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàbān hòu wǒmen jiù zhíjiē qù diànyǐngyuàn, bùyòng huí jiā le.
examples.example_translation: After work, we'll go directly to the cinema, no need to go home.

examples.example_chinese: 小时候喜怒哀乐都直接表现在脸上
examples.example_pinyin: xiǎo shí hòu xǐ-nù-āi-lè dōu zhí jiē biǎoxiàn zài liǎn shàng

meaning: adj.正合适（指时间、位置不前不后，体积不大不小，数量不多不少，程度不高不低等） · (of time, position, size, quantity, degree, etc., as neither too little nor too much) just in time; just right

examples.example_chinese: 今天的温度正好，不冷不热，很适合出去玩儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān de wēndù zhènghǎo, bù lěng bù rè, hěn shìhé chūqù wánr.
examples.example_translation: Today's temperature is just right, not cold or hot, perfect for going out to play.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服他穿正好，正合体。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tā chuān zhènghǎo, zhèng hétǐ.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing fits him just right, it fits perfectly.

examples.example_chinese: 这个房间可以住四个人，我们四个人正好住这个房间。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège fángjiān kěyǐ zhù sì ge rén, wǒmen sì ge rén zhènghǎo zhù zhè yí ge fángjiān.
examples.example_translation: This room can accommodate four people, and there are four of us, so it's just right.

examples.example_chinese: 你来得正好，我正准备去找你呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, wǒ zhèng zhǔnbèi qù zhǎo nǐ ne.
examples.example_translation: You came just in time, I was just about to look for you.

examples.example_chinese: 我们正好在同样的时间里
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ men zhèng hǎo zài tóng yàng de shí jiān lǐ

meaning: adj.言行等没有积极意义而使人讨厌 · (of speech, manner, etc.) senseless, silly

examples.example_chinese: 我看完才知道，这部电影其实很无聊。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kànwán cái zhīdào, zhè bù diànyǐng qíshí hěn wúliáo.
examples.example_translation: I only realized after watching that this movie is actually very boring.

examples.example_chinese: 对于那些无聊的问题，我不想回答。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú nàxiē wúliáo de wèntí, wǒ bù xiǎng huídá.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to answer those silly questions.

examples.example_chinese: 请你不要开这种无聊的玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bùyào kāi zhè zhǒng wúliáo de wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: Please don't make such senseless jokes.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书实在太无聊了，我看了一会儿就睡着了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū shízài tài wúliáo le, wǒ kànle yīhuǐr jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.example_translation: This book is really too boring, I fell asleep after reading for a while.

meaning: v.认真对待，看重 · attach importance to

examples.example_chinese: 我们学校非常重视年轻教师的发展。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào fēicháng zhòngshì niánqīng jiàoshī de fāzhǎn.
examples.example_translation: Our school attaches great importance to the development of young teachers.

examples.example_chinese: 经理很民主，一贯重视听取员工的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ hěn mínzhǔ, yíguàn zhòngshì tīngqǔ yuángōng de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: The manager is very democratic and always values listening to employees' opinions.

examples.example_chinese: 父母对孩子的升学问题都重视得很。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi de shēngxué wèntí dōu zhòngshì de hěn.
examples.example_translation: Parents attach great importance to their children's further education issues.

examples.example_chinese: 现在人们对心理健康问题越来越重视了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài rénmen duì xīnlǐ jiànkāng wèntí yuè lái yuè zhòngshì le.
examples.example_translation: Nowadays, people are paying more and more attention to mental health issues.

examples.example_chinese: 这个发现引起了科学家们的高度重视。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège fāxiàn yǐnqǐle kēxuéjiāmen de gāodù zhòngshì.
examples.example_translation: This discovery has attracted great attention from scientists.

meaning: n.同类事物中重要的或主要的部分 · keypoint, emphasis

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章重点突出，材料充分。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng zhòngdiǎn tūchū, cáiliào chōngfèn.
examples.example_translation: The key points of this article stand out, and the material is sufficient.

examples.example_chinese: 他的讲话内容杂乱，让人抓不住重点。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jiǎnghuà nèiróng záluàn, ràng rén zhuā bù zhù zhòngdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: The content of his speech is disorganized, making it hard for people to grasp the key points.

examples.example_chinese: 我们今天学习的重点是“把”字句。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān xuéxí de zhòngdiǎn shì “bǎ” zì jù.
examples.example_translation: The key point of our study today is the "ba" sentence structure.

examples.example_chinese: 目前，大力推进经济建设是我市的工作重点。
examples.example_pinyin: Mùqián, dàlì tuījìn jīngjì jiànshè shì wǒ shì de gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: At present, vigorously promoting economic development is the key focus of our city's work.

meaning: v. 把东西放入容器或放到运输工具上 load, pack, hold, put something into a vessel; 装配,安装 install, fit, assemble; 装饰,化装,装扮 dress up; 假装 pretend

examples.example_chinese: 她正在往书包里装书。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhèngzài wǎng shūbāo lǐ zhuāng shū.
examples.example_translation: She is putting books into her schoolbag.

examples.example_chinese: 他把不用的东西装进了箱子。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ bùyòng de dōngxi zhuāng jìn le xiāngzi.
examples.example_translation: He packed the unused things into the box.

examples.example_chinese: 那辆车上装满了各种水果。
examples.example_pinyin: nà liàng chē shàng zhuāng mǎn le gèzhǒng shuǐguǒ.
examples.example_translation: That car was loaded with various fruits.

examples.example_chinese: 东西太多,屋子里装不下了。
examples.example_pinyin: dōngxi tài duō, wūzi lǐ zhuāng bù xià le.
examples.example_translation: There were too many things, the room couldn't hold them all.

examples.example_chinese: 这所学校很先进,每个教室都装了多媒体。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè suǒ xuéxiào hěn xiānjìn, měi ge jiàoshì dōu zhuāng le duōméitǐ.
examples.example_translation: This school is very advanced, every classroom is equipped with multimedia.

examples.example_chinese: 我家新装了一部电话。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ jiā xīn zhuāng le yī bù diànhuà.
examples.example_translation: My home just had a new phone installed.

examples.example_chinese: 师傅正认真地装着空调,没听见我说话。
examples.example_pinyin: shīfu zhèng rènzhēn de zhuāngzhe kōngtiáo, méi tīngjiàn wǒ shuōhuà.
examples.example_translation: The master was diligently installing the air conditioner and didn't hear me speak.

examples.example_chinese: 这些软件我已经帮你装好了,可以用了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē ruǎnjiàn wǒ yǐjīng bāng nǐ zhuāng hǎo le, kěyǐ yòng le.
examples.example_translation: I have already installed these software for you, you can use them now.

examples.example_chinese: 她在表演中装一只小鸭子。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài biǎoyǎn zhōng zhuāng yī zhī xiǎo yāzi.
examples.example_translation: She dressed up as a little duck in the performance.

examples.example_chinese: 我在剧中装一个坏人,你看了别当真。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zài jù zhōng zhuāng yī ge huàirén, nǐ kàn le bié dàngzhēn.
examples.example_translation: I played a bad guy in the play, don't take it seriously when you watch it.

examples.example_chinese: 他在电影中装皇帝装得还挺像。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài diànyǐng zhōng zhuāng huángdì zhuāng de hái tǐng xiàng.
examples.example_translation: He dressed up as an emperor in the movie and looked quite similar.

examples.example_chinese: 他装病,不想上班。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhuāng bìng, bù xiǎng shàngbān.
examples.example_translation: He pretended to be sick and didn't want to go to work.

examples.example_chinese: 你别装了,我早就知道你是谁了。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ bié zhuāng le, wǒ zǎojiù zhīdào nǐ shì shuí le.
examples.example_translation: Stop pretending, I already know who you are.

examples.example_chinese: 别人一批评他,他就装出一副可怜的样子。
examples.example_pinyin: biérén yī pīpíng tā, tā jiù zhuāng chū yī fù kělián de yàngzi.
examples.example_translation: As soon as others criticized him, he put on a pitiful look.

examples.example_chinese: 他虽然很生气,却装得一点儿事也没有。
examples.example_pinyin: tā suīrán hěn shēngqì, què zhuāng de yīdiǎnr shì yě méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: Although he was very angry, he pretended that nothing was wrong.

meaning: adj.正确，没有差错 · exact, accurate

examples.example_chinese: 孩子出生的准确时间是下午两点12分。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi chūshēng de zhǔnquè shíjiān shì xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn shí'èr fēn.
examples.example_translation: The exact time of the child's birth was 2:12 p.m.

examples.example_chinese: 他的回答非常准确，获得了满分。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de huídá fēicháng zhǔnquè, huòdéle mǎnfēn.
examples.example_translation: His answer was very accurate and he got full marks.

examples.example_chinese: 他计算得很准确，我就没必要再算一遍了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jìsuàn de hěn zhǔnquè, wǒ jiù méi bìyào zài suàn yí biàn le.
examples.example_translation: His calculation is very accurate, so I don't need to calculate it again.

examples.example_chinese: 请告诉我开会的准确时间和地点。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ kāihuì de zhǔnquè shíjiān hé dìdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Please tell me the exact time and place of the meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 新闻报道力求做到及时而准确。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīnwén bàodào lìqiú zuòdào jíshí ér zhǔnquè.
examples.example_translation: News reports strive to be timely and accurate.

meaning: v.交钱后在一定时间内使用别人的东西, 租用 · rent, hire, charter

examples.example_chinese: 我想租一套两居室的房子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zū yí tào liǎng jūshì de fángzi.
examples.example_translation: I want to rent a two-bedroom apartment.

examples.example_chinese: 我们租辆车吧，这样旅游更方便些。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zū liàng chē ba, zhèyàng lǚyóu gèng fāngbiàn xiē.
examples.example_translation: Let's rent a car, it will make traveling more convenient.

examples.example_chinese: 他租下了一个摊位，开始做起生意来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zūxiàle yí ge tānwèi, kāishǐ zuòqǐ shēngyì lái.
examples.example_translation: He rented a stall and started doing business.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书你可以租一个月。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ kěyǐ zū yí ge yuè.
examples.example_translation: You can rent this book for a month.

examples.example_chinese: 他还没租到自己满意的房子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hái méi zūdào zìjǐ mǎnyì de fángzi.
examples.example_translation: He hasn't found a house he is satisfied with to rent yet.

meaning: n.从事文学创作有成就的人 · writer, author

examples.example_chinese: 他是一位著名作家。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi zhùmíng zuòjiā.
examples.example_translation: He is a famous writer.

examples.example_chinese: 她的梦想是成为一名作家。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì chéngwéi yī míng zuòjiā.
examples.example_translation: Her dream is to become a writer.

examples.example_chinese: 这位作家出版了很多书。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā chūbǎnle hěnduō shū.
examples.example_translation: This author has published many books.

examples.example_chinese: 我很欣赏这位作家的作品。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīnshǎng zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn.
examples.example_translation: I really admire this writer's works.

examples.example_chinese: 就像作家余华说的
examples.example_pinyin: jiù xiàng zuò jiā yú huá shuō de

meaning: n.学生作为练习所写的文章 · composition, essay written by students as practice

examples.example_chinese: 这篇作文写得很生动,很感人。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè piān zuòwén xiě de hěn shēngdòng, hěn gǎnrén.
examples.example_translation: This composition is written very vividly and is very touching.

examples.example_chinese: 他写的作文每次都能得到老师的表扬。
examples.example_pinyin: tā xiě de zuòwén měi cì dōu néng dédào lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
examples.example_translation: His compositions always receive praise from the teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 明天下午我们有写作文大赛。
examples.example_pinyin: míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒmen yǒu xiě zuòwén dàsài.
examples.example_translation: We have a composition contest tomorrow afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢写作文,因为它是表达自己思想感情的一种方式。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuān xiě zuòwén, yīnwèi tā shì biǎodá zìjǐ sīxiǎng gǎnqíng de yī zhǒng fāngshì.
examples.example_translation: I like writing compositions very much because it is a way to express my thoughts and feelings.

meaning: n.对事物产生的影响 · role, effect

examples.example_chinese: 他烧已经退了，看起来药已经产生作用了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shāo yǐjīng tuìle, kànlái yào yǐjīng chǎnshēng zuòyòng le.
examples.example_translation: His fever has gone. It seems the medicine has worked.

examples.example_chinese: 这次比赛，他起了很重要的作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài, tā qǐle hěn zhòngyào de zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: He played a very important role in this game.

examples.example_chinese: 吃饭和穿衣在人们生活中起着最基本的作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Chīfàn hé chuānyǐ zài rénmen shēnghuó zhōng qǐzhe zuì jīběn de zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: Food and clothing are the basic necessities of people’s life.

examples.example_chinese: 在信息交流中，语言起着重要的沟通作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài xìnxī jiāoliú zhōng, yǔyán qǐzhe zhòngyào de gōutōng zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: Language plays an important role in communication.

examples.example_chinese: 他的话对孩子根本不起任何作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de huà duì háizi gēnběn bù qǐ rènhe zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: The kid turned deaf ears to his words.

meaning: cl.用于较大或固定的物体 · used for massive or fixed objects

examples.example_pinyin: yí zuò gōngyuán
examples.example_translation: a park

examples.example_chinese: 一座白塔
examples.example_pinyin: yí zuò bái tǎ
examples.example_translation: a white pagoda

examples.example_chinese: 一座山峰
examples.example_pinyin: yí zuò shānfēng
examples.example_translation: a mountain peak

examples.example_chinese: 一座雕像
examples.example_pinyin: yí zuò diāoxiàng
examples.example_translation: a statue

examples.example_chinese: 在离火线不远的一座小庙里，白求恩大夫正在给伤员做手术。

meaning: n.供人坐的位子（多用于公共场所） · seat (often in a public place)

examples.example_chinese: 这个教室已经没有空座位了，我们去别的教室看看吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège jiàoshì yǐjīng méiyǒu kòng zuòwèi le, wǒmen qù bié de jiàoshì kànkan ba.
examples.example_translation: There are no empty seats in this classroom, let's check another classroom.

examples.example_chinese: 这趟车不挤，人人都有座位。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tàng chē bù jǐ, rénrén dōu yǒu zuòwèi.
examples.example_translation: This train is not crowded, everyone has a seat.

examples.example_chinese: 他喜欢坐在车厢靠窗的座位上。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zuò zài chēxiāng kào chuāng de zuòwèi shang.
examples.example_translation: He likes to sit in the seat by the window in the carriage.

examples.example_chinese: 这个电影院有2000多个座位。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège diànyǐngyuàn yǒu liǎngqiān duō ge zuòwèi.
examples.example_translation: This cinema has more than 2,000 seats.

examples.example_chinese: 旁边有人把座位搬过,
examples.example_pinyin: páng biān yǒu rén bǎ zuò wèi bān guò

meaning: n.关怀、爱护人的思想感情 · love; compassion

examples.example_chinese: 老人对孙子充满了爱心。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎorén duì sūnzi chōngmǎnle àixīn.
examples.example_translation: The old man is full of love for his grandson.

examples.example_chinese: 人们为受灾地区捐款，献出了一片爱心。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénmen wèi shòuzāi dìqū juānkuǎn, xiànchūle yì piàn àixīn.
examples.example_translation: People donated money to disaster areas, showing their love and compassion.

examples.example_chinese: 他经常参加关心残疾儿童的爱心活动。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng cānjiā guānxīn cánjí értóng de àixīn huódòng.
examples.example_translation: He often participates in charity activities for disabled children.

examples.example_chinese: 她是个有爱心、善良、美丽的女孩子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì ge yǒu àixīn, shànliáng, měilì de nǚháizi.
examples.example_translation: She is a loving, kind, and beautiful girl.

meaning: v.有计划、有安排地对人或事物进行安置或处理 · arrange

examples.example_chinese: 经理安排我参加这次会议。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ ānpái wǒ cānjiā zhè cì huìyì.
examples.example_translation: The manager arranged for me to attend this meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 到了北京以后，朋友帮我安排了一切。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàole Běijīng yǐhòu, péngyǒu bāng wǒ ānpái le yīqiē.
examples.example_translation: After arriving in Beijing, my friend arranged everything for me.

examples.example_chinese: 你们的座位都已经安排好了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen de zuòwèi dōu yǐjīng gǎnpái hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: Your seats have already been arranged.

examples.example_chinese: 他这次来北京时间安排得很紧。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhè cì lái Běijīng shíjiān ānpái de hěn jǐn.
examples.example_translation: His schedule in Beijing this time was very tight.

examples.example_chinese: 你先安排生活问题，然后我们再谈工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiān ānpái shēnghuó wéntí, ránhòu wǒmen zài tán gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: You first arrange the living matters, then we will discuss work.

meaning: prep.把某种规定、计划等作为根据 (与后面的名词性成分组成介词短语做状语 ) · according to

examples.example_chinese: 按照他的方法，我做了这个菜。
examples.example_pinyin: Ànzhào tā de fāngfǎ, wǒ zuòle zhège cài.
examples.example_translation: According to his method, I made this dish.

examples.example_chinese: 你要按照医生说的话做，病才会好得快。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yào ànzhào yīshēng shuō de huà zuò, bìng cái huì hǎo de kuài.
examples.example_translation: You should follow the doctor’s advice for a quicker recovery.

examples.example_chinese: 按照中国的法律，你不能这么做。
examples.example_pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de fǎlǜ, nǐ bù néng zhème zuò.
examples.example_translation: According to Chinese law, you cannot do this.

examples.example_chinese: 按照学校的规定，你应该参加考试。
examples.example_pinyin: Ànzhào xuéxiào de guīdìng, nǐ yīnggāi cānjiā kǎoshì.
examples.example_translation: According to the school rules, you should attend the exam.

examples.example_chinese: 请大家按照老师的要求做。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā ànzhào lǎoshī de yāoqiú zuò.
examples.example_translation: Please act according to the teacher’s instructions.

meaning: v. 处理（事物） handle, conduct, transact

examples.example_chinese: 他正在办理出国手续，准备去留学。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhèngzài bànlǐ chūguó shǒuxù, zhǔnbèi qù liúxué.
examples.example_translation: He is handling the procedures for going abroad, preparing to study overseas.

examples.example_chinese: 你先办理住宿吧，这样就可以休息了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiān bànlǐ zhùsù ba, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ xiūxi le.
examples.example_translation: Handle your accommodation first, so you can rest.

examples.example_chinese: 我们公司办理各种旅游业务。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī bànlǐ gèzhǒng lǚyóu yèwù.
examples.example_translation: Our company handles all kinds of travel services.

examples.example_chinese: 这种事我们从来没有办理过。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shì wǒmen cónglái méi yǒu bànlǐ guò.
examples.example_translation: We have never handled this kind of thing before.

examples.example_chinese: 请大家在这里排队办理登机手续，办理完后就可以登机了。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zài zhèlǐ páiduì bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bànlǐ wán hòu jiù kěyǐ dēngjī le.
examples.example_translation: Please line up here to handle the check-in procedures; after that, you can board the plane.

meaning: v.担保，答应一定做到 · pledge, guarantee, assure, ensure

examples.example_chinese: 他已经保证以后不再说谎了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bǎozhèng yǐhòu bú zài shuōhuǎng le.
examples.example_translation: He has promised not to lie anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 我借你的钱，下个星期保证还你。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiè nǐ de qián, xià ge xīngqī bǎozhèng huán nǐ.
examples.example_translation: I borrowed your money and promise to return it next week.

examples.example_chinese: 我保证所说的话都是真的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎozhèng suǒ shuō de huà dōu shì zhēn de.
examples.example_translation: I guarantee that everything I said is true.

examples.example_chinese: 这项检查措施保证了产品的质量。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiǎnchá cuòshī bǎozhèngle chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng.
examples.example_translation: These inspection measures ensured the quality of the products.

examples.example_chinese: 他向老师再三保证，以后不会迟到。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎoshī zàisān bǎozhèng, yǐhòu bú huì chídào.
examples.example_translation: He repeatedly promised the teacher that he would not be late again.

meaning: v.尽力照顾，使不受损害 · protect

examples.example_chinese: 他用身体保护着这些孩子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yòng shēntǐ bǎohùzhe zhèxiē háizi.
examples.example_translation: He used his body to protect these children.

examples.example_chinese: 这个地区保护得很好，环境优美。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dìqū bǎohù de hěn hǎo, huánjìng yōuměi.
examples.example_translation: This area is well protected, and the environment is beautiful.

examples.example_chinese: 你现在还小，保护不了父母。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài hái xiǎo, bǎohù bù liǎo fùmǔ.
examples.example_translation: You are still too young to protect your parents.

examples.example_chinese: 由于受到了国家保护，老虎的数量开始增加了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóuyú shòudàole guójiā bǎohù, lǎohǔ de shùliàng kāishǐ zēngjiā le.
examples.example_translation: Thanks to national protection, the number of tigers has started to increase.

examples.example_chinese: 对这里的古代建筑应该加以保护。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì zhèlǐ de gǔdài jiànzhù yīnggāi jiāyǐ bǎohù.
examples.example_translation: The ancient buildings here should be further protected.

meaning: v.记下来 · recite from memory, learn by heart or by rote

examples.example_chinese: 老师天天让我们背课文，说这是一种很好的学习方法。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī tiāntiān ràng wǒmen bèi kèwén, shuō zhè shì yī zhǒng hěn hǎo de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: The teacher makes us recite the text every day, saying it is a very good way to learn.

examples.example_chinese: 他每天早上都背英语单词。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang dōu bèi yīngyǔ dāncí.
examples.example_translation: He memorizes English words every morning.

examples.example_chinese: 他看一遍就能背下来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kàn yí biàn jiù néng bèi xiàlái.
examples.example_translation: He can memorize it after reading it once.

examples.example_chinese: 我背了好几天也没记住这些词。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bèi le hǎo jǐ tiān yě méi jì zhù zhèxiē cí.
examples.example_translation: I recited these words for several days but still couldn't remember them.

meaning: n.具有创造性的方法、方式 · skill, art, craft

examples.example_chinese: 经理很懂得领导艺术。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ hěn dǒngdé lǐngdǎo yìshù.
examples.example_translation: The manager is very skilled in the art of leadership.

examples.example_chinese: 生活也是一门艺术，也需要学习。
examples.example_pinyin: Shēnghuó yě shì yì mén yìshù, yě xūyào xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: Life is also an art and needs to be learned.

examples.example_chinese: 他说话很有艺术性，让人接受起来很容易。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒu yìshùxìng, ràng rén jiēshòu qǐlái hěn róngyì.
examples.example_translation: He speaks very skillfully, making it easy for people to accept what he says.

examples.example_chinese: 在《爱的艺术》里
examples.example_pinyin: zài ài de yì shù lǐ

examples.example_chinese: 说话是一门艺术,更是一门学问。
examples.example_pinyin: shuō huà shì yī mén yì shù gèngshì yī mén xuéwen

meaning: adj.原有的 · original

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服本来的颜色是黄的，现在变白了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu běnlái de yánsè shì huáng de. xiànzài biàn bái le.
examples.example_translation: The original color of this piece of clothing was yellow, but now it has turned white.

examples.example_chinese: 我本来的想法不是这样的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ běnlái de xiǎngfǎ bú shì zhèyàng de.
examples.example_translation: My original idea was not like this.

examples.example_chinese: 她本来的样子就挺好看，打扮后就更漂亮了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā běnlái de yàngzi jiù tǐng hǎokàn. dǎbàn hòu jiù gèng piàoliang le.
examples.example_translation: She originally looked quite good, and after dressing up, she looked even prettier.

examples.example_chinese: 我还是坚持我本来的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ háishi jiānchí wǒ běnlái de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: I still stick to my original opinion.

meaning: n.检查事物是否达到要求的准则 · standard, criterion

examples.example_chinese: 他符合我们的用人标准。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā fúhé wǒmen de yòng rén biāozhǔn.
examples.example_translation: He meets our employment standards.

examples.example_chinese: 在这个问题上，我不知道对错的标准是什么。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, wǒ bù zhīdào duì-cuò de biāozhǔn shì shénme.
examples.example_translation: On this issue, I don't know what the standard for right and wrong is.

examples.example_chinese: 公司招聘人才有一套严格的标准。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī zhāopìn réncái yǒu yí tào yángé de biāozhǔn.
examples.example_translation: The company has a set of strict standards for recruiting talent.

examples.example_chinese: 如果你能达到这个标准，就可以毕业。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng dádào zhège biāozhǔn, jiù kěyǐ bìyè.
examples.example_translation: If you can meet this standard, you can graduate.

examples.example_chinese: 你所说的“能力”，可以告诉我们具体标准吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ suǒ shuō de “nénglì”, kěyǐ gàosu wǒmen jùtǐ biāozhǔn ma?
examples.example_translation: The "ability" you mentioned, can you tell us the specific standard?

meaning: n.一种资料，把项目画成格子后在里面填写文字或数字 · form, table

examples.example_chinese: 请你填一下这张表格。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng nǐ tián yíxià zhè zhāng biǎogé.
examples.example_translation: Please fill out this form.

examples.example_chinese: 这个表格应该怎么填写？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège biǎogé yīnggāi zěnme tiánxiě?
examples.example_translation: How should this form be filled out?

examples.example_chinese: 请你在表格的第一行写上自己的名字。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài biǎogé de dì-yī háng xiěshàng zìjǐ de míngzi.
examples.example_translation: Please write your name in the first row of the form.

examples.example_chinese: 我画个表格，你们就会看得更清楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huà gè biǎogé, nǐmen jiù huì kàn de gèng qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: If I draw a table, you will see it more clearly.

examples.example_chinese: 我发现这个表格里的数字有不少错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhège biǎogé lǐ de shùzì yǒu bù shǎo cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: I found quite a few mistakes in the numbers in this table.

meaning: v.显示出来（多指精神, 品质等）；表示出来的行为, 作风等 · show, display, manifest; manifestation

examples.example_chinese: 在这次活动中，他表现得很勇敢。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhè cì huódòng zhōng, tā biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒnggǎn.
examples.example_translation: In this activity, he behaved very bravely.

examples.example_chinese: 演员很好地表现了人物的性格。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǎnyuán hěn hǎo de biǎoxiàn le rénwù de xìnggé.
examples.example_translation: The actor displayed the character's personality very well.

examples.example_chinese: 他说话办事表现出了很高的水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuōhuà bànshì biǎoxiàn chūle hěn gāo de shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: He showed a high level in speaking and handling affairs.

examples.example_chinese: 面对困难，他表现得非常坚强。
examples.example_pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán, tā biǎoxiàn de fēicháng jiānqiáng.
examples.example_translation: Facing difficulties, he showed great strength.

examples.example_chinese: 他的聪明表现在很多方面。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de cōngmíng biǎoxiàn zài hěn duō fāngmiàn.
examples.example_translation: His intelligence is manifested in many aspects.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天在活动中有很好的表现。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān zài huódòng zhōng yǒu hěn hǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.example_translation: He had a good performance in the activity today.

examples.example_chinese: 根据他平时的表现，大家都认为他很能干。
examples.example_pinyin: Gēnjù tā píngshí de biǎoxiàn, dàjiā dōu rènwéi tā hěn nénggàn.
examples.example_translation: According to his usual performance, everyone thinks he is very capable.

examples.example_chinese: 在这次招聘中，你的表现不错。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhè cì zhāopìn zhōng, nǐ de biǎoxiàn búcuò.
examples.example_translation: In this recruitment, your performance was good.

examples.example_chinese: 他这么做是一种自私的表现。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhème zuò shì yī zhǒng zìsī de biǎoxiàn.
examples.example_translation: Doing this is a manifestation of selfishness.

meaning: conj.表示更进一步的意思，连接两个并列的动词或形容词等，更常用的是连接两个分句 · and, besides, moreover, furthermore

examples.example_chinese: 爸爸理解并且支持我的做法。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàba lǐjiě bìngqiě zhīchí wǒ de zuòfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Dad understands and supports what I do.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不但认识，并且是好朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bùdàn rènshi, bìngqiě shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: We not only know each other, but we are also good friends.

examples.example_chinese: 我听过这首歌，并且会唱。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tīngguò zhè shǒu gē, bìngqiě huì chàng.
examples.example_translation: I have heard this song, and I can sing it.

examples.example_chinese: 他一直照顾这位老人，并且从经济上帮助他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīzhí zhàogù zhè wèi lǎorén, bìngqiě cóng jīngjì shàng bāngzhù tā.
examples.example_translation: He has always taken care of this old man and also helped him financially.

examples.example_chinese: 这些花儿不仅漂亮，并且还香得很。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē huār bùjǐn piàoliang, bìngqiě hái xiāng de hěn.
examples.example_translation: These flowers are not only beautiful, but also very fragrant.

meaning: v.通过广播、电视等让人听到或看到 · broadcast, play (audio/video)

examples.example_chinese: 收音机里播放了他的讲话。
examples.example_pinyin: shōuyīnjī lǐ bōfàng le tā de jiǎnghuà.
examples.example_translation: His speech was broadcast on the radio.

examples.example_chinese: 电视台正在播放这场比赛。
examples.example_pinyin: diànshìtái zhèngzài bōfàng zhè chǎng bǐsài.
examples.example_translation: The TV station is broadcasting this game.

examples.example_chinese: 这场比赛已经播放过了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè chǎng bǐsài yǐjīng bōfàng guò le.
examples.example_translation: This game has already been broadcast.

examples.example_chinese: 这个台每天下午三点播放音乐节目。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège tái měitiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn bōfàng yīnyuè jiémù.
examples.example_translation: This station broadcasts music programs at 3 PM every day.

examples.example_chinese: 你可以在报纸上查到播放时间。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ zài bàozhǐ shàng chádào bōfàng shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: You can find the broadcast time in the newspaper.

examples.example_chinese: 那部电视剧已经被禁止播放了。
examples.example_pinyin: nà bù diànshìjù yǐjīng bèi jìnzhǐ bōfàng le.
examples.example_translation: That TV series has been banned from broadcasting.

meaning: adv.表示事理上或情理上不需要 · need not, not have to

examples.example_chinese: 这只是单元考试，你不必那么紧张。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì dānyuán kǎoshì, nǐ bùbì nàme jǐnzhāng.
examples.example_translation: This is just a unit test, you don't need to be so nervous.

examples.example_chinese: 我自己可以做，不必麻烦别人了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bùbì máfan biérén le.
examples.example_translation: I can do it myself, no need to trouble others.

examples.example_chinese: 你不必着急，我们会帮你找到他的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bùbì zhāojí, wǒmen huì bāng nǐ zhǎodào tā de.
examples.example_translation: You don't have to worry, we will help you find him.

examples.example_chinese: 我去就可以了，你不必去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qù jiù kěyǐ le, nǐ bùbì qù le.
examples.example_translation: I can go, you don't have to go.

examples.example_chinese: 文章不必写得太长，能说明问题就可以了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wénzhāng bùbì xiě de tài cháng, néng shuōmíng wèntí jiù kěyǐ le.
examples.example_translation: The article doesn't have to be too long, as long as it explains the problem.

meaning: conj.合在一起，并且 · to be side by side, simultaneously, and

examples.example_chinese: “我确实不敢碰你，但并不是懦弱。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ què shí bù gǎn pèng nǐ dàn bìng bù shì nuò ruò
examples.example_translation: "I really wouldn’t dare touch you, but it’s not because I’m cowardly.

examples.example_chinese: ”陶罐争辩说，“我们生来就是盛东西的，并不是来互相碰撞的。
examples.example_pinyin: táo guàn zhēng biàn shuō wǒ men 生 lái jiù shì chéng dōngxi de bìng bù shì lái hù xiāng pèngzhuàng de
examples.example_translation: " the clay jar argued, "We are meant to hold things, not to collide with each other.

examples.example_chinese: 它是隋朝的石匠李春设计并参加建造的，到现在已经有一千四百多年了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shì suí cháo de shí jiàng lǐ chūn shè jì bìng cān jiā jiàn zào de dào xiàn zài yǐ jīng yǒu yī qiān sì bǎi duō nián le
examples.example_translation: It was designed and constructed by the stone mason Li Chun during the Sui Dynasty, and it has been over fourteen hundred years since its completion.

examples.example_chinese: “固然，我并不出名， 我没有出现在地图上， 像你那样蜿蜒地贯穿全国， 也没有行吟诗人为我弹琴歌唱。
examples.example_pinyin: gù rán wǒ bìng bù chū míng wǒ méi yǒu chū xiàn zài de tú shàng xiàng nǐ nà yàng wān yán de guàn chuān quán guó yě méi yǒu xíng yín shī rén wèi wǒ tán qín gē chàng
examples.example_translation: "Of course, I am not famous, I am not marked on any map, winding through the country like you, nor do wandering poets play music and sing for me."

examples.example_chinese: 这种境界并不太易得，与环境有关，更与心境有关。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhǒng bìng bù tài de yǔ huán yǒu guān gèng yǔ yǒu guān
examples.example_translation: This state of mind is not easily attained; it relates not only to the environment but even more to one's inner state.

meaning: conj.表示条件或情况不同而结果不变 · conj.: no matter how/who/what/etc.

examples.example_chinese: 不论任何关系
examples.example_pinyin: bùlùn rèn hé guān xì
examples.example_translation: In any relationship

examples.example_chinese: 不论你是否愿意,现实都摆在你面前。
examples.example_pinyin: bùlùn nǐ shì fǒu yuàn yì xiànshí dōu bǎi zài nǐ miàn qián
examples.example_translation: Whether you're willing or not, reality stands before you.

examples.example_chinese: 一不论脑袋
examples.example_pinyin: yī bùlùn nǎodai

examples.example_chinese: 不论任何关系
examples.example_pinyin: bùlùn rèn hé guān xì
examples.example_translation: In any relationship

examples.example_chinese: 不论你是否愿意,现实都摆在你面前。
examples.example_pinyin: bùlùn nǐ shì fǒu yuàn yì xiànshí dōu bǎi zài nǐ miàn qián
examples.example_translation: Whether you're willing or not, reality stands before you.

meaning: adv.连续不断地 · continuously, constantly

examples.example_chinese: 她的眼泪不断地往下流。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de yǎnlèi bùduàn de wǎng xià liú.
examples.example_translation: Her tears kept flowing down.

examples.example_chinese: 河水不断地流向大海。
examples.example_pinyin: Héshuǐ bùduàn de liú xiàng dàhǎi.
examples.example_translation: The river water continuously flows to the sea.

examples.example_chinese: 他不断鼓励我，我才有了信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bùduàn gǔlì wǒ, wǒ cái yǒule xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: He kept encouraging me, so I gained confidence.

examples.example_chinese: 我还要不断地提高自己的汉语水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái yào bùduàn de tígāo zìjǐ de hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: I still need to constantly improve my Chinese level.

examples.example_chinese: 经过不断努力，他终于考上了重点大学。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngguò bùduàn nǔlì, tā zhōngyú kǎo shàngle zhòngdiǎn dàxué.
examples.example_translation: After continuous effort, he was finally admitted to a key university.

meaning: phr.表示虽然不愿意但也只能这样 · have to, cannot but

examples.example_chinese: 我的鞋坏了，不得不再买一双。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de xié huài le, bùdébù zài mǎi yì shuāng.
examples.example_translation: My shoes are broken, so I have to buy another pair.

examples.example_chinese: 我生病了，不得不休息。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, bùdébù xiūxi.
examples.example_translation: I got sick, so I have to rest.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈打来电话了，他不得不回家。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma dǎlái diànhuà le, tā bùdébù huí jiā.
examples.example_translation: His mom called, so he had to go home.

examples.example_chinese: 门太矮了，他不得不低头。
examples.example_pinyin: Mén tài ǎi le, tā bùdébù dī tóu.
examples.example_translation: The door is too low, so he has to lower his head.

examples.example_chinese: 这里不能吸烟，他们不得不到外面去吸。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli bù néng xī yān, tāmen bùdébù dào wàimiàn qù xī.
examples.example_translation: Smoking is not allowed here, so they have to go outside to smoke.

meaning: conj.不但 · not only

examples.example_chinese: 不仅我想去游泳,大家都想去。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùjǐn wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, dàjiā dōu xiǎng qù.
examples.example_translation: Not only do I want to go swimming, everyone wants to go.

examples.example_chinese: 我不仅见过他,而且我们很熟悉。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bùjǐn jiànguo tā, érqiě wǒmen hěn shúxī.
examples.example_translation: Not only have I met him, but we are also very familiar with each other.

examples.example_chinese: 不仅人有生命,树木、花草都有生命。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùjǐn rén yǒu shēngmìng, shùmù、 huācǎo dōu yǒu shēngmìng.
examples.example_translation: Not only do people have lives, but trees and flowers also have lives.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不仅需要粮食,而且还需要被子、家具等。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bùjǐn xūyào liángshi, érqiě hái xūyào bèizi、 jiājù děng.
examples.example_translation: Not only do we need food, but we also need quilts, furniture, etc.

examples.example_chinese: 他不仅在中国有名,在世界上也很有名。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zài Zhōngguó yǒumíng, zài shìjiè shang yě hěn yǒumíng.
examples.example_translation: Not only is he famous in China, but also very famous in the world.

meaning: n.组成某一整体的部分或单位 · department, branch

examples.example_chinese: 我们公司有五个部门。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī yǒu wǔ gè bùmén.
examples.example_translation: Our company has five departments.

examples.example_chinese: 我哥哥在交通部门工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gēge zài jiāotōng bùmén gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: My older brother works in the transportation department.

examples.example_chinese: 这个会议要求各个部门的领导都参加。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège huìyì yào qiú gè gè bùmén de lǐngdǎo dōu cānjiā.
examples.example_translation: This meeting requires the leaders of all departments to attend.

examples.example_chinese: 学校的各个部门都是为学生服务的。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào de gè gè bùmén dōu shì wèi xuéshēng fúwù de.
examples.example_translation: All departments of the school serve the students.

examples.example_chinese: 这个问题你得找别的部门，我们不负责。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí nǐ děi zhǎo bié de bùmén, wǒmen bù fùzé.
examples.example_translation: For this problem, you need to contact another department; we are not responsible.

meaning: v.由已有事物生出新的事物, 出现 · give rise to, bring about

examples.example_chinese: 最近妻子也对足球产生了兴趣。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuìjìn qīzi yě duì zúqiú chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
examples.example_translation: Recently, my wife has also developed an interest in football.

examples.example_chinese: 他们在一起工作，渐渐产生了爱情。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zài yìqǐ gōngzuò, jiànjiàn chǎnshēng le àiqíng.
examples.example_translation: They worked together and gradually fell in love.

examples.example_chinese: 这样做可能会产生一些问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò kěnéng huì chǎnshēng yìxiē wèntí.
examples.example_translation: Doing this may cause some problems.

examples.example_chinese: 他的行为已经产生了不良影响。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi yǐjīng chǎnshēng le bùliáng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: His behavior has already had a negative impact.

examples.example_chinese: 旧的矛盾没有消除，新的矛盾又产生了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiù de yáyín méi yǒu xiāochú, xīn de yáyín yòu chǎnshēng le.
examples.example_translation: The old conflicts have not been resolved, and new ones have arisen.

meaning: n.指万里长城 · the Great Wall

examples.example_chinese: 我们明天要去游览长城。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yào qù yóulǎn Chángchéng.
examples.example_translation: We are going to visit the Great Wall tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 来到长城脚下，我非常激动。
examples.example_pinyin: Láidào Chángchéng jiǎo xià, wǒ fēicháng jīdòng.
examples.example_translation: Standing at the foot of the Great Wall, I was very excited.

examples.example_chinese: 长城真是一个了不起的奇迹。
examples.example_pinyin: Chángchéng zhēn shì yí ge liǎobuqǐ de qíjì.
examples.example_translation: The Great Wall is truly a remarkable wonder.

examples.example_chinese: 他们爬到了长城最高的地方，兴奋极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen pá dào le Chángchéng zuì gāo de dìfang, xīngfèn jí le.
examples.example_translation: They climbed to the highest point of the Great Wall and were extremely excited.

examples.example_chinese: 北京的长城、故宫、颐和园都是世界文化遗产。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng de Chángchéng, Gùgōng, Yíhé Yuán dōu shì shìjiè wénhuà yíchǎn.
examples.example_translation: The Great Wall, the Forbidden City, and the Summer Palace in Beijing are all World Cultural Heritage sites.

meaning: v.获得预期的结果（跟“失败”相对） · succeed (as opposed to "fail")

examples.example_chinese: 我申请奖学金成功了！
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn chénggōng le!
examples.example_translation: I succeeded in applying for the scholarship!

examples.example_chinese: 经过努力，他们的实验终于成功了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì, tāmen de shíyàn zhōngyú chénggōng le.
examples.example_translation: After hard work, their experiment finally succeeded.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要泄气，一定会成功的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ búyào xièqì, yídìng huì chénggōng de.
examples.example_translation: Don't lose heart, you will definitely succeed.

examples.example_chinese: 他成功过，也失败过，不过他从来都很乐观。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chénggōngguo, yě shībàiguo, bùguò tā cónglái dōu hěn lèguān.
examples.example_translation: He has succeeded and failed, but he has always been optimistic.

meaning: n.城墙以内的地方，城市（跟“乡”相对） · city wall, city, town, castle

examples.example_chinese: 他画了一幅著名的画——《清明上河图》，画的是北宋都城汴京热闹的场面。
examples.example_pinyin: tā huà le yī fú zhù míng de huà qīng míng shàng hé tú huà de shì běi sòng dōu chéng biàn jīng rè nào de chǎng miàn
examples.example_translation: He painted a famous picture—"Along the River During the Qingming Festival"—which depicts the bustling scene of the capital city Bianjing during the Northern Song dynasty.

examples.example_chinese: 被郑伦给拿进冀州城了,
examples.example_pinyin: bèi zhèng lún gěi ná jìn jì zhōu chéng le
examples.example_translation: has been captured by Zheng Lun and taken into Jizhou City.

examples.example_chinese: 到这一叫城,
examples.example_pinyin: dào zhè yī jiào chéng
examples.example_translation: Upon reaching the city gate,

examples.example_chinese: 朝歌城的老百姓啊
examples.example_pinyin: zhāo gē chéng de lǎobǎixìng a
examples.example_translation: The common people of Zhaoge City

examples.example_chinese: 黄飞虎众人全都进了城
examples.example_pinyin: huáng fēi hǔ zhòngrén quándōu jìn le chéng
examples.example_translation: Huang Feihu and his men have all entered the city

meaning: adv.从过去到现在（多用于否定式） · always

examples.example_chinese: 我从来不向别人借钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cónglái bù xiàng biéren jiè qián.
examples.example_translation: I never borrow money from others.

examples.example_chinese: 我从来没离开过中国。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi líkāiguo Zhōngguó.
examples.example_translation: I have never left China.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事我从来没听说过。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ cónglái méi tīngshuōguo.
examples.example_translation: I have never heard of this before.

examples.example_chinese: 他从来不吸烟、不喝酒。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cónglái bù xī yān, bù hē jiǔ.
examples.example_translation: He never smokes or drinks.

examples.example_chinese: 她的房间从来都是这么干净、整齐。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de fángjiān cónglái dōu shì zhème gānjìng, zhěngqí.
examples.example_translation: Her room has always been this clean and tidy.

meaning: v.储蓄 · save, deposit

examples.example_chinese: 我下午要去银行存钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yínháng cún qián.
examples.example_translation: I am going to the bank to deposit money this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 他把这个月的工资都存起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zhège yuè de gōngzī dōu cún qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: He has saved all his salary for this month.

examples.example_chinese: 这笔钱我存了两年了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián wǒ cún le liǎng nián le.
examples.example_translation: I have saved this sum of money for two years.

examples.example_chinese: 老人的钱都在银行里存着呢，舍不得花。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎorén de qián dōu zài yínháng lǐ cún zhe ne, shěbùdé huā.
examples.example_translation: The old person's money is all deposited in the bank, he is reluctant to spend it.

meaning: adj.不正确的, 与客观实际不符的 · wrong, mistaken, incorrect

examples.example_chinese: 你的这种想法是非常错误的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ shì fēicháng cuòwù de.
examples.example_translation: This way of thinking is very wrong.

examples.example_chinese: 我们错误地估计了他们的水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen cuòwù de gūjì le tāmen de shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: We wrongly estimated their level.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要在错误的道路上越走越远。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bú yào zài cuòwù de dàolù shàng yuè zǒu yuè yuǎn.
examples.example_translation: Don't go further and further down the wrong path.

examples.example_chinese: 我们及时纠正了错误的想法。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jíshí jiūzhèng le cuòwù de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: We corrected the wrong idea in time.

meaning: v.到, 实现（多指抽象事物或程度） · achieve, attain, reach (usually abstract objective or degree)

examples.example_chinese: 他的汉语达到了很高的水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ dádào le hěn gāo de shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: His Chinese has reached a very high level.

examples.example_chinese: 这次考试我没有达到及格的标准。
