meaning: n.妈妈 · mother

examples.example_chinese: 我来给你们介绍一下：这是我母亲，这是我父亲。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ lái gěi nǐmen jièshào yíxià: Zhè shì wǒ mǔqīn, zhè shì wǒ fùqīn.
examples.example_translation: Let me introduce: this is my mother, this is my father.

examples.example_chinese: 我母亲生我养我，我要好好儿报答她。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mǔqīn shēng wǒ yǎng wǒ, wǒ yào hǎohāor bàodá tā.
examples.example_translation: My mother gave birth to me and raised me, I must repay her well.

examples.example_chinese: 远方的孩子很想念母亲，想念家。
examples.example_pinyin: Yuǎnfāng de háizi hěn xiǎngniàn mǔqīn, xiǎngniàn jiā.
examples.example_translation: Children far away miss their mothers and home very much.

examples.example_chinese: 母亲见到回国的儿子时，激动得流下了热泪。
examples.example_pinyin: Mǔqīn jiàndào huí guó de érzi shí, jīdòng de liúxiàle rè lèi.
examples.example_translation: When the mother saw her son return home, she was so moved that she shed tears of joy.

examples.example_chinese: 每年五月的第二个星期日是母亲节。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi nián wǔ yuè de dì-èr ge xīngqīrì shì Mǔqīn Jié.
examples.example_translation: The second Sunday of May every year is Mother's Day.

meaning: n. 打击或寻求的对象, object, target; 想要达到的境地或标准, purpose, goal, aim

examples.example_chinese: 目标被击中了。
examples.example_pinyin: mùbiāo bèi jīzhòng le.
examples.example_translation: The target was hit.

examples.example_chinese: 你只有找准了目标，才能练好射击。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ zhǐyǒu zhǎo zhǔn le mùbiāo, cái néng liàn hǎo shèjī.
examples.example_translation: You can only practice good shooting if you aim accurately at the target.

examples.example_chinese: 他们发现目标后，显得很兴奋。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen fāxiàn mùbiāo hòu, xiǎnde hěn xīngfèn.
examples.example_translation: They seemed very excited after discovering the target.

examples.example_chinese: 现在，目标的方位还不确定。
examples.example_pinyin: xiànzài, mùbiāo de fāngwèi hái bù quèdìng.
examples.example_translation: Currently, the target's location is still uncertain.

examples.example_chinese: 她曾是许多男孩子追求的目标。
examples.example_pinyin: tā céng shì xǔduō nánháizi zhuīqiú de mùbiāo.
examples.example_translation: She used to be the object of many boys' pursuit.

examples.example_chinese: 他学汉语的目标很明确，就是为了在中国找工作。
examples.example_pinyin: tā xué hànyǔ de mùbiāo hěn míngquè, jiùshì wèile zài zhōngguó zhǎo gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: His goal in learning Chinese is very clear: to find a job in China.

examples.example_chinese: 生活有了目标，你才会觉得有意思。
examples.example_pinyin: shēnghuó yǒu le mùbiāo, nǐ cái huì juéde yǒu yìsi.
examples.example_translation: Life only becomes interesting when you have a goal.

examples.example_chinese: 年轻人应该树立远大的人生目标。
examples.example_pinyin: niánqīngrén yīnggāi shùlì yuǎndà de rénshēng mùbiāo.
examples.example_translation: Young people should set ambitious life goals.

meaning: n.for now, at present, at the moment

examples.example_chinese: 我们的汉语水平目前还不够好。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen de hànyǔ shuǐpíng mùqián hái bù gòu hǎo.
examples.example_translation: Our Chinese level is not good enough at present.

examples.example_chinese: 到目前为止，我还没有接到录取通知书。
examples.example_pinyin: dào mùqián wéizhǐ, wǒ hái méiyǒu jiē dào lùqǔ tōngzhīshū.
examples.example_translation: Up to now, I haven't received the admission notice.

examples.example_chinese: 我们目前的主要任务是学习。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen mùqián de zhǔyào rènwù shì xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: Our main task at present is to study.

examples.example_chinese: 目前你有什么打算？
examples.example_pinyin: mùqián nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
examples.example_translation: What are your plans for now?

meaning: adv.用在反问句中加强反问语气 · used to reiterate a rhetorical question

examples.example_chinese: 我们四点开会，难道你忘了？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen sì diǎn kāihuì, nándào nǐ wàng le?
examples.example_translation: We have a meeting at four, did you forget?

examples.example_chinese: 你难道不知道明天有考试吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ nándào bù zhīdào míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì ma?
examples.example_translation: Don't you know there's an exam tomorrow?

examples.example_chinese: 难道你没看昨天的新闻吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nándào nǐ méi kàn zuótiān de xīnwén ma?
examples.example_translation: Didn't you watch yesterday's news?

examples.example_chinese: 难道我们没有一点儿办法？
examples.example_pinyin: Nándào wǒmen méiyǒu yìdiǎnr bànfǎ?
examples.example_translation: Is there really nothing we can do?

examples.example_chinese: 这么有名的地方，难道你没听说过？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème yǒumíng de dìfang, nándào nǐ méi tīngshuōguo?
examples.example_translation: Such a famous place, haven't you heard of it?

meaning: n.里头，里面（跟“外”相对） · inside (as opposed to "外 outside")

examples.example_chinese: 学校内就有银行，很方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào nèi jiù yǒu yínháng, hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: There is a bank inside the school, which is very convenient.

examples.example_chinese: 图书馆内非常安静。
examples.example_pinyin: Túshūguǎn nèi fēicháng ānjìng.
examples.example_translation: It is very quiet inside the library.

examples.example_chinese: 他走进屋内后就没出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒujìn wū nèi hòu jiù méi chūlái.
examples.example_translation: He didn’t come out after entering the room.

examples.example_chinese: 我今年年内要考两次HSK考试。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián nián nèi yào kǎo liǎng cì HSK kǎoshì.
examples.example_translation: I will take the HSK exam twice within this year.

examples.example_chinese: 他这个月月内就回国了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhège yuè yuè nèi jiù huí guó le.
examples.example_translation: He will return to his country within this month.

examples.example_chinese: 我的妻子和孩子还在国内。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de qīzi hé háizi hái zài guó nèi.
examples.example_translation: My wife and children are still in the country.

meaning: n.事物内部存在的情况或包含的实质 · content

examples.example_chinese: 我们用的这本汉语书内容很有意思。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yòng de zhè běn Hànyǔ shū nèiróng hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.example_translation: The content of this Chinese book we use is very interesting.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书的内容很适合小学生阅读。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn shìhé xiǎoxuéshēng yuèdú.
examples.example_translation: The content of this book is very suitable for primary school students to read.

examples.example_chinese: 你能简单介绍一下电影的内容吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng jiǎndān jièshào yīxià diànyǐng de nèiróng ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you briefly introduce the content of the movie?

examples.example_chinese: 你们谈话的内容你还记得吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen tánhuà de nèiróng nǐ hái jìde ma?
examples.example_translation: Do you still remember the content of your conversation?

examples.example_chinese: 这封信的内容很简单，就是向你借钱。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn de nèiróng hěn jiǎndān, jiù shì xiàng nǐ jiè qián.
examples.example_translation: The content of this letter is very simple, it is just to borrow money from you.

meaning: n.做好某件事情的本领 · ability, capacity

examples.example_chinese: 他办事能力很强。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bànshì nénglì hěn qiáng.
examples.example_translation: He has strong ability to handle affairs.

examples.example_chinese: 我想提高一下汉语的表达能力。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo yīxià Hànyǔ de biǎodá nénglì.
examples.example_translation: I want to improve my Chinese expression ability.

examples.example_chinese: 他的能力是在工作中锻炼出来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de nénglì shì zài gōngzuò zhōng duànliàn chūlái de.
examples.example_translation: His ability was developed through work.

examples.example_chinese: 父母很注意培养孩子的生活能力。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùmǔ hěn zhùyì péiyǎng háizi de shēnghuó nénglì.
examples.example_translation: Parents pay great attention to cultivating their children's life skills.

examples.example_chinese: 老师鼓励大家都把自己的能力发挥出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì dàjiā dōu bǎ zìjǐ de nénglì fāhuī chūlái.
examples.example_translation: The teacher encourages everyone to bring out their abilities.

meaning: n.以从事农业生产为主的人聚居的地方 · country, village

examples.example_chinese: 我是在农村长大的，20岁才来城市。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shì zài nóngcūn zhǎng dà de, èrshí suì cái lái chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: I grew up in the countryside and only came to the city at the age of 20.

examples.example_chinese: 我比较喜欢农村的生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuan nóngcūn de shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: I prefer life in the countryside.

examples.example_chinese: 现在，农村的变化非常大。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài, nóngcūn de biànhuà fēicháng dà.
examples.example_translation: Now, the changes in the countryside are tremendous.

examples.example_chinese: 这20多年的时间，很多农村都富起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè èrshí duō nián de shíjiān, hěn duō nóngcūn dōu fù qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: In these more than 20 years, many villages have become rich.

examples.example_chinese: 我老家是农村的，父母还在那里。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ lǎojiā shì nóngcūn de, fùmǔ hái zài nàlǐ.
examples.example_translation: My hometown is in the countryside, and my parents are still there.

meaning: adj.气温不冷不热，让人感到很舒服 · warm, nice and warm

examples.example_chinese: 春天来了，天气暖和了。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì nuǎnhuo le.
examples.example_translation: Spring has come, and the weather is warm.

examples.example_chinese: 今天比昨天天暖和很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān nuǎnhuo hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: Today is much warmer than yesterday.

examples.example_chinese: 外面很冷，房间里却很暖和。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, fángjiān lǐ què hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.example_translation: It’s very cold outside, but it’s warm in the room.

examples.example_chinese: 天太冷了，我穿了很多衣服，也不觉得暖和。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiān tài lěng le, wǒ chuān le hěn duō yīfu, yě bù juéde nuǎnhuo.
examples.example_translation: It’s too cold, I wore a lot of clothes, but still don’t feel warm.

examples.example_chinese: 记着穿暖和一些，别感冒了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìzhe chuān nuǎnhuo yīxiē, bié gǎnmào le.
examples.example_translation: Remember to dress warmly, don’t catch a cold.

meaning: v. 用手掌或成片的东西打, pat, tap with a palm; 拍摄, take (a picture), shoot (a film); 吹捧，献媚, flatter, toady

examples.example_chinese: 小朋友们在拍皮球。
examples.example_pinyin: xiǎopéngyǒumen zài pāi píqiú.
examples.example_translation: The children are bouncing the ball.

examples.example_chinese: 他走到她跟前，轻轻地拍了她一下。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zǒu dào tā gēnqián, qīngqīng de pāi le tā yīxià.
examples.example_translation: He walked up to her and gently patted her.

examples.example_chinese: 我拍了两次都没拍着，那蚊子飞走了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ pāi le liǎng cì dōu méi pāi zháo, nà wénzi fēi zǒu le.
examples.example_translation: I tried to swat it twice but missed, and the mosquito flew away.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚一进屋，妈妈就帮我拍掉了身上的雪。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ gāng yī jìn wū, māma jiù bāng wǒ pāi diào le shēnshang de xuě.
examples.example_translation: As soon as I entered the house, Mom helped me brush off the snow from my body.

examples.example_chinese: 我们在天安门广场拍了好多照片。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zài tiān'ānmén guǎngchǎng pāi le hǎo duō zhàopiàn.
examples.example_translation: We took many photos in Tiananmen Square.

examples.example_chinese: 演员们都很投入地拍这场戏。
examples.example_pinyin: yǎnyuánmen dōu hěn tóurù de pāi zhè chǎng xì.
examples.example_translation: The actors were very dedicated in shooting this scene.

examples.example_chinese: 这个故事片拍好了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège gùshìpiàn pāi hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: This feature film has been shot well.

examples.example_chinese: 他拍的这部故事片获奖了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā pāi de zhè bù gùshìpiàn huòjiǎng le.
examples.example_translation: The feature film he shot won an award.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影，导演打算尽快拍完。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè bù diànyǐng, dǎoyǎn dǎsuàn jǐnkuài pāi wán.
examples.example_translation: The director plans to finish shooting this movie as soon as possible.

examples.example_chinese: 他一天到晚地拍领导马屁。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yītiān dào wǎn de pāi lǐngdǎo mǎpì.
examples.example_translation: He flatters his boss all day long.

examples.example_chinese: 他这几句话，明显是在拍领导。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhè jǐ jù huà, míngxiǎn shì zài pāi lǐngdǎo.
examples.example_translation: These few words of his are clearly meant to flatter the leader.

meaning: v.根据情况做出决定 · judge, estimate

examples.example_chinese: 迷路时，我们可以根据太阳的位置判断方向。
examples.example_pinyin: Mílù shí, wǒmen kěyǐ gēnjù tàiyáng de wèizhì pànduàn fāngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: When lost, we can judge the direction according to the position of the sun.

examples.example_chinese: 他准确地判断了当前的形势，做出了正确的决定。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhǔnquè de pànduànle dāngqián de xíngshì, zuòchūle zhèngquè de juédìng.
examples.example_translation: He accurately judged the current situation and made the right decision.

examples.example_chinese: 你要动动脑筋，好好儿地判断一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yào dòngdòng nǎojīn, hǎohāor de pànduàn yīxià.
examples.example_translation: You need to use your brain and judge carefully.

examples.example_chinese: 他的判断能力相当强。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de pànduàn nénglì xiāngdāng qiáng.
examples.example_translation: His judgment ability is quite strong.

examples.example_chinese: 让他在这种情况下做出判断，的确很难。
examples.example_pinyin: Ràng tā zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià zuòchū pànduàn, díquè hěn nán.
examples.example_translation: It is indeed difficult for him to make a judgment in this situation.

examples.example_chinese: 判断下列句子的说法是否正确。
examples.example_pinyin: Pànduàn xiàliè jùzi de shuōfǎ shìfǒu zhèngquè.
examples.example_translation: Judge whether the following statements are correct.

meaning: v.对错误和缺点提出意见 · criticize

examples.example_chinese: 爸爸批评了孩子的撒谎行为。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàba pīpíngle háizi de sāhuǎng xíngwéi.
examples.example_translation: Dad criticized the child's lying behavior.

examples.example_chinese: 因为跟客户争吵，经理毫不客气地批评了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi gēn kèhù zhēngchǎo, jīnglǐ háo bú kèqi de pīpíngle tā.
examples.example_translation: Because he quarreled with a client, the manager criticized him bluntly.

examples.example_chinese: 你批评得很对，以后我一定改正。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ pīpíng de hěn duì, yǐhòu wǒ yídìng gǎizhèng.
examples.example_translation: Your criticism is correct, I will definitely correct it in the future.

examples.example_chinese: 校长对他犯的错误提出了批评。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàozhǎng duì tā fàn de cuòwù tíchūle pīpíng.
examples.example_translation: The principal criticized the mistakes he made.

examples.example_chinese: 就容不得别人的批评
examples.example_pinyin: jiù róng bù dé bié ren de pī píng

meaning: adj.有共同性的，广泛存在的 · at large, widespread, universal

examples.example_chinese: 散步有利于身体健康，这是大家普遍的看法。
examples.example_pinyin: Sànbù yǒulì yú shēntǐ jiànkāng, zhè shì dàjiā pǔbiàn de kànfǎ.
examples.example_translation: Walking is good for health, this is a common view.

examples.example_chinese: 重男轻女的观念以前在中国农村很普遍。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhòng nán qīng nǚ de guānniàn yǐqián zài Zhōngguó nóngcūn hěn pǔbiàn.
examples.example_translation: The idea of valuing boys over girls used to be widespread in rural China.

examples.example_chinese: 随着时代的发展，人们的知识水平普遍提高了。
examples.example_pinyin: Suízhe shídài de fāzhǎn, rénmen de zhīshi shuǐpíng pǔbiàn tígāo le.
examples.example_translation: With the development of the times, people’s knowledge level has generally improved.

examples.example_chinese: 大城市里，青年男女晚婚晚育的现象越来越普遍了。
examples.example_pinyin: Dà chéngshì lǐ, qīngnián nánnǚ wǎnhūn wǎnyù de xiànxiàng yuè lái yuè pǔbiàn le.
examples.example_translation: In big cities, the phenomenon of late marriage and late childbirth among young people is becoming more and more common.

examples.example_chinese: 这位外国朋友问我这是不是国内各地普遍的风俗，我告诉他我走过十几省还不曾遇见过这样的场面，而且当场若无壁板设备，或是顾客嘴部筋肉不够发达，此种盛况即不易发生。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè wèi wài guó péng you wèn wǒ zhè shì bù shì nèi gè de pǔbiàn de fēngsú wǒ gàosu tā wǒ zǒu guo shí jǐ shěng huán bù céng yù jian guo zhè yàng de chǎng miàn érqiě dāng chǎng ruò wú bǎn shèbèi huò shì gùkè zuǐ bù jīn ròu bù gòu fā cǐ zhòng chéng jí bù fāshēng

meaning: cl.一段时间 · a period of time

examples.example_chinese: 万物有期
examples.example_pinyin: wàn wù yǒu qī
examples.example_translation: All things have their season

examples.example_chinese: 一个星期过后，它已经学得相当不错了。
examples.example_pinyin: yī gè qī guò tā jīng de dāng bù cuò le
examples.example_translation: A week later, it had learned quite well.

examples.example_chinese: 或者叛逆期打架斗殴
examples.example_pinyin: huò zhě pànnì qī dǎ jià dòu ōu
examples.example_translation: Or got into fights during rebellious years

meaning: adj.不完整的，破烂的 · broken, torn, worn-out

examples.example_chinese: 这些破家具，都该清理出去。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē pò jiājù, dōu gāi qīnglǐ chūqù le.
examples.example_translation: These broken pieces of furniture should all be cleared out.

examples.example_chinese: 这扇窗户破了，赶紧找人修一修吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shàn chuānghu pò le, gǎnjǐn zhǎo rén xiū yī xiū ba.
examples.example_translation: This window is broken, hurry and find someone to fix it.

examples.example_chinese: 这辆自行车太破了，不能骑了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē tài pò le, bù néng qí le.
examples.example_translation: This bicycle is too worn-out to ride.

examples.example_chinese: 他非常节省，衣服穿破了也舍不得扔了买新的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā fēicháng jiéshěng, yīfu chuān pò le yě shěbude rēngle mǎi xīn de.
examples.example_translation: He is very frugal, even when his clothes are worn out, he is reluctant to throw them away and buy new ones.

examples.example_chinese: 你要破了十绝阵
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ yào pò le shí jué zhèn

meaning: pron.用于列举事项，作用与“第二”相同 · (when enumerating items, events, etc.) next; secondly

examples.example_chinese: 首先是你发言，其次是他。
examples.example_pinyin: Shǒuxiān shì nǐ fāyán, qícì shì tā.
examples.example_translation: First, you speak; next, it’s him.

examples.example_chinese: 这次旅游，我们先到英国，其次是法国。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒmen xiān dào Yīngguó, qícì shì Fàguó.
examples.example_translation: On this trip, we will go to the UK first, and next to France.

examples.example_chinese: 我们首先讨论会议的内容，其次是时间和地点。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shǒuxiān tǎolùn huìyì de nèiróng, qícì shì shíjiān hé dìdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: We will first discuss the content of the meeting, and next the time and place.

examples.example_chinese: 一年级的同学在前面，其次是二年级，再次是三年级。
examples.example_pinyin: Yī niánjí de tóngxué zài qiánmiàn, qícì shì èr niánjí, zàicì shì sān niánjí.
examples.example_translation: First are the first graders, next are the second graders, and then the third graders.

meaning: n.一定地区气象状态的总体情况 · climate

examples.example_chinese: 冬天，北京的气候非常冷。
examples.example_pinyin: Dōngtiān, Běijīng de qìhòu fēicháng lěng.
examples.example_translation: In winter, the climate in Beijing is very cold.

examples.example_chinese: 我还不习惯这里的气候。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái bù xíguàn zhèli de qìhòu.
examples.example_translation: I am still not used to the climate here.

examples.example_chinese: 这里的气候很好，四季如春。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli de qìhòu hěn hǎo, sìjì rú chūn.
examples.example_translation: The climate here is very good, like spring all year round.

examples.example_chinese: 最近几年，这里的气候不太正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuìjìn jǐ nián, zhèli de qìhòu bù tài zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: In recent years, the climate here has not been very normal.

examples.example_chinese: 我不太适应这里潮湿的气候。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù tài shìyìng zhèli cháoshī de qìhòu.
examples.example_translation: I am not very used to the humid climate here.

meaning: adv.一定，务必 · (of an admonition) make sure to, must

examples.example_chinese: 你晚上开车，千万要小心。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ wǎnshang kāi chē, qiānwàn yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.example_translation: If you drive at night, make sure to be careful.

examples.example_chinese: 你千万要注意自己的身体。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ qiānwàn yào zhùyì zìjǐ de shēntǐ.
examples.example_translation: You must pay attention to your health.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事我们千万不能出错。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen qiānwàn bù néng chū cuò.
examples.example_translation: We must not make any mistakes in this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 记住，千万要按我说的去做。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìzhù, qiānwàn yào àn wǒ shuō de qù zuò.
examples.example_translation: Remember, you must do as I say.

examples.example_chinese: 千万别忘了我跟你说过的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiānwàn bié wàngle wǒ gēn nǐ shuōguo de huà.
examples.example_translation: Be sure not to forget what I told you.

meaning: n.修在河上可以通行的建筑 · bridge

examples.example_chinese: 你可以从那边的小桥上过河。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ cóng nà biān de xiǎo qiáo shang guò hé.
examples.example_translation: You can cross the river by the small bridge over there.

examples.example_chinese: 这座桥把两个地区连接了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo bǎ liǎng ge dìqū liánjiēle qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: This bridge connects two areas together.

examples.example_chinese: 他们用了三年多的时间才修好了这座桥。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen yòngle sān nián duō de shíjiān cái xiūhǎole zhè zuò qiáo.
examples.example_translation: It took them more than three years to finish building this bridge.

examples.example_chinese: 南京长江大桥在中国很有名。
examples.example_pinyin: Nánjīng Chángjiāng Dàqiáo zài Zhōngguó hěn yǒumíng.
examples.example_translation: The Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is very famous in China.

examples.example_chinese: 有了这座桥，人们过河方便多了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒule zhè zuò qiáo, rénmen guò hé fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.example_translation: With this bridge, it’s much more convenient for people to cross the river.

meaning: n.对人或事物的关切、喜爱之情 · affection, love, concern and favor about somebody or something

examples.example_chinese: 他在北京住了四年，对北京已经产生了感情。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài Běijīng zhùle sì nián, duì Běijīng yǐjīng chǎnshēngle gǎnqíng.
examples.example_translation: He has lived in Beijing for four years and has developed feelings for the city.

examples.example_chinese: 我们之间已经建立了很深的感情。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān yǐjīng jiànlìle hěn shēn de gǎnqíng.
examples.example_translation: We have already established a deep affection between us.

examples.example_chinese: 他对用过的东西是有感情的，总舍不得扔掉。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì yòngguò de dōngxi shì yǒu gǎnqíng de, zǒng shěbude rēngdiào.
examples.example_translation: He has feelings for things he has used and is always reluctant to throw them away.

examples.example_chinese: 你这样做，可能会伤害你们之间的感情。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, kěnéng huì shānghài nǐmen zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.example_translation: If you do this, it may hurt the feelings between you.

examples.example_chinese: 一段感情最好的状态
examples.example_pinyin: yī duàn gǎn qíng zuì hǎo de zhuàngtài

meaning: n.事物表现出来的样子, 状况 · situation, condition, case

examples.example_chinese: 明天天气情况怎么样？
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?
examples.example_translation: How will the weather be tomorrow?

examples.example_chinese: 我不了解他的情况。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù liǎojiě tā de qíngkuàng.
examples.example_translation: I don’t know his situation.

examples.example_chinese: 他从来没有谈起过他的家庭情况。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cónglái méiyǒu tánqǐguò tā de jiātíng qíngkuàng.
examples.example_translation: He has never talked about his family situation.

examples.example_chinese: 这些情况表明，我们还有很多问题不熟悉。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē qíngkuàng biǎomíng, wǒmen hái yǒu hěn duō wèntí bù shúxī.
examples.example_translation: These situations show that we are still unfamiliar with many problems.

examples.example_chinese: 在任何情况下，我们的感情都不会发生变化。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài rènhé qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen de gǎnqíng dōu bú huì fāshēng biànhuà.
examples.example_translation: In any situation, our feelings will not change.

meaning: n.喜欢打球或看球赛入迷的人 · (football, basketball, etc.) fan

examples.example_chinese: 这场足球比赛吸引了八万名球迷。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè chǎng zúqiú bǐsài xīyǐn le bā wàn míng qiúmí.
examples.example_translation: This football match attracted 80,000 fans.

examples.example_chinese: 球迷们陆续来到了体育场。
examples.example_pinyin: qiúmí men lùxù lái dào le tǐyùchǎng.
examples.example_translation: Fans arrived at the stadium one after another.

examples.example_chinese: 他觉得无论如何要对得起自己的球迷。
examples.example_pinyin: tā juéde wúlùn rúhé yào duìdeqǐ zìjǐ de qiúmí.
examples.example_translation: He felt that no matter what, he had to live up to his fans.

examples.example_chinese: 我是巴西队的球迷，他们的比赛我每场都看。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ shì Bāxī duì de qiúmí, tāmen de bǐsài wǒ měi chǎng dōu kàn.
examples.example_translation: I am a fan of the Brazilian team, and I watch every one of their matches.

examples.example_chinese: 很多没有买到票的球迷非常着急。
examples.example_pinyin: hěnduō méiyǒu mǎi dào piào de qiúmí fēicháng zháojí.
examples.example_translation: Many fans who couldn't get tickets were very anxious.

meaning: v.使原有的规章,制度,资格,权利等失去效力 · (of rules and regulations, qualifications, rights, etc.) abolish, cancel

examples.example_chinese: 下午的会议取消了。
examples.example_pinyin: xiàwǔ de huìyì qǔxiāo le.
examples.example_translation: The afternoon meeting has been canceled.

examples.example_chinese: 他们取消了去美国的计划。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen qǔxiāo le qù Měiguó de jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: They canceled their plan to go to the United States.

examples.example_chinese: 那些规定早就取消了，你可以报名。
examples.example_pinyin: nàxiē guīdìng zǎojiù qǔxiāo le, nǐ kěyǐ bàomíng.
examples.example_translation: Those regulations were canceled long ago, you can sign up.

examples.example_chinese: 学校取消了一些收费制度，提高了服务质量。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéxiào qǔxiāo le yīxiē shōufèi zhìdù, tígāo le fúwù zhìliàng.
examples.example_translation: The school canceled some fee systems and improved service quality.

examples.example_chinese: 我的考试资格被取消了没有？
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de kǎoshì zīgé bèi qǔxiāo le méiyǒu?
examples.example_translation: Has my exam qualification been canceled?

meaning: v.为共同的喜事进行一些活动表示高兴或纪念 · celebrate

examples.example_chinese: 我们举办了一个派对来庆祝他毕业。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jǔbàn le yígè pàiduì lái qìngzhù tā bìyè.
examples.example_translation: We held a party to celebrate his graduation.

examples.example_chinese: 让我们来庆祝我们的胜利吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Ràng wǒmen lái qìngzhù wǒmen de shènglì ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's celebrate our victory.

examples.example_chinese: 人们正在街上庆祝新年。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénmen zhèngzài jiē shàng qìngzhù xīnnián.
examples.example_translation: People are celebrating the New Year on the street.

examples.example_chinese: 这家餐厅品种丰富，很适合庆祝生日。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng pǐnzhòng fēngfù, hěn shìhé qìngzhù shēngrì.
examples.example_translation: This restaurant has a wide variety of food and is perfect for celebrating a birthday.

meaning: n.彼此不同的地方 · difference

examples.example_chinese: 我看不出这两个手机的区别。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kàn bu chū zhè liǎng ge shǒujī de qūbié.
examples.example_translation: I can't tell the difference between these two phones.

examples.example_chinese: 你能说出姐姐和妹妹的区别吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng shuōchū jiějie hé mèimei de qūbié ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you tell the difference between the older and younger sister?

examples.example_chinese: 这两个词语有很大的区别。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge cíyǔ yǒu hěn dà de qūbié.
examples.example_translation: There is a big difference between these two words.

examples.example_chinese: 我觉得他们没什么区别。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ juéde tāmen méi shénme qūbié.
examples.example_translation: I think there is no difference between them.

examples.example_chinese: 你能告诉我们这两台电脑有什么区别吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng gàosu wǒmen zhè liǎng tái diànnǎo yǒu shénme qūbié ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you tell us the difference between these two computers?

meaning: v.指人或物的数量不够 · (often something or somebody) be not enough, lack, be short of

examples.example_chinese: 这个客厅还缺少一个沙发。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège kètīng hái quēshǎo yí ge shāfā.
examples.example_translation: This living room is still short of a sofa.

examples.example_chinese: 我们学校缺少青年教师。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào quēshǎo qīngnián jiàoshī.
examples.example_translation: Our school lacks young teachers.

examples.example_chinese: 他最近缺少运动，越来越胖了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuìjìn quēshǎo yùndòng, yuè lái yuè pàng le.
examples.example_translation: He has lacked exercise recently and is getting fatter and fatter.

examples.example_chinese: 由于缺少一个零件，这台机器不能工作了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóuyú quēshǎo yí ge língjiàn, zhè tái jīqì bù néng gōngzuò le.
examples.example_translation: Because of the lack of a part, this machine can't work.

examples.example_chinese: 空气和水是人类不可缺少的两样东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Kōngqì hé shuǐ shì rénlèi bù kě quēshǎo de liǎng yàng dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: Air and water are two things indispensable to humans.

meaning: n.欠缺或不完善的地方（跟“优点”相对） · shortcoming, defect (as opposed to "优点 merit")

examples.example_chinese: 他有很多优点，也有一些缺点。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒu hěn duō yōudiǎn, yě yǒu yìxiē quēdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: He has many merits, but also some shortcomings.

examples.example_chinese: 你能说说你的缺点是什么吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng shuōshuo nǐ de quēdiǎn shì shénme ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you tell me what your shortcomings are?

examples.example_chinese: 我知道自己的缺点是做事不认真。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào zìjǐ de quēdiǎn shì zuòshì bù rènzhēn.
examples.example_translation: I know my shortcoming is not being serious in doing things.

examples.example_chinese: 我尽量改正自己的这些缺点。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jǐnliàng gǎizhèng zìjǐ de zhèxiē quēdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: I try my best to correct these shortcomings of mine.

examples.example_chinese: 有人能指出我的缺点，我觉得是一件高兴的事。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu rén néng zhǐchū wǒ de quēdiǎn, wǒ juéde shì yí jiàn gāoxìng de shì.
examples.example_translation: If someone can point out my shortcomings, I think it’s a good thing.

examples.example_chinese: 每个人都应该试着克服自己的缺点。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi shìzhe kèfú zìjǐ de quēdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Everyone should try to overcome their own shortcomings.

meaning: adv.对客观情况的真实性表示肯定 · indeed, really

examples.example_chinese: 这台电视确实比那台好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tái diànshì quèshí bǐ nà tái hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This TV is indeed better than that one.

examples.example_chinese: 我确实在邮局看到了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ quèshí zài yóujú kàndào le tā.
examples.example_translation: I did see him at the post office.

examples.example_chinese: 我确实不知道她说的是真是假。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ quèshí bù zhīdào tā shuō de shì zhēn shì jiǎ.
examples.example_translation: I really don't know whether what she said is true or false.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影确实很好看。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng quèshí hěn hǎokàn.
examples.example_translation: This movie is indeed very good.

examples.example_chinese: 确实，这些情况值得我们注意。
examples.example_pinyin: Quèshí, zhèxiē qíngkuàng zhídé wǒmen zhùyì.
examples.example_translation: Indeed, these situations deserve our attention.

meaning: n.人的生存与生活 · life

examples.example_chinese: 人生是幸福的，也是短暂的。
examples.example_pinyin: rénshēng shì xìngfú de, yě shì duǎnzàn de.
examples.example_translation: Life is happy, but also brief.

examples.example_chinese: 他们经常在一起讨论人生的价值。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen jīngcháng zài yīqǐ tǎolùn rénshēng de jiàzhí.
examples.example_translation: They often discuss the value of life together.

examples.example_chinese: 我很赞赏她积极的人生态度。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ hěn zànshǎng tā jījí de rénshēng tàidù.
examples.example_translation: I greatly appreciate her positive attitude towards life.

examples.example_chinese: 希望每个人都有一个幸福的人生。
examples.example_pinyin: xīwàng měi gè rén dōu yǒu yī gè xìngfú de rénshēng.
examples.example_translation: I hope everyone has a happy life.

examples.example_chinese: 你还年轻，人生的道路还很长。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ hái niánqīng, rénshēng de dàolù hái hěn cháng.
examples.example_translation: You are still young, the road of life is still very long.

examples.example_chinese: 结婚是人生中的一件大事。
examples.example_pinyin: jiéhūn shì rénshēng zhōng de yī jiàn dàshì.
examples.example_translation: Marriage is a major event in life.

meaning: n.担任某种职务或属于某一类的人 · staff, personnel

examples.example_chinese: 我是车站的工作人员，有问题可以找我。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ shì chēzhàn de gōngzuò rényuán, yǒu wèntí kěyǐ zhǎo wǒ.
examples.example_translation: I am a staff member of the station, you can find me if you have any problems.

examples.example_chinese: 这项政策大大调动了科技人员的积极性。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè xiàng zhèngcè dàdà diàodòng le kējì rényuán de jījíxìng.
examples.example_translation: This policy has greatly mobilized the enthusiasm of scientific and technical personnel.

examples.example_chinese: 全校的教学人员都参加了这次会议。
examples.example_pinyin: quánxiào de jiàoxué rényuán dōu cānjiā le zhè cì huìyì.
examples.example_translation: All teaching staff in the school attended this meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 这个地区人员构成非常复杂。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège dìqū rényuán gòuchéng fēicháng fùzá.
examples.example_translation: The composition of personnel in this area is very complex.

examples.example_chinese: 他们为社会培养了大批经济管理人员。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen wèi shèhuì péiyǎng le dàpī jīngjì guǎnlǐ rényuán.
examples.example_translation: They have trained a large number of economic management personnel for society.

meaning: pron.不论什么, 不论哪个 · any, whichever, whatever

examples.example_chinese: 我现在不想见任何人。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bù xiǎng jiàn rènhé rén.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to see anyone right now.

examples.example_chinese: 你放心吧，这儿没有任何危险。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn ba, zhèr méiyǒu rènhé wēixiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Don't worry, there's no danger here at all.

examples.example_chinese: 对于这件事，你不需要做任何解释。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú zhè jiàn shì, nǐ bù xūyào zuò rènhé jiěshì.
examples.example_translation: You don't need to make any explanation about this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要找任何借口，错了就是错了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bùyào zhǎo rènhé jièkǒu, cuò le jiù shì cuò le.
examples.example_translation: Don't look for any excuses, a mistake is a mistake.

examples.example_chinese: 他任何意见都听不进去。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā rènhé yìjiàn dōu tīng bu jìnqù.
examples.example_translation: He won't listen to any opinions.

meaning: adv.表示情况或状态持续不变（多用于书面语） · indicating continuity or resumption of a situation, mostly used in written Chinese; still, as before

examples.example_chinese: 过去我们是朋友，现在我们仍然是朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Guòqù wǒmen shì péngyou, xiànzài wǒmen réngrán shì péngyou.
examples.example_translation: We were friends in the past, and we are still friends now.

examples.example_chinese: 他仍然像过去一样爱开玩笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā réngrán xiàng guòqù yíyàng ài kāi wánxiào.
examples.example_translation: He still likes to joke as he did in the past.

examples.example_chinese: 直到今天，母亲仍然不赞成我这么做。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhídào jīntiān, mǔqīn réngrán bú zànchéng wǒ zhème zuò.
examples.example_translation: Even today, my mother still does not approve of me doing this.

examples.example_chinese: 现在我的父母仍然住在农村。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ de fùmǔ réngrán zhù zài nóngcūn.
examples.example_translation: My parents still live in the countryside now.

examples.example_chinese: 他盖了两条被子，仍然觉得冷。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gàile liǎng tiáo bèizi, réngrán juéde lěng.
examples.example_translation: He covered himself with two quilts and still felt cold.

meaning: n.指定担任的工作或责任 · assignment, task

examples.example_chinese: 今年的工作任务很重，大家压力很大。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de gōngzuò rènwu hěn zhòng, dàjiā yālì hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: This year's work tasks are heavy, and everyone is under a lot of pressure.

examples.example_chinese: 我接受了一项光荣的任务。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiēshòule yí xiàng guāngróng de rènwu.
examples.example_translation: I accepted an honorable assignment.

examples.example_chinese: 任务终于完成了，大家感到很高兴。
examples.example_pinyin: Rènwu zhōngyú wánchéng le, dàjiā gǎndào hěn gāoxìng.
examples.example_translation: The task was finally completed, and everyone felt very happy.

examples.example_chinese: 当前的主要任务是发展经济。
examples.example_pinyin: Dāngqián de zhǔyào rènwu shì fāzhǎn jīngjì.
examples.example_translation: The main task at present is to develop the economy.

examples.example_chinese: 修改文章的任务就交给你了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiūgǎi wénzhāng de rènwu jiù jiāo gěi nǐ le.
examples.example_translation: The task of revising the article is assigned to you.

meaning: adj.平时的,习以为常的 · daily, day-to-day, everyday

examples.example_chinese: 这个商店只卖一些日常用品。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège shāngdiàn zhǐ mài yīxiē rìcháng yòngpǐn.
examples.example_translation: This store only sells some daily necessities.

examples.example_chinese: 学校的日常工作由副校长负责。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéxiào de rìcháng gōngzuò yóu fù xiàozhǎng fùzé.
examples.example_translation: The school's daily work is handled by the vice principal.

examples.example_chinese: 她的日常生活一点儿规律也没有。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de rìcháng shēnghuó yīdiǎnr guīlǜ yě méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: Her daily life has no regularity at all.

examples.example_chinese: 他带了几件日常穿的衣服就走了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā dài le jǐ jiàn rìcháng chuān de yīfu jiù zǒu le.
examples.example_translation: He took a few pieces of everyday clothes and left.

examples.example_chinese: 我们每周都有些日常活动，比如唱歌、打球等等。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen měi zhōu dōu yǒu xiē rìcháng huódòng, bǐrú chànggē, dǎqiú děngděng.
examples.example_translation: We have some daily activities every week, such as singing, playing ball, and so on.

meaning: v.轻松随便地走走（一种锻炼身体或休息的方式） · take a walk, go for a walk or stroll

examples.example_chinese: 他每天吃完晚饭后都要在校园里散步。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān chīwán wǎnfàn hòu dōu yào zài xiàoyuán lǐ sànbù.
examples.example_translation: He takes a walk on campus every day after dinner.

examples.example_chinese: 他们到外面散步去了，半小时后回来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen dào wàimiàn sànbù qù le, bàn xiǎoshí hòu huílai.
examples.example_translation: They went out for a walk and will be back in half an hour.

examples.example_chinese: 我在散步的时候遇到了他们。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài sànbù de shíhou yùdàole tāmen.
examples.example_translation: I ran into them while I was taking a walk.

examples.example_chinese: 我没别的运动，就是每天散散步。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi bié de yùndòng, jiù shì měi tiān sànsan bù.
examples.example_translation: I don't do any other exercise, I just take a walk every day.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚才出去散了一会儿步。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái chūqù sànle yíhuìr bù.
examples.example_translation: I just went out for a short walk.

meaning: adj.心里悲伤、痛苦 · sad, grieved, broken-hearted

examples.example_chinese: 比赛输了，队员们都很伤心。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài shū le, duìyuánmen dōu hěn shāngxīn.
examples.example_translation: The team members were all very sad after losing the match.

examples.example_chinese: 母亲去世了，他伤心到了极点。
examples.example_pinyin: Mǔqīn qùshì le, tā shāngxīn dào le jídiǎn.
examples.example_translation: His mother passed away, and he was extremely grieved.

examples.example_chinese: 他再也不愿意提起那段伤心的经历。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài yě bù yuànyì tíqǐ nà duàn shāngxīn de jīnglì.
examples.example_translation: He is no longer willing to talk about that sad experience.

examples.example_chinese: 面对不幸，他伤心地哭了起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Miànduì bùxìng, tā shāngxīn de kūle qǐlai.
examples.example_translation: Facing misfortune, he cried sadly.

examples.example_chinese: 你这样做，会伤大家的心的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, huì shāng dàjiā de xīn de.
examples.example_translation: If you do this, you will hurt everyone's feelings.

examples.example_chinese: 他伤透了女朋友的心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shāngtòule nǚpéngyou de xīn.
examples.example_translation: He broke his girlfriend's heart.

meaning: n.供在市场上买卖的物品 · commodity, goods

examples.example_chinese: 这些商品包装得都很精美。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē shāngpǐn bāozhuāng de dōu hěn jīngměi.
examples.example_translation: The packaging of these goods is very exquisite.

examples.example_chinese: 这里出售的商品有质量保证。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèlǐ chūshòu de shāngpǐn yǒu zhìliàng bǎozhèng.
examples.example_translation: The goods sold here have quality assurance.

examples.example_chinese: 我想买一些进口商品,去哪里比较好?
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yīxiē jìnkǒu shāngpǐn, qù nǎlǐ bǐjiào hǎo?
examples.example_translation: I want to buy some imported goods, where is the best place to go?

examples.example_chinese: 我买东西一般都去小商品批发市场。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ mǎi dōngxi yībān dōu qù xiǎo shāngpǐn pīfā shìchǎng.
examples.example_translation: I usually go to the small commodities wholesale market to buy things.

examples.example_chinese: 我买东西主要看商品的质量。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ mǎi dōngxi zhǔyào kàn shāngpǐn de zhìliàng.
examples.example_translation: When I buy things, I mainly look at the quality of the goods.

meaning: n.居民身份证的简称 · identity card, ID

examples.example_chinese: 请出示您的身份证。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng chūshì nín de shēnfènzhèng.
examples.example_translation: Please show your ID card.

examples.example_chinese: 我忘记带身份证了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì dài shēnfènzhèng le.
examples.example_translation: I forgot to bring my ID card.

meaning: n.指由一定经济基础和上层建筑构成的整体 · society

examples.example_chinese: 社会在不断发展，我们的思想也会发生变化。
examples.example_pinyin: Shèhuì zài bùduàn fāzhǎn, wǒmen de sīxiǎng yě huì fāshēng biànhuà.
examples.example_translation: Society is constantly developing, and our thinking will also change.

examples.example_chinese: 这些大学生马上就要毕业，走向社会了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dàxuéshēng mǎshàng jiù yào bìyè, zǒu xiàng shèhuì le.
examples.example_translation: These college students are about to graduate and enter society.

examples.example_chinese: 这两个国家的社会制度不同。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā de shèhuì zhìdù bù tóng.
examples.example_translation: The social systems of these two countries are different.

examples.example_chinese: 中国经历了两千多年的封建社会。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó jīnglìle liǎngqiān duō nián de fēngjiàn shèhuì.
examples.example_translation: China went through more than two thousand years of feudal society.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要制止这种不良的社会风气。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhìzhǐ zhè zhǒng bù liáng de shèhuì fēngqì.
examples.example_translation: We must put a stop to this unhealthy social trend.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要学社会上流行的这一套。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ búyào xué shèhuì shàng liúxíng de zhè yī tào.
examples.example_translation: You shouldn't follow these popular social trends.

meaning: adj.从上到下或从外到里距离大（跟“浅”相对） · deep (as opposed to "shallow")

examples.example_chinese: 这条河很深。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé hěn shēn.
examples.example_translation: This river is very deep.

examples.example_chinese: 在这么深的湖里游泳是很危险的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhème shēn de hú lǐ yóuyǒng shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
examples.example_translation: It is very dangerous to swim in such a deep lake.

examples.example_chinese: 这种鱼生活在深海里。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yú shēnghuó zài shēn hǎi lǐ.
examples.example_translation: This kind of fish lives in the deep sea.

examples.example_chinese: 这条胡同很深，半天也没走到头儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo hútòng hěn shēn, bàntiān yě méi zǒudào tóur.
examples.example_translation: This alley is very deep, and I couldn't reach the end even after a long time.

examples.example_chinese: 你把坑挖得深一些，才能种活这棵树。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bǎ kēng wā de shēn yīxiē, cái néng zhònghuó zhè kē shù.
examples.example_translation: You need to dig the hole deeper to plant this tree successfully.

meaning: n.生物体所具有的活动能力，有时也比喻一些抽象事物的生存、活动能力 · life

examples.example_chinese: 每个人的生命只有一次。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi gè rén de shēngmìng zhǐ yǒu yí cì.
examples.example_translation: Everyone has only one life.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要珍惜自己和别人的生命。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhēnxī zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng.
examples.example_translation: We should cherish our own life and the lives of others.

examples.example_chinese: 医生正在抢救病人的生命。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài qiǎngjiù bìngrén de shēngmìng.
examples.example_translation: The doctor is saving the patient's life.

examples.example_chinese: 生命在于运动，所以要坚持锻炼。
examples.example_pinyin: Shēngmìng zàiyú yùndòng, suǒyǐ yào jiānchí duànliàn.
examples.example_translation: Life lies in movement, so we should keep exercising.

examples.example_chinese: 我认为，生命的价值就在于奉献自己。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi, shēngmìng de jiàzhí jiù zàiyú fèngxiàn zìjǐ.
examples.example_translation: I believe the value of life lies in dedicating oneself to others.

meaning: n.买卖，商业经营活动 · business, trade

examples.example_chinese: 他们在谈一笔大生意。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zài tán yī bǐ dà shēngyi.
examples.example_translation: They are negotiating a big business deal.

examples.example_chinese: 这家商店的生意很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de shēngyi hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This store's business is very good.

examples.example_chinese: 他做生意很成功。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuò shēngyi hěn chénggōng.
examples.example_translation: He is very successful in business.

examples.example_chinese: 最近生意不好做。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuìjìn shēngyi bù hǎo zuò.
examples.example_translation: Business has been difficult recently.

examples.example_chinese: 世界各地的商人都乐意来这里做生意，来自不同国家和地区的商品，琳琅满目，应有尽有，“万国市场”的美名当之无愧。
examples.example_pinyin: shì jiè gè dì de shāng rén dōu lè yì lái zhè lǐ zuò shēng yi lái zì bù tóng guó jiā hé dìqū de shāngpǐn lín láng mǎn mù yīng yǒu jǐn yǒu wàn guó shì chǎng de měi míng dāngzhī-wúkuì

meaning: v.丢掉,失掉 · lose

examples.example_chinese: 他的死,让我失去了一位好朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de sǐ, ràng wǒ shīqù le yī wèi hǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: His death made me lose a good friend.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要失去信心,继续努力吧。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ bùyào shīqù xìnxīn, jìxù nǔlì ba.
examples.example_translation: Don't lose confidence, keep working hard.

examples.example_chinese: 自从大学毕业以后,我们就失去了联系。
examples.example_pinyin: zìcóng dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, wǒmen jiù shīqù le liánxì.
examples.example_translation: Since graduating from college, we have lost contact.

examples.example_chinese: 他失去记忆已经很多年了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shīqù jìyì yǐjīng hěn duō nián le.
examples.example_translation: He has lost his memory for many years.

examples.example_chinese: 你失去了一次非常好的机会。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ shīqù le yī cì fēicháng hǎo de jīhuì.
examples.example_translation: You missed a very good opportunity.

examples.example_chinese: 我们永远失去了这位与我们最亲密的人,心里非常痛苦。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen yǒngyuǎn shīqù le zhè wèi yǔ wǒmen zuì qīnmì de rén, xīn lǐ fēicháng tòngkǔ.
examples.example_translation: We have forever lost the person closest to us, and we feel deep pain in our hearts.

meaning: adj.具体的, 实有的, 合乎事实的 · practical, real

examples.example_chinese: 实际情况是我们俩并不认识。
examples.example_pinyin: Shíjì qíngkuàng shì wǒmen liǎ bìng bù rènshi.
examples.example_translation: The actual situation is that the two of us don't know each other at all.

examples.example_chinese: 你应尽快拿出实际行动，来解决这个问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yīng jǐnkuài náchū shíjì xíngdòng, lái jiějué zhège wèntí.
examples.example_translation: You should take practical action as soon as possible to solve this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 这次考试成绩代表了我的实际水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì chéngjì dàibiǎole wǒ de shíjì shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: The result of this exam represents my real level.

examples.example_chinese: 他看着像中国人，实际上他是日本人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kànzhe xiàng Zhōngguó rén, shíjì shàng tā shì Rìběn rén.
examples.example_translation: He looks like a Chinese, but in fact he is Japanese.

examples.example_chinese: 你能给我们讲几个实际的例子吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng gěi wǒmen jiǎng jǐ ge shíjì de lìzi ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you give us a few practical examples?

meaning: n.商店出售的经过加工的食物 · food

examples.example_chinese: 他买了很多好吃的食品。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā mǎile hěn duō hǎochī de shípǐn.
examples.example_translation: He bought a lot of delicious food.

examples.example_chinese: 附近有几家食品商店，买东西很方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu jǐ jiā shípǐn shāngdiàn, mǎi dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: There are several food stores nearby, so shopping is very convenient.

examples.example_chinese: 他们非常重视食品安全的问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen fēicháng zhòngshì shípǐn ānquán de wèntí.
examples.example_translation: They attach great importance to food safety issues.

examples.example_chinese: 受灾地区食品和水都十分缺乏，需要人们支援。
examples.example_pinyin: Shòu zāi dìqū shípǐn hé shuǐ dōu shífēn quēfá, xūyào rénmen zhīyuán.
examples.example_translation: Food and water are in short supply in disaster areas, and people need help.

examples.example_chinese: 过期的食品就不能吃，否则容易生病。
examples.example_pinyin: Guòqī de shípǐn jiù bù néng chī, fǒuzé róngyì shēngbìng.
examples.example_translation: Expired food should not be eaten, otherwise it is easy to get sick.

examples.example_chinese: 不管什么时候，都要注意食品卫生。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùguǎn shénme shíhou, dōu yào zhùyì shípǐn wèishēng.
examples.example_translation: No matter when, you should always pay attention to food hygiene.

meaning: v.使用 · to use, to employ

examples.example_chinese: 他会使筷子吃饭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā huì shǐ kuàizi chīfàn le.
examples.example_translation: He can use chopsticks to eat.

examples.example_chinese: 他画画儿的时候，喜欢使铅笔。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā huà huàr de shíhòu, xǐhuān shǐ qiānbǐ.
examples.example_translation: He likes drawing pictures using a pencil.

examples.example_chinese: 这个空调我就使过一次。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège kōngtiáo wǒ jiù shǐguò yī cì.
examples.example_translation: I used this air conditioner only once.

examples.example_chinese: 我这台电脑使了十年了，一点儿问题也没有。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhè tái diànnǎo shǐle shí nián le, yīdiǎnr wèntí yě méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: My computer has been used for ten years and it still works perfectly.

examples.example_chinese: 你使过的东西别乱放，还放回原处。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ shìguò de dōngxī bié luàn fàng, hái fàng qù yuánchù.
examples.example_translation: Don't leave things around after using them. Please put them back.

examples.example_chinese: 这本词典我不使了，还给你吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn wǒ bù shǐ le, hái gěi nǐ ba.
examples.example_translation: I won’t use this dictionary anymore. I’ll return it to you.

meaning: n.国际通用的计算年代的单位，一百年为一个世纪 · century

examples.example_chinese: 他是上个世纪90年代出生的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì shàng ge shìjì jiǔshí niándài chūshēng de.
examples.example_translation: He was born in the 1990s of the last century.

examples.example_chinese: 人类已经进入了一个新世纪。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénlèi yǐjīng jìnrùle yí ge xīn shìjì.
examples.example_translation: Humanity has already entered a new century.

examples.example_chinese: 你们都是跨世纪的新青年，未来是你们的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen dōu shì kuà shìjì de xīn qīngnián, wèilái shì nǐmen de.
examples.example_translation: You are all new youth of the turn of the century, the future belongs to you.

examples.example_chinese: 电脑是上个世纪里人类最重要的发明之一。
examples.example_pinyin: Diànnǎo shì shàng ge shìjì lǐ rénlèi zuì zhòngyào de fāmíng zhī yī.
examples.example_translation: The computer is one of the most important inventions of mankind in the last century.

meaning: n. 集中进行商品交易的场所 market; 商品流通、行销的区域 marketplace

examples.example_chinese: 我经常去附近的蔬菜市场买菜。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīngcháng qù fùjìn de shūcài shìchǎng mǎi cài.
examples.example_translation: I often go to the nearby vegetable market to buy vegetables.

examples.example_chinese: 学校后面有一个自由市场，什么都有卖的。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yí ge zìyóu shìchǎng, shénme dōu yǒu mài de.
examples.example_translation: There is a free market behind the school where you can buy anything.

examples.example_chinese: 快过年了，市场更加热闹起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuài guònián le, shìchǎng gèngjiā rènào qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: As the New Year approaches, the market becomes even more lively.

examples.example_chinese: 这种新产品在市场上已经有卖的了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn chǎnpǐn zài shìchǎng shang yǐjīng yǒu mài de le.
examples.example_translation: This new product is already available on the market.

examples.example_chinese: 这些商品满足了国外市场的需要。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn mǎnzúle guó wài shìchǎng de xūyào.
examples.example_translation: These products meet the needs of foreign markets.

examples.example_chinese: 我们应该力争率先抢占市场。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi lìzhēng shuàixiān qiǎngzhàn shìchǎng.
examples.example_translation: We should strive to be the first to seize the market.

meaning: v.符合（实际情况或客观要求） · fit, suit (the actual situation or objective requirement)

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服很适合你。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn shìhé nǐ.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing suits you very well.

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜完全适合他的口味。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài wánquán shìhé tā de kǒuwèi.
examples.example_translation: This dish completely suits his taste.

examples.example_chinese: 我还没找到适合自己的工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái méi zhǎodào shìhé zìjǐ de gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: I haven't found a job that suits me yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他去做办公室工作更适合一些。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qù zuò bàngōngshì gōngzuò gèng shìhé yīxiē.
examples.example_translation: It suits him better to work in an office.

examples.example_chinese: 你不适合穿这种颜色的衣服。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bú shìhé chuān zhè zhǒng yánsè de yīfu.
examples.example_translation: You are not suited to wearing this color of clothing.

examples.example_chinese: 这个城市被评为最适合人类居住的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì bèi píngwéi zuì shìhé rénlèi jūzhù de dìfāng.
examples.example_translation: This city has been rated as the most suitable place for human habitation.

meaning: v.随着客观条件的变化而调整状态 · accommodate, adapt to

examples.example_chinese: 来中国半年了，我一切都很适应。
examples.example_pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó bàn nián le, wǒ yīqiè dōu hěn shìyìng.
examples.example_translation: I have been in China for half a year, and I have adapted to everything.

examples.example_chinese: 我还没适应北京的气候。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái méi shìyìng Běijīng de qìhòu.
examples.example_translation: I haven't adapted to Beijing's climate yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他基本适应了这种紧张的工作和生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīběn shìyìngle zhè zhǒng jǐnzhāng de gōngzuò hé shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: He has basically adapted to this kind of stressful work and life.

examples.example_chinese: 你到那里以后，要尽快适应新的环境。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dào nàlǐ yǐhòu, yào jǐnkuài shìyìng xīn de huánjìng.
examples.example_translation: After you arrive there, you should adapt to the new environment as soon as possible.

examples.example_chinese: 我们慢慢适应了这里的生活节奏。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen mànmàn shìyìngle zhèlǐ de shēnghuó jiézòu.
examples.example_translation: We gradually adapted to the pace of life here.

examples.example_chinese: 到一个新的地方，每个人都要适应一段时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Dào yí ge xīn de dìfāng, měi ge rén dōu yào shìyìng yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: When arriving at a new place, everyone needs some time to adapt.

examples.example_chinese: 他的适应能力很强，到哪儿都没问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shìyìng nénglì hěn qiáng, dào nǎr dōu méi wèntí.
examples.example_translation: He has a strong ability to adapt, and has no problem wherever he goes.

meaning: n.一个国家最高政权机关所在地, 是全国的政治中心 · capital (of a country)

examples.example_chinese: 北京是中国的首都。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.
examples.example_translation: Beijing is the capital of China.

examples.example_chinese: 这里是首都，到处是非常繁华的景象。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli shì shǒudū, dàochù shì fēicháng fánhuá de jǐngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: This is the capital, and everywhere is very prosperous.

examples.example_chinese: 我去过日本的首都，印象很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qùguo Rìběn de shǒudū, yìnxiàng hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: I have been to the capital of Japan, and I had a good impression.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要努力搞好首都建设。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào nǔlì gǎohǎo shǒudū jiànshè.
examples.example_translation: We must work hard to build up the capital.

examples.example_chinese: 他住在首都，很少去别的城市。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhù zài shǒudū, hěn shǎo qù bié de chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: He lives in the capital and rarely goes to other cities.

meaning: adv.最先, 最开始 · before all others, first

examples.example_chinese: 下了飞机，我首先找了辆出租车。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàle fēijī, wǒ shǒuxiān zhǎole liàng chūzūchē.
examples.example_translation: After getting off the plane, I first looked for a taxi.

examples.example_chinese: 今年的汉语水平考试，他首先报了名。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì, tā shǒuxiān bàole míng.
examples.example_translation: For this year's HSK, he was the first to sign up.

examples.example_chinese: 你们几个人谁首先发言？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen jǐ ge rén shéi shǒuxiān fāyán?
examples.example_translation: Who among you will speak first?

examples.example_chinese: 他首先想到的不是自己，而是别人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shǒuxiān xiǎngdào de bú shì zìjǐ, ér shì biérén.
examples.example_translation: The first person he thinks of is not himself, but others.

examples.example_chinese: 首先他见到武成王黄飞虎
examples.example_pinyin: shǒu xiān tā jiàn dào wǔ chéng wáng huáng fēi hǔ

meaning: v.身体或物体受到损伤 · be injured, be wounded

examples.example_chinese: 他的腿受伤了，至少两个月不能走路。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de tuǐ shòushāng le, zhìshǎo liǎng gè yuè bùnéng zǒulù.
examples.example_translation: His leg is injured, he can't walk for at least two months.

examples.example_chinese: 你身体受伤没有？到医院做个检查吧。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ shēntǐ shòushāng méiyǒu? dào yīyuàn zuò gè jiǎnchá ba.
examples.example_translation: Are you injured? Go to the hospital for a check-up.

examples.example_chinese: 他在这个事故中受伤了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài zhège shìgù zhōng shòushāng le.
examples.example_translation: He was injured in this accident.

examples.example_chinese: 他害怕受伤，所以不敢从事这项运动。
examples.example_pinyin: tā hàipà shòushāng, suǒyǐ bù gǎn cóngshì zhè xiàng yùndòng.
examples.example_translation: He is afraid of getting injured, so he doesn't dare to engage in this sport.

examples.example_chinese: 她受了很严重的伤，现在在家休息。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shòu le hěn yánzhòng de shāng, xiànzài zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.example_translation: She suffered a serious injury and is now resting at home.

examples.example_chinese: 我的手受过两次伤，现在不能拿重东西。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de shǒu shòu guò liǎng cì shāng, xiànzài bùnéng ná zhòng dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: My hand has been injured twice, now I can't lift heavy things.

meaning: v.在较量中失败 · lose, be beaten (as opposed to “赢 win”)

examples.example_chinese: 篮球比赛的结果是，北京队输了12分。
examples.example_pinyin: Lánqiú bǐsài de jiéguǒ shì, Běijīng duì shūle shí'èr fēn.
examples.example_translation: The result of the basketball game is that the Beijing team lost by 12 points.

examples.example_chinese: 跟他们比赛，我们从来没输过。
examples.example_pinyin: Gēn tāmen bǐsài, wǒmen cónglái méi shūguo.
examples.example_translation: We have never lost when competing with them.

examples.example_chinese: 他把钱都输光了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ qián dōu shūguāng le.
examples.example_translation: He lost all his money.

examples.example_chinese: 你放心吧，我们队输不了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn ba, wǒmen duì shū bù liǎo.
examples.example_translation: Don't worry, our team can't lose.

examples.example_chinese: 我现在输着呢，老王赢着呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài shūzhe ne. Lǎo Wáng yíngzhe ne.
examples.example_translation: I'm losing right now, and Lao Wang is winning.

examples.example_chinese: 这场比赛我们输了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài wǒmen shū le.
examples.example_translation: We lost this match.

meaning: n.事物的多少 · quantity, amount, number

examples.example_chinese: 我们学校教师的数量是两千多。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào jiàoshī de shùliàng shì liǎngqiān duō.
examples.example_translation: The number of teachers in our school is more than two thousand.

examples.example_chinese: 开学以后，我的词语数量在进一步增加。
examples.example_pinyin: Kāixué yǐhòu, wǒ de cíyǔ shùliàng zài jìnyībù zēngjiā.
examples.example_translation: After the school started, the number of my vocabulary words kept increasing.

examples.example_chinese: 全国今年博士生招生的数量比去年多。
examples.example_pinyin: Quán guó jīnnián bóshìshēng zhāoshēng de shùliàng bǐ qùnián duō.
examples.example_translation: The number of PhD students enrolled nationwide this year is more than last year.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不仅重视产品数量，更重视产品质量。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bùjǐn zhòngshì chǎnpǐn shùliàng, gèng zhòngshì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
examples.example_translation: We not only value the quantity of products, but also value the quality of products even more.

examples.example_chinese: 这种电脑数量不多了，要买就尽快买。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diànnǎo shùliàng bù duō le, yào mǎi jiù jǐnkuài mǎi.
examples.example_translation: There are not many of this type of computer left, buy quickly if you want one.

examples.example_chinese: 这个国家的人口数量在下降，老龄化问题越来越严重。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège guójiā de rénkǒu shùliàng zài xiàjiàng, lǎolínghuà wèntí yuè lái yuè yánzhòng.
examples.example_translation: The population of this country is decreasing, and the aging problem is becoming more and more serious.

meaning: v.生物失去生命 · die, pass away (as opposed to “生, 活 live”)

examples.example_chinese: 河里死了很多鱼。
examples.example_pinyin: Hé lǐ sǐle hěn duō yú.
examples.example_translation: Many fish died in the river.

examples.example_chinese: 那个人死在医院里了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà ge rén sǐ zài yīyuàn lǐ le.
examples.example_translation: That person died in the hospital.

examples.example_chinese: 他死了以后，子女们闹了很多矛盾。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā sǐle yǐhòu, zǐnǚmen nàole hěn duō máodùn.
examples.example_translation: After he died, his children had many conflicts.

examples.example_chinese: 事故当时就死了三个人。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìgù dāngshí jiù sǐle sān ge rén.
examples.example_translation: Three people died immediately in the accident.

examples.example_chinese: 这棵树死不了，浇点儿水就可以了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kē shù sǐ bu liǎo, jiāo diǎnr shuǐ jiù kěyǐ le.
examples.example_translation: This tree won't die, just water it a bit and it'll be fine.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一只死狗，不用怕。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì zhī sǐ gǒu, bùyòng pà.
examples.example_translation: This is a dead dog, don't be afraid.

meaning: n.运动的物体在单位时间内所经过的距离 · speed

examples.example_chinese: 那辆汽车的速度很快。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē de sùdù hěn kuài.
examples.example_translation: The speed of that car is very fast.

examples.example_chinese: 这趟火车的速度是每小时200公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo huǒchē de sùdù shì měi xiǎoshí èrbǎi gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: The speed of this train is 200 kilometers per hour.

examples.example_chinese: 你开车时速度别太快了，注意安全。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kāi chē shí sùdù bié tài kuài le, zhùyì ānquán.
examples.example_translation: Don't drive too fast, pay attention to safety.

examples.example_chinese: 他的百米速度超过了我们所有的人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de bǎi mǐ sùdù chāoguòle wǒmen suǒyǒu de rén.
examples.example_translation: His 100-meter speed surpassed all of us.

examples.example_chinese: 看看他回复你微信的速度就知道了
examples.example_pinyin: kàn kàn tā huífù nǐ wēi xìn de sù dù jiù zhī dao le

meaning: cl.用于机械、演出等 · used for certain machinery, apparatus, performance, etc.

examples.example_chinese: 这台电脑是我昨天刚买的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo shì wǒ zuótiān gāng mǎi de.
examples.example_translation: This computer is the one I just bought yesterday.

examples.example_chinese: 他家有三台电视机。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiā yǒu sān tái diànshìjī.
examples.example_translation: There are three televisions in his house.

examples.example_chinese: 我们正在准备一台晚会。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài zhǔnbèi yì tái wǎnhuì.
examples.example_translation: We are preparing a performance (evening party).

examples.example_chinese: 他们合作演了一台好戏。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen hézuò yǎnle yì tái hǎo xì.
examples.example_translation: They cooperated to put on a great show.

examples.example_chinese: 台仔细地看过
examples.example_pinyin: tái zǐ xì de kàn guò

meaning: v.说话或讨论 · talk, discuss

examples.example_chinese: 他俩昨晚谈了很长时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā liǎ zuówǎn tánle hěn cháng shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: The two of them talked for a long time last night.

examples.example_chinese: 我想跟你谈一件事。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ tán yí jiàn shì.
examples.example_translation: I want to talk to you about something.

examples.example_chinese: 他们正在谈事情，你先别进去。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài tán shìqing, nǐ xiān bié jìnqù.
examples.example_translation: They are talking about something, don't go in yet.

examples.example_chinese: 大家都谈了自己的想法，这很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā dōu tánle zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, zhè hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: Everyone talked about their own ideas, which is very good.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经谈过好几次了，但仍然没有结果。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng tán guò hǎo jǐ cì le, dàn réngrán méiyǒu jiéguǒ.
examples.example_translation: We have talked several times, but still have no result.

examples.example_chinese: 关于出国的事，我还没跟父母谈。
examples.example_pinyin: Guānyú chūguó de shì, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ tán.
examples.example_translation: I haven't talked to my parents about going abroad yet.

meaning: n.食物煮熟后所得的汁水 · soup

examples.example_chinese: 他吃饭前喜欢先喝汤。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chī fàn qián xǐhuan xiān hē tāng.
examples.example_translation: He likes to drink soup before meals.

examples.example_chinese: 我们每个人要一碗鸡蛋汤。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen měi ge rén yào yì wǎn jīdàntāng.
examples.example_translation: Each of us wants a bowl of egg soup.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈做的鱼汤味道好极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma zuò de yútāng wèidào hǎojí le.
examples.example_translation: The fish soup made by mom tastes wonderful.

examples.example_chinese: 我吃饱了，不想喝汤了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ chī bǎo le, bù xiǎng hē tāng le.
examples.example_translation: I'm full, I don't want any more soup.

examples.example_chinese: 这锅汤已经凉了，热热再喝吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè guō tāng yǐjīng liáng le, rèrè zài hē ba.
examples.example_translation: This pot of soup is already cold, heat it up before drinking.

meaning: v.（把预定的时间）往前移 · ahead of schedule, shift to an earlier date

examples.example_chinese: 请大家注意，开会时间提前了。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zhùyì, kāihuì shíjiān tíqián le.
examples.example_translation: Please note, the meeting time has been moved up.

examples.example_chinese: 我想提前参加考试，不知道老师同意不同意。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tíqián cānjiā kǎoshì, bù zhīdào lǎoshī tóngyì bù tóngyì.
examples.example_translation: I want to take the exam ahead of schedule, but I don't know if the teacher will agree.

examples.example_chinese: 公司提前完成了今年的销售任务。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī tíqián wánchéngle jīnnián de xiāoshòu rènwu.
examples.example_translation: The company completed this year's sales task ahead of schedule.

examples.example_chinese: 我提前一个月就知道了这个消息。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tíqián yí ge yuè jiù zhīdào le zhège xiāoxi.
examples.example_translation: I knew this news a month in advance.

examples.example_chinese: 他每天都提前半个小时到达学校。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu tíqián bàn ge xiǎoshí dàodá xuéxiào.
examples.example_translation: He arrives at school half an hour early every day.

meaning: v.不再进行 · stop, cease

examples.example_chinese: 战争停止了，人们过上了和平的日子。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhànzhēng tíngzhǐ le, rénmen guòshangle hépíng de rìzi.
examples.example_translation: The war stopped, and people began to live peaceful lives.

examples.example_chinese: 病人已经停止了呼吸。
examples.example_pinyin: Bìngrén yǐjīng tíngzhǐle hūxī.
examples.example_translation: The patient has stopped breathing.

examples.example_chinese: 他从来没有停止过帮助那些孩子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cónglái méiyǒu tíngzhǐguo bāngzhù nàxiē háizi.
examples.example_translation: He has never stopped helping those children.

examples.example_chinese: 比赛停止了一会儿，又开始了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài tíngzhǐle yíhuìr, yòu kāishǐ le.
examples.example_translation: The match stopped for a while and then started again.

examples.example_chinese: 我不想停止汉语学习。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng tíngzhǐ Hànyǔ xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to stop learning Chinese.

meaning: v.推诿, 推托 · dodge, make an excuse

examples.example_chinese: 明天的活动我推不掉，就不能陪你了。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān de huódòng wǒ tuī bù diào, jiù bù néng péi nǐ le.
examples.example_translation: I can't get out of tomorrow's event, so I can't accompany you.

examples.example_chinese: 他把自己的责任推得干干净净的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de zérèn tuī de gāngqīngjìng de.
examples.example_translation: He completely dodged his own responsibility.

examples.example_chinese: 你怎么把这件事推到我头上了？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bǎ zhè jiàn shì tuī dào wǒ tóu shàng le?
examples.example_translation: How did you push this matter onto me?

meaning: v.推迟 · delay, postpone, put off

examples.example_chinese: 会议的时间往后推了。
examples.example_pinyin: Huìyì de shíjiān wǎng hòu tuī le.
examples.example_translation: The meeting time has been postponed.

examples.example_chinese: 我们的婚礼推后两天举行。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de hūnlǐ tuīhòu liǎng tiān jǔxíng.
examples.example_translation: Our wedding will be held two days later than planned.

examples.example_chinese: 还钱的事你打算推到什么时候？
examples.example_pinyin: Huán qián de shì nǐ dǎsuàn tuī dào shénme shíhou?
examples.example_translation: Until when do you plan to put off paying back the money?

examples.example_chinese: 任凭人世间忙忙碌碌， 我只在睡梦中推究哲理。
examples.example_pinyin: rèn píng rén shì jiān máng máng lù lù wǒ zhǐ zài shuì mèng zhōng tuī jiū zhé lǐ

examples.example_chinese: “啊，你在推究哲理？
examples.example_pinyin: a nǐ zài tuī jiū zhé lǐ

meaning: adv.表示某种情况经常发生或时常存在 · often, frequently

examples.example_chinese: 人们往往不注意这些小事。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénmen wǎngwǎng bú zhùyì zhèxiē xiǎo shì.
examples.example_translation: People often don't pay attention to these small things.

examples.example_chinese: 晚上，他往往到附近的公园散步。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǎnshang, tā wǎngwǎng dào fùjìn de gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.example_translation: In the evening, he often goes for a walk in the nearby park.

examples.example_chinese: 骄傲往往容易导致失败。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiāo'ào wǎngwǎng róngyì dǎozhì shībài.
examples.example_translation: Pride often easily leads to failure.

examples.example_chinese: 上中学的时候，他往往学习到深夜。
examples.example_pinyin: Shàng zhōngxué de shíhou, tā wǎngwǎng xuéxí dào shēnyè.
examples.example_translation: When he was in middle school, he often studied until late at night.

examples.example_chinese: 你越想得到的东西往往越不容易得到。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yuè xiǎng dédào de dōngxi wǎngwǎng yuè bù róngyì dédào.
examples.example_translation: The more you want something, the harder it often is to get it.

meaning: adj.不安全, 有遭到失败或损害的可能 · dangerous, perilous

examples.example_chinese: 这儿很危险，请你们赶快离开！
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèr hěn wēixiǎn, qǐng nǐmen gǎnkuài líkāi!
examples.example_translation: It's very dangerous here, please leave quickly!

examples.example_chinese: 这是一条危险的山路，要格外小心。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì tiáo wēixiǎn de shānlù, yào géwài xiǎoxīn.
examples.example_translation: This is a dangerous mountain road, be especially careful.

examples.example_chinese: 在这危险的时刻，他保护了我们。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhè wēixiǎn de shíkè, tā bǎohùle wǒmen.
examples.example_translation: At this dangerous moment, he protected us.

examples.example_chinese: 现在病人的情况很危险，需要马上做手术。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài bìngrén de qíngkuàng hěn wēixiǎn, xūyào mǎshàng zuò shǒushù.
examples.example_translation: The patient's condition is very dangerous and surgery is needed immediately.

examples.example_chinese: 还有一个危险
examples.example_pinyin: hái yǒu yí gè wēi xiǎn

meaning: n.合乎卫生的情况 · hygiene, health, sanitation

examples.example_chinese: 保持个人卫生很重要。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǎochí gèrén wèishēng hěn zhòngyào.
examples.example_translation: Maintaining personal hygiene is very important.

examples.example_chinese: 这家餐厅的卫生条件不太好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de wèishēng tiáojiàn bù tài hǎo.
examples.example_translation: The hygiene conditions of this restaurant are not very good.

meaning: n.公文、信件和政治理论方面的重要文章的总称 · official documents, letters and articles dealing with political theories, etc., file

examples.example_chinese: 这份文件很重要,你要保存好。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn zhòngyào, nǐ yào bǎocún hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This document is very important, you must keep it well.

examples.example_chinese: 他每天要阅读大量的文件。
examples.example_pinyin: tā měi tiān yào yuèdú dàliàng de wénjiàn.
examples.example_translation: He has to read a lot of documents every day.

examples.example_chinese: 我还没对这些文件进行整理和分类。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ hái méi duì zhèxiē wénjiàn jìnxíng zhěnglǐ hé fēnlèi.
examples.example_translation: I haven't sorted and categorized these documents yet.

examples.example_chinese: 我们刚刚收到一份上级发下来的文件。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen gānggāng shōu dào yī fèn shàngjí fā xiàlái de wénjiàn.
examples.example_translation: We just received a document issued by our superior.

examples.example_chinese: 这些都是保密文件,不能让别人看到。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē dōu shì bǎomì wénjiàn, bù néng ràng biérén kàn dào.
examples.example_translation: These are confidential documents and cannot be seen by others.

meaning: n.篇幅不很长的一篇文字作品 · article, essay

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章写得很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This article is very well written.

examples.example_chinese: 他写了很多篇关于道德建设方面的文章。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiěle hěn duō piān guānyú dàodé jiànshè fāngmiàn de wénzhāng.
examples.example_translation: He has written many articles on moral development.

examples.example_chinese: 我认识这篇文章的作者，他是我的中学老师。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ rènshi zhè piān wénzhāng de zuòzhě, tā shì wǒ de zhōngxué lǎoshī.
examples.example_translation: I know the author of this article, he is my middle school teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章还需要修改。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng hái xūyào xiūgǎi.
examples.example_translation: This article still needs to be revised.

examples.example_chinese: 这家报纸一连发表了五篇关于经济改革的文章。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiā bàozhǐ yīlián fābiǎole wǔ piān guānyú jīngjì gǎigé de wénzhāng.
examples.example_translation: This newspaper published five articles in a row about economic reform.

meaning: n.可以当时支付的货币 · ready money, cash

examples.example_chinese: 这里只能用现金付款,刷不了银行卡。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèlǐ zhǐ néng yòng xiànjīn fùkuǎn, shuā bùliǎo yínhángkǎ.
examples.example_translation: Here you can only pay with cash, you can't swipe a bank card.

examples.example_chinese: 我身上没带多少现金。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ shēnshang méi dài duōshao xiànjīn.
examples.example_translation: I don't have much cash on me.

examples.example_chinese: 现在各单位对现金的管理非常严格。
examples.example_pinyin: xiànzài gè dānwèi duì xiànjīn de guǎnlǐ fēicháng yángé.
examples.example_translation: Now all units have very strict management of cash.

examples.example_chinese: 我只有两千元现金了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zhǐ yǒu liǎng qiān yuán xiànjīn le.
examples.example_translation: I only have 2,000 yuan in cash left.

examples.example_chinese: 信用卡比现金要方便多了。
examples.example_pinyin: xìnyòngkǎ bǐ xiànjīn yào fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.example_translation: Credit cards are much more convenient than cash.

meaning: adj.（气味）好闻（跟“臭”相对） · fragrant, aromatic, scented (as opposed to "臭 smelly")

examples.example_chinese: 这种花闻起来很香。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā wén qǐlái hěn xiāng.
examples.example_translation: This kind of flower smells very fragrant.

examples.example_chinese: 走进花园，到处都那么香。
examples.example_pinyin: Zǒujìn huāyuán, dàochù dōu nàme xiāng.
examples.example_translation: When you walk into the garden, it smells fragrant everywhere.

examples.example_chinese: 我喜欢吃这种香水果。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī zhè zhǒng xiāng shuǐguǒ.
examples.example_translation: I like to eat this kind of fragrant fruit.

examples.example_chinese: 这种大米煮熟了是香的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng dàmǐ zhǔshúle shì xiāng de.
examples.example_translation: This kind of rice is fragrant when cooked.

examples.example_chinese: 梅子熟时栀子香
examples.example_pinyin: méi zi shú shí zhī zi xiāng

meaning: n.关于人或事物情况的报道 · news, information

examples.example_chinese: 听到这个消息，他非常高兴。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā fēicháng gāoxìng.
examples.example_translation: He was very happy to hear this news.

examples.example_chinese: 这条消息是我从报纸上看到的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi shì wǒ cóng bàozhǐ shàng kàndào de.
examples.example_translation: I saw this news in the newspaper.

examples.example_chinese: 他给我们带来了一条好消息。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gěi wǒmen dàilái le yì tiáo hǎo xiāoxi.
examples.example_translation: He brought us good news.

examples.example_chinese: 有消息说，我们两个大学要合并。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu xiāoxi shuō, wǒmen liǎng ge dàxué yào hébìng.
examples.example_translation: There is news that our two universities will merge.

examples.example_chinese: 报纸上的消息我已经看过了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng de xiāoxi wǒ yǐjīng kànguo le.
examples.example_translation: I have already read the news in the newspaper.

meaning: n.人或高等动物体内循环系统中的液体（书面语中常读 xuè） · blood; fluid circulating in the vascular system of human beings or higher animals (often pronounced as xuè in written Chinese)

examples.example_chinese: 他的手流血了，需要包扎。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shǒu liú xiě le, xūyào bāozā.
examples.example_translation: His hand is bleeding and needs to be bandaged.

examples.example_chinese: 我受伤了，流了很多血。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shòushāng le, liúle hěn duō xiě.
examples.example_translation: I got injured and lost a lot of blood.

examples.example_chinese: 他经常去医院献血。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng qù yīyuàn xiàn xiě.
examples.example_translation: He often goes to the hospital to donate blood.

examples.example_chinese: 他的身上流着祖先的血。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shēnshang liúzhe zǔxiān de xiě.
examples.example_translation: The blood of his ancestors flows in his veins.

examples.example_chinese: 鼻子也出了血了
examples.example_pinyin: bí zi yě chū le xiě le
examples.example_translation: His nose was bleeding

meaning: n.由某种力量、做法或因素产生的结果（多指好的） · effect, result arising from certain strengths, approaches or factors (usually good)

examples.example_chinese: 这种药的效果很好，吃两天病就好了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào de xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo, chī liǎng tiān bìng jiù hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: The effect of this medicine is very good; after taking it for two days, the illness is gone.

examples.example_chinese: 我学习一直很努力，但效果并不太好，可能是方法不对。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí yīzhí hěn nǔlì, dàn xiàoguǒ bìng bú tài hǎo, kěnéng shì fāngfǎ bú duì.
examples.example_translation: I have always studied hard, but the results are not very good; maybe the method is wrong.

examples.example_chinese: 他采用了这个新办法以后，效果很明显。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cǎiyòngle zhège xīn bànfǎ yǐhòu, xiàoguǒ hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.example_translation: After he adopted this new method, the effect was obvious.

examples.example_chinese: 昨天演出的效果超过了我们的想象。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān yǎnchū de xiàoguǒ chāoguòle wǒmen de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: The result of yesterday's performance exceeded our expectations.

meaning: adj.（生活、境遇）称心如意 · happy (life and circumstances)

examples.example_chinese: 他有一个幸福的家。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒu yí ge xìngfú de jiā.
examples.example_translation: He has a happy family.

examples.example_chinese: 新年到了，祝你们全家幸福！
examples.example_pinyin: Xīnnián dào le, zhù nǐmen quán jiā xìngfú!
examples.example_translation: The New Year has arrived, I wish your whole family happiness!

examples.example_chinese: 他的脸上露出了幸福的微笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de liǎn shang lòuchūle xìngfú de wēixiào.
