examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò tài máng, yào xuéhuì fàngsōng zìjǐ.
examples.example_translation: Work is too busy, you need to learn to relax yourself.

examples.example_chinese: 我们去听听音乐，放松一下吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen qù tīngting yīnyuè, fàngsōng yíxià ba.
examples.example_translation: Let’s go listen to some music and relax a bit.

examples.example_chinese: 我们还没有赢得最后的胜利，大家还要坚持，不能放松。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen hái méiyǒu yíngdé zuìhòu de shènglì, dàjiā hái yào jiānchí, bùnéng fàngsōng.
examples.example_translation: We haven’t won the final victory yet, everyone must persist and not relax.

meaning: n.供人欣赏的景象 · view, scenery

examples.example_chinese: 这儿的风景真漂亮！
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèr de fēngjǐng zhēn piàoliang!
examples.example_translation: The scenery here is really beautiful!

examples.example_chinese: 这里是著名的风景区。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli shì zhùmíng de fēngjǐngqū.
examples.example_translation: This is a famous scenic area.

examples.example_chinese: 北京的秋天，风景格外美丽。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng de qiūtiān, fēngjǐng géwài měilì.
examples.example_translation: Beijing's autumn scenery is especially beautiful.

examples.example_chinese: 不在于风景多美多壮观
examples.example_pinyin: bù zàiyú fēngjǐng duō měi duō zhuàng guān
examples.example_translation: Not about how beautiful the scenery is

examples.example_chinese: 共同经历一些风景
examples.example_pinyin: gòng tóng jīng lì yī xiē fēngjǐng
examples.example_translation: Share some scenery together

meaning: conj.如果不这样 · conj. 如果不这样 otherwise, if not, or else

examples.example_chinese: 一定是堵车了，否则他不会迟到。
examples.example_pinyin: Yídìng shì dǔchē le, fǒuzé tā bú huì chídào.
examples.example_translation: It must have been a traffic jam, otherwise he wouldn’t be late.

examples.example_chinese: 他一定是爱上你了，否则不会送你这个礼物。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yídìng shì àishàng nǐ le, fǒuzé bú huì sòng nǐ zhège lǐwù.
examples.example_translation: He must have fallen in love with you, otherwise he wouldn’t give you this gift.

examples.example_chinese: 看来她的病好了，否则不会出来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Kànlái tā de bìng hǎo le, fǒuzé bú huì chūlái de.
examples.example_translation: It seems her illness is cured, otherwise she wouldn’t have come out.

examples.example_chinese: 他可能不生气了，否则怎么会笑得这么开心？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kěnéng bù shēngqì le, fǒuzé zěnme huì xiào de zhème kāixīn?
examples.example_translation: He may not be angry anymore, otherwise how could he laugh so happily?

examples.example_chinese: 你应该早点儿告诉他，否则他会着急的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zǎodiǎnr gàosu tā, fǒuzé tā huì zháojí de.
examples.example_translation: You should have told him earlier, otherwise he would be anxious.

meaning: v.（数量、形状、情节等）与标准、要求等一致 · (of quantity, shape, circumstances, etc.) accord with, be in line with

examples.example_chinese: 他符合公司的要求，我们决定聘用他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā fúhé gōngsī de yāoqiú, wǒmen juédìng pìnyòng tā.
examples.example_translation: He meets the company's requirements, so we decided to hire him.

examples.example_chinese: 这些产品质量完全符合标准，没有任何问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē chǎnpǐn zhìliàng wánquán fúhé biāozhǔn, méiyǒu rènhé wèntí.
examples.example_translation: The quality of these products fully meets the standards, there are no problems at all.

examples.example_chinese: 他说的话不符合事实。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù fúhé shìshí.
examples.example_translation: What he said does not accord with the facts.

examples.example_chinese: 这个学生符合我们招生的条件。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng fúhé wǒmen zhāoshēng de tiáojiàn.
examples.example_translation: This student meets our admission requirements.

examples.example_chinese: 戴上符合年代气息的首饰
examples.example_pinyin: dài shàng fú hé niándài qìxī de shǒu shì

meaning: pron.每个，所有的单个 · every, each

examples.example_chinese: 我们要了解各个国家的文化。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen yào liǎojiě gè gè guójiā de wénhuà.
examples.example_translation: We need to understand the cultures of different countries.

examples.example_chinese: 各个部门都要参加这次会议。
examples.example_pinyin: gè gè bùmén dōu yào cānjiā zhè cì huìyì.
examples.example_translation: Every department needs to attend this meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书介绍了中国各个朝代的历史。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè běn shū jièshào le Zhōngguó gè gè cháodài de lìshǐ.
examples.example_translation: This book introduces the history of each Chinese dynasty.

meaning: adv.总共，合计 · altogether, in total

examples.example_chinese: 这本书共有三百页。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè běn shū gòng yǒu sān bǎi yè.
examples.example_translation: This book has three hundred pages in total.

examples.example_chinese: 我们班共有二十五个学生。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen bān gòng yǒu èrshí wǔ gè xuéshēng.
examples.example_translation: Our class has twenty-five students in total.

examples.example_chinese: 这次活动共收到了一百份报名表。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè cì huódòng gòng shōudào le yì bǎi fèn bàomíng biǎo.
examples.example_translation: This event received one hundred registration forms in total.

meaning: v.买东西 · go shopping

examples.example_chinese: 她到商场购物去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā dào shāngchǎng gòuwù qù le.
examples.example_translation: She went shopping at the mall.

examples.example_chinese: 她很喜欢购物，经常买回很多没用的东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan gòuwù, jīngcháng mǎihuí hěn duō méi yòng de dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: She likes shopping very much and often buys a lot of useless things.

examples.example_chinese: 附近有一个大型购物中心。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yí ge dàxíng gòuwù zhōngxīn.
examples.example_translation: There is a large shopping center nearby.

examples.example_chinese: 下午谁跟我一起上街购物？
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàwǔ shéi gēn wǒ yìqǐ shàng jiē gòuwù?
examples.example_translation: Who will go shopping with me this afternoon?

examples.example_chinese: 香港位于我国南部，南海之滨，虽然面积不大，却是享誉世界的金融、航运和贸易中心，还是购物、品尝美食和旅游的好去处。
examples.example_pinyin: xiāng gǎng wèi yú wǒ guó nán bù nán hǎi zhī bīn suī rán miànjī bù dà què shì xiǎng yù shì jiè de jīn róng hángyùn hé màoyì zhōngxīn huán shì gòu wù pǐn cháng měi shí hé lǚ yóu de hǎo qùchù

meaning: v.买 · buy, purchase

examples.example_chinese: 我想在网上购买一本中文书。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài wǎngshàng gòumǎi yì běn zhōngwén shū.
examples.example_translation: I want to buy a Chinese book online.

examples.example_chinese: 顾客可以使用信用卡购买这件商品。
examples.example_pinyin: gùkè kěyǐ shǐyòng xìnyòngkǎ gòumǎi zhè jiàn shāngpǐn.
examples.example_translation: Customers can use a credit card to purchase this product.

examples.example_chinese: 公司计划购买一批新电脑。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngsī jìhuà gòumǎi yì pī xīn diànnǎo.
examples.example_translation: The company plans to purchase a batch of new computers.

examples.example_chinese: 你可以在网上购买这本书,价格比书店便宜。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng gòumǎi zhè běn shū, jiàgé bǐ shūdiàn piányi.
examples.example_translation: You can purchase this book online, it's cheaper than in bookstores.

examples.example_chinese: 购买商品前请仔细阅读产品说明。
examples.example_pinyin: Gòumǎi shāngpǐn qián qǐng zǐxì yuèdú chǎnpǐn shuōmíng.
examples.example_translation: Please read the product description carefully before purchasing.

meaning: v.外出散步 · stroll, wander, roam

examples.example_chinese: 这地方没什么可逛的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè dìfāng méi shénme kě guàng de.
examples.example_translation: There's nothing to stroll around here.

examples.example_chinese: 下午我们一起去逛街吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen yìqǐ qù guàng jiē ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's go shopping together this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 她逛了一天，没买什么东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā guàngle yì tiān, méi mǎi shénme dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: She wandered around all day and didn't buy anything.

examples.example_chinese: 他俩谈恋爱的时候经常去逛公园。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā liàn'ài de shíhou jīngcháng qù guàng gōngyuán.
examples.example_translation: When they were in love, they often strolled in the park.

examples.example_chinese: 你在屋子里工作一天了，出去逛逛吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zài wūzi lǐ gōngzuò yì tiān le, chūqù guàngguang ba.
examples.example_translation: You've been working indoors all day, go out for a stroll.

examples.example_chinese: 周末时，我喜欢一个人在大街上闲逛。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōumò shí, wǒ xǐhuan yí ge rén zài dàjiē shàng xián guàng.
examples.example_translation: On weekends, I like to stroll alone on the street.

meaning: n.学校中冬季的假期 · winter vacation

examples.example_chinese: 寒假的时候，我要去南方旅游。
examples.example_pinyin: Hánjià de shíhou, wǒ yào qù nánfāng lǚyóu.
examples.example_translation: During the winter vacation, I will travel to the south.

examples.example_chinese: 再过一个星期，就要放寒假了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài guò yí ge xīngqī, jiù yào fàng hánjià le.
examples.example_translation: After another week, it will be winter vacation.

examples.example_chinese: 你寒假打算做什么？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ hánjià dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
examples.example_translation: What do you plan to do during the winter vacation?

examples.example_chinese: 寒假很快就结束了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hánjià hěn kuài jiù jiéshù le.
examples.example_translation: The winter vacation ended very quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 老师给我们留了很多寒假作业。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen liúle hěn duō hánjià zuòyè.
examples.example_translation: The teacher gave us a lot of winter vacation homework.

meaning: n.客机或客轮航行的班次，也指某一班次的客机或客轮 · scheduled flight (of a plane) or voyage (of a passenger liner)

examples.example_chinese: 我坐明天的航班回国。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuò míngtiān de hángbān huí guó.
examples.example_translation: I will take tomorrow's flight to return to my country.

examples.example_chinese: 从北京到上海一天有几个航班？
examples.example_pinyin: Cóng Běijīng dào Shànghǎi yì tiān yǒu jǐ ge hángbān?
examples.example_translation: How many flights are there from Beijing to Shanghai in a day?

examples.example_chinese: 因为天气原因，我们的航班取消了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn, wǒmen de hángbān qǔxiāo le.
examples.example_translation: Our flight was canceled due to the weather.

examples.example_chinese: 我们没赶上飞机，只好等下个航班了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen méi yǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo děng xià ge hángbān le.
examples.example_translation: We missed the flight, so we have to wait for the next one.

examples.example_chinese: 轮船每小时一个航班。
examples.example_pinyin: Lúnchuán měi xiǎoshí yí ge hángbān.
examples.example_translation: There is a ship voyage every hour.

meaning: n.用红纸做的包儿,里面放钱,用于送礼或奖励他人 · red envelope

examples.example_chinese: 过春节时，小孩子们会收到大人们给的红包。
examples.example_pinyin: Guò Chūnjié shí, xiǎo háizimen huì shōudào dàrenmen gěi de hóngbāo.
examples.example_translation: During the Spring Festival, children will receive red envelopes from adults.

examples.example_chinese: 我弟弟快结婚了，我得送个大红包。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dìdi kuài jiéhūn le, wǒ děi sòng ge dà hóngbāo.
examples.example_translation: My younger brother is getting married soon, I have to give him a big red envelope.

examples.example_chinese: 每年年底，公司会给职工发红包。
examples.example_pinyin: Měinián niándǐ, gōngsī huì gěi zhígōng fā hóngbāo.
examples.example_translation: At the end of every year, the company gives red envelopes to its employees.

examples.example_chinese: 这是我第一次得红包，很开心。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì dé hóngbāo, hěn kāixīn.
examples.example_translation: This is the first time I've received a red envelope, I'm very happy.

examples.example_chinese: 学校奖励了他一个红包。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào jiǎnglì le tā yí ge hóngbāo.
examples.example_translation: The school rewarded him with a red envelope.

meaning: adj.扁平物体上下两面之间的距离大（跟“薄”相对） · thick (as opposed to "thin")

examples.example_chinese: 这本词典太厚了，带着不方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn tài hòu le, dàizhe bù fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: This dictionary is too thick, it's inconvenient to carry.

examples.example_chinese: 晚上很冷，要盖厚被子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǎnshang hěn lěng, yào gài hòu bèizi.
examples.example_translation: It's very cold at night, you need a thick quilt.

examples.example_chinese: 你穿得太厚了，脱掉一件吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ chuān de tài hòu le, tuōdiào yí jiàn ba.
examples.example_translation: You are wearing too many thick clothes, take one off.

examples.example_chinese: 地上的雪很厚。
examples.example_pinyin: Dìshang de xuě hěn hòu.
examples.example_translation: The snow on the ground is very thick.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服厚了点儿，我想买件薄的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hòule diǎnr, wǒ xiǎng mǎi jiàn báo de.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing is a bit thick, I want to buy a thinner one.

meaning: n.医院中担任护理工作的人员 · nurse

examples.example_chinese: 我妹妹是一名护士。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mèimei shì yì míng hùshi.
examples.example_translation: My younger sister is a nurse.

examples.example_chinese: 她一直想当一名护士。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīzhí xiǎng dāng yì míng hùshi.
examples.example_translation: She has always wanted to be a nurse.

examples.example_chinese: 护士已经给我打过针了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hùshi yǐjīng gěi wǒ dǎguo zhēn le.
examples.example_translation: The nurse has already given me an injection.

examples.example_chinese: 护士们对病人都很耐心。
examples.example_pinyin: Hùshimen duì bìngrén dōu hěn nàixīn.
examples.example_translation: Nurses are very patient with patients.

examples.example_chinese: 护士可以说是白衣天使。
examples.example_pinyin: Hùshi kěyǐ shuō shì báiyī tiānshǐ.
examples.example_translation: Nurses can be called angels in white.

meaning: v.带着疑惑，不很相信 · doubt, suspect

examples.example_chinese: 我怀疑他说的不是真的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huáiyí tā shuō de bú shì zhēn de.
examples.example_translation: I doubt what he said is true.

examples.example_chinese: 大家都怀疑这件事是他干的。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huáiyí zhè jiàn shì shì tā gàn de.
examples.example_translation: Everyone suspects that he did this.

examples.example_chinese: 事实证明，你怀疑错了。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìshí zhèngmíng, nǐ huáiyí cuò le.
examples.example_translation: The facts proved that your suspicion was wrong.

examples.example_chinese: 她的行为引起了人们的怀疑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi yǐnqǐle rénmen de huáiyí.
examples.example_translation: Her behavior aroused people's suspicion.

examples.example_chinese: 你怎么怀疑起我来了？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zěnme huáiyí qǐ wǒ lái le?
examples.example_translation: Why do you suspect me?

meaning: v.回答别人的问题、信件或消息 · to reply, to recover, to return (to a previous condition)

examples.example_chinese: 我等一下再回复你的消息。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ děng yíxià zài huífù nǐ de xiāoxi.
examples.example_translation: I’ll reply to your message in a moment.

examples.example_chinese: 老师很快就回复了我的邮件。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī hěn kuài jiù huífù le wǒ de yóujiàn.
examples.example_translation: The teacher replied to my email very quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 你看到后请尽快回复。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ kàn dào hòu qǐng jǐnkuài huífù.
examples.example_translation: Please reply as soon as possible after you see this.

meaning: v.取得，得到（多用于抽象事物） · obtain, acquire (mostly abstract things)

examples.example_chinese: 今年的粮食获得了丰收。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de liángshi huòdéle fēngshōu.
examples.example_translation: This year's grain harvest was abundant.

examples.example_chinese: 这次比赛我们获得了第一名。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài wǒmen huòdéle dì-yī míng.
examples.example_translation: We won first place in this competition.

examples.example_chinese: 他终于获得了自由。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhōngyú huòdéle zìyóu.
examples.example_translation: He finally gained freedom.

examples.example_chinese: 这位教授曾获得过国家最高奖励。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu céng huòdéguò guójiā zuì gāo jiǎnglì.
examples.example_translation: This professor has received the highest national award.

examples.example_chinese: 我们通过调查，获得了不少重要资料。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen tōngguò diàochá, huòdé bù shǎo zhòngyào zīliào.
examples.example_translation: We obtained a lot of important information through the investigation.

meaning: v.取得；猎取 · to gain, to get, to acquire

examples.example_chinese: 学生可以通过图书馆网站获取电子资源。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuésheng kěyǐ tōngguò túshūguǎn wǎngzhàn huòqǔ diànzǐ zīyuán.
examples.example_translation: Students can obtain electronic resources through the library website.

examples.example_chinese: 他通过努力工作获取了成功。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tōngguò nǔlì gōngzuò huòqǔ le chénggōng.
examples.example_translation: He achieved success through hard work.

meaning: n.货物；商品 · commodity, idiot, money, blockhead, loading, goods

examples.example_chinese: 旁边两头运货的小毛驴正在下坡，脚下不稳。
examples.example_pinyin: páng biān liǎng tóu yùn huò de xiǎo máo lǘ zhèng zài xià pō, jiǎo xià bù wěn.
examples.example_translation: Two small donkeys carrying goods nearby are going down a slope and are unsteady on their feet.

examples.example_chinese: “我总是看见， 你一会儿背着沉重的货船， 一会儿驮着长串的木筏， 还有小划子啊小船， 简直数也数不完。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zǒng shì kàn jiàn nǐ yī huì ér bèi zhe chén zhòng de huò chuán yī huì ér tuó zhe cháng chuàn de mù fá hái yǒu xiǎo huà zi a xiǎo chuán jiǎn zhí shǔ yě shǔ bù wán
examples.example_translation: "I always see you carrying heavy cargo boats one moment, and long strings of rafts the next, along with small rowboats, it's simply countless."

meaning: v.（事物）逐渐聚集起来 · accumulate, build up (one’s knowledge, experience, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 他的经验是在生活中积累起来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jīngyàn shì zài shēnghuó zhōng jīlěi qǐlái de.
examples.example_translation: His experience was accumulated in daily life.

examples.example_chinese: 他现阶段的任务是积累知识。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiànjiēduàn de rènwu shì jīlěi zhīshi.
examples.example_translation: His current task is to accumulate knowledge.

examples.example_chinese: 知识积累到一定程度，你就可以解决这个问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhīshi jīlěi dào yídìng chéngdù, nǐ jiù kěyǐ jiějué zhège wèntí.
examples.example_translation: When your knowledge accumulates to a certain level, you can solve this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 工作经验是一点一点积累起来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò jīngyàn shì yìdiǎn yìdiǎn jīlěi qǐlái de.
examples.example_translation: Work experience is accumulated bit by bit.

examples.example_chinese: 资金积累到一定程度，就可以用于投资。
examples.example_pinyin: Zījīn jīlěi dào yídìng chéngdù, jiù kěyǐ yòng yú tóuzī.
examples.example_translation: When funds accumulate to a certain level, they can be used for investment.

meaning: adj.（感情）因受刺激而非常兴奋 · excited

examples.example_chinese: 见到了老朋友，他非常激动。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàndao le lǎo péngyou, tā fēicháng jīdòng.
examples.example_translation: He was very excited to see his old friend.

examples.example_chinese: 他考上了名牌大学，激动得哭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kǎoshàngle míngpái dàxué, jīdòng de kū le.
examples.example_translation: He was so excited to be admitted to a prestigious university that he cried.

examples.example_chinese: 比赛得了冠军，他激动得说不出话了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài déle guànjūn, tā jīdòng de shuō bu chū huà le.
examples.example_translation: He was so excited after winning the championship that he couldn't speak.

examples.example_chinese: 病人的情绪很激动，需要平静下来才能继续治疗。
examples.example_pinyin: Bìngrén de qíngxù hěn jīdòng, xūyào píngjìng xiàlái cái néng jìxù zhìliáo.
examples.example_translation: The patient's emotions are very agitated and need to calm down to continue treatment.

examples.example_chinese: 这个消息让他激动了好几天。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng tā jīdòngle hǎojǐ tiān.
examples.example_translation: This news made him excited for several days.

meaning: conj.跟“且、又、也”等副词呼应，表示两种情况兼而有之 · since...then

examples.example_chinese: 再把浆捞出来晒干，就成了一种既轻便又好用的纸。
examples.example_pinyin: zài bǎ jiāng lāo chū lái shài gān jiù chéng le yī zhǒng jì qīng biàn yòu hǎo yòng de zhǐ
examples.example_translation: He then scooped the pulp out and dried it, resulting in a type of paper that was lightweight and easy to use.

examples.example_chinese: 既是注定，何须执着。
examples.example_pinyin: jì shì zhù dìng hé xū zhí zhuó
examples.example_translation: If it's meant to be, why hold on?

examples.example_chinese: 以后的日子既不悲观也不乐观
examples.example_pinyin: yǐhòu de rì zi jì bù bēiguān yě bù lèguān
examples.example_translation: In the days ahead, neither pessimistic nor optimistic

examples.example_chinese: 就是我既想纠缠你
examples.example_pinyin: jiù shì wǒ jì xiǎng jiūchán nǐ

examples.example_chinese: 既想做到和你不再联系
examples.example_pinyin: jì xiǎng zuò dào hé nǐ bùzài lián xì

meaning: conj.用在上半句里，下半句里往往有副词“就、也、还”等与之呼应，表示依据前面的情况得出后面的结论 · since, as, now that (used in the first half of a sentence; used correlatively with 就, 也, 还, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 既然你喜欢这本书，就买了吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán nǐ xǐhuan zhè běn shū, jiù mǎi le ba.
examples.example_translation: Since you like this book, just buy it.

examples.example_chinese: 既然你不想学习了，就休息一会儿吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng xuéxí le, jiù xiūxi yíhuìr ba.
examples.example_translation: Since you don't want to study anymore, just take a break.

examples.example_chinese: 既然已经决定了，就开始干吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán yǐjīng juédìng le, jiù kāishǐ gàn ba.
examples.example_translation: Since it's already decided, let's get started.

examples.example_chinese: 既然大家都同意，我们就不讨论了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā dōu tóngyì, wǒmen jiù bù tǎolùn le.
examples.example_translation: Since everyone agrees, we won't discuss it anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 既然他已经想好了，我也不好再劝他了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán tā yǐjīng xiǎnghǎo le, wǒ yě bù hǎo zài quàn tā le.
examples.example_translation: Since he has already made up his mind, I shouldn't try to persuade him anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 既然你那么爱她，为什么不告诉她呢？
examples.example_pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme ài tā, wèi shénme bú gàosu tā ne?
examples.example_translation: Since you love her so much, why don't you tell her?

meaning: v.在规定以外增加工作时间 · work overtime

examples.example_chinese: 他工作很努力，经常加班。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, jīngcháng jiābān.
examples.example_translation: He works very hard and often works overtime.

examples.example_chinese: 他每天都加班到很晚。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu jiābān dào hěn wǎn.
examples.example_translation: He works overtime until very late every day.

examples.example_chinese: 他工作没做完，只好加班了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gōngzuò méi zuòwán, zhǐhǎo jiābān le.
examples.example_translation: He didn't finish his work, so he had to work overtime.

examples.example_chinese: 昨天我加了三个小时班，才写完这个报告。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ jiāle sān ge xiǎoshí bān, cái xiěwán zhège bàogào.
examples.example_translation: Yesterday I worked three hours overtime to finish this report.

examples.example_chinese: 我们有临时任务，只好加个班了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu línshí rènwu, zhǐhǎo jiā ge bān le.
examples.example_translation: We had a temporary task, so we had to work overtime.

meaning: v.专指通过邮局递送 · post, mail

examples.example_chinese: 他每个月给家里寄一封信。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè gěi jiālǐ jì yì fēng xìn.
examples.example_translation: He mails a letter to his family every month.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈给他寄来了一个新手机。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma gěi tā jìle yí ge xīn shǒujī.
examples.example_translation: His mom sent him a new phone.

examples.example_chinese: 这封信我要寄到美国。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn wǒ yào jì dào Měiguó.
examples.example_translation: I want to mail this letter to the USA.

examples.example_chinese: 我去邮局给朋友寄一本书。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qù yóujú gěi péngyou jì yì běn shū.
examples.example_translation: I am going to the post office to mail a book to my friend.

examples.example_chinese: 学校会把录取通知书寄给你。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéxiào huì bǎ lùqǔ tōngzhīshū jì gěi nǐ.
examples.example_translation: The school will mail you the admission notice.

meaning: v.参加进去；加上，掺进去 · join, accede to

examples.example_chinese: 我想加入这个学习小组。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiārù zhège xuéxí xiǎozǔ.
examples.example_translation: I want to join this study group.

examples.example_chinese: 他去年加入了这家公司。
examples.example_pinyin: tā qùnián jiārù le zhè jiā gōngsī.
examples.example_translation: He joined this company last year.

examples.example_chinese: 请在汤里加入一点盐。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng zài tāng lǐ jiārù yìdiǎn yán.
examples.example_translation: Please add a little salt to the soup.

examples.example_chinese: 加入牛奶后，面团会变得更软。
examples.example_pinyin: jiārù niúnǎi hòu, miàntuán huì biàn de gèng ruǎn.
examples.example_translation: After adding milk, the dough will become softer.

meaning: n.为汽车等添加燃油的地方 · gas station

examples.example_chinese: 我去加油站加点儿油。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qù jiāyóuzhàn jiā diǎnr yóu.
examples.example_translation: I'm going to the gas station to get some fuel.

examples.example_chinese: 我们中间要路过一个加油站。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngjiān yào lùguò yí ge jiāyóuzhàn.
examples.example_translation: We will pass by a gas station on the way.

examples.example_chinese: 他们说好在那个加油站见面。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen shuō hǎo zài nàge jiāyóuzhàn jiànmiàn.
examples.example_translation: They agreed to meet at that gas station.

examples.example_chinese: 加油站离这儿还很远呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiāyóuzhàn lí zhèr hái hěn yuǎn ne.
examples.example_translation: The gas station is still far from here.

meaning: v.减去一部分 · reduce, lessen, cut down

examples.example_chinese: 快放假了，来上课的学生明显减少了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuài fàngjià le, lái shàngkè de xuésheng míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo le.
examples.example_translation: The holidays are coming, and the number of students attending class has obviously decreased.

examples.example_chinese: 有些动物的数量减少了很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒuxiē dòngwù de shùliàng jiǎnshǎole hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: The number of some animals has decreased a lot.

examples.example_chinese: 我这个月的收入比上个月减少了20%。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhège yuè de shōurù bǐ shàng ge yuè jiǎnshǎole bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.
examples.example_translation: My income this month has decreased by 20% compared to last month.

examples.example_chinese: 经常运动，就可以减少疾病的发生。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngcháng yùndòng, jiù kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo jíbìng de fāshēng.
examples.example_translation: Exercising regularly can reduce the occurrence of diseases.

examples.example_chinese: 也会减少一半
examples.example_pinyin: yě huì jiǎn shǎo yí bàn

meaning: v.从原有数量中去掉一部分，使变少 · reduce, decrease, subtract

examples.example_chinese: 我想减一点体重。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiǎn yìdiǎn tǐzhòng.
examples.example_translation: I want to lose a little weight.

examples.example_chinese: 这件衣服减了五十块钱。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfu jiǎn le wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.example_translation: This piece of clothing has been reduced by fifty yuan.

examples.example_chinese: 十减三等于七。
examples.example_pinyin: shí jiǎn sān děngyú qī.
examples.example_translation: Ten minus three equals seven.

examples.example_chinese: 医生建议他减少糖的摄入。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng jiànyì tā jiǎnshǎo táng de shèrù.
examples.example_translation: The doctor advised him to reduce his sugar intake.

meaning: n.专门用于体育锻炼的屋子 · gym, room or building equipped for workouts

examples.example_chinese: 他下班后去了健身房。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàbān hòu qù le jiànshēnfáng.
examples.example_translation: He went to the gym after work.

examples.example_chinese: 我经常到健身房锻炼身体。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīngcháng dào jiànshēnfáng duànliàn shēntǐ.
examples.example_translation: I often go to the gym to work out.

examples.example_chinese: 附近的健身房不错，什么项目都有。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùjìn de jiànshēnfáng búcuò, shénme xiàngmù dōu yǒu.
examples.example_translation: The nearby gym is good, it has all kinds of programs.

examples.example_chinese: 我们一起去健身房练跳舞吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù jiànshēnfáng liàn tiàowǔ ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's go to the gym to practice dancing together.

examples.example_chinese: 他是一家健身房的教练。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yì jiā jiànshēnfáng de jiàoliàn.
examples.example_translation: He is a coach at a gym.

meaning: n.大河 · river

examples.example_chinese: 这条江穿过了整个城市。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè tiáo jiāng chuān guò le zhěng gè chéngshì.
examples.example_translation: This river runs through the entire city.

examples.example_chinese: 春天的江水慢慢变暖了。
examples.example_pinyin: chūntiān de jiāngshuǐ mànmàn biàn nuǎn le.
examples.example_translation: The river water slowly becomes warmer in spring.

examples.example_chinese: 他从江边的小镇来。
examples.example_pinyin: tā cóng jiāngbiān de xiǎo zhèn lái.
examples.example_translation: He comes from a small town by the river.

meaning: n.奖励；夸奖 · award, prize, reward

examples.example_chinese: 她在比赛中获得了一等奖。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng huòdé le yī děng jiǎng.
examples.example_translation: She won first prize in the competition.

examples.example_chinese: 公司决定奖励表现优秀的员工。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiǎnglì biǎoxiàn yōuxiù de yuángōng.
examples.example_translation: The company decided to reward outstanding employees.

examples.example_chinese: 获得了冰心散文奖
examples.example_pinyin: huò dé le bīng xīn sǎn wén jiǎng
examples.example_translation: Won the Bing Xin Prose Award

meaning: n.用作奖励的钱 · money given as an incentive, bonus

examples.example_chinese: 公司每年都要发一笔奖金。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu yào fā yì bǐ jiǎngjīn.
examples.example_translation: The company gives out a bonus every year.

examples.example_chinese: 他因工作出色，得到了 一笔奖金。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīn gōngzuò chūsè, dédàole yì bǐ jiǎngjīn.
examples.example_translation: He received a bonus for his outstanding work.

examples.example_chinese: 他把自己的奖金捐给了学校。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de jiǎngjīn juān gěile xuéxiào.
examples.example_translation: He donated his bonus to the school.

examples.example_chinese: 今年公司效益不好，恐怕连奖金也没了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián gōngsī xiàoyì bù hǎo, kǒngpà lián jiǎngjīn yě méi le.
examples.example_translation: The company's performance is not good this year, so there may not even be a bonus.

examples.example_chinese: 他用奖金买了一台电脑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yòng jiǎngjīn mǎile yì tái diànnǎo.
examples.example_translation: He bought a computer with his bonus.

meaning: n.学校、团体或个人给予学习成绩优良的学生的奖金 · stipend, scholarship

examples.example_chinese: 他因为成绩优秀获得了全额奖学金。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chéngjì yōuxiù huòdé le quán'é jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.example_translation: He received a full scholarship because of his excellent grades.

examples.example_chinese: 这所大学为国际学生提供多种奖学金。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué wèi guójì xuésheng tígōng duō zhǒng jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.example_translation: This university offers various scholarships for international students.

meaning: n.降低原来的定价 · lower prices

examples.example_chinese: 超市里很多商品都在降价促销。
examples.example_pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ hěn duō shāngpǐn dōu zài jiàng jià cùxiāo.
examples.example_translation: Many products in the supermarket are on sale with reduced prices.

examples.example_chinese: 这款手机降价了三百元。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī jiàng jià le sānbǎi yuán.
examples.example_translation: This phone model has been reduced by 300 yuan.

meaning: v.从高处往低处移动，下降，降低 · descend, fall, lower, reduce

examples.example_chinese: 气温今天降了很多。
examples.example_pinyin: qìwēn jīntiān jiàng le hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: The temperature dropped a lot today.

examples.example_chinese: 飞机正在缓慢下降。
examples.example_pinyin: fēijī zhèngzài huǎnmàn xiàjiàng.
examples.example_translation: The airplane is slowly descending.

meaning: v.使越来越低；使下降 · drop, recede, come down

examples.example_chinese: 我一年没说汉语，感觉水平降低了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yì nián méi shuō Hànyǔ, gǎnjué shuǐpíng jiàngdī le.
examples.example_translation: I haven't spoken Chinese for a year, and I feel my proficiency has dropped.

examples.example_chinese: 他们降低了电脑价格，所以卖得很快。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen jiàngdīle diànnǎo jiàgé, suǒyǐ mài de hěn kuài.
examples.example_translation: They lowered the price of computers, so they sold quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 我们不能降低对他的要求。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng jiàngdī duì tā de yāoqiú.
examples.example_translation: We can't lower our expectations for him.

examples.example_chinese: 这两天气温又降低了不少。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān qìwēn yòu jiàngdīle bù shǎo.
examples.example_translation: The temperature has dropped a lot in the past two days.

examples.example_chinese: 因为很多人不合格，所以我们不得不降低了标准。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn duō rén bù hégé, suǒyǐ wǒmen bùdébù jiàngdīle biāozhǔn.
examples.example_translation: Because many people were unqualified, we had to lower the standards.

meaning: v.从空中往下落 · land, descend

examples.example_chinese: 飞机即将降落，请大家系好安全带。
examples.example_pinyin: Fēijī jíjiāng jiàngluò, qǐng dàjiā jì hǎo ānquándài.
examples.example_translation: The plane is about to land, please fasten your seat belts.

examples.example_chinese: 我们的航班已经降落到地面了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de hángbān yǐjīng jiàngluò dào dìmiàn le.
examples.example_translation: Our flight has already landed.

examples.example_chinese: 大雪不停地降落下来，越来越厚了。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàxuě bù tíng de jiàngluò xiàlái, yuè lái yuè hòu le.
examples.example_translation: The heavy snow kept falling, getting thicker and thicker.

examples.example_chinese: 大风一吹，树叶纷纷降落。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàfēng yì chuī, shùyè fēnfēn jiàngluò.
examples.example_translation: When the wind blew, the leaves fell one after another.

examples.example_chinese: 因为天气原因，飞机暂时无法降落。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn, fēijī zànshí wúfǎ jiàngluò.
examples.example_translation: Due to the weather, the plane cannot land for now.

meaning: n.高等学校中职称最高的教师 · professor

examples.example_chinese: 他是经济学院的著名教授。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì jīngjì xuéyuàn de zhùmíng jiàoshòu.
examples.example_translation: He is a famous professor at the School of Economics.

examples.example_chinese: 我晚上去听王教授的讲座。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang qù tīng Wáng jiàoshòu de jiǎngzuò.
examples.example_translation: I am going to attend Professor Wang's lecture tonight.

examples.example_chinese: 给我们上课的老师都是年轻教授。
examples.example_pinyin: Gěi wǒmen shàngkè de lǎoshī dōu shì niánqīng jiàoshòu.
examples.example_translation: The teachers who teach us are all young professors.

examples.example_chinese: 老教授讲课非常认真。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎo jiàoshòu jiǎngkè fēicháng rènzhēn.
examples.example_translation: The old professor teaches very conscientiously.

examples.example_chinese: 就像复旦大学教授陈果所说
examples.example_pinyin: jiù xiàng fù dàn dà xué jiào shòu chén guǒ suǒ shuō

meaning: n.旁边有房屋的比较宽阔的道路 · street

examples.example_chinese: 这个城市的每条街道都很干净。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de měi tiáo jiēdào dōu hěn gānjìng.
examples.example_translation: Every street in this city is very clean.

examples.example_chinese: 这条街道有三百多年历史了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào yǒu sānbǎi duō nián lìshǐ le.
examples.example_translation: This street has a history of over 300 years.

examples.example_chinese: 他们每天早晨都打扫街道。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen měitiān zǎochén dōu dǎsǎo jiēdào.
examples.example_translation: They clean the street every morning.

examples.example_chinese: 我们住在同一条街道上。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài tóng yì tiáo jiēdào shàng.
examples.example_translation: We live on the same street.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢街道两边的大树。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan jiēdào liǎng biān de dà shù.
examples.example_translation: I like the big trees along the street very much.

examples.example_chinese: 以前这条街道很窄，现在变宽了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǐqián zhè tiáo jiēdào hěn zhǎi, xiànzài kuān le.
examples.example_translation: It was a very narrow street and now it has been widened.

meaning: v.消费完以后付钱 · settle (or close) an account

examples.example_chinese: 服务员，结账！
examples.example_pinyin: fúwùyuán, jiézhàng!
examples.example_translation: Waiter, the bill please!

examples.example_chinese: 这顿饭我是来结账的。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè pán fàn wǒ shì lái jiézhàng de.
examples.example_translation: I came to settle the bill for this meal.

examples.example_chinese: 我们吃完了，现在结账吧。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen chī wánle, xiànzài jiézhàng ba.
examples.example_translation: We are done eating, let's settle the bill now.

examples.example_chinese: 请您到服务台那边结账。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng nín dào fúwùtái nà biān jiézhàng.
examples.example_translation: Please go to the service desk to settle the bill.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚才才已经结过账了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ gāngcái cái jīngguò jiézhàng le.
examples.example_translation: I just settled the bill a moment ago.

examples.example_chinese: 我的房租三个月结一次账。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de fángzū sān gè yuè jié yī cì zhàng.
examples.example_translation: I settle my rent every three months.

meaning: v.降低温度 · to become cooler, to lower the temperature, cooling, (of interest, activity etc) to decline

examples.example_chinese: 天气预报说明天会降温,记得多穿点衣服。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān huì jiàng wēn, jìde duō chuān diǎn yīfu.
examples.example_translation: The weather forecast says the temperature will drop tomorrow, remember to wear more clothes.

examples.example_chinese: 空调可以帮助房间快速降温。
examples.example_pinyin: Kōngtiáo kěyǐ bāngzhù fángjiān kuàisù jiàng wēn.
examples.example_translation: Air conditioning can help cool down the room quickly.

meaning: v.分析说明, 分辨 · explain, expound, interpret

examples.example_chinese: 老师一解释，学生们就都明白了。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī yī jiěshì, xuéshengmen jiù dōu míngbai le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as the teacher explained, all the students understood.

examples.example_chinese: 你能解释一下事情发生的原因吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng jiěshì yíxià shìqíng fāshēng de yuányīn ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you explain the reason why this happened?

examples.example_chinese: 我解释了半天，他还是不懂。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiěshìle bàntiān, tā háishi bù dǒng.
examples.example_translation: I explained for a long time, but he still didn't understand.

examples.example_chinese: 无论我怎么解释，他就是不相信。
examples.example_pinyin: Wúlùn wǒ zěnme jiěshì, tā jiù shì bù xiāngxìn.
examples.example_translation: No matter how I explain, he just doesn't believe it.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事情他解释不清楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing tā jiěshì bù qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: He can't explain this matter clearly.

meaning: v.不许可 · prohibit, ban, forbid

examples.example_chinese: 公共场所禁止吸烟。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ jìnzhǐ xī yān.
examples.example_translation: Smoking is prohibited in public places.

examples.example_chinese: 交通规则禁止骑车带人。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiāotōng guīzé jìnzhǐ qí chē dài rén.
examples.example_translation: Traffic regulations prohibit carrying passengers on a bicycle.

examples.example_chinese: 不合格产品被严格禁止进入市场。
examples.example_pinyin: Bù hégé chǎnpǐn bèi yángé jìnzhǐ jìnrù shìchǎng.
examples.example_translation: Unqualified products are strictly prohibited from entering the market.

examples.example_chinese: 喝酒以后禁止开车。
examples.example_pinyin: Hē jiǔ yǐhòu jìnzhǐ kāi chē.
examples.example_translation: Driving is prohibited after drinking alcohol.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影已经禁止播出了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yǐjīng jìnzhǐ bōchū le.
examples.example_translation: This movie has already been banned from broadcasting.

examples.example_chinese: 医院内禁止大声喧哗。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīyuàn nèi jìnzhǐ dà shēng xuānhuá.
examples.example_translation: Loud noise is prohibited in the hospital.

meaning: adv.出乎意料地, 没有想到地 · unexpectedly, to one’s surprise

examples.example_chinese: 他这次竟然考了第一名。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhè cì jìngrán kǎole dì-yī míng.
examples.example_translation: He unexpectedly got first place in the exam this time.

examples.example_chinese: 他竟然能听懂中国的方言。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jìngrán néng tīngdǒng Zhōngguó de fāngyán.
examples.example_translation: He can actually understand Chinese dialects.

examples.example_chinese: 我们从来没见过，他竟然知道我的名字。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen cónglái méi jiànguo, tā jìngrán zhīdào wǒ de míngzi.
examples.example_translation: We have never met, yet he actually knows my name.

examples.example_chinese: 这么多钱，他竟然一分也不要。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème duō qián, tā jìngrán yì fēn yě bú yào.
examples.example_translation: So much money, yet he doesn't want a single cent.

examples.example_chinese: 我没听说他谈恋爱，现在竟然要结婚了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngshuō tā tán liàn’ài, xiànzài jìngrán yào jiéhūn le.
examples.example_translation: I never heard he was in a relationship, and now he is actually getting married.

meaning: n.有光滑的平面, 能照见形象的玻璃品 · mirror

examples.example_chinese: 墙上挂着一面大镜子。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe yí miàn dà jìngzi.
examples.example_translation: There is a big mirror hanging on the wall.

examples.example_chinese: 卫生间里有镜子，你可以去照一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèishēngjiān lǐ yǒu jìngzi, nǐ kěyǐ qù zhào yíxià.
examples.example_translation: There is a mirror in the bathroom, you can go take a look.

examples.example_chinese: 你照照镜子，看这件衣服是否合适。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhàozhao jìngzi, kàn zhè jiàn yīfu shìfǒu héshì.
examples.example_translation: Look in the mirror to see if these clothes fit you.

examples.example_chinese: 她在对着镜子打扮自己。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài duìzhe jìngzi dǎbàn zìjǐ.
examples.example_translation: She is dressing herself up in front of the mirror.

examples.example_chinese: 看着镜子里的自己，她很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Kànzhe jìngzi lǐ de zìjǐ, tā hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: Looking at herself in the mirror, she is very satisfied.

meaning: adv.用在问句里, 表示追究 · (used in questions to ask for an exact answer) actually, exactly

examples.example_chinese: 你究竟同意还是不同意？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jiùjìng tóngyì háishi bù tóngyì?
examples.example_translation: Do you actually agree or not?

examples.example_chinese: 我们究竟哪儿做错了？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen jiùjìng nǎr zuòcuò le?
examples.example_translation: Where exactly did we go wrong?

examples.example_chinese: 你究竟看清楚了没有？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jiùjìng kàn qīngchu le méiyǒu?
examples.example_translation: Did you actually see it clearly or not?

examples.example_chinese: 他究竟为什么生气？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiùjìng wèishénme shēngqì?
examples.example_translation: Why exactly is he angry?

examples.example_chinese: 他究竟什么时候能回来？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiùjìng shénme shíhou néng huílái?
examples.example_translation: When exactly can he come back?

meaning: v.在空间或时间上相隔 · space distance, time interval

examples.example_chinese: 我家距离学校十公里。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiā jùlí xuéxiào shí gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: My home is ten kilometers away from the school.

examples.example_chinese: 我距离他很近，能清楚地看清他。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jùlí tā hěn jìn, néng qīngchu de kànqīng tā.
examples.example_translation: I am very close to him and can see him clearly.

examples.example_chinese: 距离新年还有五天的时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Jùlí xīnnián hái yǒu wǔ tiān de shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: There are still five days until the New Year.

examples.example_chinese: 距离他们结婚还有一个月。
examples.example_pinyin: Jùlí tāmen jiéhūn hái yǒu yí ge yuè.
examples.example_translation: There is still one month before their wedding.

examples.example_chinese: 距离下课只有五分钟了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jùlí xiàkè zhǐ yǒu wǔ fēnzhōng le.
examples.example_translation: There are only five minutes left until class ends.

meaning: v.聚在一起搞活动 · get together, assemble

examples.example_chinese: 晚上我们中学同学聚会。
examples.example_pinyin: wǎnshàng wǒmen zhōngxué tóngxué jùhuì.
examples.example_translation: In the evening, our middle school classmates will have a get-together.

examples.example_chinese: 最近我们常在一起聚会。
examples.example_pinyin: zuìjìn wǒmen cháng zài yīqǐ jùhuì.
examples.example_translation: Recently, we often get together.

examples.example_chinese: 老同学五年才能聚会一次，多难得啊！
examples.example_pinyin: lǎo tóngxué wǔ nián cái néng jùhuì yī cì, duō nándé a!
examples.example_translation: Old classmates can only get together once every five years, how rare!

examples.example_chinese: 同学们一聚会，就有说不完的话。
examples.example_pinyin: tóngxuémen yī jùhuì, jiù yǒu shuō bù wán de huà.
examples.example_translation: As soon as classmates get together, they have endless things to talk about.

examples.example_chinese: 聚会终会散场
examples.example_pinyin: jù huì zhōng huì sàn chǎng

meaning: v.集合在一起 · gather, assemble, come together

examples.example_chinese: 同学们聚在教室里讨论问题。
examples.example_pinyin: tóng xué men jù zài jiào shì lǐ tǎo lùn wèn tí.
examples.example_translation: The classmates gathered in the classroom to discuss the problem.

examples.example_chinese: 周末我们一家人聚在一起吃饭。
examples.example_pinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men yī jiā rén jù zài yì qǐ chī fàn.
examples.example_translation: On the weekend, our whole family gets together to eat.

meaning: v.思考问题，以便做出决定 · think over, consider

examples.example_chinese: 你应该考虑结婚的事情了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi kǎolǜ jiéhūn de shìqing le.
examples.example_translation: You should consider getting married.

examples.example_chinese: 我已经考虑好了，毕业后就去中国留学。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng kǎolǜ hǎo le, bìyè hòu jiù qù Zhōngguó liúxué.
examples.example_translation: I have already decided; after graduation, I will study in China.

examples.example_chinese: 希望你能细细考虑我的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ néng xìxì kǎolǜ wǒ de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: I hope you can carefully consider my opinion.

examples.example_chinese: 经过反复考虑，他决定继续读书。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù kǎolǜ, tā juédìng jìxù dúshū.
examples.example_translation: After much consideration, he decided to continue studying.

examples.example_chinese: 这个问题我已经考虑很长时间了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ yǐjīng kǎolǜ hěn cháng shíjiān le.
examples.example_translation: I have been considering this issue for a long time.

meaning: cl.多用于植物 · often used for plants

examples.example_chinese: 他站在一棵大树下。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhàn zài yì kē dà shù xià.
examples.example_translation: He is standing under a big tree.

examples.example_chinese: 这棵树已经长高了很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kē shù yǐjīng zhǎnggāo le hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: This tree has grown much taller.

examples.example_chinese: 他家门前种着一棵树。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiā mén qián zhòngzhe yì kē shù.
examples.example_translation: There is a tree planted in front of his house.

examples.example_chinese: 院子里长出了几棵草。
examples.example_pinyin: Yuànzi li zhǎngchū-le jǐ kē cǎo.
examples.example_translation: Several blades of grass have grown in the yard.

examples.example_chinese: 好不容易来在洞门外找了棵树
examples.example_pinyin: hǎo bù róng yì lái zài dòng mén wài zhǎo le kē shù

meaning: adj.一种难吃的味道（跟“甜”相对） · bitter (as opposed to "甜 sweet")

examples.example_chinese: 这种药很苦，我吃不下去。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn kǔ, wǒ chī bu xiàqù.
examples.example_translation: This medicine is very bitter, I can't swallow it.

examples.example_chinese: 他喜欢喝苦咖啡。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan hē kǔ kāfēi.
examples.example_translation: He likes to drink bitter coffee.

examples.example_chinese: 这种水果有点儿苦味儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ yǒudiǎnr kǔ wèir.
examples.example_translation: This fruit has a slightly bitter taste.

examples.example_chinese: 刚吃的时候苦，后来觉得又有点儿甜。
examples.example_pinyin: Gāng chī de shíhou kǔ, hòulái juéde yòu yǒudiǎnr tián.
examples.example_translation: It was bitter at first, but then it tasted a bit sweet.

examples.example_chinese: 你看这山里的泉水，从山上跳下来，一路上摔了多少跟头啊，可是他唱着快乐的歌，勇敢地向前奔跑，从来不叫苦。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ kàn zhè shān lǐ de quán shuǐ cóng shān shàng tiào xià lái yī lù shàng shuāi le duō shǎo gēn tóu a kě shì tā chàng zhe kuài lè de gē yǒng gǎn de xiàng qián bēnpǎo cóng lái bù jiào kǔ

meaning: n.特快专递的简称 · express delivery

examples.example_chinese: 我在网上买的书,快递明天就能送到。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎngshàng mǎi de shū, kuàidì míngtiān jiù néng sòng dào.
examples.example_translation: The book I bought online will be delivered by express tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 快递员把包裹放在了门口。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuàidìyuán bǎ bāoguǒ fàng zài le ménkǒu.
examples.example_translation: The courier left the package at the door.

meaning: n.用于存放垃圾的桶状物 · garbage can, dustbin

examples.example_chinese: 我把那张纸扔到垃圾桶里了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ rēngdào lājītǒng li le.
examples.example_translation: I threw that piece of paper into the garbage can.

examples.example_chinese: 你这办公室怎么连个垃圾桶也没有？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhè bàngōngshì zěnme lián ge lājītǒng yě méiyǒu?
examples.example_translation: How come there isn’t even a garbage can in your office?

examples.example_chinese: 垃圾桶已经满了，我帮你倒了吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Lājītǒng yǐjīng mǎn le. wǒ bāng nǐ dào le ba.
examples.example_translation: The garbage can is already full, let me empty it for you.

examples.example_chinese: 这支笔没用了，扔到垃圾桶里去吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ méi yòng le, rēngdào lājītǒng li qù ba.
examples.example_translation: This pen is useless now, throw it in the garbage can.

examples.example_chinese: 将朋友当成情绪垃圾桶去诉苦
examples.example_pinyin: jiāng péng you dàngchéng qíngxù lā jī tǒng qù sù kǔ

meaning: v.因时间短，无法赶上做某事 · there is not enough time (to do something)

examples.example_chinese: 火车还有半个小时就开了，现在出发已经来不及了。
examples.example_pinyin: Huǒchē hái yǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí jiù kāi le, xiànzài chūfā yǐjīng láibují le.
examples.example_translation: The train leaves in half an hour, it's too late to leave now.

examples.example_chinese: 我下午要去飞机场，来不及跟你见面了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù fēijīchǎng, láibují gēn nǐ jiànmiàn le.
examples.example_translation: I have to go to the airport this afternoon, there's no time to meet you.

examples.example_chinese: 如果明天就考试，那我们肯定来不及准备。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān jiù kǎoshì, nà wǒmen kěndìng láibují zhǔnbèi.
examples.example_translation: If the exam is tomorrow, we definitely won't have time to prepare.

examples.example_chinese: 我起得太晚了，早饭也来不及吃了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ qǐ de tài wǎn le, zǎofàn yě láibují chī le.
examples.example_translation: I got up too late, there's no time for breakfast either.

examples.example_chinese: 他一直在问我，我都来不及认真考虑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yīzhí zài wèn wǒ, wǒ dōu láibují rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
examples.example_translation: He kept asking me, I didn't have time to think it over seriously.

meaning: adj.像姜、蒜、辣椒等有刺激性的味道 · hot, pungent

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜太辣，我不敢吃。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài tài là, wǒ bù gǎn chī.
examples.example_translation: This dish is too spicy, I don't dare to eat it.

examples.example_chinese: 师傅，我们的菜不要做得太辣。
examples.example_pinyin: Shīfu, wǒmen de cài bùyào zuò de tài là.
examples.example_translation: Chef, don't make our dish too spicy.

examples.example_chinese: 你能不能吃辣？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng chī là?
examples.example_translation: Can you eat spicy food?

examples.example_chinese: 她吃不了这个辣白菜。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chī bù liǎo zhège là báicài.
examples.example_translation: She can't eat this spicy cabbage.

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜特别辣，你小心点儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài tèbié là, nǐ xiǎoxīn diǎnr.
examples.example_translation: This dish is especially spicy, be careful.

meaning: v.有时间，能够赶上做某事 · there is still time (to do something)

examples.example_chinese: 抓紧时间，现在去火车站还来得及。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhuājǐn shíjiān, xiànzài qù huǒchēzhàn hái láidejí.
examples.example_translation: If you hurry, there is still time to get to the train station now.

examples.example_chinese: 别着急，时间来得及。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié zhāojí, shíjiān láidejí.
examples.example_translation: Don't worry, there's still enough time.

examples.example_chinese: 我还没来得及跟你说这件事。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hái méi láidejí gēn nǐ shuō zhè jiàn shì.
examples.example_translation: I haven't had time to tell you about this yet.

examples.example_chinese: 如果来得及，你就来办公室一趟吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ láidejí, nǐ jiù lái bàngōngshì yí tàng ba.
examples.example_translation: If you have time, come to the office.

examples.example_chinese: 只要来得及，我一定会去看你的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhǐyào láidejí, wǒ yídìng huì qù kàn nǐ de.
examples.example_translation: As long as I have time, I will definitely go to see you.

meaning: n.指原籍 · hometown, one's original home

examples.example_chinese: 我在三山关老家一带多好
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zài sān shān guān lǎojiā yīdài duō hǎo
examples.example_translation: How good it was back home at Sanshan Pass

examples.example_chinese: 春节我要回老家看望父母。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūnjié wǒ yào huí lǎojiā kànwàng fùmǔ.
examples.example_translation: I'm going back to my hometown to visit my parents during Spring Festival.

examples.example_chinese: 他的老家在四川,那里的火锅很有名。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de lǎojiā zài Sìchuān, nàlǐ de huǒguō hěn yǒumíng.
examples.example_translation: His hometown is in Sichuan, where the hot pot is very famous.

examples.example_chinese: 我在三山关老家一带多好
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zài sān shān guān lǎojiā yīdài duō hǎo

examples.example_chinese: 看到钱老家中陈设简朴
examples.example_pinyin: kàn dào qián lǎojiā zhōng chén shè jiǎn piáo

meaning: adj.遇到事情沉着，不慌张 · as cool as cucumber, calm, sober

examples.example_chinese: 他做事非常冷静，不会出问题的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuò shì fēicháng lěngjìng, bú huì chū wèntí de.
examples.example_translation: He is very calm when doing things, so nothing will go wrong.

examples.example_chinese: 你先冷静下来，别激动。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěngjìng xiàlai, bié jīdòng.
examples.example_translation: Calm down first, don't get excited.

examples.example_chinese: 我们对情况冷静地进行了分析。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen duì qíngkuàng lěngjìng de jìnxíngle fēnxī.
examples.example_translation: We calmly analyzed the situation.

examples.example_chinese: 如果遇到危险，首先要保持冷静。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wēixiǎn, shǒuxiān yào bǎochí lěngjìng.
examples.example_translation: If you encounter danger, the first thing is to stay calm.

examples.example_chinese: 让我冷静地思考一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Ràng wǒ lěngjìng de sīkǎo yíxià.
examples.example_translation: Let me think calmly for a moment.

examples.example_chinese: 在关键时刻，他表现得特别冷静。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài guānjiàn shíkè, tā biǎoxiàn de tèbié lěngjìng.
examples.example_translation: At the critical moment, he behaved especially calmly.

meaning: v.用尺、容器或其他作为标准的东西来确定事物的长短、大小、多少或其他性质 · to measure

examples.example_chinese: 我用尺子量了一下桌子的长度。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ yòng chǐzi liáng le yíxià zhuōzi de chángdù.
examples.example_translation: I measured the length of the table with a ruler.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈用量杯量出了两杯水。
examples.example_pinyin: māma yòng liàngbēi liáng chū le liǎng bēi shuǐ.
examples.example_translation: Mom measured out two cups of water with a measuring cup.

examples.example_chinese: 工人正在量房间的大小。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngrén zhèngzài liáng fángjiān de dàxiǎo.
examples.example_translation: The worker is measuring the size of the room.

meaning: cl.用于纸张、书页等（常儿化） · sheet, leaf, piece (usually for paper, book leaves, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 这个宣传材料用了三篇儿纸。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xuānchuán cáiliào yòngle sān piānr zhǐ.
examples.example_translation: This promotional material used three sheets of paper.

examples.example_chinese: 你再翻两篇儿就是第五课了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zài fān liǎng piānr jiù shì dì-wǔ kè le.
examples.example_translation: If you turn two more pages, it will be lesson five.

examples.example_chinese: 这个宣传册一共有几篇儿？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xuānchuáncè yígòng yǒu jǐ piānr?
examples.example_translation: How many sheets are there in this brochure in total?

meaning: n.排成的行或队 · row, line

examples.example_chinese: 图书馆前排着一列人。
examples.example_pinyin: túshūguǎn qián pái zhe yī liè rén.
examples.example_translation: There is a line of people in front of the library.

examples.example_chinese: 这列火车正在开往北京。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè liè huǒchē zhèngzài kāiwǎng běijīng.
examples.example_translation: This train is heading to Beijing.

meaning: adj.满足，满意，常与“不”一起使用 · be satisfied, be pleased

examples.example_chinese: 我对他的做法不满。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de zuòfǎ bù mǎn.
examples.example_translation: I am not satisfied with his way of doing things.

examples.example_chinese: 他对自己的成绩很不满。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de chéngjì hěn bù mǎn.
examples.example_translation: He is very dissatisfied with his grades.

examples.example_chinese: 你有什么不满就说出来。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme bùmǎn jiù shuō chūlái.
examples.example_translation: If you have any dissatisfaction, just say it.

examples.example_chinese: 我能从他的表情上看出他的不满。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ néng cóng tā de biǎoqíng shang kànchū tā de bùmǎn.
examples.example_translation: I can see his dissatisfaction from his expression.

meaning: num.两个 · two

examples.example_chinese: 我刚吃了俩苹果。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāng chīle liǎ píngguǒ.
examples.example_translation: I just ate two apples.

examples.example_chinese: 他俩是多年的老朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā liǎ shì duō nián de lǎo péngyou.
examples.example_translation: The two of them have been old friends for many years.

examples.example_chinese: 我分不清他俩谁是弟弟，谁是哥哥。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ fēn bu qīng tā liǎ shéi shì dìdi, shéi shì gēge.
examples.example_translation: I can't tell which of the two is the younger brother and which is the older.

examples.example_chinese: 教室里就剩俩人了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ jiù shèng liǎ rén le.
examples.example_translation: There are only two people left in the classroom.

examples.example_chinese: 他们夫妻俩从来没吵过架。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen fūqī liǎ cónglái méi chǎoguò jià.
examples.example_translation: The couple have never quarreled.

meaning: n.正常吃饭以外的零星食品 · snack

examples.example_chinese: 他从小就不爱吃零食。
examples.example_pinyin: tā cóngxiǎo jiù bù ài chī língshí.
examples.example_translation: He hasn't liked eating snacks since childhood.

examples.example_chinese: 她生气的时候，就买一大包零食吃。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shēngqì de shíhou, jiù mǎi yī dà bāo língshí chī.
examples.example_translation: When she's angry, she buys a big bag of snacks to eat.

examples.example_chinese: 这孩子老吃零食，当然就不爱吃饭了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè háizi lǎo chī língshí, dāngrán jiù bù ài chī fàn le.
examples.example_translation: This child always eats snacks, so of course he doesn't like eating meals.

examples.example_chinese: 零食吃多了，对身体没什么好处。
examples.example_pinyin: língshí chī duō le, duì shēntǐ méiyǒu shénme hǎochù.
examples.example_translation: Eating too many snacks is not good for your health.

examples.example_chinese: 她的包里永远放着零食。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de bāo lǐ yǒngyuǎn fàng zhe língshí.
examples.example_translation: There are always snacks in her bag.

meaning: n.依法协助当事人进行诉讼、辩护以及处理有关法律事务的专业人员 · lawyer

examples.example_chinese: 我以后想当一名律师。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐhòu xiǎng dāng yì míng lǜshī.
examples.example_translation: I want to be a lawyer in the future.

examples.example_chinese: 他爸爸是一位非常著名的律师。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bàba shì yí wèi fēicháng zhùmíng de lǜshī.
examples.example_translation: His father is a very famous lawyer.

examples.example_chinese: 我建议你请一个律师，帮你处理这些事情。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì nǐ qǐng yí ge lǜshī, bāng nǐ chǔlǐ zhèxiē shìqing.
examples.example_translation: I suggest you hire a lawyer to help you handle these matters.

examples.example_chinese: 有问题你找我们公司的律师吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒu wèntí nǐ zhǎo wǒmen gōngsī de lǜshī ba.
examples.example_translation: If you have any problems, contact our company's lawyer.

examples.example_chinese: 他已经拿到了律师资格证书。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjīng nádaole lǜshī zīgé zhèngshū.
examples.example_translation: He has already obtained his lawyer's qualification certificate.

meaning: v.物体因失去支持而下来；下降 · fall, land

examples.example_chinese: 瓢虫款款地落下来了，折好它的黑绸衬裙——膜翅，顺顺溜溜；
examples.example_pinyin: piáo chóng kuǎn kuǎn de luò xià lái le zhé hǎo tā de hēi chóu chèn qún mó chì shùn shùn liū liū
examples.example_translation: The ladybug gracefully lands, folding its black silk underskirt—its membranous wings, smooth and slick;

examples.example_chinese: 我不用为大船和木筏操心， 小划子有多重也用不着想， 至多，有一两片树叶被微风吹落， 在我的胸膛上轻轻摇荡。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ bù yòng wèi dà chuán hé mù fá cāo xīn xiǎo huà zi yǒu duō zhòng yě yòng bù zhe xiǎng zhì duō yǒu yī liǎng piàn shù yè bèi wēi fēng chuī luò zài wǒ de xiōng táng shàng qīng qīng yáo dàng
examples.example_translation: "I don't have to worry about the large ships and rafts, and I don't need to think about how heavy the little rowboats are; at most, a leaf or two is blown off by the gentle breeze, lightly swaying on my chest."

examples.example_chinese: 月光是隔了树照过来的，高处丛生的灌木，落下参差的斑驳的黑影，峭楞楞如鬼一般；
examples.example_pinyin: yuè guāng shì gé le shù zhào guo lái de gāo chǔ cóng shēng de guàn luò xià chà de bān de hēi rú guǐ yī
examples.example_translation: The moonlight filters through the trees, casting uneven, mottled shadows from the tall, dense bushes, eerily sharp like ghosts;

examples.example_chinese: 小水滴聚在一起落下来，人们叫我“雨”。
examples.example_pinyin: xiǎo shuǐ dī jù zài yì qǐ luò xià lái rén men jiào wǒ yǔ
examples.example_translation: The little water droplets gather together and fall, and people call me "rain."

examples.example_chinese: 突然，几发炮弹落在小庙前的空地上。
examples.example_pinyin: tū rán jǐ fā pào dàn luò zài xiǎo miào qián de kōng de shàng
examples.example_translation: Suddenly, several shells landed in the open space in front of the small temple.

meaning: n.一种擦脸、擦澡用的针织品 · towel

examples.example_chinese: 这是新毛巾，你擦擦汗吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì xīn máojīn, nǐ cāca hàn ba.
examples.example_translation: This is a new towel, wipe your sweat.

examples.example_chinese: 这块是我的擦脸毛巾。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kuài shì wǒ de cā liǎn máojīn.
examples.example_translation: This one is my face towel.

examples.example_chinese: 这块毛巾是新买的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kuài máojīn shì xīn mǎi de.
examples.example_translation: This towel is newly bought.

examples.example_chinese: 我到球场才发现忘了带毛巾。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dào qiúchǎng cái fāxiàn wàngle dài máojīn.
examples.example_translation: I only realized I forgot to bring a towel when I got to the court.

examples.example_chinese: 拿他当毛巾晃来晃去
examples.example_pinyin: ná tā dāng máo jīn huǎng lái huǎng qù

meaning: n.用毛线织成的上衣 · (wool) sweater

examples.example_chinese: 天气冷了,我需要买一件新毛衣。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, wǒ xūyào mǎi yī jiàn xīn máoyī.
examples.example_translation: The weather is getting cold, I need to buy a new sweater.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈给我织了一件红色的毛衣。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ zhī le yī jiàn hóngsè de máoyī.
examples.example_translation: Mom knitted me a red sweater.

meaning: n.戴在头上保暖、防雨、遮日光等或做装饰的用品 · hat, cap

examples.example_chinese: 外面很冷，你戴上帽子吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, nǐ dàishang màozi ba.
examples.example_translation: It’s cold outside; you’d better put on the hat.

examples.example_chinese: 他一进屋子，就摘了帽子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yī jìn wūzi, jiù zhāile màozi.
examples.example_translation: He took off his hat as soon as he entered the room.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢那顶花帽子，很漂亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan nà dǐng huā màozi, hěn piàoliang.
examples.example_translation: I like that beautiful flowery hat very much.

examples.example_chinese: 这种衣服上都有个帽子。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīfu shàng dōu yǒu ge màozi.
examples.example_translation: This kind of clothes is designed with a hood.

examples.example_chinese: 你戴红颜色的帽子很好看。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dài hóng yánsè de màozi hěn hǎokàn.
examples.example_translation: You look good in a red hat.

meaning: adj.形容事情又多又乱，不好办 · troublesome, knotty

examples.example_chinese: 出国的手续特别麻烦。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūguó de shǒuxù tèbié máfan.
examples.example_translation: The procedures for going abroad are especially troublesome.

examples.example_chinese: 东西这么多，收拾起来麻烦极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Dōngxi zhème duō, shōushi qǐlai máfan jí le.
examples.example_translation: There are so many things, it's extremely troublesome to tidy up.

examples.example_chinese: 事情变得麻烦起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìqing biàn de máfan qǐlai le.
examples.example_translation: Things have become troublesome.

examples.example_chinese: 这种鱼有一套很麻烦的饲养方法。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yú yǒu yí tào hěn máfan de sìyǎng fāngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: This kind of fish has a very troublesome way of being raised.

examples.example_chinese: 互相一点点麻烦
examples.example_pinyin: hù xiāng yì diǎn diǎn má fan

meaning: n.渴望实现的的想法，愿望 · dream, wish

examples.example_chinese: 我们的梦想也许能够实现。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de mèngxiǎng yěxǔ nénggòu shíxiàn.
examples.example_translation: Perhaps our dream can come true.

examples.example_chinese: 同一个世界，同一个梦想。
examples.example_pinyin: Tóng yīgè shìjiè, tóng yīgè mèngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: One world, one dream.

examples.example_chinese: 中国人终于实现了飞天的梦想。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó rén zhōngyú shíxiàn le fēitiān de mèngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: The Chinese people have finally realized their dream of flying to the sky.

examples.example_chinese: 你想长生不老，这只能是个永远的梦想。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chángshēng bù lǎo, zhè zhǐ néng shì ge yǒngyuǎn de mèngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: You want to live forever; this can only be an eternal dream.

meaning: v.十分渴望，非常希望 · to dream of, to long for

examples.example_translation: I really like Chinese culture, but I don't know much about it yet.

examples.example_chinese: 他水平虽然低一点儿，然而他很努力。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shuǐpíng suīrán dī yìdiǎnr, rán’ér tā hěn nǔlì.
examples.example_translation: Although his level is a bit low, he works very hard.

examples.example_chinese: 我说的你们可能不相信，然而这是真实。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shuō de nǐmen kěnéng bù xiāngxìn, rán’ér zhè shì shìshí.
examples.example_translation: You may not believe what I say, but it is true.

examples.example_chinese: 虽然我们认识十年了，然而很少在一起聊天儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshi shí nián le, rán’ér hěn shǎo zài yìqǐ liáotiānr.
examples.example_translation: Although we have known each other for ten years, we rarely chat together.

meaning: adj.人多，气氛热烈的 · bustling with noise and excitement, lively

examples.example_chinese: 这里是北京最热闹的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli shì Běijīng zuì rènao de dìfang.
examples.example_translation: This is the liveliest place in Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 节日期间，街上很热闹，卖什么的都有。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, jiē shang hěn rènao, mài shénme de dōu yǒu.
examples.example_translation: During the festival, the street is lively and you can buy anything.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子们一回来，家里就变得热闹了。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizimen yī huílái, jiālǐ jiù biàn de rènao le.
examples.example_translation: As soon as the children come back, the house becomes lively.

examples.example_chinese: 我们热热闹闹地过了个新年。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen rèrènaonao de guòle ge xīnnián.
examples.example_translation: We celebrated the New Year in a lively way.

examples.example_chinese: 我爱热闹，也爱冷静；
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ ài rènao yě ài lěngjìng

meaning: n.关于每天工作、生活或感想的记录（多指个人的） · diary, journal

examples.example_chinese: 他每天坚持用汉语写日记。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān jiānchí yòng Hànyǔ xiě rìjì.
examples.example_translation: He insists on writing a diary in Chinese every day.

examples.example_chinese: 他从六岁开始记日记，到现在已经20多年了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cóng liù suì kāishǐ jì rìjì, dào xiànzài yǐjīng èrshí duō nián le.
examples.example_translation: He started keeping a diary at the age of six, and it's been more than 20 years now.

examples.example_chinese: 我的工作日记锁在一个抽屉里。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò rìjì suǒ zài yí ge chōuti li.
examples.example_translation: My work diary is locked in a drawer.

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈曾经偷看过我的日记。
examples.example_pinyin: Māma céngjīng tōu kànguo wǒ de rìjì.
examples.example_translation: My mom once secretly read my diary.

examples.example_chinese: 他发表了很多篇旅游日记。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā fābiǎole hěn duō piān lǚyóu rìjì.
examples.example_translation: He has published many travel diaries.

meaning: adj.符合希望的，令人满意的 · ideal, satisfactory

examples.example_chinese: 我终于找到一份理想的工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú zhǎodào yí fèn lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: I finally found an ideal job.

examples.example_chinese: 我考试考得不太理想。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kǎoshì kǎo de bù tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: I didn't do very well in the exam.

examples.example_chinese: 这个位置非常理想，哪儿都可以看到。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèizhì fēicháng lǐxiǎng, nǎr dōu kěyǐ kàndào.
examples.example_translation: This position is ideal, you can see from anywhere.

examples.example_chinese: 他比较理想地完成了这项任务。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǐjiào lǐxiǎng de wánchéngle zhè xiàng rènwu.
examples.example_translation: He completed this task quite satisfactorily.

examples.example_chinese: 共同的理想
examples.example_pinyin: gòng tóng de lǐ xiǎng

meaning: v.向有关部门提出请求并说明理由 · apply, file an application

examples.example_chinese: 我申请到了中国政府奖学金。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shēnqǐng dào le Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.example_translation: I received a Chinese government scholarship by application.

examples.example_chinese: 这个奖学金很难申请吧？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège jiǎngxuéjīn hěn nán shēnqǐng ba?
examples.example_translation: This scholarship is hard to apply for, right?

examples.example_chinese: 他向公司申请调到销售部门。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàng gōngsī shēnqǐng diàodào xiāoshòu bùmén.
examples.example_translation: He applied to the company to be transferred to the sales department.

examples.example_chinese: 我已经申请了出国留学。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng shēnqǐngle chūguó liúxué.
examples.example_translation: I have already applied to study abroad.

examples.example_chinese: 他向银行申请了购房贷款。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàng yínháng shēnqǐngle gòufáng dàikuǎn.
examples.example_translation: He applied to the bank for a mortgage loan.

examples.example_chinese: 我申请得早，所以批下来得也早。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shēnqǐng de zǎo, suǒyǐ pī xiàlái de yě zǎo.
examples.example_translation: I applied early, so the approval also came early.

meaning: v.辣味刺激（口、胃、鼻、眼） · (of smell or taste) hot and stinging

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜辣得他眼泪都出来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài là de tā yǎnlèi dōu chūlái le.
examples.example_translation: This dish is so spicy that it made him cry.

examples.example_chinese: 切洋葱时，小心辣你的眼睛。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiē yángcōng shí, xiǎoxīn là nǐ de yǎnjing.
examples.example_translation: Be careful of the onions stinging your eyes when cutting them.

examples.example_chinese: 我吃了个辣椒，辣得我一身汗。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ chīle gè làjiāo, là de wǒ yī shēn hàn.
examples.example_translation: I ate a chili pepper, and it made me sweat all over.

examples.example_chinese: 两人一商量,费仲说坏了,咱们俩在天子面前呢,这本宝的,得做辣不可啊。
examples.example_pinyin: liǎng rén yī shāng liang fèi zhòng shuō huài le zán men liǎ zài tiān zi miàn qián ne zhè běn bǎo de děi zuò là bù kě a

examples.example_chinese: 我不能忘记那个小店的老板娘，她独自应接顾客，老板司厨，她很俏丽泼辣，但不幸有个名副其实的狮子鼻。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ bù néng nà gè xiǎo de lǎo niáng tā dú jiē gù lǎo tā hěn pō là bù yǒu gè fù qí de

meaning: v.在战争或比赛中被对手打败（跟“胜利”相对） · be defeated, lose (a war, game, etc.) (as opposed to "victory")

examples.example_chinese: 尽管他们准备得很充分，可最终还是失败了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tāmen zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngfèn, kě zuìzhōng háishi shībài le.
examples.example_translation: Although they were well prepared, they still lost in the end.

examples.example_chinese: 这场战斗敌人彻底失败了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhàndòu dírén chèdǐ shībài le.
examples.example_translation: The enemy was completely defeated in this battle.

examples.example_chinese: 他在参加过的比赛中，仅仅失败过一次。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài cānjiāguò de bǐsài zhōng, jǐnjǐn shībàiguò yí cì.
examples.example_translation: He has only lost once in all the competitions he has participated in.

examples.example_chinese: 他虽然失败了，可没有泄气。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā suīrán shībài le, kě méiyǒu xièqì.
examples.example_translation: Although he failed, he did not lose heart.

examples.example_chinese: 人不怕遇到坎坷和失败
examples.example_pinyin: rén bù pà yù dào kǎn kě hé shī bài

meaning: adv.强调突出的事例，表示更进一步，后面常有“都、也”等副词 · even; (go) so far as to (usually accompanied by an adverb such as “都” or “也”);

examples.example_chinese: 他胖得甚至都走不动路了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā pàng de shènzhì dōu zǒu bu dòng lù le.
examples.example_translation: He is so fat that he can't even walk.

examples.example_chinese: 这里很落后，甚至连电灯都没有。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn luòhòu, shènzhì lián diàndēng dōu méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: This place is so backward that it doesn't even have electric lights.

examples.example_chinese: 他比以前高多了，我甚至都认不出他来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǐ yǐqián gāo duō le, wǒ shènzhì dōu rèn bu chū tā lái le.
examples.example_translation: He is much taller than before, I can't even recognize him.

examples.example_chinese: 这个题甚至老师也不会做。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège tí shènzhì lǎoshī yě bú huì zuò.
examples.example_translation: Even the teacher can't solve this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 他汉语说得很好，人们甚至听不出他是外国人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo, rénmen shènzhì tīng bu chū tā shì wàiguó rén.
examples.example_translation: He speaks Chinese so well that people can't even tell he's a foreigner.

meaning: n.容易发怒的性格 · irritable disposition, bad temper

examples.example_chinese: 这人脾气很大，动不动就发火。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè rén píqi hěn dà, dòng bu dòng jiù fāhuǒ.
examples.example_translation: This person has a bad temper and gets angry easily.

examples.example_chinese: 那时候，爸爸总爱发脾气，孩子们都很怕他。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà shíhou, bàba zǒng ài fā píqi, háizimen dōu hěn pà tā.
examples.example_translation: At that time, dad always lost his temper, and the children were all afraid of him.

examples.example_chinese: 这人有点儿脾气，你最好别惹他。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè rén yǒu diǎnr píqi, nǐ zuìhǎo bié rě tā.
examples.example_translation: This person has a bit of a temper, you’d better not provoke him.

meaning: adj.因希望没有实现而不高兴 · disappointed, unhappy because one’s wish fails to be realized

examples.example_chinese: 这个大学没有我想象的好，我很失望。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dàxué méiyǒu wǒ xiǎngxiàng de hǎo, wǒ hěn shīwàng.
examples.example_translation: This university is not as good as I imagined, I am very disappointed.

examples.example_chinese: 从他失望的表情可以看出，这场球赛又输了。
examples.example_pinyin: Cóng tā shīwàng de biǎoqíng kěyǐ kànchū, zhè chǎng qiúsài yòu shū le.
examples.example_translation: From his disappointed expression, you can tell that the game was lost again.

examples.example_chinese: 看着这个结果，他留下了失望的眼泪。
examples.example_pinyin: Kànzhe zhège jiéguǒ, tā liúxiàle shīwàng de yǎnlèi.
examples.example_translation: Looking at this result, he shed tears of disappointment.

examples.example_chinese: 自己支持的球队输了，球迷们失望地离开了球场。
examples.example_pinyin: Zìjǐ zhīchí de qiúduì shū le, qiúmímén shīwàng de líkāile qiúchǎng.
examples.example_translation: The team they supported lost, and the fans left the stadium disappointed.

examples.example_chinese: 付出得不到珍惜,耗完了耐心,攒够了失望。
examples.example_pinyin: fù chū dé bú dào zhēnxī hào wán le nài xīn zǎn gòu le shī wàng

meaning: prep.引进对象，表示包括在内 · including

examples.example_chinese: 教室里连老师一共是18个人。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ lián lǎoshī yīgòng shí bā ge rén.
examples.example_translation: There are 18 people in the classroom including the teacher.

examples.example_chinese: 这些大米连袋子一共42斤。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dàmǐ lián dàizi yīgòng sìshí'èr jīn.
examples.example_translation: These bags of rice weigh 42 jin in total including the bags.

examples.example_chinese: 这次旅行，连花钱带路费，一共花了3200元。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng, lián huā qián dài lùfèi, yīgòng huāle sānqiān èrbǎi yuán.
examples.example_translation: This trip, including spending money and travel expenses, cost a total of 3200 yuan.

examples.example_chinese: 站在桥栏杆边欣赏风景的人被惊扰了，连忙回过头来……
examples.example_pinyin: zhàn zài qiáo lán gān liǎng jǐng de rén bèi le lián máng huí guò qíng lái

examples.example_chinese: 因为平常连这一点点渺小之感都不会有的！
examples.example_pinyin: yīn wèi píng lián zhè yī diǎn diǎn xiǎo zhī dōu bù huì yǒu de

meaning: n.机关、学校、工厂等供应饭食的地方 · dining hall, cafeteria

examples.example_chinese: 我每天中午都在学校食堂吃饭。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ měitiān zhōngwǔ dōu zài xuéxiào shítáng chīfàn.
examples.example_translation: I eat lunch in the school cafeteria every day.

examples.example_chinese: 公司食堂的饭很便宜，也很好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngsī shítáng de fàn hěn piányi, yě hěn hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: The food in the company cafeteria is cheap and also very tasty.

examples.example_chinese: 下课后，学生们一起去食堂吃晚饭。
examples.example_pinyin: xiàkè hòu, xuéshengmen yìqǐ qù shítáng chī wǎnfàn.
examples.example_translation: After class, the students go to the dining hall together to have dinner.

examples.example_chinese: 今天食堂里有面条和鸡肉。
examples.example_pinyin: jīntiān shítáng lǐ yǒu miàntiáo hé jīròu.
examples.example_translation: Today there are noodles and chicken in the cafeteria.

meaning: adj.在一段时间很盛行的 · popular

examples.example_chinese: 这是现在最流行的说法。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì xiànzài zuì liúxíng de shuōfa.
examples.example_translation: This is the most popular saying now.

examples.example_chinese: 他很喜欢听流行音乐。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan tīng liúxíng yīnyuè.
examples.example_translation: He likes listening to pop music.

examples.example_chinese: 这种衣服已经不流行了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīfu yǐjīng bù liúxíng le.
examples.example_translation: This kind of clothing is no longer in fashion.

examples.example_chinese: 这种运动今年很流行。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yùndòng jīnnián hěn liúxíng.
examples.example_translation: This sport is very popular this year.

examples.example_chinese: 你得的是一种流行病。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ dé de shì yì zhǒng liúxíngbìng.
examples.example_translation: You have a kind of infectious disease.

meaning: adv.是不是，表示商量、怀疑、不确定的语气 · whether or not, whether, if

examples.example_chinese: 他是否认为这件事情跟你没关系？
examples.example_pinyin: tā shìfǒu rènwéi zhè jiàn shìqíng gēn nǐ méi guānxi?
examples.example_translation: Does he think whether or not this matter has nothing to do with you?

examples.example_chinese: 不知你们是否明白了我的意思。
examples.example_pinyin: bù zhī dào nǐmen shìfǒu míngbai le wǒ de yìsi.
examples.example_translation: I don't know whether you have understood my meaning.

examples.example_chinese: 这些理论是否正确，还要经过实践检验。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē lǐlùn shìfǒu zhèngquè, hái yào jīngguò shíjiàn jiǎnyàn.
examples.example_translation: Whether these theories are correct still needs to be tested in practice.

examples.example_chinese: 你们是否能毕业，主要看你们的成绩。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐmen shìfǒu néng bìyè, zhǔyào kàn nǐmen de chéngjì.
examples.example_translation: Whether you can graduate mainly depends on your grades.

examples.example_chinese: 公司是否支持我们这个计划，谁也不敢保证。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngsī shìfǒu zhīchí wǒmen zhège jìhuà, shéi yě bù gǎn bǎozhèng.
examples.example_translation: No one can guarantee whether the company will support our plan.

meaning: v.保留，遗留 · keep something for, leave something for

examples.example_chinese: 他留着很多小时候的照片。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā liúzhe hěn duō xiǎoshíhou de zhàopiàn.
examples.example_translation: He keeps many childhood photos.

examples.example_chinese: 他走的时候，给你留了一些书。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒu de shíhou, gěi nǐ liúle yìxiē shū.
examples.example_translation: When he left, he left you some books.

examples.example_chinese: 父母没给他留下什么财产。
examples.example_pinyin: Fùmǔ méi gěi tā liúxià shénme cáichǎn.
examples.example_translation: His parents didn't leave him any property.

examples.example_chinese: 这套房子是母亲留给她的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi shì mǔqīn liúgěi tā de.
examples.example_translation: This house was left to her by her mother.

examples.example_chinese: 人们用蚕茧制作丝绵时发现，盛放蚕茧的篾席上，会留下一层薄片，可用于书写。
examples.example_pinyin: rén men yòng cán jiǎn zhìzuò sī mián shí fā xiàn shèng fàng cán jiǎn de miè xí shàng huì liú xià yī céng báo piàn kě yòngyú shūxiě

meaning: phr.不能忍受 · cannot stand, cannot bear

examples.example_chinese: 天气太热了，很多人受不了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, hěn duō rén shòubuliǎo.
