examples.example_translation: The weather is too hot, many people can't stand it.

examples.example_chinese: 你什么都忘，真让人受不了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ shénme dōu wàng, zhēn ràng rén shòubuliǎo.
examples.example_translation: You forget everything, it's really unbearable.

examples.example_chinese: 我受不了这里的环境污染，想马上离开。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shòubuliǎo zhèli de huánjìng wūrǎn, xiǎng mǎshàng líkāi.
examples.example_translation: I can't stand the environmental pollution here and want to leave immediately.

examples.example_chinese: 你要是头疼得受不了，就赶快去医院。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi tóuténg de shòubuliǎo, jiù gǎnkuài qù yīyuàn.
examples.example_translation: If your headache is unbearable, go to the hospital quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 工作上的困难和压力他实在受不了，只好辞职了。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò shang de kùnnan hé yālì tā shízài shòubuliǎo, zhǐhǎo cízhí le.
examples.example_translation: He really couldn't stand the difficulties and pressure at work, so he had to resign.

meaning: cl.用于诗歌、歌曲等 · measure word for poems, songs, etc.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢这首歌。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè shǒu gē.
examples.example_translation: I really like this song.

examples.example_chinese: 他会唱三首中文歌。
examples.example_pinyin: tā huì chàng sān shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.example_translation: He can sing three Chinese songs.

examples.example_chinese: 老师叫我们读一首诗。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī jiào wǒmen dú yì shǒu shī.
examples.example_translation: The teacher asked us to read a poem.

examples.example_chinese: 这首诗写的是春天。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè shǒu shī xiě de shì chūntiān.
examples.example_translation: This poem is about spring.

meaning: n.卖商品的人 · shop assistant, salesclerk

examples.example_chinese: 我妹妹是一家商场的售货员。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mèimei shì yì jiā shāngchǎng de shòuhuòyuán.
examples.example_translation: My younger sister is a shop assistant in a mall.

examples.example_chinese: 你还记得是哪个售货员卖给你的吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ hái jìde shì nǎge shòuhuòyuán mài gěi nǐ de ma?
examples.example_translation: Do you still remember which shop assistant sold it to you?

examples.example_chinese: 你问问售货员还有没有那本书。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ wènwen shòuhuòyuán hái yǒu méiyǒu nà běn shū.
examples.example_translation: Ask the shop assistant if they still have that book.

examples.example_chinese: 这个书店的售货员非常热情。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège shūdiàn de shòuhuòyuán fēicháng rèqíng.
examples.example_translation: The shop assistant in this bookstore is very enthusiastic.

examples.example_chinese: 他找到了一份售货员的工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhǎodào le yí fèn shòuhuòyuán de gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: He found a job as a shop assistant.

meaning: phr.在规定的暑期内停止学习或工作 · have one’s summer vacation

examples.example_chinese: 这所大学七月末开始放暑假。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué qī yuè mò kāishǐ fàng shǔjià.
examples.example_translation: This university starts summer vacation at the end of July.

examples.example_chinese: 放暑假了，孩子们很高兴。
examples.example_pinyin: Fàng shǔjià le, háizimen hěn gāoxìng.
examples.example_translation: It's summer vacation, the children are very happy.

examples.example_chinese: 我准备放暑假的时候去北京。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǔnbèi fàng shǔjià de shíhou qù Běijīng.
examples.example_translation: I plan to go to Beijing during the summer vacation.

examples.example_chinese: 你们什么时候放暑假？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen shénme shíhou fàng shǔjià?
examples.example_translation: When do you have summer vacation?

examples.example_chinese: 我们放了两个月的暑假。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen fàngle liǎng ge yuè de shǔjià.
examples.example_translation: We had a two-month summer vacation.

meaning: n.成片生长的许多树木 · woods, grove

examples.example_chinese: 我们在树林里散步。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zài shùlín lǐ sànbù.
examples.example_translation: We are taking a walk in the woods.

examples.example_chinese: 树林里有很多小鸟。
examples.example_pinyin: shùlín lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎo niǎo.
examples.example_translation: There are many birds in the woods.

examples.example_chinese: 一阵风吹过树林。
examples.example_pinyin: yì zhèn fēng chuīguò shùlín.
examples.example_translation: A gust of wind blew through the woods.

examples.example_chinese: 太阳慢慢从树林后面升起来。
examples.example_pinyin: tài yáng mànmàn cóng shùlín hòumiàn shēng qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: The sun slowly rose from behind the woods.

meaning: adv.任意，随便 · at will, randomly

examples.example_chinese: 他总是乱花钱，买了很多没用的东西。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒngshi luàn huā qián, mǎile hěn duō méi yòng de dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: He always spends money recklessly and buys a lot of useless things.

examples.example_chinese: 别乱吃东西，那样会生病的。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié luàn chī dōngxi, nàyàng huì shēngbìng de.
examples.example_translation: Don't eat things randomly, you'll get sick that way.

examples.example_chinese: 你不了解情况，就不要乱说。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bù liǎojiě qíngkuàng, jiù bùyào luàn shuō.
examples.example_translation: If you don't understand the situation, don't speak carelessly.

examples.example_chinese: 他在街上乱走，也不知道去哪儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài jiē shang luàn zǒu, yě bù zhīdào qù nǎr.
examples.example_translation: He wandered aimlessly in the street, not knowing where to go.

examples.example_chinese: 这是我自己乱想的，不一定对。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ luàn xiǎng de, bù yídìng duì.
examples.example_translation: This is just my random thought, it may not be right.

meaning: adj.伤心，不愉快 · unhappy, sad

examples.example_chinese: 比赛输了，队员们都很难受。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài shū le, duìyuánmen dōu hěn nánshòu.
examples.example_translation: After losing the game, all the team members felt very bad.

examples.example_chinese: 他离开父母时，心里难受极了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā líkāi fùmǔ shí, xīnlǐ nánshòu jí le.
examples.example_translation: He felt extremely sad when he left his parents.

examples.example_chinese: 老人想起自己远在外地的孩子，难受地哭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎorén xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yuǎn zài wàidì de háizi, nánshòu de kū le.
examples.example_translation: The old man cried sadly when he thought of his children far away.

examples.example_chinese: 你难受的心情我们都能理解。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ nánshòu de xīnqíng wǒmen dōu néng lǐjiě.
examples.example_translation: We can all understand how sad you feel.

examples.example_chinese: 别太难受了，以后会慢慢好起来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié tài nánshòu le, yǐhòu huì mànmàn hǎo qǐlai de.
examples.example_translation: Don't feel too bad, things will get better gradually.

meaning: adj.英俊, 潇洒 · handsome

examples.example_chinese: 那个小伙子长得很帅。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàge xiǎohuǒzi zhǎng de hěn shuài.
examples.example_translation: That young man is very handsome.

examples.example_chinese: 他是个帅哥，姑娘们都喜欢他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì gè shuàigē, gūniangmen dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.example_translation: He is a handsome guy, all the girls like him.

examples.example_chinese: 他的动作太帅了，我就喜欢看他打球。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de dòngzuò tài shuài le, wǒ jiù xǐhuan kàn tā dǎ qiú.
examples.example_translation: His moves are so cool, I just like watching him play ball.

examples.example_chinese: 他那么帅，怎么会找不到女朋友呢？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā nàme shuài, zěnme huì zhǎo bu dào nǚpéngyou ne?
examples.example_translation: He is so handsome, how could he not find a girlfriend?

examples.example_chinese: 你穿上这套西服，显得帅多了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ chuānshang zhè tào xīfú, xiǎnde shuài duō le.
examples.example_translation: You look much more handsome in this suit.

meaning: n.指遇到事情不着急，不厌烦的心理 · patience

examples.example_chinese: 他缺乏耐心，爱着急。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā quēfá nàixīn, ài zhāojí.
examples.example_translation: He lacks patience and is easily anxious.

examples.example_chinese: 耐心不够是他最大的缺点。
examples.example_pinyin: Nàixīn bú gòu shì tā zuì dà de quēdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: Lack of patience is his biggest shortcoming.

examples.example_chinese: 对孩子，他很有耐心。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì háizi, tā hěn yǒu nàixīn.
examples.example_translation: He is very patient with children.

examples.example_chinese: 你怎么一点儿耐心也没有？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìdiǎnr nàixīn yě méiyǒu?
examples.example_translation: How come you don't have any patience at all?

meaning: n.作为担保的事务 · that which guarantees

examples.example_chinese: 这项检查措施让产品质量有了保证。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiǎnchá cuòshī ràng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng yǒule bǎozhèng.
examples.example_translation: These inspection measures provide a guarantee for product quality.

examples.example_chinese: 团结是胜利的保证。
examples.example_pinyin: Tuánjié shì shènglì de bǎozhèng.
examples.example_translation: Unity is the guarantee of victory.

examples.example_chinese: 你如果总是做不到，就没人相信你的保证了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ rúguǒ zǒngshì zuò bù dào, jiù méi rén xiāngxìn nǐ de bǎozhèng le.
examples.example_translation: If you always fail to do what you promised, no one will trust your guarantees.

examples.example_chinese: 你就敢保证榜上没你吗？
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ jiù gǎn bǎo zhèng bǎng shàng méi nǐ ma

examples.example_chinese: 保证你一家人团聚
examples.example_pinyin: bǎo zhèng nǐ yījiārén tuánjù

meaning: n.次序 · order, sequence

examples.example_chinese: 会议发言的顺序已经确定了。
examples.example_pinyin: Huìyì fāyán de shùnxù yǐjīng quèdìng le.
examples.example_translation: The order of speeches at the meeting has been decided.

examples.example_chinese: 请按先后顺序上车。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng àn xiānhòu shùnxù shàng chē.
examples.example_translation: Please get on the bus in order.

examples.example_chinese: 这些文件是按时间顺序排列的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē wénjiàn shì àn shíjiān shùnxù páiliè de.
examples.example_translation: These documents are arranged in chronological order.

examples.example_chinese: 你们的顺序别乱了，一个一个来。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐmen de shùnxù bié luàn le, yí ge yí ge lái.
examples.example_translation: Don't mess up your order, come one by one.

examples.example_chinese: 这些东西的摆放顺序都是有讲究的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi de bǎifàng shùnxù dōu shì yǒu jiǎngjiu de.
examples.example_translation: There is a particular order to the arrangement of these things.

meaning: n.用塑料制成的装食品或其他东西的袋子 · plastic bag

examples.example_chinese: 你能给我一个塑料袋吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng gěi wǒ yí ge sùliàodài ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you give me a plastic bag?

examples.example_chinese: 超市里的塑料袋都是收费的。
examples.example_pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ de sùliàodài dōu shì shōufèi de.
examples.example_translation: Plastic bags in the supermarket are all charged for.

examples.example_chinese: 我买的面包在塑料袋里面呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de miànbāo zài sùliàodài lǐ ne.
examples.example_translation: The bread I bought is in the plastic bag.

examples.example_chinese: 现在已经禁止使用这种一次性塑料袋了。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng zhè zhǒng yīcìxìng sùliàodài le.
examples.example_translation: Now it is forbidden to use this kind of disposable plastic bag.

meaning: adj.像醋的气味或味道的 · sour, tart, having the taste or smell of vinegar

examples.example_chinese: 你买的橘子太酸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ mǎi de júzi tài suān le.
examples.example_translation: The tangerines you bought are too sour.

examples.example_chinese: 他不爱吃酸的水果。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù ài chī suān de shuǐguǒ.
examples.example_translation: He doesn't like to eat sour fruits.

examples.example_chinese: 你想吃甜的还是酸的？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī tián de háishì suān de?
examples.example_translation: Do you want to eat something sweet or sour?

examples.example_chinese: 你的房间里有一股酸味。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu yì gǔ suān wèi.
examples.example_translation: There is a sour smell in your room.

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜酸得不能吃了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài suān de bù néng chī le.
examples.example_translation: This dish is so sour that it can't be eaten.

meaning: n.以树脂等高分子化合物为基本成分，与配料混合后加热加压而成的、具有一定形状的材料 · plastics

examples.example_chinese: 为了保护环境,我们应该少用塑料袋。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, wǒmen yīnggāi shǎo yòng sùliào dài.
examples.example_translation: To protect the environment, we should use fewer plastic bags.

examples.example_chinese: 这个玩具是塑料做的,很轻。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wánjù shì sùliào zuò de, hěn qīng.
examples.example_translation: This toy is made of plastic, it's very light.

meaning: adj.悲痛, 伤心 · grieved, distressed

examples.example_chinese: 他这一生，充满了坎坷与辛酸。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhè yìshēng, chōngmǎnle kǎnkě yǔ xīnsuān.
examples.example_translation: His life was full of hardships and bitterness.

examples.example_chinese: 她心里一酸，眼泪掉了下来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ yì suān, yǎnlèi diāole xiàlái.
examples.example_translation: She felt a pang of sadness and tears fell from her eyes.

meaning: n.儿子的儿子 · grandson

examples.example_chinese: 他已经有孙子了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǐjing yǒu sūnzi le.
examples.example_translation: He already has a grandson.

examples.example_chinese: 爷爷每天带着孙子玩儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Yéye měi tiān dàizhe sūnzi wánr.
examples.example_translation: Grandpa plays with his grandson every day.

examples.example_chinese: 这是我孙子，今年四岁。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ sūnzi, jīnnián sì suì.
examples.example_translation: This is my grandson, he is four years old this year.

examples.example_chinese: 他去学校接孙子去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā qù xuéxiào jiē sūnzi qù le.
examples.example_translation: He went to the school to pick up his grandson.

examples.example_chinese: 他给孙子买了很多玩具。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gěi sūnzi mǎile hěn duō wánjù.
examples.example_translation: He bought a lot of toys for his grandson.

meaning: n.儿子的女儿 · son's daughter, granddaughter

examples.example_chinese: 奶奶很疼爱她的小孙女。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǎinai hěn téng'ài tā de xiǎo sūnnǚ.
examples.example_translation: Grandma loves her little granddaughter very much.

examples.example_chinese: 我的孙女今年上小学一年级了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de sūnnǚ jīnnián shàng xiǎoxué yī niánjí le.
examples.example_translation: My granddaughter is in first grade of elementary school this year.

meaning: v.身体倒在地上或其他物体上, 也指车辆、器具等倒在地上 · recline, lie

examples.example_chinese: 他生病了，在床上躺了一天。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shēngbìng le, zài chuáng shang tǎngle yì tiān.
examples.example_translation: He was sick and lay in bed for a whole day.

examples.example_chinese: 他突然躺倒在地上。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tūrán tǎngdǎo zài dìshang.
examples.example_translation: He suddenly lay down on the ground.

examples.example_chinese: 别躺着，快点儿起床吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié tǎngzhe, kuài diǎnr qǐchuáng ba.
examples.example_translation: Don't just lie there, get up quickly.

examples.example_chinese: 我刚躺下，就有人打电话过来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāng tǎngxià, jiù yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà guòlái le.
examples.example_translation: I had just lain down when someone called me.

examples.example_chinese: 前面发生了交通事故，一辆汽车躺在道路中间了。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēngle jiāotōng shìgù, yì liàng qìchē tǎng zài dàolù zhōngjiān le.
examples.example_translation: There was a traffic accident ahead, and a car was lying in the middle of the road.

meaning: v.从旁指点, 促使注意 · remind, call somebody’s attention to

examples.example_chinese: 我提醒大家，在上山的时候要注意安全。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tíxǐng dàjiā, zài shàng shān de shíhou yào zhùyì ānquán.
examples.example_translation: I remind everyone to pay attention to safety when climbing the mountain.

examples.example_chinese: 明天开会前，请你再提醒我一次。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān kāihuì qián, qǐng nǐ zài tíxǐng wǒ yí cì.
examples.example_translation: Please remind me again before the meeting tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 如果不是他提醒我，我肯定忘了今天的作业。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ bú shì tā tíxǐng wǒ, wǒ kěndìng wàngle jīntiān de zuòyè.
examples.example_translation: If he hadn't reminded me, I would have definitely forgotten today's homework.

examples.example_chinese: 你提醒得很及时，我差点儿忘了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ tíxǐng de hěn jíshí, wǒ chàdiǎn wàng le.
examples.example_translation: Your reminder was very timely, I almost forgot.

examples.example_chinese: 我给你提个醒儿，他姓张。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ tí ge xǐngr, tā xìng Zhāng.
examples.example_translation: Let me remind you, his surname is Zhang.

meaning: v.供给（意见、资料、物资、条件等） · provide (the opinion, materials, conditions, etc.), supply, offer

examples.example_chinese: 这个律师公司向很多人提供过帮助。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège fǎlǜ gōngsī xiàng hěn duō rén tígōngguo bāngzhù.
examples.example_translation: This law firm has provided help to many people.

examples.example_chinese: 他们给残疾人提供了很多方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen gěi cánjírén tígōngle hěn duō fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: They have provided a lot of convenience for disabled people.

examples.example_chinese: 你还能提供一些新的情况吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ hái néng tígōng yìxiē xīn de qíngkuàng ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you provide some new information?

examples.example_chinese: 这些消息提供得很及时。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē xiāoxi tígōng de hěn jíshí.
examples.example_translation: This information was provided very promptly.

examples.example_chinese: 谢谢你提供的这些材料。
examples.example_pinyin: Xièxie nǐ tígōng de zhèxiē cáiliào.
examples.example_translation: Thank you for providing these materials.

meaning: n.身体的重量 · body weight

examples.example_chinese: 你的体重是多少？
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ de tǐzhòng shì duōshǎo?
examples.example_translation: What is your body weight?

examples.example_chinese: 我最近体重增加了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zuìjìn tǐzhòng zēngjiā le.
examples.example_translation: My body weight has increased recently.

examples.example_chinese: 她每天都量体重。
examples.example_pinyin: tā měitiān dōu liáng tǐzhòng.
examples.example_translation: She measures her body weight every day.

examples.example_chinese: 医生建议他控制体重。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng jiànyì tā kòngzhì tǐzhòng.
examples.example_translation: The doctor advised him to control his body weight.

meaning: n.身体检查 · physical examination

examples.example_chinese: 我明天要去医院体检。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ míngtiān yào qù yīyuàn tǐjiǎn.
examples.example_translation: I am going to the hospital for a physical examination tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 公司每年都安排员工体检。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngsī měinián dōu ānpái yuángōng tǐjiǎn.
examples.example_translation: The company arranges physical examinations for employees every year.

examples.example_chinese: 体检前最好不要吃东西。
examples.example_pinyin: tǐjiǎn qián zuìhǎo bùyào chī dōngxi.
examples.example_translation: It is best not to eat anything before a physical examination.

examples.example_chinese: 他的体检结果很正常。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de tǐjiǎn jiéguǒ hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: His physical examination results are normal.

meaning: v.教学中测验的一种方法，把题写成一句话，空着要求回答的部分，让人填写 · fill in the blanks (in a test paper)

examples.example_chinese: 这道题是请大家根据课文内容填空。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè dào tí shì qǐng dàjiā gēnjù kèwén nèiróng tiánkòng.
examples.example_translation: For this question, please fill in the blanks according to the text.

examples.example_chinese: 老师正在教我们怎么填空。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài jiāo wǒmen zěnme tiánkòng.
examples.example_translation: The teacher is teaching us how to fill in the blanks.

examples.example_chinese: 这次考试全是填空题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì quán shì tiánkòngtí.
examples.example_translation: This exam is all fill-in-the-blank questions.

examples.example_chinese: 我不会做这些填空题。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù huì zuò zhèxiē tiánkòngtí.
examples.example_translation: I don't know how to do these fill-in-the-blank questions.

examples.example_chinese: 请同学们填上这些空。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng tóngxuémen tiánshang zhèxiē kòng.
examples.example_translation: Students, please fill in these blanks.

meaning: v.使丰富 · enrich

examples.example_chinese: 他通过学习，丰富了自己的知识。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tōngguò xuéxí, fēngfùle zìjǐ de zhīshi.
examples.example_translation: He enriched his knowledge through studying.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要想办法丰富业余生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiǎng bànfǎ fēngfù yèyú shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: We need to find ways to enrich our spare time life.

examples.example_chinese: 这几个月的旅游，大大丰富了我的经历。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè de lǚyóu, dàdà fēngfùle wǒ de jīnglì.
examples.example_translation: These months of travel greatly enriched my experience.

examples.example_chinese: 这些游戏，可以丰富孩子的想象力。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē yóuxì, kěyǐ fēngfù háizi de xiǎngxiànglì.
examples.example_translation: These games can enrich children's imagination.

examples.example_chinese: 那里风景优美，物产丰富，是个可爱的地方。
examples.example_pinyin: nà lǐ fēngjǐng yōuměi wù chǎn fēng fù shì gè kě ài de dì fang

meaning: prep.考试等达到一定标准 · pass (an examination)

examples.example_chinese: 我通过了这次汉语水平考试。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tōngguòle zhè cì Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì.
examples.example_translation: I passed this HSK exam.

examples.example_chinese: 你通过了几门课程？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ tōngguòle jǐ mén kèchéng?
examples.example_translation: How many courses did you pass?

examples.example_chinese: 他有两门考试没有通过。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒu liǎng mén kǎoshì méiyǒu tōngguò.
examples.example_translation: He didn't pass two exams.

examples.example_chinese: 是通过长期的积累
examples.example_pinyin: shì tōng guò cháng qī de jī lěi

examples.example_chinese: 于是通过讨好的方式，
examples.example_pinyin: yú shì tōng guò tǎo hǎo de fāng shì

meaning: n.告诉人知道的文字或口信 · notice, circular

examples.example_chinese: 我们刚刚接到一个通知，明天的会议取消了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen gānggāng jiēdào yí ge tōngzhī, míngtiān de huìyì qǔxiāo le.
examples.example_translation: We just received a notice that tomorrow's meeting is canceled.

examples.example_chinese: 这个通知的内容大家都已经知道了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège tōngzhī de nèiróng dàjiā dōu yǐjīng zhīdào le.
examples.example_translation: Everyone already knows the content of this notice.

examples.example_chinese: 通知上说得清清楚楚，12号开始上课。
examples.example_pinyin: Tōngzhī shàng shuō de qīngqīngchǔchǔ, shí'èr hào kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.example_translation: The notice clearly states that classes start on the 12th.

examples.example_chinese: 我没接到公司任何形式的通知。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi jiēdào gōngsī rènhé xíngshì de tōngzhī.
examples.example_translation: I haven't received any form of notice from the company.

examples.example_chinese: 因为时间无需通知我们
examples.example_pinyin: yīn wèi shí jiān wú xū tōng zhī wǒ men

meaning: n.儿童时期，幼年 · childhood

examples.example_chinese: 我的童年是快乐的。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de tóngnián shì kuàilè de.
examples.example_translation: My childhood was happy.

examples.example_chinese: 他常常回忆自己的童年。
examples.example_pinyin: tā chángcháng huíyì zìjǐ de tóngnián.
examples.example_translation: He often recalls his childhood.

examples.example_chinese: 童年的经历对一个人有很大的影响。
examples.example_pinyin: tóngnián de jīnglì duì yīgè rén yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: Childhood experiences have a great influence on a person.

meaning: v.把预定时间向后改动 · postpone, defer, delay, put off

examples.example_chinese: 会议往后推迟了一天。
examples.example_pinyin: Huìyì wǎng hòu tuīchíle yì tiān.
examples.example_translation: The meeting was postponed by one day.

examples.example_chinese: 比赛日期已经推迟过两次了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bǐsài rìqī yǐjīng tuīchíguò liǎng cì le.
examples.example_translation: The date of the competition has already been postponed twice.

examples.example_chinese: 他们的结婚日期推迟了，具体什么时候还不知道。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen de jiéhūn rìqī tuīchí le, jùtǐ shénme shíhou hái bù zhīdào.
examples.example_translation: Their wedding date has been postponed, but the exact time is still unknown.

examples.example_chinese: 飞机可能推迟到达一个小时。
examples.example_pinyin: Fēijī kěnéng tuīchí dào dé yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.example_translation: The plane may be delayed by an hour.

examples.example_chinese: 别再推迟了，我们都等不及了。
examples.example_pinyin: Bié zài tuīchí le, wǒmen dōu děng bù jí le.
examples.example_translation: Don't postpone it any longer, we can't wait anymore.

meaning: n.一种套在脚上的丝、线等织品 · socks, stockings

examples.example_chinese: 我买了一双棉袜子。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yì shuāng mián wàzi.
examples.example_translation: I bought a pair of cotton socks.

examples.example_chinese: 这两双袜子都破了，该买几双新的了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng shuāng wàzi dōu pò le, gāi mǎi jǐ shuāng xīn de le.
examples.example_translation: Both pairs of socks are worn out, it's time to buy some new ones.

examples.example_chinese: 快把袜子脱了，洗洗吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuài bǎ wàzi tuō le, xǐxǐ ba.
examples.example_translation: Take off your socks and wash them.

examples.example_chinese: 他不喜欢穿袜子，常常光着脚穿鞋。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan chuān wàzi, chángcháng guāngzhe jiǎo chuān xié.
examples.example_translation: He doesn't like wearing socks and often wears shoes barefoot.

examples.example_chinese: 他不敢脱鞋，怕露出破袜子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù gǎn tuō xié, pà lòuchū pò wàzi.
examples.example_translation: He doesn't dare take off his shoes for fear of revealing his worn-out socks.

meaning: v.取下, 除去 · take off, cast off

examples.example_chinese: 你觉得热，就把大衣脱了吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ juéde rè, jiù bǎ dàyī tuō le ba.
examples.example_translation: If you feel hot, just take off your coat.

examples.example_chinese: 他脱下鞋，轻轻走了过去。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tuōxia xié, qīngqīng zǒule guòqu.
examples.example_translation: He took off his shoes and walked over quietly.

examples.example_chinese: 你怎么进屋不脱鞋啊？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zěnme jìn wū bù tuō xié a?
examples.example_translation: Why did you enter the room without taking off your shoes?

examples.example_chinese: 她把丈夫脱下来的衣服都洗了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zhàngfu tuō xiàlái de yīfu dōu xǐ le.
examples.example_translation: She washed all the clothes her husband took off.

examples.example_chinese: 正当我准备脱衣服洗澡的时候，她来电话了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèngdāng wǒ zhǔnbèi tuō yīfu xǐzǎo de shíhou, tā lái diànhuà le.
examples.example_translation: Just as I was about to take off my clothes to shower, she called.

meaning: v.想办法得到 · attempt to obtain something

examples.example_chinese: 你帮我弄点儿热水来吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bāng wǒ nòng diǎnr rè shuǐ lái ba.
examples.example_translation: Help me get some hot water, please.

examples.example_chinese: 我弄来了两张演出票，我们一起去看怎么样？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ nònglái le liǎng zhāng yǎnchū piào, wǒmen yīqǐ qù kàn zěnmeyàng?
examples.example_translation: I got two tickets for the show, how about we go together?

examples.example_chinese: 这么宝贵的资料，你是怎么弄到的？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème bǎoguì de zīliào, nǐ shì zěnme nòngdào de?
examples.example_translation: How did you manage to get such valuable information?

examples.example_chinese: 你去弄几瓶啤酒来。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ qù nòng jǐ píng píjiǔ lái.
examples.example_translation: Go get a few bottles of beer.

examples.example_chinese: 蚂蚱飞起来会咯咯作响，不知道它是怎么弄出这种声音的。
examples.example_pinyin: fēi lái huì zuò xiǎng bù zhī dào tā shì zěn me nòng chū zhè zhǒng shēng de

meaning: adv.表示经过种种变化或曲折最后出现某种结果 · at last, eventually, finally

examples.example_chinese: 问题到底得到了解决。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèntí dàodǐ dédàole jiějué.
examples.example_translation: The problem was finally solved.

examples.example_chinese: 他们到底还是拿到了冠军。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen dàodǐ háishi ná dàole guànjūn.
examples.example_translation: They finally won the championship after all.

examples.example_chinese: 我到底也不知道他的名字。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dàodǐ yě bù zhīdào tā de míngzi.
examples.example_translation: I still don't know his name after all.

examples.example_chinese: 虽然他不太愿意，但到底还是答应了。
examples.example_pinyin: Suīrán tā bú tài yuànyì, dàn dàodǐ háishi dāyìng le.
examples.example_translation: Although he was not very willing, he agreed in the end.

examples.example_chinese: 这辈子到底有什么意义
examples.example_pinyin: zhè bèi zi dào dǐ yǒu shén me yìyì

meaning: adv.毕竟 · after all , when all is said and done

examples.example_chinese: 到底是北方，夏天就是比南方凉快。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàodǐ shì běifāng, xiàtiān jiù shì bǐ nánfāng liángkuai.
examples.example_translation: After all, it's the north; summer is indeed cooler than in the south.

examples.example_chinese: 到底是年轻人，熬了一宿也没怎么样。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàodǐ shì niánqīngrén, áole yì xiǔ yě méi zěnmeyàng.
examples.example_translation: After all, he is young; staying up all night didn't affect him much.

examples.example_chinese: 我们到底才来中国半年多，说不好汉语也正常。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen dàodǐ cái lái Zhōngguó bàn nián duō, shuō bu hǎo Hànyǔ yě zhèngcháng.
examples.example_translation: After all, we've only been in China for just over half a year, so it's normal not to speak Chinese well.

examples.example_chinese: 北京到底是北京，跟一般的城市就是不一样。
examples.example_pinyin: Běijīng dàodǐ shì Běijīng, gēn yìbān de chéngshì jiù shì bù yíyàng.
examples.example_translation: After all, Beijing is Beijing; it's just different from other cities.

meaning: v.用车运送 · transport (by vehicle)

examples.example_chinese: 你把我拉到火车站吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bǎ wǒ lādao huǒchēzhàn ba.
examples.example_translation: Please give me a ride to the train station.

examples.example_chinese: 我搬家时，这些东西总共拉了三车。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bānjiā shí, zhèxiē dōngxi zǒnggòng lāle sān chē.
examples.example_translation: When I moved, all these things took three truckloads.

examples.example_chinese: 我找了辆出租车，把电脑拉过来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole liàng chūzūchē, bǎ diànnǎo lā guòlai le.
examples.example_translation: I found a taxi and brought the computer over.

examples.example_chinese: 东西太多，还得再拉一趟。
examples.example_pinyin: Dōngxi tài duō, hái děi zài lā yí tàng.
examples.example_translation: There are too many things, we need to make another trip.

examples.example_chinese: 据说给它套上一辆泥制的小车，它拉着就走。
examples.example_pinyin: jù shuō gěi tā tào shàng yī liàng ní de xiǎo tā lā zhe jiù zǒu

meaning: v.没有（跟“有”相对） · not have (as opposed to “有 have”)

examples.example_chinese: 不要相信这些无根据的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Bùyào xiāngxìn zhèxiē wú gēnjù de huà.
examples.example_translation: Don't believe these groundless words.

examples.example_chinese: 他进去一看，房间里并无一人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jìnqù yí kàn, fángjiān lǐ bìng wú yī rén.
examples.example_translation: He went in and saw that there was not a single person in the room.

examples.example_chinese: 他无正当职业，常常去酒吧喝酒。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wú zhèngdàng zhíyè, chángcháng qù jiǔbā hē jiǔ.
examples.example_translation: He has no proper job and often goes to bars to drink.

examples.example_chinese: 老人无儿无女，现在一个人生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎorén wú ér wú nǚ, xiànzài yí ge rén shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: The old man has no children and now lives alone.

examples.example_chinese: 我向你保证，绝无此事。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàng nǐ bǎozhèng, jué wú cǐ shì.
examples.example_translation: I assure you, there is absolutely no such thing.

meaning: n.经过推论或评论后做出的决定 · judgment

examples.example_chinese: 这个判断如果是错误的，我们将面临很大麻烦。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège pànduàn rúguǒ shì cuòwù de, wǒmen jiāng miànlín hěn dà máfan.
examples.example_translation: If this judgment is wrong, we will face great trouble.

examples.example_chinese: 对这件事，大家都有了一个基本判断。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì zhè jiàn shì, dàjiā dōu yǒule yī gè jīběn pànduàn.
examples.example_translation: Everyone has made a basic judgment about this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 这是我个人的判断，不一定准确。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ gèrén de pànduàn, bù yīdìng zhǔnquè.
examples.example_translation: This is my personal judgment, it may not be accurate.

examples.example_chinese: 他每次对胜负的判断都很正确。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi cì duì shèngfù de pànduàn dōu hěn zhèngquè.
examples.example_translation: His judgment about victory or defeat is always correct.

examples.example_chinese: 2010年南非世界杯，章鱼对几场重要比赛的判断都精确无误。
examples.example_pinyin: Èr líng yī líng nián Nánfēi Shìjièbēi, zhāngyú duì jǐ chǎng zhòngyào bǐsài de pànduàn dōu jīngquè wúwù.
examples.example_translation: In the 2010 South Africa World Cup, the octopus’s judgments about several important matches were all accurate.

meaning: adj.由于清闲而烦闷 · (feel) bored for being idle

examples.example_chinese: 他喜欢紧张地工作，不习惯无聊的日子。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan jǐnzhāng de gōngzuò, bù xíguàn wúliáo de rìzi.
examples.example_translation: He likes working under pressure and is not used to idle days.

examples.example_chinese: 她离婚后，觉得生活有些无聊。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā líhūn hòu, juéde shēnghuó yǒuxiē wúliáo.
examples.example_translation: After her divorce, she felt life was a bit boring.

examples.example_chinese: 我无聊地等待着他回来。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wúliáo de děngdàizhe tā huílái.
examples.example_translation: I waited for him to come back, feeling bored.

examples.example_chinese: 他无聊的时候，就上网玩儿游戏。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wúliáo de shíhou, jiù shàngwǎng wánr yóuxì.
examples.example_translation: When he is bored, he goes online to play games.

examples.example_chinese: 看似无聊的小事
examples.example_pinyin: kànsì wú liáo de xiǎo shì

meaning: conj.表示在任何条件下情况都一样, 常与“都”呼应 · no matter what, how, etc., usually correlated with “都”

examples.example_chinese: 他无论做什么事都非常认真。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wúlùn zuò shénme shì dōu fēicháng rènzhēn.
examples.example_translation: No matter what he does, he is always very serious.

examples.example_chinese: 无论我说什么，他就是不听。
examples.example_pinyin: Wúlùn wǒ shuō shénme, tā jiù shì bù tīng.
examples.example_translation: No matter what I say, he just won't listen.

examples.example_chinese: 无论你是怎么想的，我都能理解。
examples.example_pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ shì zěnme xiǎng de, wǒ dōu néng lǐjiě.
examples.example_translation: No matter what you think, I can understand.

examples.example_chinese: 我们主张国家无论大小，一律平等。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔzhāng guójiā wúlùn dàxiǎo, yīlǜ píngděng.
examples.example_translation: We advocate that all countries, no matter their size, are equal.

examples.example_chinese: 人无论在什么时候
examples.example_pinyin: rén wú lùn zài shén me shí hou

meaning: v.误解对方的意思 · misunderstand

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，我误会了你的意思。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wùhuìle nǐ de yìsi.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, I misunderstood what you meant.

examples.example_chinese: 你完全误会了，我说的不是那件事。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ wánquán wùhuì le, wǒ shuō de bú shì nà jiàn shì.
examples.example_translation: You completely misunderstood, I wasn't talking about that.

examples.example_chinese: 我没有听清他的话，以致误会了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu tīngqīng tā de huà, yǐzhì wùhuìle tā.
examples.example_translation: I didn't hear him clearly, so I misunderstood him.

examples.example_chinese: 再这样误会，他们非离婚不可。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhèyàng wùhuì, tāmen fēi líhūn bù kě.
examples.example_translation: If this misunderstanding continues, they will have to divorce.

examples.example_chinese: 我感觉他们误会得很深，不容易和解。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué tāmen wùhuì de hěn shēn, bù róngyì héjiě.
examples.example_translation: I feel their misunderstanding is deep and not easy to resolve.

meaning: v.把别的物体、力量或别人的注意力引到自己这方面来 · attract, draw

examples.example_chinese: 她的打扮吸引了很多人的注意。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de dǎbàn xīyǐnle hěn duō rén de zhùyì.
examples.example_translation: Her outfit attracted a lot of attention.

examples.example_chinese: 他长得又高又帅，很吸引女同学。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhǎng de yòu gāo yòu shuài, hěn xīyǐn nǚ tóngxué.
examples.example_translation: He is tall and handsome, which attracts many female classmates.

examples.example_chinese: 这里的名胜古迹吸引了很多中外游客。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli de míngshèng gǔjì xīyǐnle hěn duō zhōngwài yóukè.
examples.example_translation: The famous scenic spots here attract many tourists from home and abroad.

examples.example_chinese: 游戏开始了，很多孩子都被吸引过来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Yóuxì kāishǐ le, hěn duō háizi dōu bèi xīyǐn guòlai le.
examples.example_translation: The game started, and many children were drawn over.

examples.example_chinese: 我被这场球赛深深地吸引住了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bèi zhè chǎng qiúsài shēnshēn de xīyǐn zhù le.
examples.example_translation: I was deeply attracted by this ball game.

meaning: adj.细小，不粗 · thin, slender, fine

examples.example_chinese: 她用一根很细的线把扣子缝好了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yòng yì gēn hěn xì de xiàn bǎ kòuzi féng hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: She sewed the button on with a very fine thread.

examples.example_chinese: 这支笔的笔尖很细，可以写出很小的字。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhī bǐ de bǐjiān hěn xì, kěyǐ xiě chū hěn xiǎo de zì.
examples.example_translation: The tip of this pen is very fine, so it can write very small characters.

examples.example_chinese: 小河里的水很浅，只有几条细细的水流。
examples.example_pinyin: xiǎo hé lǐ de shuǐ hěn qiǎn, zhǐ yǒu jǐ tiáo xì xì de shuǐliú.
examples.example_translation: The water in the small river is very shallow, with only a few thin streams flowing through it.

examples.example_chinese: 我一步一步小心地走着，一片一片仔细地数着。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ yī bù yī bù xiǎo xīn de zǒu zhe yī piàn yī piàn zǐ xì de shǔ zhe

meaning: v.做梦 · dream, have a dream

examples.example_chinese: 昨晚上我又梦见大学同学了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ yòu mèngjiàn dàxué tóngxué le.
examples.example_translation: Last night I dreamed of my college classmates again.

examples.example_chinese: 我梦见自己登上月球了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mèngjiàn zìjǐ dēngshàng yuèqiú le.
examples.example_translation: I dreamed that I landed on the moon.

examples.example_chinese: 我梦到自己打破了世界纪录。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ mèngdào zìjǐ dǎpòle shìjiè jìlù.
examples.example_translation: I dreamed that I broke the world record.

meaning: adj.新鲜 · fresh

examples.example_chinese: 这家超市每天早上都会卖很鲜的水果和蔬菜。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiā chāoshì měitiān zǎoshang dū huì mài hěn xiān de shuǐguǒ hé shūcài.
examples.example_translation: This supermarket sells very fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.

examples.example_chinese: 刚从河里打上来的鱼很鲜，做成汤特别好喝。
examples.example_pinyin: gāng cóng hé lǐ dǎ shànglái de yú hěn xiān, zuò chéng tāng tèbié hǎo hē.
examples.example_translation: The fish just caught from the river is very fresh, and it tastes especially good when made into soup.

examples.example_chinese: 我们到了海边以后，尝到了许多很鲜的海鲜。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen dào le hǎibiān yǐhòu, cháng dào le xǔduō hěn xiān de hǎixiān.
examples.example_translation: After we arrived at the seaside, we tasted a lot of very fresh seafood.

meaning: adj.像盐那样的味道 · salted, salty

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜做得太咸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài zuò de tài xián le.
examples.example_translation: This dish is too salty.

examples.example_chinese: 这种面包有两种口味：甜的和咸的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng miànbāo yǒu liǎng zhǒng kǒuwèi: tián de hé xián de.
examples.example_translation: This kind of bread has two flavors: sweet and salty.

examples.example_chinese: 北方人吃得比较咸，南方人吃得比较辣。
examples.example_pinyin: Běifāng rén chī de bǐjiào xián, nánfāng rén chī de bǐjiào là.
examples.example_translation: People in the north eat saltier food, while people in the south eat spicier food.

examples.example_chinese: 菜咸一点儿没关系，我的口味重。
examples.example_pinyin: Cài xián yìdiǎnr méi guānxi, wǒ de kǒuwèi zhòng.
examples.example_translation: It's okay if the dish is a bit salty, I like strong flavors.

examples.example_chinese: 你觉得这个汤咸不咸？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège tāng xián bu xián?
examples.example_translation: Do you think this soup is salty?

meaning: adj.事物的两个方面相互矛盾、互相排斥 · contrary, opposite

examples.example_chinese: 我的看法正好与你相反。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de kànfǎ zhènghǎo yǔ nǐ xiāngfǎn.
examples.example_translation: My opinion is exactly the opposite of yours.

examples.example_chinese: 对于这个问题，我听到了两种完全相反的意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí, wǒ tīngdào le liǎng zhǒng wánquán xiāngfǎn de yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: Regarding this issue, I heard two completely opposite opinions.

examples.example_chinese: 事情正朝着相反的方向发展。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìqíng zhèng cháozhe xiāngfǎn de fāngxiàng fāzhǎn.
examples.example_translation: Things are developing in the opposite direction.

examples.example_chinese: 他不但不生气，相反还显得很高兴。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bùdàn bù shēngqì, xiāngfǎn hái xiǎnde hěn gāoxìng.
examples.example_translation: Not only was he not angry, on the contrary, he seemed very happy.

examples.example_chinese: 那段书叫方弼方相反昭歌
examples.example_pinyin: nà duàn shū jiào fāng bì fāng xiāng fǎn zhāo gē

meaning: cl.用于分项目的事物 · used for itemized things

examples.example_chinese: 领导交给了我们一项重要的任务。
examples.example_pinyin: lǐngdǎo jiāo gěi le wǒmen yī xiàng zhòngyào de rènwu.
examples.example_translation: The leader assigned us an important task.

examples.example_chinese: 老师给学生们布置了两项作业,要求明天完成。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī gěi xuéshēngmen bùliàng le liǎng xiàng zuòyè, yāoqiú míngtiān wánchéng.
examples.example_translation: The teacher assigned two assignments to the students, to be completed by tomorrow.

examples.example_chinese: 我相信他能做好这项工作。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn tā néng zuò hǎo zhè xiàng gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: I believe he can do this job well.

examples.example_chinese: 我很喜欢打篮球这项体育运动。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú zhè xiàng tǐyù yùndòng.
examples.example_translation: I really like playing basketball, this sport.

examples.example_chinese: 报名表上的每一项都要认真填写。
examples.example_pinyin: bàomíng biǎo shàng de měi yī xiàng dōu yào rènzhēn tiánxiě.
examples.example_translation: Every item on the registration form must be filled out carefully.

meaning: n.指卖的包子、馄饨、元宵等一些小食品 · snacks

examples.example_chinese: 这个饭馆有各种各样的小吃。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège fànguǎn yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de xiǎochī.
examples.example_translation: This restaurant has all kinds of snacks.

examples.example_chinese: 学校里面有两个小吃店,味道都不错。
examples.example_pinyin: xuéxiào lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng ge xiǎochī diàn, wèidào dōu búcuò.
examples.example_translation: There are two snack shops in the school, and both taste good.

examples.example_chinese: 我们来点儿小吃就可以了,又便宜又好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen lái diǎnr xiǎochī jiù kěyǐ le, yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: Let's just have some snacks, they're cheap and tasty.

examples.example_chinese: 他买了很多当地的小吃带回去。
examples.example_pinyin: tā mǎi le hěn duō dāngdì de xiǎochī dài huíqù.
examples.example_translation: He bought a lot of local snacks to take back.

meaning: n.口语中对青年男子的称呼 · young man, young lad

examples.example_chinese: 这小伙子长得很帅。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè xiǎohuǒzi zhǎng de hěn shuài.
examples.example_translation: This young man is very handsome.

examples.example_chinese: 我们公司的小伙子都喜欢她。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen gōngsī de xiǎohuǒzi dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.example_translation: All the young men in our company like her.

examples.example_chinese: 来搬家的是一群20来岁的小伙子。
examples.example_pinyin: lái bānjiā de shì yī qún èrshí lái suì de xiǎohuǒzi.
examples.example_translation: The ones who came to help move were a group of young men in their twenties.

examples.example_chinese: 这小伙子特别能干,很快就当上了经理。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè xiǎohuǒzi tèbié nénggàn, hěn kuài jiù dāng shàng le jīnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: This young man is especially capable and soon became a manager.

examples.example_chinese: 哎哟这仨小伙子一个蹬着风火轮
examples.example_pinyin: āi yō zhè sā xiǎo huǒ zi yí gè dēng zhe fēng huǒ lún

meaning: adj.心情非常激动；振奋 · excited and cheerful

examples.example_chinese: 听到这个好消息，她非常兴奋。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, tā fēicháng xīngfèn.
examples.example_translation: She was very excited to hear this good news.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天当上了经理，兴奋得晚上没睡好觉。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān dāngshàngle jīnglǐ, xīngfèn de wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo jiào.
examples.example_translation: He became a manager today and was so excited that he couldn't sleep well at night.

examples.example_chinese: 多年的愿望实现了，他能不兴奋吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Duō nián de yuànwàng shíxiàn le, tā néng bù xīngfèn ma?
examples.example_translation: His wish of many years has come true, how could he not be excited?

examples.example_chinese: 来到北京，他怀着兴奋的心情下了飞机。
examples.example_pinyin: Láidào Běijīng, tā huáizhe xīngfèn de xīnqíng xiàle fēijī.
examples.example_translation: Arriving in Beijing, he got off the plane with excitement.

examples.example_chinese: 看他那兴奋的样子，就知道他遇到了高兴的事。
examples.example_pinyin: Kàn tā nà xīngfèn de yàngzi, jiù zhīdào tā yùdàole gāoxìng de shì.
examples.example_translation: Seeing how excited he looks, you know he has encountered something happy.

meaning: cl.用于报刊、文件等 · (of newpapers, periodicals, documents, etc.) copy

examples.example_chinese: 这份报纸是我刚买的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fèn bàozhǐ shì wǒ gāng mǎi de.
examples.example_translation: This newspaper is the one I just bought.

examples.example_chinese: 这份材料很重要，别弄丢了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fèn cáiliào hěn zhòngyào, bié nòngdiū le.
examples.example_translation: This document is very important, don’t lose it.

examples.example_chinese: 老师给了我一份学生名单。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī gěile wǒ yí fèn xuéshēng míngdān.
examples.example_translation: The teacher gave me a copy of the student list.

examples.example_chinese: 也有你们的份。
examples.example_pinyin: yě yǒu nǐ men de fèn

examples.example_chinese: 看在好朋友的份上
examples.example_pinyin: kàn zài hǎo péng you de fèn shàng

meaning: v.睡眠状态结束，也指尚未入睡 · be awake, wake up

examples.example_chinese: 我每天早上五点就醒了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù xǐng le.
examples.example_translation: I wake up at five o'clock every morning.

examples.example_chinese: 我醒来一看，才夜里两点多。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐnglái yí kàn, cái yè lǐ liǎng diǎn duō.
examples.example_translation: When I woke up and looked, it was just after two in the morning.

examples.example_chinese: 你是什么时候醒的？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ shì shénme shíhou xǐng de?
examples.example_translation: When did you wake up?

examples.example_chinese: 我刚睡着，手机就把我吵醒了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gāng shuìzháo, shǒujī jiù bǎ wǒ chǎoxǐng le.
examples.example_translation: I had just fallen asleep when my phone woke me up.

examples.example_chinese: 他一直醒着，直到十二点以后才睡着。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yìzhí xǐngzhe, zhídào shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái shuìzháo.
examples.example_translation: He stayed awake until after twelve before falling asleep.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子睡熟了，两个小时之内是醒不了的。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi shuìshú le, liǎng ge xiǎoshí zhī nèi shì xǐng bu liǎo de.
examples.example_translation: Once the child is sound asleep, he won't wake up within two hours.

meaning: n.哥哥和弟弟 · brothers, brotherhood

examples.example_chinese: 他们俩是兄弟。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen liǎ shì xiōngdì.
examples.example_translation: They are brothers.

examples.example_chinese: 我们兄弟三个性格完全不同。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen xiōngdì sān gè xìnggé wánquán bùtóng.
examples.example_translation: The three of us brothers have completely different personalities.

examples.example_chinese: 兄弟俩从小生活在一起，感情很深。
examples.example_pinyin: xiōngdì liǎ cóng xiǎo shēnghuó zài yīqǐ, gǎnqíng hěn shēn.
examples.example_translation: The two brothers have lived together since childhood and have a deep bond.

examples.example_chinese: 他没有兄弟，只有一个姐姐。
examples.example_pinyin: tā méiyǒu xiōngdì, zhǐ yǒu yí gè jiějie.
examples.example_translation: He has no brothers, only one elder sister.

examples.example_chinese: 他们的关系像兄弟一样亲密。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen de guānxì xiàng xiōngdì yīyàng qīnmì.
examples.example_translation: Their relationship is as close as that of brothers.

meaning: v.经过加工，使损坏的东西能重新使用 · to repair, to fix, to mend

examples.example_chinese: 我的手表坏了，需要修理。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de shǒubiǎo huài le, xūyào xiūlǐ.
examples.example_translation: My watch is broken and needs to be repaired.

examples.example_chinese: 他正在修理汽车。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiūlǐ qìchē.
examples.example_translation: He is repairing the car.

examples.example_chinese: 这台电脑修理一下还能用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo xiūlǐ yīxià hái néng yòng.
examples.example_translation: This computer can still be used after being repaired.

examples.example_chinese: 你知道哪儿可以修理手表吗?
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ zhīdào nǎ'er kěyǐ xiūlǐ shǒubiǎo ma?
examples.example_translation: Do you know where I can get my watch repaired?

examples.example_chinese: 他的自行车坏了，送去修理了。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de zìxíngchē huàile, sòng qù xiūlǐle.
examples.example_translation: His bicycle broke and was sent for repair.

examples.example_chinese: 他在汽车修理厂工作。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài qìchē xiūlǐ chǎng gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: He works at a car repair shop.

examples.example_chinese: 我会修理电脑，电脑有什么问题可以找我。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ huì xiūlǐ diànnǎo, diànnǎo yǒu shé me wèntí kěyǐ zhǎo wǒ.
examples.example_translation: I can repair computers, so you can come to me if you have any computer problems.

examples.example_chinese: 师傅，能帮我修理一下自行车?
examples.example_pinyin: shīfù, néng bāng wǒ xiūlǐ yīxià zìxíngchē?
examples.example_translation: Master, can you help me fix my bicycle?

examples.example_chinese: 他的修理技术很好，而且收费不高。
examples.example_pinyin: tā de xiūlǐ jìshù hěn hǎo, érqiě shōufèi bù gāo.
examples.example_translation: His repair skills are very good, and his fees are not high.

meaning: adj.不灵巧, 不灵活 · clumsy, awkward

examples.example_chinese: 我嘴笨，不会说好听的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuì bèn, bú huì shuō hǎotīng de huà.
examples.example_translation: I’m clumsy with words and can't say pleasant things.

examples.example_chinese: 他手笨得很，打字特别慢。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shǒu bèn de hěn, dǎzì tèbié màn.
examples.example_translation: He is very clumsy with his hands and types extremely slowly.

examples.example_chinese: 他太胖了，走路显得很笨。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tài pàng le, zǒulù xiǎnde hěn bèn.
examples.example_translation: He is too fat and looks clumsy when walking.

examples.example_chinese: 安德烈·纪德在《窄门》讲道,我爱你,所以显得笨,所以显得笨拙。
examples.example_pinyin: ān dé liè jì dé zài zhǎi mén jiǎng dào wǒ ài nǐ suǒyǐ xiǎnde bèn suǒyǐ xiǎnde bènzhuō

examples.example_chinese: 我的善良不是笨
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de shànliáng bú shì bèn

meaning: adv.表示理所当然 · of course, naturally

examples.example_chinese: 学生本来就应该好好儿学习。
examples.example_pinyin: Xuéshēng běnlái jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: Students are supposed to study hard by nature.

examples.example_chinese: 你本来就应该说实话。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ běnlái jiù yīnggāi shuō shíhuà.
examples.example_translation: You are supposed to tell the truth naturally.

examples.example_chinese: 你本来就应该出去玩儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ běnlái jiù yīnggāi chūqù wánr.
examples.example_translation: You were supposed to go out and have fun.

examples.example_chinese: 你本来就应该听老师的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ běnlái jiù yīnggāi tīng lǎoshī de huà.
examples.example_translation: You should naturally listen to the teacher.

meaning: adj.做事情时很认真，也指坚决按规定执行 · strict

examples.example_chinese: 他是一位很严格的教授。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi hěn yángé de jiàoshòu.
examples.example_translation: He is a very strict professor.

examples.example_chinese: 公司有严格的制度，我们都不敢请假。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī yǒu yángé de zhìdù, wǒmen dōu bù gǎn qǐngjià.
examples.example_translation: The company has strict rules, so none of us dare to ask for leave.

examples.example_chinese: 他在学问上对我们要求很严格，但在生活上对我们很关心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài xuéwèn shang duì wǒmen yāoqiú hěn yángé, dàn zài shēnghuó shang duì wǒmen hěn guānxīn.
examples.example_translation: He is very strict with us academically, but cares a lot about us in life.

examples.example_chinese: 在学习上他总是严格要求自己，不放过任何问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài xuéxí shang tā zǒngshì yángé yāoqiú zìjǐ, bú fàngguò rènhé wèntí.
examples.example_translation: He is always strict with himself in his studies and never lets any problem slip by.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事要严格按照规定办。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yào yángé ànzhào guīdìng bàn.
examples.example_translation: This matter must be handled strictly according to the regulations.

meaning: adv.表示在所说的范围之外 · besides, in addition

examples.example_chinese: 今天太晚了，我们另外找时间谈吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān tài wǎn le, wǒmen lìngwài zhǎo shíjiān tán ba.
examples.example_translation: It's too late today, let's find another time to talk.

examples.example_chinese: 我另外安排了一个房间给你住。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ lìngwài ānpái le yí ge fángjiān gěi nǐ zhù.
examples.example_translation: I have arranged another room for you to stay in.

examples.example_chinese: 这个办法领导不同意，你另外想想别的办法吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ lǐngdǎo bù tóngyì, nǐ lìngwài xiǎngxiang bié de bànfǎ ba.
examples.example_translation: The leader doesn't agree with this method, think of another way.

examples.example_chinese: 我说完以后，他另外又补充了一些意见。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shuōwán yǐhòu, tā lìngwài yòu bǔchōngle yìxiē yìjiàn.
examples.example_translation: After I finished speaking, he added some more comments.

examples.example_chinese: 去过自己另外的生活
examples.example_pinyin: qù guò zì jǐ lìng wài de shēng huó

meaning: adj.程度深, 影响大, 情况急 · serious, grave

examples.example_chinese: 她的病很严重，需要马上送医院。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de bìng hěn yánzhòng, xūyào mǎshàng sòng yīyuàn.
examples.example_translation: Her illness is very serious and she needs to be taken to the hospital immediately.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一场严重的交通事故，有很多人伤亡。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yí cì yánzhòng de jiāotōng shìgù, yǒu hěn duō rén shāngwáng.
examples.example_translation: This is a serious traffic accident with many casualties.

examples.example_chinese: 地震对当地经济产生了严重的影响。
examples.example_pinyin: Dìzhèn duì dāngdì jīngjì chǎnshēngle yánzhòng de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: The earthquake had a serious impact on the local economy.

examples.example_chinese: 他的做法严重伤害了我们的感情。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de zuòfǎ yánzhòng shānghàile wǒmen de gǎnqíng.
examples.example_translation: His actions seriously hurt our feelings.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要把问题说得太严重了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bùyào bǎ wèntí shuō de tài yánzhòng le.
examples.example_translation: Don't make the problem sound too serious.

meaning: v.探求事物的性质、规律等, 商讨 · to research, to study, to discuss

examples.example_chinese: 科学家们在研究这一课题。
examples.example_pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zài yánjiū zhè yī kètí.
examples.example_translation: The scientists are researching this topic.

examples.example_chinese: 我们应该研究怎么解决这个问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yánjiū zěnme jiějué zhège wèntí.
examples.example_translation: We should discuss how to solve this problem.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事情，我们得好好研究研究。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo yánjiū yánjiū.
examples.example_translation: We need to carefully study this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 这个费仲专门研究溜须传
examples.example_pinyin: zhè ge fèi zhòng zhuān mén yán jiū liū xū chuán

examples.example_chinese: 这尤浑专门研究拍马经
examples.example_pinyin: zhè yóu hún zhuān mén yán jiū pāi mǎ jīng

meaning: n.大学毕业后获得硕士、博士学位的人 · postgraduate

examples.example_chinese: 我毕业后还想读研究生。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bìyè hòu hái xiǎng dú yánjiūshēng.
examples.example_translation: I still want to pursue postgraduate studies after graduation.

examples.example_chinese: 他考上了北京大学的研究生。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kǎoshàngle Běijīng Dàxué de yánjiūshēng.
examples.example_translation: He was admitted as a postgraduate student at Peking University.

examples.example_chinese: 我弟弟现在是法学博士研究生。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xiànzài shì fǎxué bóshì yánjiūshēng.
examples.example_translation: My younger brother is now a doctoral candidate in law.

examples.example_chinese: 王教授的研究生们帮他完成这项工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu de yánjiūshēngmen bāng tā wánchéng zhè xiàng gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: Professor Wang's postgraduate students helped him complete this project.

examples.example_chinese: 上了研究生
examples.example_pinyin: shàng le yánjiūshēng
examples.example_translation: Pursued graduate studies

meaning: n.使食物有咸味的东西 · salt

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜盐放多了，很咸。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài yán fàng duō le, hěn xián.
examples.example_translation: There is too much salt in this dish; it's very salty.

examples.example_chinese: 你每天不要吃太多的盐。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān bùyào chī tài duō de yán.
examples.example_translation: You shouldn't eat too much salt every day.

examples.example_chinese: 这个菜忘了放盐，什么味儿也没有。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège cài wàngle fàng yán, shénme wèi er yě méiyǒu.
examples.example_translation: This dish has no taste because it was made without salt.

examples.example_chinese: 家里没盐了，你去买两袋吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Jiālǐ méi yán le, nǐ qù mǎi liǎng dài ba.
examples.example_translation: We're out of salt at home, go buy two bags.

examples.example_chinese: 朋友就是盐
examples.example_pinyin: péng you jiù shì yán

meaning: n.戴在眼睛上矫正视力或保护眼睛的透镜 · glasses

examples.example_chinese: 他很小就近视了，戴上了眼镜。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎo jiù jìnshì le, dàishangle yǎnjìng.
examples.example_translation: He became near-sighted and wore glasses when he was a little boy.

examples.example_chinese: 你别压坏了我的眼镜。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bié yāhuàile wǒ de yǎnjìng.
examples.example_translation: Don’t crush my glasses.

examples.example_chinese: 她眼睛不大，戴着一副眼镜。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǎnjing bú dà, dàizhe yī fù yǎnjìng.
examples.example_translation: She has small eyes and wears a pair of glasses.

examples.example_chinese: 他摘了眼镜什么都看不清楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhāile yǎnjìng shénme dōu kàn bu qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: He cannot see anything clearly without glasses.

examples.example_chinese: 我这副眼镜是500度的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhè fù yǎnjìng shì 500 dù de.
examples.example_translation: The strength of my glasses is 500 degrees.

meaning: v.使形成某种习惯、作风等 · develop, cultivate

examples.example_chinese: 他养成了爱看书的好习惯。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǎngchéngle ài kàn shū de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.example_translation: He has developed a good habit of loving to read books.

examples.example_chinese: 他的这种坏习惯不是一天养成的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de zhè zhǒng huài xíguàn bú shì yī tiān yǎngchéng de.
examples.example_translation: This bad habit of his was not developed in a day.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子养成一种勤劳的作风，对今后的成长很有好处。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi yǎngchéng yī zhǒng qínláo de zuòfēng, duì jīnhòu de chéngzhǎng hěn yǒu hǎochù.
examples.example_translation: It is very beneficial for children to develop a hardworking attitude for their future growth.

examples.example_chinese: 你这种坏毛病是什么时候养成的？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhè zhǒng huài máobìng shì shénme shíhòu yǎngchéng de?
examples.example_translation: When did you develop this bad habit?

examples.example_chinese: 好的生活习惯是从小逐渐养成的。
examples.example_pinyin: Hǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn shì cóngxiǎo zhújiàn yǎngchéng de.
examples.example_translation: Good living habits are gradually developed from childhood.

meaning: n.植物的营养器官之一，叶的通称 · leaf

examples.example_chinese: 秋天到了，树上的叶子开始变黄了。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiūtiān dào le, shù shang de yèzi kāishǐ biàn huáng le.
examples.example_translation: Autumn has arrived, and the leaves on the trees have started to turn yellow.

examples.example_chinese: 她从树上摘了一片叶子夹在书里。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā cóng shù shang zhāile yí piàn yèzi jiā zài shū lǐ.
examples.example_translation: She picked a leaf from the tree and put it in her book.

examples.example_chinese: 这些菜不新鲜了，你看叶子都烂了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē cài bù xīnxiān le, nǐ kàn yèzi dōu làn le.
examples.example_translation: These vegetables are no longer fresh, look, the leaves are all rotten.

examples.example_chinese: 这棵树只剩下几片叶子了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kē shù zhǐ shèngxià jǐ piàn yèzi le.
examples.example_translation: There are only a few leaves left on this tree.

examples.example_chinese: 这两种树的叶子样子差不多。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng shù de yèzi yàngzi chàbuduō.
examples.example_translation: The leaves of these two kinds of trees look almost the same.

meaning: adv.原先, 先前 · originally, at first

examples.example_chinese: 他本来挺胖的，现在变瘦了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā běnlái tǐng pàng de, xiànzài biàn shòu le.
examples.example_translation: He used to be quite fat, but now he has become thin.

examples.example_chinese: 我本来不想参加这次活动，是他让我来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ běnlái bù xiǎng cānjiā zhè cì huódòng, shì tā ràng wǒ lái de.
examples.example_translation: I originally didn’t want to participate in this event; he asked me to come.

examples.example_chinese: 我们本来想去北京，后来改变了计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng qù Běijīng, hòulái gǎibiànle jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We originally planned to go to Beijing, but later changed our plan.

examples.example_chinese: 经理本来打算批评你的，后来原谅你了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ běnlái dǎsuàn pīpíng nǐ de, hòulái yuánliàng nǐ le.
examples.example_translation: The manager originally intended to criticize you but later forgave you.

examples.example_chinese: 世上最凄绝的事是两个人本来距离很远，
examples.example_pinyin: shì shàng zuì qī jué de shì shì liǎng gè rén běn lái jù lí hěn yuǎn

meaning: v.一种事物、现象等使另一种事物、现象等出现 · cause, arouse

examples.example_chinese: 这件事情引起了人们的注意。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng yǐnqǐle rénmen de zhùyì.
examples.example_translation: This matter has attracted people's attention.

examples.example_chinese: 你最近生病拉肚子就是由饮食习惯不好引起的。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn shēngbìng lā dùzi jiù shì yóu yǐnshí xíguàn bù hǎo yǐnqǐ de.
examples.example_translation: Your recent illness and diarrhea were caused by bad eating habits.

examples.example_chinese: 这个问题需要大家引起注意。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí xūyào dàjiā yǐnqǐ zhùyì.
examples.example_translation: This problem needs everyone's attention.

examples.example_chinese: 没想到这件事引起了严重的后果。
examples.example_pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào zhè jiàn shì yǐnqǐle yánzhòng de hòuguǒ.
examples.example_translation: I didn't expect this matter to cause serious consequences.

examples.example_chinese: 这些麻烦是我引起的，应该由我负责。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē máfan shì wǒ yǐnqǐ de, yīnggāi yóu wǒ fùzé.
examples.example_translation: These troubles were caused by me, so I should take responsibility.

meaning: adj.贫困, 阻碍多, 不好过 · difficult, hard

examples.example_chinese: 他家生活比较困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiā shēnghuó bǐjiào kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: His family life is relatively difficult.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天嗓子疼，说话都很困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān sāngzi téng, shuōhuà dōu hěn kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: His throat hurts today, it’s hard for him to speak.

examples.example_chinese: 学汉语对他说，不是一件困难的事。
examples.example_pinyin: Xué Hànyǔ duì tā lái shuō, bú shì yí jiàn kùnnan de shì.
examples.example_translation: Learning Chinese is not a difficult thing for him.

examples.example_chinese: 现在找工作变得困难起来。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài zhǎo gōngzuò biàn de kùnnan qǐlai.
examples.example_translation: It has become difficult to find a job now.

examples.example_chinese: 困难的时候已经过去了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kùnnan de shíhou yǐjīng guòqù le.
examples.example_translation: The difficult times are over.

meaning: adj.有胆量的, 不怕危险和困难的 · brave

examples.example_chinese: 他一个人登上了那座高山，非常勇敢。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yí ge rén dēngshangle nà zuò gāo shān, fēicháng yǒnggǎn.
examples.example_translation: He climbed that high mountain alone, very brave.

examples.example_chinese: 这支勇敢的军队取得了无数次胜利。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhī yǒnggǎn de jūnduì qǔdéle wúshù cì shènglì.
examples.example_translation: This brave army has won countless victories.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要勇敢地面对困难，战胜困难。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒnggǎn de miànduì kùnnan, zhànshèng kùnnan.
examples.example_translation: We must bravely face difficulties and overcome them.

examples.example_chinese: 他勇敢地承担起了这次事故的责任。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒnggǎn de chéngdān qǐ le zhè cì shìgù de zérèn.
examples.example_translation: He bravely took responsibility for this accident.

examples.example_chinese: 消防队员表现得十分勇敢，很快就扑灭了大火。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiāofáng duìyuán biǎoxiàn de shífēn yǒnggǎn, hěn kuài jiù pǔmièle dà huǒ.
examples.example_translation: The firefighters acted very bravely and quickly put out the fire.

meaning: adj.非常好, 很出色 · excellent

examples.example_chinese: 去年她被评为了校优秀教师。
examples.example_pinyin: Qùnián tā bèi píngwéi le xiào yōuxiù jiàoshī.
examples.example_translation: Last year she was rated as an excellent teacher at the school.

examples.example_chinese: 他各方面都很优秀，是个难得的人才。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gè fāngmiàn dōu hěn yōuxiù, shì ge nándé de réncái.
examples.example_translation: He is excellent in every aspect and is a rare talent.

examples.example_chinese: 大卫的学习成绩非常优秀。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàwèi de xuéxí chéngjì fēicháng yōuxiù.
examples.example_translation: David's academic performance is excellent.

examples.example_chinese: 他是一名很优秀的足球运动员。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yì míng hěn yōuxiù de zúqiú yùndòngyuán.
examples.example_translation: He is a very outstanding football player.

examples.example_chinese: 这所大学培养出了许多优秀人才。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué péiyǎng chū le xǔduō yōuxiù réncái.
examples.example_translation: This university has produced many outstanding talents.

meaning: adj.有意思的, 能引起人们兴趣的 · interesting, fascinating, amusing

examples.example_chinese: 他的表演很有趣，我们都喜欢看。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn yǒuqù, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan kàn.
examples.example_translation: His performance is very interesting, we all like to watch it.

examples.example_chinese: 他给我们讲了一个很有趣的故事。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gěi wǒmen jiǎngle yí gè hěn yǒuqù de gùshi.
examples.example_translation: He told us a very interesting story.

examples.example_chinese: 当我累的时候，就回忆那些有趣的经历。
examples.example_pinyin: Dāng wǒ lèi de shíhou, jiù huíyì nàxiē yǒuqù de jīnglì.
examples.example_translation: When I am tired, I recall those interesting experiences.

examples.example_chinese: 跟这些孩子在一起，多有趣啊！
examples.example_pinyin: Gēn zhèxiē háizi zài yìqǐ, duō yǒuqù a!
examples.example_translation: It's so much fun to be with these children!

examples.example_chinese: 我想起那件事就觉得有趣。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ nà jiàn shì jiù juéde yǒuqù.
examples.example_translation: I find it interesting whenever I think of that event.

meaning: conj.表示后面的事往往是由前面的事引起的，用在下半句里 · (indicating the latter is often led to by the former) hence, thereupon, as a result

examples.example_chinese: 我接到了电话通知，于是就来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiēdàole diànhuà tōngzhī, yúshì jiù lái le.
examples.example_translation: I received a phone call notification, so I came.

examples.example_chinese: 本来说好今天一起出去玩儿的，结果突然下了大雨，于是大家只好改变了计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Běnlái shuōhǎo jīntiān yìqǐ chūqù wánr de, jiéguǒ tūrán jiù xiàle dà yǔ, yúshì dàjiā zhǐhǎo gǎibiànle jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: We had planned to go out together today, but it suddenly rained heavily, so everyone had to change the plan.

examples.example_chinese: 我们请了个翻译，于是问题就解决了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen qǐngle ge fānyì, yúshì wèntí jiù jiějué le.
examples.example_translation: We hired a translator, so the problem was solved.

examples.example_chinese: 听说这部影片很好看，于是我也买了一张票。
examples.example_pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù yǐngpiàn hěn hǎokàn, yúshì wǒ yě mǎile yì zhāng piào.
examples.example_translation: I heard this movie is very good, so I also bought a ticket.

examples.example_chinese: 他提出的条件我不能接受，于是便拒绝了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tíchū de tiáojiàn wǒ bù néng jiēshòu, yúshì biàn jùjué le.
examples.example_translation: I couldn't accept the conditions he proposed, so I refused.

meaning: n.语言的结构规则 · grammar

examples.example_chinese: 我觉得汉语语法很难。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ juéde Hànyǔ yǔfǎ hěn nán.
examples.example_translation: I think Chinese grammar is very difficult.

examples.example_chinese: 今天下午有语法课。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu yǔfǎkè.
examples.example_translation: There is a grammar class this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 王老师讲语法讲得很清楚。
examples.example_pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī jiǎng yǔfǎ jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
examples.example_translation: Teacher Wang explains grammar very clearly.

examples.example_chinese: 你学会了语法，就能说出正确的句子。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xuéhuìle yǔfǎ, jiù néng shuōchū zhèngquè de jùzi.
examples.example_translation: If you master grammar, you can say correct sentences.

examples.example_chinese: 语法是比语音和汉字难学吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Yǔfǎ shì bǐ yǔyīn hé Hànzì nán xué ma?
examples.example_translation: Is grammar harder to learn than pronunciation and Chinese characters?

meaning: adv.指明范围，含有往小里说或轻里说的意味，仅仅 · only, merely, no more than

examples.example_chinese: 我不过是开玩笑，没想到她生气了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ búguò shì kāi wánxiào, méi xiǎngdào tā shēngqì le.
examples.example_translation: I was only joking, I didn't expect her to get angry.

examples.example_chinese: 我不过随便看看，没想买什么。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ búguò suíbiàn kànkan, méi xiǎng mǎi shénme.
examples.example_translation: I'm just looking around, I don't intend to buy anything.

examples.example_chinese: 我们认识才不过十来天，还不太了解。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen rènshi cái búguò shí lái tiān, hái bù tài liǎojiě.
examples.example_translation: We've only known each other for about ten days, and don't know each other well yet.

examples.example_chinese: 我不过是想让你高兴才这么做的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ búguò shì xiǎng ràng nǐ gāoxìng cái zhème zuò de.
examples.example_translation: I did this only to make you happy.

examples.example_chinese: 对于一个不过马路的人
examples.example_pinyin: duì yú yí gè bú guò mǎ lù de rén

meaning: adj.合乎准则的 · serving as or conforming to a standard

examples.example_chinese: 他的普通话很标准。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de pǔtōnghuà hěn biāozhǔn.
examples.example_translation: His Mandarin is very standard.

examples.example_chinese: 他会说一口标准的英语。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā huì shuō yì kǒu biāozhǔn de Yīngyǔ.
examples.example_translation: He can speak standard English.

examples.example_chinese: 他是个非常标准的好丈夫。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì gè fēicháng biāozhǔn de hǎo zhàngfu.
examples.example_translation: He is a very standard good husband.

examples.example_chinese: 他打球的动作标准、规范。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā dǎ qiú de dòngzuò biāozhǔn, guīfàn.
examples.example_translation: His movements when playing ball are standard and regulated.

examples.example_chinese: 不在意世俗的标准
examples.example_pinyin: bù zài yì shì sú de biāo zhǔn

meaning: n.事先约定好的见面 · appointment, date

examples.example_chinese: 我晚上七点有个约会。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang qī diǎn yǒu ge yuēhuì.
examples.example_translation: I have an appointment at seven o'clock in the evening.

examples.example_chinese: 他跟女朋友的第一次约会就迟到了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gēn nǚpéngyou de dì-yī cì yuēhuì jiù chídào le.
examples.example_translation: He was late for his first date with his girlfriend.

examples.example_chinese: 你别忘了下午的约会。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bié wàngle xiàwǔ de yuēhuì.
examples.example_translation: Don't forget the afternoon appointment.

examples.example_chinese: 我们的约会时间是下午四点。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de yuēhuì shíjiān shì xiàwǔ sì diǎn.
examples.example_translation: Our appointment time is four o'clock in the afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 我记不清我们第一次约会的地点了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jì bu qīng wǒmen dì-yī cì yuēhuì de dìdiǎn le.
examples.example_translation: I can't remember the place of our first date.

meaning: v.涂抹 · spread on

examples.example_chinese: 这姑娘脸上擦了一层粉。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè gūniang liǎn shang cāle yì céng fěn.
examples.example_translation: This girl put a layer of powder on her face.

examples.example_chinese: 机器擦上了油,很好用。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīqì cāshàngle yóu, hěn hǎoyòng.
examples.example_translation: The machine is oiled, it's very easy to use.

examples.example_chinese: 你的手流血了,快擦点儿药吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de shǒu liú xiě le, kuài cā diǎnr yào ba.
examples.example_translation: Your hand is bleeding, quickly put some medicine on it.

meaning: v.高出……之上 · above, more than

examples.example_chinese: 今年的学生数量超过了去年。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de xuéshēng shùliàng chāoguòle qùnián.
examples.example_translation: The number of students this year is more than last year.

examples.example_chinese: 他的汉语水平已经超过了哥哥。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yǐjīng chāoguòle gēge.
examples.example_translation: His Chinese level has already surpassed his older brother's.

examples.example_chinese: 他想把体重控制在不超过80公斤。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiǎng bǎ tǐzhòng kòngzhì zài bù chāoguò bāshí gōngjīn.
examples.example_translation: He wants to keep his weight under 80 kilograms.

examples.example_chinese: 今年我们出口的产品数量超过了以往任何一年。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen chūkǒu de chǎnpǐn shùliàng chāoguòle yǐwǎng rènhé yī nián.
examples.example_translation: This year, the number of products we exported exceeded any previous year.

examples.example_chinese: 但别超过我的底线。
examples.example_pinyin: dàn bié chāo guò wǒ de dǐxiàn

meaning: v.通过文字材料理解内容 · read

examples.example_chinese: 他可以阅读中文报纸了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kěyǐ yuèdú Zhōngwén bàozhǐ le.
examples.example_translation: He can read Chinese newspapers now.

examples.example_chinese: 我认真阅读了这篇文章，很有收获。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ rènzhēn yuèdúle zhè piān wénzhāng, hěn yǒu shōuhuò.
examples.example_translation: I read this article carefully and gained a lot.

examples.example_chinese: 课文我已经阅读了四遍，几乎可以背下来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Kèwén wǒ yǐjīng yuèdúle sì biàn, jīhū kěyǐ bèi xiàlai le.
examples.example_translation: I have read the text four times and can almost recite it.

examples.example_chinese: 他阅读的速度很快，这本小说一天就看完了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yuèdú de sùdù hěn kuài, zhè běn xiǎoshuō yī tiān jiù kànwán le.
examples.example_translation: He reads very fast, he finished this novel in one day.

examples.example_chinese: 我想提高我的阅读能力。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo wǒ de yuèdú nénglì.
examples.example_translation: I want to improve my reading ability.

meaning: v.（东西）暂由别人保管 · store, keep

examples.example_chinese: 这里可以存行李箱。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ cún xínglǐ xiāng.
examples.example_translation: You can store your suitcase here.

examples.example_chinese: 这些东西先存在这里，一会儿我们来取。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi xiān cún zài zhèlǐ, yíhuìr wǒmen lái qǔ.
examples.example_translation: Let's store these things here for now, we'll come to get them later.

examples.example_chinese: 自行车存起来就不会丢了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zìxíngchē cún qǐlái jiù bù huì sàn le.
examples.example_translation: If you store your bicycle, it won't get lost.

examples.example_chinese: 火车站里有存处，我们把东西先存在那儿吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Huǒchē zhàn lǐ yǒu cúnchǔ chù, wǒmen bǎ dōngxi xiān cún zài nàr ba.
examples.example_translation: There is a storage place in the train station, let's store our things there first.

examples.example_chinese: 这幅画有八九百年的历史，早已名扬中外，现在保存在北京故宫博物院里。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè fú huà yǒu bā jiǔ bǎi nián de lì shǐ zǎo yǐ míng yáng zhōng wài xiàn zài bǎo cún zài běi jīng gù gōng bó wù yuàn lǐ

meaning: n.不正确的事物，行为等 · mistake, error

examples.example_chinese: 他在工作中很少犯错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài gōngzuò zhōng hěn shǎo fàn cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: He rarely makes mistakes at work.

examples.example_chinese: 他改正了错误，大家也就原谅了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gǎizhèng le cuòwù, dàjiā yě jiù yuánliàng le tā.
examples.example_translation: He corrected his mistake, so everyone forgave him.

examples.example_chinese: 这不是什么大错误，改了就好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bù shì shénme dà cuòwù, gǎi le jiù hǎo.
examples.example_translation: This is not a big mistake, just correct it and it will be fine.

examples.example_chinese: 如果我有什么错误，希望你能告诉我。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ yǒu shénme cuòwù, xīwàng nǐ néng gàosu wǒ.
examples.example_translation: If I make any mistakes, I hope you can tell me.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子向妈妈承认了错误，妈妈表扬了他的诚实。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi xiàng māmā chéngrèn le cuòwù, māmā biǎoyáng le tā de chéngshí.
examples.example_translation: The child admitted his mistake to his mother, and his mother praised his honesty.

meaning: n.生物的一大类，一般有叶绿素 · plant

examples.example_chinese: 植物生长离不开阳光、空气和水。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhíwù shēngzhǎng lí bù kāi yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ.
examples.example_translation: Plants cannot grow without sunlight, air, and water.

examples.example_chinese: 这里有很多绿色植物，空气清新。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli yǒu hěn duō lǜsè zhíwù, kōngqì qīngxīn.
examples.example_translation: There are many green plants here, and the air is fresh.

examples.example_chinese: 我们这儿的热带植物品种很丰富。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zhèr de rèdài zhíwù pǐnzhǒng hěn fēngfù.
examples.example_translation: The tropical plant varieties here are very abundant.

examples.example_chinese: 许多植物的根、叶、花等都可以入药。
examples.example_pinyin: Xǔduō zhíwù de gēn, yè, huā děng dōu kěyǐ rùyào.
examples.example_translation: The roots, leaves, flowers, etc. of many plants can be used as medicine.

examples.example_chinese: 不同的植物为什么开花的时间不同呢？
examples.example_pinyin: bù tóng de zhí wù wèi shén me kāi huā de shí jiān bù tóng ne

meaning: n.产品或工作的好坏程度 · quality

examples.example_chinese: 这台电脑质量不错，我都用了十年了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo zhìliàng bùcuò, wǒ dōu yòngle shí nián le.
examples.example_translation: The quality of this computer is good, I've used it for ten years.

examples.example_chinese: 公司非常注重产品质量，因为质量决定声誉。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngsī fēicháng zhùzhòng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng, yīnwèi zhìliàng juédìng shēngyù.
examples.example_translation: The company pays great attention to product quality because quality determines reputation.

examples.example_chinese: 他们生产的服装质量可靠，样式新颖。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen shēngchǎn de fúzhuāng zhìliàng kěkào, yàngshì xīnyǐng.
examples.example_translation: The clothes they produce are of reliable quality and have novel styles.

examples.example_chinese: 售出的商品要是出现质量问题，可以退换。
examples.example_pinyin: Shòuchū de shāngpǐn yàoshi chūxiàn zhìliàng wèntí, kěyǐ tuìhuàn.
examples.example_translation: If there are quality problems with the sold goods, they can be returned or exchanged.

examples.example_chinese: 这照理质量还真不错
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhào lǐ zhì liàng hái zhēn bù cuò

meaning: adj.有成果的 · successful

examples.example_chinese: 这次会议组织得很成功，代表们都很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zǔzhī de hěn chénggōng, dàibiǎomen dōu hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: This conference was organized successfully, and all the delegates were very satisfied.

examples.example_chinese: 他们成功举办了这次运动会。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen chénggōng jǔbànle zhè cì yùndònghuì.
examples.example_translation: They successfully held this sports meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 他成功地解决了遇到的各种问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā chénggōng de jiějuéle yùdào de gè zhǒng wèntí.
examples.example_translation: He successfully solved all the problems he encountered.

examples.example_chinese: 他对孩子的教育是一个成功的典型。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì háizi de jiàoyù shì yí ge chénggōng de diǎnxíng.
examples.example_translation: He is a successful example in children's education.

examples.example_chinese: 所以你羡慕别人的风光无限，羡慕别人的成功人生，
examples.example_pinyin: suǒyǐ nǐ xiàn mù bié ren de fēng guāng wú xiàn xiàn mù bié ren de chéng gōng rénshēng

meaning: adj.有名，闻名 · famous, well-known

examples.example_chinese: 他是一位著名的科学家，在国际上声望很高。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā, zài guójì shàng shēngwàng hěn gāo.
examples.example_translation: He is a famous scientist with a high reputation internationally.

examples.example_chinese: 古老的长城非常著名，全世界都知道。
examples.example_pinyin: Gǔlǎo de Chángchéng fēicháng zhùmíng, quán shìjiè dōu zhīdào.
examples.example_translation: The ancient Great Wall is very famous, and the whole world knows about it.

examples.example_chinese: 李白是中国古代著名诗人。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǐ Bái shì Zhōngguó gǔdài zhùmíng shīrén.
examples.example_translation: Li Bai is a famous ancient Chinese poet.

examples.example_chinese: 这儿生产的葡萄酒著名得很，你带两瓶回去吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèr shēngchǎn de pútaojiǔ zhùmíng de hěn, nǐ dài liǎng píng huíqù ba.
examples.example_translation: The wine produced here is very famous, take two bottles back with you.

examples.example_chinese: 著名国学大师季羡林教授
examples.example_pinyin: zhù míng guóxué dàshī jì xiàn lín jiào shòu

meaning: n.提供著作内容的信息 · facts, information etc. to be used in writing
