examples.example_chinese: 写文章要收集很多材料。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiě wénzhāng yào shōují hěn duō cáiliào.
examples.example_translation: Writing an article requires collecting a lot of material.

examples.example_chinese: 材料收集得差不多了，可以开始写了。
examples.example_pinyin: Cáiliào shōují de chàbuduō le, kěyǐ kāishǐ xiě le.
examples.example_translation: The material has been almost collected, you can start writing.

examples.example_chinese: 这些经历都是写小说的好材料。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē jīnglì dōu shì xiě xiǎoshuō de hǎo cáiliào.
examples.example_translation: These experiences are all good material for writing novels.

examples.example_chinese: 有了这些丰富的材料，你一定可以写出好文章。
examples.example_pinyin: Yǒule zhèxiē fēngfù de cáiliào, nǐ yīdìng kěyǐ xiěchū hǎo wénzhāng.
examples.example_translation: With this rich material, you will definitely be able to write a good article.

examples.example_chinese: 我绝不亏了你的材料
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ jué bù kuī le nǐ de cái liào

meaning: n.对人或事物进行的安排或处理 · arrangement

examples.example_chinese: 我今天听你的安排，你让我做什么我就做什么。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān tīng nǐ de ānpái, nǐ ràng wǒ zuò shénme wǒ jiù zuò shénme.
examples.example_translation: I will follow your arrangement today, whatever you ask me to do, I will do it.

examples.example_chinese: 这个星期天你有什么安排？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān nǐ yǒu shénme ānpái?
examples.example_translation: What are your arrangements for this Sunday?

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，明天晚上我已经有安排了。
examples.example_pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, míngtiān wǎnshàng wǒ yǐjīng yǒu ānpái le.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, I already have an arrangement for tomorrow evening.

examples.example_chinese: 大家他对这次活动的安排都很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā tā duì zhè cì huódòng de ānpái dōu hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: Everyone is very satisfied with the arrangements for this event.

examples.example_chinese: 生命不是安排而是追求
examples.example_pinyin: shēng mìng bú shì ān pái ér shì zhuīqiú

meaning: adj.按照约定的时间的，不早不晚 · punctual, on time, on schedule

examples.example_chinese: 他是一个很准时的人，从来不迟到。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yí ge hěn zhǔnshí de rén, cónglái bù chídào.
examples.example_translation: He is a very punctual person and is never late.

examples.example_chinese: 他每次都很准时，不用担心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi cì dōu hěn zhǔnshí, bùyòng dānxīn.
examples.example_translation: He is always on time, so don't worry.

examples.example_chinese: 这些工作你们必须准时完成，否则会影响整体进度。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē gōngzuò nǐmen bìxū zhǔnshí wánchéng, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ jìndù.
examples.example_translation: You must finish these tasks on time, otherwise it will affect the overall progress.

examples.example_chinese: 大会上午八点准时开始，请大家准时参加。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàhuì shàngwǔ bā diǎn zhǔnshí kāishǐ, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí cānjiā.
examples.example_translation: The meeting will start at 8 a.m. sharp, please attend on time.

examples.example_chinese: 而不是每次准时准点
examples.example_pinyin: ér bú shì měi cì zhǔn shí zhǔn diǎn

meaning: n.可用来作为参考或依据的材料; 生产或生活上必需的东西 · data, material, information; necessary materials for production or life

examples.example_chinese: 我写论文的资料还没找全,还不能动笔。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ xiě lùnwén de zīliào hái méi zhǎo quán, hái bùnéng dòngbǐ.
examples.example_translation: I haven't found all the materials for my thesis yet, so I can't start writing.

examples.example_chinese: 这篇文章的资料很丰富,很有说服力。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè piān wénzhāng de zīliào hěn fēngfù, hěn yǒu shuōfúlì.
examples.example_translation: The materials in this article are very rich and very convincing.

examples.example_chinese: 这些会议资料你要好好儿保存,千万别弄丢了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē huìyì zīliào nǐ yào hǎohǎo'er bǎocún, qiānwàn bié nòng diū le.
examples.example_translation: You must keep these meeting materials safe, don't lose them.

examples.example_chinese: 为了研究这个问题,他查了国内外各种技术资料。
examples.example_pinyin: wèile yánjiū zhège wèntí, tā chá le guónèi wài gè zhǒng jìshù zīliào.
examples.example_translation: To study this problem, he consulted various technical materials from home and abroad.

examples.example_chinese: 那位专家怀疑这些资料的真实性。
examples.example_pinyin: nà wèi zhuānjiā huáiyí zhèxiē zīliào de zhēnshíxìng.
examples.example_translation: That expert doubts the authenticity of these materials.

examples.example_chinese: 这个国家的生活资料比较贫乏,主要依靠进口。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège guójiā de shēnghuó zīliào bǐjiào pínfá, zhǔyào yīkào jìnkǒu.
examples.example_translation: This country's living materials are relatively scarce, mainly relying on imports.

examples.example_chinese: 目前市场上生产资料充足,可以保障建设的需求。
examples.example_pinyin: mùqián shìchǎng shàng shēngchǎn zīliào chōngzú, kěyǐ bǎozhàng jiànshè de xūqiú.
examples.example_translation: Currently, production materials are abundant in the market and can meet construction needs.

examples.example_chinese: 我们会努力搞活经济,保证物质资料的供应。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen huì nǔlì gǎohuó jīngjì, bǎozhèng wùzhì zīliào de gōngyìng.
examples.example_translation: We will work hard to invigorate the economy and ensure the supply of material resources.

meaning: v.对自己的能力有信心 · believe in oneself, be confident

examples.example_chinese: 他自信可以找到那个地方。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zìxìn kěyǐ zhǎodào nàgè dìfang.
examples.example_translation: He is confident he can find that place.

examples.example_chinese: 我自信没有做错什么。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zìxìn méiyǒu zuòcuò shénme.
examples.example_translation: I am confident I didn't do anything wrong.

examples.example_chinese: 只要你自信起来,就离成功不远了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ zìxìn qǐlái, jiù lí chénggōng bù yuǎn le.
examples.example_translation: As long as you become confident, success is not far away.

examples.example_chinese: 我们已经没有了自信，
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ men yǐ jīng méiyou le zì xìn

examples.example_chinese: 劳拉·斯通却自信地回绝了
examples.example_pinyin: láo lā sī tōng què zì xìn de huí jué le

meaning: v.当作 · regard as, treat as, consider as

examples.example_chinese: 我们选王教授作为教师代表参加这次会议。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen xuǎn wáng jiàoshòu zuòwéi jiàoshī dàibiǎo cānjiā zhè cì huìyì.
examples.example_translation: We elected Professor Wang as the teacher representative to attend this meeting.

examples.example_chinese: 他把这句名言作为自己的座右铭来鼓励自己。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ zhè jù míngyán zuòwéi zìjǐ de zuòyòumíng lái gǔlì zìjǐ.
examples.example_translation: He took this famous saying as his motto to encourage himself.

examples.example_chinese: 我把中国作为我的第二故乡。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhōngguó zuòwéi wǒ de dì èr gùxiāng.
examples.example_translation: I regard China as my second home.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子把妈妈作为自己的朋友,无话不说。
examples.example_pinyin: háizi bǎ māma zuòwéi zìjǐ de péngyou, wúhuà bù shuō.
examples.example_translation: The child treats his mother as a friend and tells her everything.

meaning: n.用高粱、玉米、甘薯等粮食或某些果品发酵、蒸馏制成的酒，没有颜色，含酒精量较高。也叫烧酒、白干儿。 · spirit usually distilled from sorghum or maize, white spirit

examples.example_chinese: 中国人喜欢在聚会时喝白酒。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhōngguó rén xǐhuan zài jùhuì shí hē báijiǔ.
examples.example_translation: Chinese people like to drink baijiu at gatherings.

examples.example_chinese: 这瓶白酒的度数很高。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè píng báijiǔ de dùshù hěn gāo.
examples.example_translation: This bottle of baijiu has a very high alcohol content.

meaning: adj.（体力或能力）强，（水平）高，（成绩）好 · good, fine, excellent

examples.example_chinese: 他的身体很棒，从来不生病。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ hěn bàng, cónglái bù shēngbìng.
examples.example_translation: He is in great health and never gets sick.

examples.example_chinese: 他的汉语说得特别棒，跟中国人一样。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de tèbié bàng, gēn Zhōngguó rén yíyàng.
examples.example_translation: He speaks Chinese extremely well, just like a native.

examples.example_chinese: 你真棒，这次考了100分！
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zhēn bàng, zhè cì kǎo le 100 fēn!
examples.example_translation: You are amazing, you scored 100 points on this test!

examples.example_chinese: 这么棒的小伙子，你不喜欢？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème bàng de xiǎo huǒzi, nǐ bù xǐhuan?
examples.example_translation: Such an excellent young man, don’t you like him?

examples.example_chinese: 昨天晚上的比赛太棒了！
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de bǐsài tài bàng le!
examples.example_translation: Last night’s match was fantastic!

meaning: n.一种可以背在背（bèi）上的包 · knapsack, rucksack, infantry pack, field pack

examples.example_chinese: 我的背包里装满了书。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de bēibāo lǐ zhuāngmǎnle shū.
examples.example_translation: My backpack is full of books.

examples.example_chinese: 去旅行时,带一个轻便的背包比较方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Qù lǚxíng shí, dài yí ge qīngbiàn de bēibāo bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: When traveling, it's more convenient to bring a lightweight backpack.

meaning: n.人或高等动物的嗅觉器官，也是呼吸器官的一部分，位于头部，有两个孔 · nose

examples.example_chinese: 我感冒了，鼻子不通气。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, bízi bù tōngqì.
examples.example_translation: I have a cold and got a stuffy nose.

examples.example_chinese: 你的鼻子出血了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ de bízi chū xiě le.
examples.example_translation: Your nose is bleeding.

examples.example_chinese: 他的鼻子高高的，眼睛大大的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de bízi gāogāo de, yǎnjing dàdà de.
examples.example_translation: He has a Roman nose and big eyes.

examples.example_chinese: 我的鼻子不通气了，真难受。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de bízi bù tōngqì le, zhēn nánshòu.
examples.example_translation: My nose is stuffy, which makes me feel awful.

examples.example_chinese: 他的声音是从鼻子里发出来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn shì cóng bízi lǐ fā chūlái de.
examples.example_translation: He made a sound out of his nose.

meaning: v.比较容易 (做某事) · easy to, convenient for

examples.example_chinese: 笔记本电脑便于携带。
examples.example_pinyin: bǐjìběn diànnǎo biànyú xiédài.
examples.example_translation: Laptops are easy to carry.

examples.example_chinese: 字典就放在桌子上，便于查阅。
examples.example_pinyin: cídiǎn jiù fàng zài zhuōzi shàng, biànyú cháyuè.
examples.example_translation: The dictionary is on the table, convenient for reference.

examples.example_chinese: 在这里建一个市场管理办公室，便于管理市场。
examples.example_pinyin: zài zhèlǐ jiàn yīgè shìchǎng guǎnlǐ bàngōngshì, biànyú guǎnlǐ shìchǎng.
examples.example_translation: An office for market management is built here, which is convenient for managing the market.

examples.example_chinese: 他把书都捆起来了，便于运输。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ shū dōu kǔn qǐlái le, biànyú yùnshū.
examples.example_translation: He tied all the books together for easy transportation.

examples.example_chinese: 人们开始研究更便于书写的工具。
examples.example_pinyin: rénmen kāishǐ yánjiū gèng biànyú shūxiě de gōngjù.
examples.example_translation: People began to research tools that were easier to write with.

examples.example_chinese: 开会时，他坐在靠门的位置，便于出入。
examples.example_pinyin: kāihuì shí, tā zuò zài kào mén de wèizhì, biànyú chūrù.
examples.example_translation: During the meeting, he sat near the door for easy access.

meaning: n.一种食品，用面粉加糖、鸡蛋、牛奶等烤成的小薄块 · biscuit, cracker

examples.example_chinese: 他早饭就吃了几块饼干。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǎofàn jiù chīle jǐ kuài bǐnggān.
examples.example_translation: He ate a few biscuits for breakfast.

examples.example_chinese: 我这儿有饼干，你饿了可以吃点儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhèr yǒu bǐnggān, nǐ èle kěyǐ chī diǎnr.
examples.example_translation: I have some biscuits here. If you're hungry, you can have some.

examples.example_chinese: 我喜欢吃这种甜饼干，每次都买很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī zhè zhǒng tián bǐnggān, měi cì dōu mǎi hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: I like to eat this kind of sweet biscuit, and I buy a lot every time.

examples.example_chinese: 她送给我的那包巧克力饼干非常好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā sònggěi wǒ de nà bāo qiǎokèlì bǐnggān fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: The pack of chocolate biscuits she gave me was very delicious.

examples.example_chinese: 他在床头柜放了牛奶和饼干
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài chuáng tóu guì fàng le niú nǎi hé bǐng gān

meaning: n.学位的最高一级 · doctor, Ph.D

examples.example_chinese: 他是博士毕业，很有水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì bóshì bìyè, hěn yǒu shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: He has a Ph.D. and is very competent.

examples.example_chinese: 他在美国一所大学读博士。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài Měiguó yì suǒ dàxué dú bóshì.
examples.example_translation: He is studying for a Ph.D. at a university in the United States.

examples.example_chinese: 他博士毕业后，找到了一个研究单位。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bóshì bìyè hòu, zhǎodàole yí ge yánjiū dānwèi.
examples.example_translation: After graduating with a Ph.D., he found a research position.

examples.example_chinese: 我们学院的老师都是博士毕业。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xuéyuàn de lǎoshī dōu shì bóshì bìyè.
examples.example_translation: All the teachers in our college have Ph.D. degrees.

meaning: v.根据某些线索或想象来寻找正确的答案 · guess

examples.example_chinese: 你猜，他今年多大了？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ cāi, tā jīnnián duō dà le?
examples.example_translation: Guess, how old is he this year?

examples.example_chinese: 这个答案是我猜出来的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dá'àn shì wǒ cāi chūlái de.
examples.example_translation: This answer is what I guessed.

examples.example_chinese: 我猜了三次，也没猜对。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cāile sān cì, yě méi cāiduì.
examples.example_translation: I guessed three times, but I didn't guess right.

examples.example_chinese: 我猜不到，你告诉我答案吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cāi bu dào, nǐ gàosu wǒ dá'àn ba.
examples.example_translation: I can't guess, tell me the answer.

examples.example_chinese: 他不直接说出想法，总是让人猜。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù zhíjiē shuōchū xiǎngfǎ, zǒngshì ràng rén cāi.
examples.example_translation: He doesn't directly express his thoughts, always letting people guess.

meaning: n.供吃饭用的大房间 · dining room, dining hall

examples.example_chinese: 先生，请问餐厅在哪儿？
examples.example_pinyin: Xiānsheng, qǐngwèn cāntīng zài nǎr?
examples.example_translation: Sir, may I ask where the dining hall is?

examples.example_chinese: 我每天中午都在大学的餐厅吃饭。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zhōngwǔ dōu zài dàxué de cāntīng chīfàn.
examples.example_translation: I have lunch in the university dining hall every day.

examples.example_chinese: 我们楼下就是餐厅，吃饭很方便。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen lóu xià jiù shì cāntīng, chīfàn hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.example_translation: There is a dining hall downstairs, so eating is very convenient.

examples.example_chinese: 火车站附近有很多小餐厅。
examples.example_pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn fùjìn yǒu hěn duō xiǎo cāntīng.
examples.example_translation: There are many small restaurants near the train station.

examples.example_chinese: 她是一家餐厅的服务员。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì yì jiā cāntīng de fúwùyuán.
examples.example_translation: She is a waitress in a restaurant.

meaning: v.坐（某些交通工具） · take (a certain means of transport)

examples.example_chinese: 我是乘公共汽车来的。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ shì chéng gōnggòng qìchē lái de.
examples.example_translation: I came by public bus.

examples.example_chinese: 时间太紧了，我们选择了乘飞机。
examples.example_pinyin: shíjiān tài jǐn le, wǒmen xuǎnzé le chéng fēijī.
examples.example_translation: Time was too tight, so we chose to take the plane.

examples.example_chinese: 我们乘火车到北京需要20个小时。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen chéng huǒchē dào Běijīng xūyào 20 gè xiǎoshí.
examples.example_translation: It takes us 20 hours to get to Beijing by train.

examples.example_chinese: 去年我乘船去了五个国家。
examples.example_pinyin: qùnián wǒ chéng chuán qù le wǔ gè guójiā.
examples.example_translation: Last year I went to five countries by boat.

examples.example_chinese: 因为人太多，眼看就要撞上对面来的一乘轿子。
examples.example_pinyin: yīn wèi rén tài duō yào kàn jiù yào zhuàng shàng duì miàn lái de yī chéng jǐn zǐ

meaning: v.坐（车、船等） · take a ride (in a car, ship, etc)

examples.example_chinese: 我们乘坐T207次火车到北京。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen chéngzuò T207 cì huǒchē dào Běijīng.
examples.example_translation: We took train T207 to Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 他将乘坐大型轮船来这里。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiāng chéngzuò dàxíng lúnchuán lái zhèlǐ.
examples.example_translation: He will come here by taking a large ship.

examples.example_chinese: 我们乘坐的航班快起飞了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen chéngzuò de hángbān kuài qǐfēi le.
examples.example_translation: The flight we are taking is about to take off.

examples.example_chinese: 我从来没乘坐过晚上上的飞机。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi chéngzuòguo wǎnshang de fēijī.
examples.example_translation: I have never taken a night flight before.

examples.example_chinese: 姜子牙乘坐四不像
examples.example_pinyin: jiāng zi yá chéng zuò sì bù xiàng

meaning: n.搭乘车、船、飞机等交通工具的人 · fare, rider, passenger

examples.example_chinese: 飞机上的乘客都系好了安全带。
examples.example_pinyin: Fēijī shàng de chéngkè dōu jìhǎole ānquándài.
examples.example_translation: The passengers on the plane all fastened their seatbelts.

examples.example_chinese: 司机提醒乘客不要把头伸出窗外。
examples.example_pinyin: Sījī tíxǐng chéngkè bú yào bǎ tóu shēnchū chuāngwài.
examples.example_translation: The driver reminded passengers not to stick their heads out the window.

meaning: adj.晚，比规定的、合适的时间靠后 · late, delayed

examples.example_chinese: 因为路上堵车，他今天上班迟到了十分钟。
examples.example_pinyin: yīnwèi lù shàng dǔchē, tā jīntiān shàngbān chí dào le shí fēnzhōng.
examples.example_translation: Because there was traffic on the road, he was ten minutes late for work today.

examples.example_chinese: 我们最好早一点出门，免得赶到火车站的时候太迟。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zuì hǎo zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén, miǎnde gǎn dào huǒchēzhàn de shíhou tài chí.
examples.example_translation: We had better leave a little earlier, so that it will not be too late when we get to the train station.

examples.example_chinese: 他直到很迟才回家，所以家人都有些担心。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhídào hěn chí cái huí jiā, suǒyǐ jiārén dōu yǒuxiē dānxīn.
examples.example_translation: He did not come home until very late, so his family was a little worried.

meaning: v.暂时到外地办公事 · go on a business trip

examples.example_chinese: 我下个月要到美国出差。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào dào Měiguó chūchāi.
examples.example_translation: I will go on a business trip to the United States next month.

examples.example_chinese: 他的工作需要经常出差。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò xūyào jīngcháng chūchāi.
examples.example_translation: His job requires frequent business trips.

examples.example_chinese: 他每次出差都给妻子买礼物。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi cì chūchāi dōu gěi qīzi mǎi lǐwù.
examples.example_translation: He buys gifts for his wife every time he goes on a business trip.

examples.example_chinese: 我一年出差也就一两次，不太多。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yì nián chūchāi yě jiù yī-liǎng cì, bú tài duō.
examples.example_translation: I only go on business trips once or twice a year, not very often.

examples.example_chinese: 我这几天没在北京，到南京出了五天差。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān méi zài Běijīng, dào Nánjīng chūle wǔ tiān chāi.
examples.example_translation: I haven't been in Beijing these days, I was on a five-day business trip to Nanjing.

examples.example_chinese: 他今年已经出了两趟差了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīnnián yǐjīng chūle liǎng tàng chāi le.
examples.example_translation: He has already been on two business trips this year.

meaning: n.做饭菜的屋子 · kitchen

examples.example_chinese: 我也想有一个这么大的厨房。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng yǒu yí gè zhème dà de chúfáng.
examples.example_translation: I also want to have such a big kitchen.

examples.example_chinese: 这边是餐厅，那边是厨房。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè biān shì cāntīng, nà biān shì chúfáng.
examples.example_translation: The dining room is here, and the kitchen is over there.

examples.example_chinese: 我的厨房很小，不过一个人做饭没问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de chúfáng hěn xiǎo, bùguò yí gè rén zuòfàn méi wèntí.
examples.example_translation: My kitchen is very small, but it is big enough for one person to cook in it.

examples.example_chinese: 她正在厨房做饭呢，您等一下，我去叫她。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chúfáng zuòfàn ne, nín děng yīxià, wǒ qù jiào tā.
examples.example_translation: She is cooking in the kitchen. Please wait for a while and I’ll call her.

examples.example_chinese: 你家的厨房真干净。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jiā de chúfáng zhēn gānjìng.
examples.example_translation: Your kitchen is spotlessly clean.

examples.example_chinese: 你做完饭，收拾一下厨房。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zuòwán fàn, shōushi yīxià chúfáng.
examples.example_translation: Please clean the kitchen after you finish cooking.

examples.example_chinese: 厨房的卫生都是我自己打扫。
examples.example_pinyin: Chúfáng de wèishēng dōu shì wǒ zìjǐ dǎsǎo.
examples.example_translation: I always clean the kitchen myself.

meaning: v.使别人不能正常工作或休息 · to disturb, to bother

examples.example_chinese: 他在睡觉，我不想打扰他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài shuìjiào, wǒ bù xiǎng dǎrǎo tā.
examples.example_translation: He is sleeping, I don't want to disturb him.

examples.example_chinese: 这么晚给你打电话，打扰你了吧？
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème wǎn gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, dǎrǎo nǐ le ba?
examples.example_translation: Calling you so late, did I disturb you?

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，打扰一下，我能请你帮个忙吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dǎrǎo yíxià, wǒ néng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng ma?
examples.example_translation: Sorry to bother you, can I ask you for a favor?

examples.example_chinese: 我们最好不要打扰他休息。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen zuìhǎo bùyào dǎrǎo tā xiūxi.
examples.example_translation: We'd better not disturb his rest.

examples.example_chinese: 因为刚才的打扰，我不得不重新开始。
examples.example_pinyin: Yīnwèi gāngcái de dǎrǎo, wǒ bùdébù chóngxīn kāishǐ.
examples.example_translation: Because of the earlier interruption, I have to start over.

meaning: n.较大的建筑物中宽敞的房间，多用于集会或招待宾客等 · hall, lobby

examples.example_chinese: 我们在酒店大厅等了十分钟，然后才去办理入住手续。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zài jiǔdiàn dàtīng děng le shí fēn zhōng, ránhòu cái qù bànlǐ rùzhù shǒuxù.
examples.example_translation: We waited in the hotel lobby for ten minutes before going to check in.

examples.example_chinese: 会议开始前，很多来宾都在一楼大厅里交谈和签到。
examples.example_pinyin: huìyì kāishǐ qián, hěn duō láibīn dōu zài yī lóu dàtīng lǐ jiāotán hé qiāndào.
examples.example_translation: Before the meeting began, many guests were chatting and signing in in the first-floor hall.

examples.example_chinese: 银行大厅里人很多，所以他拿了号码后就坐下来等。
examples.example_pinyin: yínháng dàtīng lǐ rén hěn duō, suǒyǐ tā ná le hàomǎ hòu jiù zuò xiàlái děng.
examples.example_translation: There were many people in the bank lobby, so after taking a number, he sat down to wait.

examples.example_chinese: 新的图书馆大厅十分明亮，墙上还挂着当地艺术家的作品。
examples.example_pinyin: xīn de túshūguǎn dàtīng shífēn míngliàng, qiáng shàng hái guà zhe dāngdì yìshùjiā de zuòpǐn.
examples.example_translation: The new library hall is very bright, and works by local artists hang on the walls.

examples.example_chinese: 演出结束后，观众从剧场大厅慢慢走出来，还在讨论刚才的节目。
examples.example_pinyin: yǎnchū jiéshù hòu, guānzhòng cóng jùchǎng dàtīng mànmàn zǒu chūlái, hái zài tǎolùn gāngcái de jiémù.
examples.example_translation: After the performance ended, the audience slowly walked out of the theater lobby, still discussing the show.

meaning: v.停留，居留，逗留 · stay, remain

examples.example_chinese: 我今天身体不太舒服，想待在家里好好休息一天。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ jīntiān shēntǐ bù tài shūfu, xiǎng dāi zài jiālǐ hǎohǎo xiūxi yítiān.
examples.example_translation: I do not feel very well today, so I want to stay at home and rest properly for a day.

examples.example_chinese: 他在这个小城市待了三年，已经习惯了这里的生活。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zài zhège xiǎo chéngshì dāi le sān nián, yǐjīng xíguàn le zhèlǐ de shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: He has stayed in this small city for three years and has already become used to life here.

examples.example_chinese: 下午雨下得很大，孩子们只好待在教室里等家长来接。
examples.example_pinyin: xiàwǔ yǔ xià de hěn dà, háizimen zhǐhǎo dāi zài jiàoshì lǐ děng jiāzhǎng lái jiē.
examples.example_translation: It rained heavily in the afternoon, so the children had to stay in the classroom and wait for their parents to pick them up.

examples.example_chinese: 你不要一直待在电脑前，最好出去走走，让眼睛休息一下。
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ bùyào yìzhí dāi zài diànnǎo qián, zuìhǎo chūqù zǒu zou, ràng yǎnjing xiūxi yíxià.
examples.example_translation: Do not stay in front of the computer all the time, it would be better to go outside for a walk and let your eyes rest.

meaning: v.来到，来临 · arrive, come, advent

examples.example_chinese: 春天的到来让城市里的公园重新变得热闹起来。
examples.example_pinyin: chūntiān de dàolái ràng chéngshì lǐ de gōngyuán chóngxīn biàn de rènào qǐlái.
examples.example_translation: The arrival of spring made the parks in the city lively again.

examples.example_chinese: 随着人工智能时代的到来，许多行业开始重新思考人才培养方式。
examples.example_pinyin: suí zhe réngōng zhìnéng shídài de dàolái, xǔduō hángyè kāishǐ chóngxīn sīkǎo réncái péiyǎng fāngshì.
examples.example_translation: With the arrival of the age of artificial intelligence, many industries have begun to rethink how they train talent.

examples.example_chinese: 我们没有被困难吓倒，而是在暴风雨到来之前提前加固了屋顶。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen méiyǒu bèi kùnnán xiàdǎo, érshì zài bàofēngyǔ dàolái zhīqián tíqián jiāgù le wūdǐng.
examples.example_translation: We were not frightened by the difficulties, but reinforced the roof before the storm arrived.

examples.example_chinese: 新年的到来总会让人想起过去一年的收获与遗憾。
examples.example_pinyin: xīnnián de dàolái zǒng huì ràng rén xiǎngqǐ guòqù yì nián de shōuhuò yǔ yíhàn.
examples.example_translation: The arrival of the New Year always makes people think of the gains and regrets of the past year.

examples.example_chinese: 当救援队的到来被确认后，被困的人们终于看到了希望。
examples.example_pinyin: dāng jiùyuán duì de dàolái bèi quèrèn hòu, bèikùn de rénmen zhōngyú kàndào le xīwàng.
examples.example_translation: After the arrival of the rescue team was confirmed, the trapped people finally saw hope.

meaning: adv.表示跟意料相反 · contrary to what is expected or a thought

examples.example_chinese: 春天来了，倒下起了大雪。
examples.example_pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, dào xià qǐ le dàxuě.
examples.example_translation: Spring has come, but it actually started snowing heavily.

examples.example_chinese: 哥哥倒比弟弟看起来年轻。
examples.example_pinyin: Gēge dào bǐ dìdi kànqǐlái niánqīng.
examples.example_translation: The older brother actually looks younger than the younger brother.

examples.example_chinese: 没想到这么便宜的东西质量倒不差。
examples.example_pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào zhème piányi de dōngxi zhìliàng dào bù chà.
examples.example_translation: I didn't expect such cheap things to actually be of good quality.

examples.example_chinese: 他学习汉语的时间不长，倒说得挺流利。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xuéxí Hànyǔ de shíjiān bù cháng, dào shuō de tǐng liúlì.
examples.example_translation: He hasn't studied Chinese for long, but he actually speaks it fluently.

examples.example_chinese: 他不仅不感谢我，倒生起我的气来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bùjǐn bù gǎnxiè wǒ, dào shēng qǐ wǒ de qì lái le.
examples.example_translation: Not only did he not thank me, but he actually got angry with me.

meaning: v.俯，头向下垂 · hang down, droop

examples.example_chinese: 他走路的时候总低着头。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zǒulù de shíhou zǒng dīzhe tóu.
examples.example_translation: He always lowers his head as he walks.

examples.example_chinese: 他在低着头看书，什么也没发现。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zài dīzhe tóu kàn shū, shénme yě méi fāxiàn.
examples.example_translation: He buried himself in his book and found nothing.

examples.example_chinese: 她一低头，看见地上有个钱包。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yī dī tóu, kànjiàn dìshang yǒu ge qiánbāo.
examples.example_translation: She lowered her head and found a wallet on the ground.

examples.example_chinese: 他低着头，一句话也不说。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā dīzhe tóu, yī jù huà yě bù shuō.
examples.example_translation: He lowered his head and said nothing.

examples.example_chinese: 他上课的时候，总是低着头不说话。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhou, zǒngshì dīzhe tóu bù shuōhuà.
examples.example_translation: He always silently lowers his head in class.

meaning: v.丢弃（原有的权利、主张、意见等） · abandon (one’s original rights, views, opinions, etc.), give up

examples.example_chinese: 工作太忙，我不得不放弃旅游的计划。
examples.example_pinyin: Gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ bùdébù fàngqì lǚyóu de jìhuà.
examples.example_translation: Work is too busy, I have to give up my travel plans.

examples.example_chinese: 他完全放弃了自己的权利。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wánquán fàngqìle zìjǐ de quánlì.
examples.example_translation: He completely gave up his rights.

examples.example_chinese: 为了照顾病人，他几乎放弃了休息时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Wèile zhàogù bìngrén, tā jīhū fàngqìle xiūxi shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: To take care of the patient, he almost gave up his rest time.

examples.example_chinese: 这是个好机会，你可不要放弃呀。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì ge hǎo jīhuì, nǐ kě bùyào fàngqì ya.
examples.example_translation: This is a good opportunity, you must not give it up.

examples.example_chinese: 我不能放弃这个观点，因为我觉得是正确的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù néng fàngqì zhège guāndiǎn, yīnwèi wǒ juéde shì zhèngquè de.
examples.example_translation: I can't give up this view, because I think it is correct.

meaning: cl.用于图画等 · used for paintings

examples.example_chinese: 墙上那幅画很漂亮。
examples.example_pinyin: Qiáng shàng nà fú huà hěn piàoliang.
examples.example_translation: That painting on the wall is very beautiful.

examples.example_chinese: 我昨天买了两幅中国画。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le liǎng fú Zhōngguó huà.
examples.example_translation: I bought two Chinese paintings yesterday.

examples.example_chinese: 这幅画是我自己画的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè fú huà shì wǒ zìjǐ huà de.
examples.example_translation: This painting was painted by myself.

examples.example_chinese: 请问，这幅画多少钱？
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè fú huà duōshǎo qián?
examples.example_translation: Excuse me, how much is this painting?

examples.example_chinese: 他画了一幅著名的画——《清明上河图》，画的是北宋都城汴京热闹的场面。
examples.example_pinyin: tā huà le yī fú zhù míng de huà qīng míng shàng hé tú huà de shì běi sòng dōu chéng biàn jīng rè nào de chǎng miàn
examples.example_translation: He painted a famous picture—"Along the River During the Qingming Festival"—which depicts the bustling scene of the capital city Bianjing during the Northern Song dynasty.

meaning: adj.（工作）尽到应尽的责任, 认真踏实 · conscientious

examples.example_chinese: 他是会计，对工作非常负责。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì kuàijì, duì gōngzuò fēicháng fùzé.
examples.example_translation: He is an accountant and is very conscientious about his work.

examples.example_chinese: 如果大家都像老王那么负责，就不会出错了。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ dàjiā dōu xiàng Lǎo Wáng nàme fùzé, jiù bú huì chūcuò le.
examples.example_translation: If everyone were as responsible as Lao Wang, there would be no mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 我可以负责地说，事情不是这样的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ fùzé de shuō, shìqing bú shì zhèyàng de.
examples.example_translation: I can say responsibly that things are not like this.

examples.example_chinese: 他这么做，是一种不负责的态度。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zhème zuò, shì yì zhǒng bú fùzé de tàidu.
examples.example_translation: Doing this shows an irresponsible attitude.

examples.example_chinese: 你得为自己负责
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ děi wèi zì jǐ fù zé

meaning: n.键盘乐器，内部装有许多钢丝弦和包有绒毡的木槌，一按键盘就能带动木槌敲打钢丝弦而发出声音。 · forte-piano, piano, pianoforte

examples.example_chinese: 她每天练习钢琴两个小时。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān liànxí gāngqín liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.example_translation: She practices piano for two hours every day.

examples.example_chinese: 这架钢琴的音色非常优美。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jià gāngqín de yīnsè fēicháng yōuměi.
examples.example_translation: This piano has a very beautiful tone.

meaning: n.较高的温度 · heat, high temperature

examples.example_chinese: 夏天的高温让很多人不愿意在中午出门。
examples.example_pinyin: xiàtiān de gāowēn ràng hěn duō rén bù yuànyì zài zhōngwǔ chūmén.
examples.example_translation: The high temperature in summer makes many people unwilling to go out at noon.

examples.example_chinese: 工人在高温环境下工作，必须多喝水并注意休息。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngrén zài gāowēn huánjìng xià gōngzuò, bìxū duō hē shuǐ bìng zhùyì xiūxí.
examples.example_translation: Workers who work in high-temperature environments must drink plenty of water and pay attention to rest.

examples.example_chinese: 这种材料能够耐受高温，所以常被用在工业生产中。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhǒng cáiliào nénggòu nàishòu gāowēn, suǒyǐ cháng bèi yòng zài gōngyè shēngchǎn zhōng.
examples.example_translation: This kind of material can withstand high temperatures, so it is often used in industrial production.

examples.example_chinese: 连续几天的高温天气，使城市的用电量明显增加。
examples.example_pinyin: liánxù jǐ tiān de gāowēn tiānqì, shǐ chéngshì de yòngdiàn liàng míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
examples.example_translation: Several consecutive days of high-temperature weather caused the city’s electricity consumption to increase noticeably.

examples.example_chinese: 医生提醒老人和孩子，在高温天气里要尽量减少户外活动。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng tíxǐng lǎorén hé háizi, zài gāowēn tiānqì lǐ yào jǐnliàng jiǎnshǎo hùwài huódòng.
examples.example_translation: The doctor reminded elderly people and children to reduce outdoor activities as much as possible during high-temperature weather.

meaning: v.表示数的大小关系或表示变量的下界 · greater than, to exceed

examples.example_chinese: 今年的销售额高于去年。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián de xiāoshòu'é gāoyú qùnián.
examples.example_translation: This year's sales are higher than last year.

examples.example_chinese: 他的身高高于平均水平。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de shēngāo gāoyú píngjūn shuǐpíng.
examples.example_translation: His height is above average.

meaning: v.大概的推测、计算（性质、数量等） · estimate, reckon (the characteristics, amount, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 我估计他不会来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gūjì tā bú huì lái le.
examples.example_translation: I estimate that he won’t come.

examples.example_chinese: 他过高地估计了自己，才导致失败。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā guò gāo de gūjìle zìjǐ, cái dǎozhì shībài.
examples.example_translation: He overestimated himself, which led to failure.

examples.example_chinese: 你估计这次考试谁能得第一名？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ gūjì zhè cì kǎoshì shéi néng dé dì-yī míng?
examples.example_translation: Who do you estimate will get first place in this exam?

examples.example_chinese: 我估计他在路上堵车了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gūjì tā zài lùshang dǔchē le.
examples.example_translation: I estimate that he is stuck in traffic.

examples.example_chinese: 那天来的人很多，估计得有100个吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà tiān lái de rén hěn duō, gūjì děi yǒu yìbǎi ge ba.
examples.example_translation: There were a lot of people that day, I estimate there were about 100.

meaning: v.说一些让人感到更有信心的话 · encourage

examples.example_chinese: 他经常鼓励孩子，很少批评。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng gǔlì háizi, hěn shǎo pīpíng.
examples.example_translation: He often encourages his children and seldom criticizes them.

examples.example_chinese: 那天老师说了很多鼓励我们的话。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà tiān lǎoshī shuōle hěn duō gǔlì wǒmen de huà.
examples.example_translation: That day the teacher said a lot of encouraging words to us.

examples.example_chinese: 他微笑着鼓励我说：“你会成功的。”
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wēixiàozhe gǔlì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ huì chénggōng de.”
examples.example_translation: He encouraged me with a smile and said, "You will succeed."

examples.example_chinese: 你多鼓励鼓励他们，他们就会愿意做。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ duō gǔlì gǔlì tāmen, tāmen jiù huì yuànyì zuò.
examples.example_translation: If you encourage them more, they will be willing to do it.

examples.example_chinese: 大家的赞扬给了他很多鼓励。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā de zànyáng gěile tā hěn duō gǔlì.
examples.example_translation: Everyone’s praise gave him a lot of encouragement.

meaning: n.比喻事物最关键的部分或对情况起决定作用的因素 · key, hinge

examples.example_chinese: 这次比赛，关键是准备工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài, guānjiàn shì zhǔnbèi gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: The key to this competition is the preparation work.

examples.example_chinese: 我们水平差不多，关键是看谁的心理更稳定。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen shuǐpíng chàbuduō, guānjiàn shì kàn shéi de xīnlǐ gèng wěndìng.
examples.example_translation: Our skills are about the same, the key is whose mentality is more stable.

examples.example_chinese: 我们能不能胜利，关键在于是否团结。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen néng bu néng shènglì, guānjiàn zàiyú shìfǒu tuánjié.
examples.example_translation: Whether we can win or not depends on whether we are united.

examples.example_chinese: 找到合适的人，是现在的关键。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhǎodào héshì de rén, shì xiànzài de guānjiàn.
examples.example_translation: Finding the right person is the key now.

examples.example_chinese: 最关键的就是彼此之间是否交心
examples.example_pinyin: zuì guān jiàn de jiù shì bǐ cǐ zhī jiān shì fǒu jiāo xīn

meaning: n.电台播送的节目 · radio program

examples.example_chinese: 他每天早晨听电台广播。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎochén tīng diàntái guǎngbō.
examples.example_translation: He listens to the radio every morning.

examples.example_chinese: 他一边开车，一边听广播。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yìbiān kāichē, yìbiān tīng guǎngbō.
examples.example_translation: He listens to the radio while driving.

examples.example_chinese: 刚才的广播是国内新闻。
examples.example_pinyin: Gāngcái de guǎngbō shì guónèi xīnwén.
examples.example_translation: The broadcast just now was domestic news.

examples.example_chinese: 每天晚上七点是新闻广播时间。
examples.example_pinyin: Měi tiān wǎnshang qī diǎn shì xīnwén guǎngbō shíjiān.
examples.example_translation: Every evening at seven is news broadcast time.

meaning: n.个人属于某个国家的身份 · nationality

examples.example_chinese: 我的国籍是中国。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ de guójí shì zhōngguó。
examples.example_translation: My nationality is Chinese.

examples.example_chinese: 你是哪国国籍？
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ shì nǎ guó guójí?
examples.example_translation: What is your nationality?

examples.example_chinese: 他已经加入了美国国籍。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yǐjīng jiārù le měiguó guójí。
examples.example_translation: He has already acquired American nationality.

examples.example_chinese: 这些不同国籍的人相处得很好。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèxiē bùtóng guójí de rén xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo。
examples.example_translation: People of different nationalities get along very well.

examples.example_chinese: 他一直保留着中国国籍。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yīzhí bǎoliú zhe zhōngguó guójí。
examples.example_translation: He has always kept his Chinese nationality.

meaning: n.人和高等动物从皮肤排出来的液体 · sweat

examples.example_chinese: 太热了，我出了一身汗。
examples.example_pinyin: Tài rè le, wǒ chūle yìshēn hàn.
examples.example_translation: It's too hot, I am covered in sweat.

examples.example_chinese: 你满头是汗，干什么去了？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ mǎn tóu shì hàn, gàn shénme qù le?
examples.example_translation: Your head is covered in sweat, what have you been doing?

examples.example_chinese: 他一干活儿就出汗。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yí gàn huór jiù chū hàn.
examples.example_translation: He starts sweating as soon as he works.

examples.example_chinese: 汗都把衣服湿透了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hàn dōu bǎ yīfu shītòu le.
examples.example_translation: The sweat soaked the clothes through.

examples.example_chinese: 快擦擦汗，休息一会儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Kuài cā cā hàn, xiūxi yíhuìr.
examples.example_translation: Quick, wipe your sweat and take a rest.

meaning: n.用来盛东西的一种物体，多为方型，有盖儿 · box, case

examples.example_chinese: 他提着一个盒子进来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tízhe yí ge hézi jìnlái le.
examples.example_translation: He came in carrying a box.

examples.example_chinese: 这个盒子里装的都是玩具。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège hézi lǐ zhuāng de dōu shì wánjù.
examples.example_translation: This box is filled with toys.

examples.example_chinese: 这个鞋盒子没用了，扔了吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège xiéhézi méi yòng le, dǎ le ba.
examples.example_translation: This shoe box is useless now, just throw it away.

examples.example_chinese: 你能帮我找一个纸盒子吗？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ zhǎo yí ge zhǐ hézi ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you help me find a paper box?

examples.example_chinese: 是个盒子，
examples.example_pinyin: shì gè hé zi

meaning: v.为自己的错误感到遗憾，认为不该那样 · regret, repent

examples.example_chinese: 他后悔当初没上大学。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hòuhuǐ dāngchū méi shàng dàxué.
examples.example_translation: He regrets not going to college at the beginning.

examples.example_chinese: 他把房子卖了，现在很后悔。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bǎ fángzi mài le, xiànzài hěn hòuhuǐ.
examples.example_translation: He sold the house and now he regrets it.

examples.example_chinese: 合同已经签了，后悔也没用了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hétóng yǐjīng qiān le, hòuhuǐ yě méi yòng le.
examples.example_translation: The contract has been signed, regret is useless now.

examples.example_chinese: 你不来，到时候别后悔。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bù lái, dào shíhou bié hòuhuǐ.
examples.example_translation: If you don't come, don't regret it later.

examples.example_chinese: 我后悔死了，要是当时一起去就好了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hòuhuǐ sǐ le, yàoshi dāngshí yìqǐ qù jiù hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: I regret it so much, if only I had gone together at that time.

meaning: n.一种哺乳动物，性情凶猛，力气大 · tiger

examples.example_chinese: 世界上老虎的数量越来越少。
examples.example_pinyin: Shìjiè shàng lǎohǔ de shùliàng yuè lái yuè shǎo.
examples.example_translation: The number of tigers in the world is getting smaller and smaller.

examples.example_chinese: 这个动物园里有五只老虎。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu wǔ zhī lǎohǔ.
examples.example_translation: There are five tigers in this zoo.

examples.example_chinese: 我儿子就爱去动物园看老虎。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ érzi jiù ài qù dòngwùyuán kàn lǎohǔ.
examples.example_translation: My son just loves to go to the zoo to see tigers.

examples.example_chinese: 老虎的叫声让人害怕。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎohǔ de jiàoshēng ràng rén hàipà.
examples.example_translation: The roar of a tiger is frightening.

examples.example_chinese: 他像老虎一样厉害。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎohǔ yíyàng lìhai.
examples.example_translation: He is as fierce as a tiger.

meaning: adj.生动自然，不呆板 · lively, vivacious, vivid and natural

examples.example_chinese: 他性格活泼，爱说爱笑。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xìnggé huópō, ài shuō ài xiào.
examples.example_translation: He is lively by nature, loves to talk and laugh.

examples.example_chinese: 这群孩子天真，活泼，非常可爱。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè qún háizi tiānzhēn, huópō, fēicháng kě'ài.
examples.example_translation: These children are innocent, lively, and very lovely.

examples.example_chinese: 她是个非常活泼的姑娘。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì ge fēicháng huópō de gūniang.
examples.example_translation: She is a very lively girl.

examples.example_chinese: 他今天说话很多，显得很活泼。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān shuōhuà hěn duō, xiǎnde hěn huópō.
examples.example_translation: He talked a lot today and seemed very lively.

examples.example_chinese: 她跳起舞来活泼得很。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā tiàoqǐ wǔ lái huópō de hěn.
examples.example_translation: She is very lively when she dances.

meaning: v.回想以前的事情或经历 · call to mind, recall

examples.example_chinese: 我常常回忆在北京的生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng huíyì zài Běijīng de shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: I often recall my life in Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 这件事让他回忆起了童年。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng tā huíyì qǐ le tóngnián.
examples.example_translation: This incident made him recall his childhood.

examples.example_chinese: 很多事我已经回忆不起来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Hěn duō shì wǒ yǐjīng huíyì bu qǐlái le.
examples.example_translation: I can't recall many things anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 人老了，就很爱回忆过去。
examples.example_pinyin: Rén lǎo le, jiù hěn ài huíyì guòqù.
examples.example_translation: When people get old, they love to recall the past.

examples.example_chinese: 我不想回忆那段痛苦的经历。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng huíyì nà duàn tòngkǔ de jīnglì.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to recall that painful experience.

meaning: conj.表示假设的让步，常与“也”搭配使用 · even if, even though (expressing supposition and often used with “也”)

examples.example_chinese: 即使没钱，他也想买汽车。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ méi qián, tā yě xiǎng mǎi qìchē.
examples.example_translation: Even if he has no money, he still wants to buy a car.

examples.example_chinese: 即使你们都不同意，我也要做。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐmen dōu bù tóngyì, wǒ yě yào zuò.
examples.example_translation: Even if none of you agree, I will still do it.

examples.example_chinese: 即使下雨，我们也要去长城。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù Chángchéng.
examples.example_translation: Even if it rains, we will still go to the Great Wall.

examples.example_chinese: 即使是最好的朋友，我也没告诉。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ shì zuì hǎo de péngyou, wǒ yě méi gàosu.
examples.example_translation: Even if it was my best friend, I didn't tell.

examples.example_chinese: 即使生病的时候，他也没停止学习。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ shēngbìng de shíhou, tā yě méi tíngzhǐ xuéxí.
examples.example_translation: Even when he was sick, he didn't stop studying.

examples.example_chinese: 即使不睡觉，我也要看比赛。
examples.example_pinyin: Jíshǐ bú shuìjiào, wǒ yě yào kàn bǐsài.
examples.example_translation: Even if I don't sleep, I still want to watch the match.

meaning: conj.承接上句，有进一步的意思，下文多表示结果 · in addition (to)

examples.example_chinese: 今天本来工作就很多，加上两个同事请假，大家都忙到很晚。
examples.example_pinyin: jīntiān běnlái gōngzuò jiù hěn duō, jiāshàng liǎng gè tóngshì qǐngjià, dàjiā dōu máng dào hěn wǎn.
examples.example_translation: There was already a lot of work today, and with two colleagues on leave, everyone stayed busy until very late.

examples.example_chinese: 这个项目有很好的创意，加上团队执行力很强，所以投资人对它很感兴趣。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège xiàngmù yǒu hěn hǎo de chuàngyì, jiāshàng tuánduì zhíxínglì hěn qiáng, suǒyǐ tóuzīrén duì tā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.example_translation: This project has a strong creative idea, and combined with the team’s excellent execution ability, investors are very interested in it.

meaning: v.使程度、重量、负担、痛苦等减少或变轻 · lighten, ease, mitigate

examples.example_chinese: 采取这些措施可以减轻空气污染对居民健康的影响。
examples.example_pinyin: cǎiqǔ zhèxiē cuòshī kěyǐ jiǎnqīng kōngqì wūrǎn duì jūmín jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.example_translation: Taking these measures can reduce the impact of air pollution on residents’ health.

examples.example_chinese: 医生给他开了药，希望能减轻手术后的疼痛。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng gěi tā kāi le yào, xīwàng néng jiǎnqīng shǒushù hòu de téngtòng.
examples.example_translation: The doctor prescribed medicine for him, hoping it would relieve the pain after the surgery.

examples.example_chinese: 合理安排学习时间，能减轻学生在考试前的心理压力。
examples.example_pinyin: hélǐ ānpái xuéxí shíjiān, néng jiǎnqīng xuéshēng zài kǎoshì qián de xīnlǐ yālì.
examples.example_translation: Arranging study time reasonably can reduce students’ psychological pressure before exams.

examples.example_chinese: 新政策减轻了小微企业的税收负担。
examples.example_pinyin: xīn zhèngcè jiǎnqīng le xiǎowēi qǐyè de shuìshōu fùdān.
examples.example_translation: The new policy reduced the tax burden on small and micro enterprises.

examples.example_chinese: 随着雨势变小，山区发生滑坡的风险也有所减轻。
examples.example_pinyin: suízhe yǔshì biàn xiǎo, shānqū fāshēng huápō de fēngxiǎn yě yǒu suǒ jiǎnqīng.
examples.example_translation: As the rain weakened, the risk of landslides in the mountain area also decreased somewhat.

meaning: adv.将要，快要 · be going to, about to

examples.example_chinese: 明天这场会议将讨论公司下一阶段的发展方向。
examples.example_pinyin: míngtiān zhè chǎng huìyì jiāng tǎolùn gōngsī xià yí jiēduàn de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
examples.example_translation: Tomorrow’s meeting will discuss the company’s development direction for the next stage.

examples.example_chinese: 根据天气预报，本周末气温将明显下降。
examples.example_pinyin: gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, běn zhōu mò qìwēn jiāng míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
examples.example_translation: According to the weather forecast, the temperature will drop noticeably this weekend.

examples.example_chinese: 这项新技术将改变人们获取知识和处理信息的方式。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè xiàng xīn jìshù jiāng gǎibiàn rénmen huòqǔ zhīshi hé chǔlǐ xìnxī de fāngshì.
examples.example_translation: This new technology will change the way people acquire knowledge and process information.

meaning: n.城市周围的地区 · suburbs

examples.example_chinese: 我家住在北京郊区。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù zài Běijīng jiāoqū.
examples.example_translation: My family lives in the suburbs of Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 城里的房子太贵了，他打算到郊区买房。
examples.example_pinyin: Chéng lǐ de fángzi tài guì le, tā dǎsuàn dào jiāoqū mǎi fáng.
examples.example_translation: Houses in the city are too expensive, so he plans to buy a house in the suburbs.

examples.example_chinese: 这些菜都是郊区生产的，很新鲜。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē cài dōu shì jiāoqū shēngchǎn de, hěn xīnxiān.
examples.example_translation: These vegetables are all produced in the suburbs and are very fresh.

examples.example_chinese: 我更喜欢住在郊区，而不是市中心。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ gèng xǐhuan zhù zài jiāoqū, ér bù shì shì zhōngxīn.
examples.example_translation: I prefer living in the suburbs rather than the city center.

examples.example_chinese: 他们每个周末都开车去郊区玩儿。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen měi gè zhōumò dōu kāichē qù jiāoqū wánr.
examples.example_translation: They drive to the suburbs to have fun every weekend.

meaning: conj.表示先承认某个事实, 后面用“但, 但是, 然而”等提出一个不同或者相反的结果 · although, even if

examples.example_chinese: 尽管他不愿意，但还是同意了。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā bù yuànyì, dàn háishi tóngyì le.
examples.example_translation: Although he was unwilling, he still agreed.

examples.example_chinese: 尽管有很多困难，但我们没有失去信心。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǒu hěn duō kùnnan, dàn wǒmen méiyǒu shīqù xìnxīn.
examples.example_translation: Although there are many difficulties, we have not lost confidence.

examples.example_chinese: 尽管是周末，但他仍然在工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shì zhōumò, dàn tā réngrán zài gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: Although it is the weekend, he is still working.

examples.example_chinese: 尽管她不算漂亮，但喜欢她的人很多。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā bù suàn piàoliang, dàn xǐhuan tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.example_translation: Although she is not considered beautiful, many people like her.

examples.example_chinese: 尽管钱不多，但我还是想去旅游。
examples.example_pinyin: Jǐnguǎn qián bù duō, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng qù lǚyóu.
examples.example_translation: Although I don't have much money, I still want to travel.

meaning: v.为了自己的利益而跟别人争胜 · compete

examples.example_chinese: 企业都在竞争市场，有了市场才有效益。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐyè dōu zài jìngzhēng shìchǎng, yǒule shìchǎng cái yǒu xiàoyì.
examples.example_translation: Enterprises all compete in the market; only with a market can there be benefits.

examples.example_chinese: 三位教授竞争校长这一职务。
examples.example_pinyin: Sān wèi jiàoshòu jìngzhēng xiàozhǎng zhè yī zhíwù.
examples.example_translation: Three professors are competing for the position of president.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要公平竞争，不能采取不正当手段。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào gōngpíng jìngzhēng, bù néng cǎiqǔ bú zhèngdàng shǒuduàn.
examples.example_translation: We must compete fairly and not use improper means.

examples.example_chinese: 现在各行各业竞争都很激烈。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiànzài gè háng gè yè jìngzhēng dōu hěn jīliè.
examples.example_translation: Competition is fierce in all trades and professions now.

examples.example_chinese: 名额只有一个，大家只能通过竞争得到。
examples.example_pinyin: Míng'é zhǐ yǒu yí ge, dàjiā zhǐ néng tōngguò jìngzhēng dédào.
examples.example_translation: There is only one spot, and everyone can only get it through competition.

meaning: v.不接受（请求、意见或赠礼等） · refuse, reject, turn down (one’s request, opinion or gift, etc.)

examples.example_chinese: 我想请她吃饭，他拒绝了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā chī fàn, tā jùjué le.
examples.example_translation: I wanted to invite her to dinner, but he refused.

examples.example_chinese: 我们要求休息，被经理拒绝了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yāoqiú xiūxi, bèi jīnglǐ jùjué le.
examples.example_translation: We asked for a break, but the manager refused.

examples.example_chinese: 他拒绝接受这种不公平的条件。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jùjué jiēshòu zhè zhǒng bù gōngpíng de tiáojiàn.
examples.example_translation: He refused to accept such unfair conditions.

examples.example_chinese: 他那么热情，我不好意思拒绝。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā nàme rèqíng, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi jùjué.
examples.example_translation: He was so enthusiastic that I felt embarrassed to refuse.

examples.example_chinese: 我已经拒绝过他们两次了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng jùjuéguo tāmen liǎng cì le.
examples.example_translation: I have already refused them twice.

meaning: n.在炉子里烤熟的鸭子, 一种名菜 · roast duck

examples.example_chinese: 北京烤鸭很好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: běijīng kǎoyā hěn hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: Beijing roast duck is very delicious.

examples.example_chinese: 我们中午去吃烤鸭吧。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zhōngwǔ qù chī kǎoyā ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's go eat roast duck at noon.

examples.example_chinese: 我们五个人吃了两只烤鸭。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen wǔ gè rén chī le liǎng zhī kǎoyā.
examples.example_translation: Five of us ate two roast ducks.

examples.example_chinese: 这只烤鸭够三个人吃。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhī kǎoyā gòu sān gè rén chī.
examples.example_translation: This roast duck is enough for three people to eat.

examples.example_chinese: 我觉得烤鸭非常好吃。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ juéde kǎoyā fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.example_translation: I think roast duck is very delicious.

meaning: v.喉咙或气管受刺激时用力呼气而发出的声音，也指这种动作 · cough

examples.example_chinese: 他因为感冒了，一个晚上都在不停地咳。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yīn wéi gǎnmào le, yí gè wǎnshang dōu zài bù tíng de ké.
examples.example_translation: Because he caught a cold, he kept coughing all night.

examples.example_chinese: 医生听到他一直咳，就建议他多喝温水并好好休息。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng tīngdào tā yìzhí ké, jiù jiànyì tā duō hē wēnshuǐ bìng hǎohǎo xiūxi.
examples.example_translation: When the doctor heard that he kept coughing, he advised him to drink more warm water and rest well.

examples.example_chinese: 教室里有人突然咳了几声，大家都转头看了一下。
examples.example_pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ yǒu rén tūrán ké le jǐ shēng, dàjiā dōu zhuǎn tóu kàn le yí xià.
examples.example_translation: Someone in the classroom suddenly coughed a few times, and everyone turned to look.

meaning: adj.令人感到遗憾的 · what a pity, it’s too bad

examples.example_chinese: 我没来看你的表演，太可惜了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ méi lái kàn nǐ de biǎoyǎn, tài kěxī le.
examples.example_translation: I didn’t come to see your performance, what a pity.

examples.example_chinese: 这么好的机会被我错过了，真可惜。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì bèi wǒ cuòguò le, zhēn kěxī.
examples.example_translation: I missed such a good opportunity, what a pity.

examples.example_chinese: 这些菜浪费了很可惜。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē cài làngfèile hěn kěxī.
examples.example_translation: It’s a pity that these dishes were wasted.

examples.example_chinese: 这位大作家40岁时去世了，死得太可惜了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè wèi dà zuòjiā sìshí suì shí qùshì le, sǐ de tài kěxī le.
examples.example_translation: This great writer died at the age of 40, it’s such a pity.

examples.example_chinese: 可惜我那时候不认识你。
examples.example_pinyin: Kěxī wǒ nà shíhou bú rènshi nǐ.
examples.example_translation: It’s a pity I didn’t know you at that time.

meaning: n.接待客人用的房间 · living room

examples.example_chinese: 他家的客厅很大。
examples.example_pinyin: tā jiā de kètīng hěn dà.
examples.example_translation: His living room is very big.

examples.example_chinese: 我们去客厅坐一会儿吧。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen qù kètīng zuò yīhuìr ba.
examples.example_translation: Let's go sit in the living room for a while.

examples.example_chinese: 他喜欢坐在客厅里听音乐。
examples.example_pinyin: tā xǐhuān zuò zài kètīng lǐ tīng yīnyuè.
examples.example_translation: He likes to sit in the living room and listen to music.

examples.example_chinese: 楼下是一个客厅和一个厨房。
examples.example_pinyin: lóuxià shì yī gè kètīng hé yī gè chúfáng.
examples.example_translation: Downstairs is a living room and a kitchen.

examples.example_chinese: 这间客厅布置得非常讲究。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiān kètīng bùzhì dé fēicháng jiǎngjiu.
examples.example_translation: This living room is very tastefully decorated.

examples.example_chinese: 我租的房子有客厅、卧室、厨房和卫生间，只是客厅有点儿小。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zū de fángzi yǒu kètīng, wòshì, chúfáng hé wèishēngjiān, zhǐshì kètīng yǒudiǎnr xiǎo.
examples.example_translation: The house I rented has a living room, bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom, but the living room is a bit small.

meaning: v.承认, 同意（跟“否定”相对） · affirm, confirm (as opposed to "否定 negate")

examples.example_chinese: 老师肯定了我们的做法。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī kěndìngle wǒmen de zuòfǎ.
examples.example_translation: The teacher affirmed our approach.

examples.example_chinese: 我不敢肯定他来不来。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bù gǎn kěndìng tā lái bù lái.
examples.example_translation: I can't be sure whether he will come or not.

examples.example_chinese: 经理在肯定我们成绩的同时，也指出了一些问题。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài kěndìng wǒmen chéngjì de tóngshí, yě zhǐchūle yìxiē wèntí.
examples.example_translation: The manager affirmed our achievements and also pointed out some problems.

examples.example_chinese: 领导肯定了我们的看法，认为很有道理。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǐngdǎo kěndìngle wǒmen de kànfǎ, rènwéi hěn yǒu dàolǐ.
examples.example_translation: The leader affirmed our opinion, thinking it was very reasonable.

meaning: adj.充满幻想的 · romantic

examples.example_chinese: 这个故事听上去很浪漫。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhège gùshi tīng shàngqu hěn làngmàn.
examples.example_translation: This story sounds very romantic.

examples.example_chinese: 她喜欢过那种非常浪漫的生活。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan guò nà zhǒng fēicháng làngmàn de shēnghuó.
examples.example_translation: She used to like a very romantic life.

examples.example_chinese: 他们有过一段浪漫的爱情，但最后还是分手了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā liǎ yǒuguo yí duàn làngmàn de àiqíng, dàn zuìhòu háishi fēnshǒu le.
examples.example_translation: They had a romantic relationship, but in the end they still broke up.

examples.example_chinese: 这是一部具有浪漫色彩的电影。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì yí bù jùyǒu làngmàn sècǎi de diànyǐng.
examples.example_translation: This is a film with a romantic touch.

examples.example_chinese: 才是终身浪漫的开始
examples.example_pinyin: cái shì zhōng shēn làngmàn de kāi shǐ

meaning: n.星期日 · Sunday

examples.example_chinese: 明天礼拜天，我打算去书店。
examples.example_pinyin: míngtiān lǐbàitiān, wǒ dǎsuàn qù shūdiàn.
examples.example_translation: Tomorrow is Sunday, I plan to go to the bookstore.

examples.example_chinese: 这个礼拜天，我们一起打篮球。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè gè lǐbàitiān, wǒmen yīqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.example_translation: This Sunday, we will play basketball together.

examples.example_chinese: 会议改在礼拜天举行了。
examples.example_pinyin: huìyì gǎi zài lǐbàitiān jǔxíng le.
examples.example_translation: The meeting has been rescheduled to Sunday.

examples.example_chinese: 我就盼着礼拜天能好好儿放松放松。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ jiù xīwàng zhe lǐbàitiān néng hǎohāor fàngsōng fàngsōng.
examples.example_translation: I'm just looking forward to Sunday so I can really relax.

examples.example_chinese: 这个礼拜天的活动，我们早商量好了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè gè lǐbàitiān de huódòng, wǒmen zǎo shāngliang hǎo le.
examples.example_translation: We discussed the activities for this Sunday a long time ago.

meaning: n.言语、行动、神情等讲求礼节的表现 · politeness, courtesy

examples.example_chinese: 他对人很有礼貌。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn yǒu lǐmào.
examples.example_translation: He is very polite to people.

examples.example_chinese: 在这种情况下，你应该使用礼貌词语。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, nǐ yīnggāi shǐyòng lǐmào cíyǔ.
examples.example_translation: In this situation, you should use polite words.

examples.example_chinese: 服务员很讲礼貌，客人很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Fúwùyuán hěn jiǎng lǐmào, kèrén hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: The waiter is very polite, and the customers are very satisfied.

examples.example_chinese: 这孩子很懂礼貌，对长辈很尊敬。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè háizi hěn dǒng lǐmào, duì zhǎngbèi hěn zūnjìng.
examples.example_translation: This child is very polite and respects elders.

examples.example_chinese: 请你注意礼貌。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhùyì lǐmào.
examples.example_translation: Please pay attention to your manners.

meaning: adj.程度严重的，凶猛的 · terrible, serious

examples.example_chinese: 我头疼得厉害。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ tóu téng de lìhai.
examples.example_translation: I have a terrible headache.

examples.example_chinese: 她哭起来很厉害，两个小时也停不下来。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kū qǐlai hěn lìhai, liǎng ge xiǎoshí yě tíng bu xiàlái.
examples.example_translation: She cried so hard that she couldn't stop even after two hours.

examples.example_chinese: 他的功夫很厉害，没人打得过他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de gōngfu hěn lìhai, méi rén dǎ de guò tā.
examples.example_translation: His kung fu is amazing, no one can beat him.

examples.example_chinese: 这条狗看起来很厉害。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo gǒu kàn qǐlai hěn lìhai.
examples.example_translation: This dog looks very fierce.

examples.example_chinese: 这玩意儿才厉害

examples.example_pinyin: xiànzài de shíjiān shì 9 diǎn 20 fēn 25 miǎo.

examples.example_chinese: 他只用了10秒就找出了答案。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhǐ yòng le 10 miǎo jiù zhǎo chū le dá'àn.
examples.example_translation: He found the answer in just 10 seconds.

examples.example_chinese: 现在离12点还差7秒钟。
examples.example_pinyin: xiànzài lí 12 diǎn hái chà 7 miǎozhōng.
examples.example_translation: It's still 7 seconds until 12 o'clock.

examples.example_chinese: 他很珍惜时间，一分一秒都不浪费。
examples.example_pinyin: tā hěn zhēnxī shíjiān, yī fēn yī miǎo dōu bù làngfèi.
examples.example_translation: He cherishes time very much, not wasting a single minute or second.

meaning: v.摩擦 · rub

examples.example_pinyin: Tài lěng le, tāmen bù tíng de cāzhe shǒu.
examples.example_translation: It was too cold, they kept rubbing their hands.

examples.example_chinese: 我的胳膊擦破了一层皮。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de gēbo cāpòle yì céng pí.
examples.example_translation: I scraped off a layer of skin on my arm.

examples.example_chinese: 苏护把眼泪擦了擦，
examples.example_pinyin: sū hù bǎ yǎnlèi cā le cā

meaning: n.人类两性之一，指男人或具有男性特征的人 · male, man, masculine

examples.example_chinese: 这家医院开设了男性健康门诊，方便患者咨询生育和内分泌问题。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiā yīyuàn kāishè le nánxìng jiànkāng ménzhěn, fāngbiàn huànzhě zīxún shēngyù hé nèifēnmì wèntí.
examples.example_translation: This hospital has opened a men's health clinic, making it easier for patients to ask about fertility and endocrine issues.

examples.example_chinese: 调查显示，越来越多的男性愿意参与家务和育儿。
examples.example_pinyin: diàochá xiǎnshì, yuèláiyuè duō de nánxìng yuànyì cānyù jiāwù hé yù'ér.
examples.example_translation: The survey shows that more and more men are willing to take part in housework and childcare.

examples.example_chinese: 这部电影刻画了不同年龄的男性在面对压力时的选择。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè bù diànyǐng kèhuà le bùtóng niánlíng de nánxìng zài miànduì yālì shí de xuǎnzé.
examples.example_translation: This film portrays the choices made by men of different ages when they face pressure.

examples.example_chinese: 报名表需要填写性别，可以选择男性、女性或其他选项。
examples.example_pinyin: bàomíng biǎo xūyào tiánxiě xìngbié, kěyǐ xuǎnzé nánxìng, nǚxìng huò qítā xuǎnxiàng.
examples.example_translation: The registration form requires you to fill in your gender, and you can choose male, female, or another option.

meaning: adj.不急躁，不厌烦; · patient

examples.example_chinese: 我们学得很慢，但老师对我们很耐心。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen xué de hěn màn, dàn lǎoshī duì wǒmen hěn nàixīn.
examples.example_translation: We learn slowly, but the teacher is very patient with us.

examples.example_chinese: 服务员耐心的服务态度让顾客很满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Fúwùyuán nàixīn de fúwù tàidu ràng gùkè hěn mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: The waiter's patient service attitude made the customers very satisfied.

examples.example_chinese: 他给我们耐心地解释了一切。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gěi wǒmen nàixīn de jiěshìle zhè yīqiè.
examples.example_translation: He patiently explained everything to us.

examples.example_chinese: 在他耐心的教育下，他改正了错误。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài tā nàixīn de jiàoyù xià, tā gǎizhèngle cuòwù.
examples.example_translation: With his patient teaching, he corrected his mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 老师一遍一遍教得很耐心。
examples.example_pinyin: Lǎoshī yí biàn yí biàn jiāo de hěn nàixīn.
examples.example_translation: The teacher teaches patiently again and again.

meaning: n.人或动植物已经生存的年数 · age

examples.example_chinese: 我和她的年龄相同，都是23岁。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ hé tā de niánlíng xiāngtóng, dōu shì èrshísān suì.
examples.example_translation: She and I are the same age, both 23 years old.

examples.example_chinese: 这棵树的年龄整一百岁了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè kē shù de niánlíng zhěngzhěng yìbǎi suì le.
examples.example_translation: This tree is exactly one hundred years old.

examples.example_chinese: 你年龄也不小了，该找女朋友了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ niánlíng yě bù xiǎo le, gāi zhǎo nǚpéngyou le.
examples.example_translation: You are not young anymore, you should find a girlfriend.

examples.example_chinese: 来这儿学习的人，什么年龄的都有。
examples.example_pinyin: Lái zhèr xuéxí de rén, shénme niánlíng de dōu yǒu.
examples.example_translation: People of all ages come here to study.

examples.example_chinese: 外国人一般不太习惯别人随意问他们的年龄。
examples.example_pinyin: Wàiguó rén yìbān bú tài xíguàn biérén suíyì wèn tāmen de niánlíng.
examples.example_translation: Foreigners are generally not used to others casually asking their age.

meaning: n.人类两性之一，能在体内产生卵子 · female, woman, women

examples.example_chinese: 这家公司正在努力提高女性在管理层中的比例。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài nǔlì tígāo nǚxìng zài guǎnlǐcéng zhōng de bǐlì.
examples.example_translation: This company is working hard to increase the proportion of women in management.

examples.example_chinese: 她是一位受人尊敬的女性科学家。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shì yī wèi shòu rén zūnjìng de nǚxìng kēxuéjiā.
examples.example_translation: She is a respected female scientist.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书关注现代女性在城市生活中的选择。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè běn shū guānzhù xiàndài nǚxìng zài chéngshì shēnghuó zhōng de xuǎnzé.
examples.example_translation: This book focuses on the choices of modern women in urban life.

examples.example_chinese: 许多女性在职场上正在展现更多领导力。
examples.example_pinyin: xǔduō nǚxìng zài zhíchǎng shàng zhèngzài zhǎnxiàn gèng duō lǐngdǎo lì.
examples.example_translation: Many women are showing greater leadership in the workplace.

meaning: adv.有时候 · once in a while, occasionally

examples.example_chinese: 我只是偶尔喝一点儿酒。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì ǒu’ěr hē yīdiǎnr jiǔ.
examples.example_translation: I only drink a little alcohol once in a while.

examples.example_chinese: 我喜欢自己做饭，偶尔也和朋友去饭店吃。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zìjǐ zuò fàn, ǒu’ěr yě hé péngyou qù fàndiàn chī.
examples.example_translation: I like to cook by myself, but occasionally I go to a restaurant with friends.

examples.example_chinese: 这里很清静，偶尔会有辆汽车开过。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn qīngjìng, ǒu’ěr huì yǒu liàng qìchē kāiguò.
examples.example_translation: It’s very quiet here, occasionally a car passes by.

examples.example_chinese: 我们联系不多，偶尔会打个电话。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen liánxì bù duō, ǒu’ěr huì dǎ gè diànhuà.
examples.example_translation: We don’t keep in touch much, but occasionally we make a phone call.

examples.example_chinese: 偶尔，我们还能在网上碰到。
examples.example_pinyin: Ǒu’ěr, wǒmen hái néng zài wǎng shàng pèngdào.
examples.example_translation: Occasionally, we can still meet online.

meaning: v.做伴，跟别人一起 · accompany

examples.example_chinese: 我下午没时间，得陪一个朋友。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ méi shíjiān, děi péi yí ge péngyou.
examples.example_translation: I don’t have time this afternoon, I have to accompany a friend.

examples.example_chinese: 他热情地陪着游客参观。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā rèqíng de péizhe yóukè cānguān.
examples.example_translation: He enthusiastically accompanied the tourists on their visit.

examples.example_chinese: 昨天女朋友心情不好，我陪了她一天。
examples.example_pinyin: Zuótiān nǚpéngyou xīnqíng bù hǎo, wǒ péile tā yì tiān.
examples.example_translation: My girlfriend was in a bad mood yesterday, I accompanied her all day.

examples.example_chinese: 来客人了，他正陪着吃饭呢。
examples.example_pinyin: Lái kèrén le, tā zhèng péizhe chī fàn ne.
examples.example_translation: Guests have arrived, he is eating with them.

examples.example_chinese: 你陪我一起去逛街，好不好？
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ péi wǒ yìqǐ qù guàng jiē, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.example_translation: Will you go shopping with me?

examples.example_chinese: 对不起，失陪了，我要出去一下。
examples.example_pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, shīpéi le, wǒ yào chūqù yíxià.
examples.example_translation: Sorry, excuse me, I have to go out for a while.

meaning: n.身体表面的一层组织 · skin

examples.example_chinese: 夏天我们要保护好皮肤。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒmen yào bǎohù hǎo pífū.
examples.example_translation: We need to protect our skin well in summer.

examples.example_chinese: 他经常去海边游泳，皮肤晒得黑黑的。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jīngcháng qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng, pífū shài de hēihēi de.
examples.example_translation: He often goes swimming at the seaside, and his skin is tanned dark.

examples.example_chinese: 他们都是黄皮肤的中国人。
examples.example_pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì huáng pífū de Zhōngguó rén.
examples.example_translation: They are all Chinese people with yellow skin.

examples.example_chinese: 他有皮肤病，不容易治好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā yǒu pífūbìng, bù róngyì zhìhǎo.
examples.example_translation: He has a skin disease, which is not easy to cure.

examples.example_chinese: 皮肤旧如初
examples.example_pinyin: pí fū jiù rú chū

meaning: n.人的性情 · irritable disposition, bad temper

examples.example_chinese: 他脾气随和，没跟人闹过矛盾。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā píqi suíhé, méi gēn rén nàoguò máodùn.
examples.example_translation: He has a gentle temperament and has never had conflicts with others.

examples.example_chinese: 她有个好脾气，从来不生气。

examples.example_translation: She has a good temper and never gets angry.

examples.example_chinese: 我知道他的脾气，他轻易不会认错。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào tā de píqi, tā qīngyì bú huì rèn cuò.
examples.example_translation: I know his temperament, he rarely admits mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 从这件事上就可以看出他是什么脾气。
examples.example_pinyin: Cóng zhè jiàn shì shang jiù kěyǐ kànchū tā shì shénme píqi.
examples.example_translation: You can tell what kind of temperament he has from this matter.

examples.example_chinese: 低级的感情,只能沦为脾气和情绪。
examples.example_pinyin: dī jí de gǎn qíng zhǐ néng lún wèi pí qi hé qíngxù

examples.example_pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng xīn píxié.
examples.example_translation: I bought a new pair of leather shoes.

examples.example_chinese: 这双红皮鞋非常好，好看。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè shuāng hóng píxié fēicháng hǎo, hǎokàn.
examples.example_translation: This pair of red leather shoes is very good and beautiful.

examples.example_chinese: 这里男皮鞋的样式不多。

examples.example_translation: There aren't many styles of men's leather shoes here.

examples.example_chinese: 这是牛皮做的皮鞋吗？

examples.example_translation: Are these leather shoes made of cowhide?

examples.example_pinyin: tā jiù ài mǎi píxié, jiālǐ yǒu jǐ shí shuāng le.
examples.example_translation: She just loves buying leather shoes, and has dozens of pairs at home.

meaning: n.一种水果，球形或椭圆形，成串生长。 · grape
