examples.example_translation: Please show your boarding pass.

examples.example_chinese: 我的登机牌找不到了，怎么办啊？
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de dēngjīpái zhǎo bù dào le, zěnme bàn a?
examples.example_translation: I can't find my boarding pass, what should I do?

examples.example_translation: Sir, here is your boarding pass.

examples.example_pinyin: lǚyóu dànjì shí, wǒmen tōngcháng néng dìng dào dījià jīpiào.
examples.example_translation: During the low travel season, we can usually book low-priced flights.

examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ zěnme guāng hē jiǔ, bù chī cài a?

examples.example_translation: Her boyfriend praised her, and she became shy instead.

examples.example_chinese: 她平时很大方的，今天怎么害羞起来了？
examples.example_pinyin: Tā píngshí hěn dàfang de, jīntiān zěnme hàixiū qǐlái le?

meaning: v.为某种目的而行动 · purposeful action

meaning: v.提出例子来说明 · give an example

examples.example_chinese: 老师举例说明了这个语法点的用法。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī jǔlì shuōmíng le zhège yǔfǎdiǎn de yòngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: The teacher gave examples to explain how this grammar point is used.

examples.example_chinese: 请你举例说明这个词在句中的意思。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng nǐ jǔlì shuōmíng zhège cí zài jùzhōng de yìsi.
examples.example_translation: Please give an example to explain the meaning of this word in a sentence.

examples.example_chinese: 这本书举例介绍了常见的学习方法。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè běn shū jǔlì jièshào le chángjiàn de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
examples.example_translation: This book uses examples to introduce common learning methods.

meaning: n.供戏剧、歌舞等演出的场所 · theater

examples.example_chinese: 周末我们全家去剧院看了一场音乐剧。
examples.example_pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen quánjiā qù jùyuàn kàn le yì chǎng yīnyuèjù.
examples.example_translation: Our whole family went to the theater to see a musical this weekend.

examples.example_chinese: 这座新剧院能容纳一千多名观众。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zuò xīn jùyuàn néng róngnà yì qiān duō míng guānzhòng.
examples.example_translation: This new theater can accommodate more than one thousand spectators.

examples.example_chinese: 演出开始前，剧院门口已经排起长队。
examples.example_pinyin: yǎnchū kāishǐ qián, jùyuàn ménkǒu yǐjīng pái qǐ chángduì.
examples.example_translation: Before the performance began, a long line had already formed outside the theater.

meaning: v.把食物放在火上或高温中使熟 · bake, roast, grill

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈正在厨房里烤孩子们最爱吃的面包。
examples.example_pinyin: māma zhèngzài chúfáng lǐ kǎo háizimen zuì ài chī de miànbāo.
examples.example_translation: Mom is baking the children’s favorite bread in the kitchen.

examples.example_chinese: 这家餐厅用果木慢慢烤出香嫩的羊排。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiā cāntīng yòng guǒmù mànmàn kǎochū xiāngnèn de yángpái.
examples.example_translation: This restaurant slowly grills tender lamb chops over fruitwood.

examples.example_chinese: 周末我们准备在院子里一起烤玉米和红薯。
examples.example_pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen zhǔnbèi zài yuànzi lǐ yìqǐ kǎo yùmǐ hé hóngshǔ.
examples.example_translation: We are going to grill corn and sweet potatoes together in the yard this weekend.

meaning: v.因嗓子受到刺激而发出声音 · cough

examples.example_chinese: 她感冒了，不停地咳嗽。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gǎnmào le, bù tíng de késou.
examples.example_translation: She caught a cold and keeps coughing.

examples.example_chinese: 我晚上咳嗽得很厉害。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang késou de hěn lìhai.
examples.example_translation: I cough badly at night.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子有点儿咳嗽，去医院检查一下吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Háizi yǒudiǎnr késou, qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià ba.
examples.example_translation: The child has a bit of a cough, take him to the hospital for a checkup.

examples.example_chinese: 他忍不住咳嗽了几声。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā rěn bu zhù késoule jǐ shēng.
examples.example_translation: He couldn't help but cough a few times.

examples.example_chinese: 我咳嗽半个月了，总也好不了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ késou bàn ge yuè le, zǒng yě hǎo bu liǎo.
examples.example_translation: I have been coughing for half a month, and I just can't get better.

meaning: n.父母或长辈给孩子个人使用的小额钱款 · pocket money, allowance

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈每周给我五十元零花钱购买文具和书本。
examples.example_pinyin: māma měi zhōu gěi wǒ wǔshí yuán línghuāqián gòumǎi wénjù hé shūběn.
examples.example_translation: Mom gives me fifty yuan in pocket money every week to buy stationery and books.

examples.example_chinese: 他把省下来的零花钱都存进了银行账户。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bǎ shěng xiàlái de línghuāqián dōu cún jìn le yínháng zhànghù.
examples.example_translation: He put all the pocket money he had saved into his bank account.

examples.example_chinese: 这个月我的零花钱已经全部花完了。
examples.example_pinyin: zhège yuè wǒ de línghuāqián yǐjīng quánbù huā wán le.
examples.example_translation: I have already spent all my pocket money this month.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子应该学会合理安排自己的零花钱。
examples.example_pinyin: háizi yīnggāi xuéhuì hélǐ ānpái zìjǐ de línghuāqián.
examples.example_translation: Children should learn to manage their pocket money wisely.

examples.example_chinese: 爷爷偶尔会多给我一点零花钱买零食。
examples.example_pinyin: yéye ǒu'ěr huì duō gěi wǒ yìdiǎn línghuāqián mǎi língshí.
examples.example_translation: Grandpa occasionally gives me some extra pocket money to buy snacks.

meaning: n.小于某一整数目的钱 · small change; money of small denominations, such as jiao and fen

examples.example_chinese: 你能帮我换点儿零钱吗？
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ néng bāng wǒ huàn diǎnr língqián ma?
examples.example_translation: Can you help me change some small change?

examples.example_chinese: 今天商场找了我很多零钱。
examples.example_pinyin: jīntiān shāngchǎng zhǎo le wǒ hěn duō língqián.
examples.example_translation: The mall gave me a lot of small change today.

examples.example_chinese: 我没有零钱了，都是一百的。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ méiyǒu língqián le, dōu shì yī bǎi de.
examples.example_translation: I don't have any small change, only hundred-yuan bills.

examples.example_chinese: 我这儿没有一分、二分的零钱。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒ zhèr méiyǒu yī fēn, èr fēn de língqián.
examples.example_translation: I don't have any one- or two-fen coins here.

meaning: n.美丽的景色 · beautiful scenery

examples.example_chinese: 山顶的美景让所有游客都舍不得离开。
examples.example_pinyin: shāndǐng de měijǐng ràng suǒyǒu yóukè dōu shěbude líkāi.
examples.example_translation: The beautiful scenery from the mountaintop made all the tourists reluctant to leave.

examples.example_chinese: 我们沿着湖边散步，欣赏眼前的美景。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen yánzhe húbiān sànbù, xīnshǎng yǎnqián de měijǐng.
examples.example_translation: We walked along the lake and admired the beautiful scenery before us.

examples.example_chinese: 秋天的树林色彩斑斓，到处都是美景。
examples.example_pinyin: qiūtiān de shùlín sècǎi bānlán, dàochù dōu shì měijǐng.
examples.example_translation: The autumn woods are full of color, with beautiful scenery everywhere.

examples.example_chinese: 这座小城因独特的自然美景吸引了许多人。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīn dútè de zìrán měijǐng xīyǐn le xǔduō rén.
examples.example_translation: This small town attracts many people with its unique natural scenery.

meaning: n.想要到达的地方 · destination

examples.example_chinese: 我们终于在天黑前到达了目的地。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zhōngyú zài tiānhēi qián dàodá le mùdìdì.
examples.example_translation: We finally reached our destination before dark.

examples.example_chinese: 列车将在十分钟后抵达目的地。
examples.example_pinyin: lièchē jiāng zài shí fēnzhōng hòu dǐdá mùdìdì.
examples.example_translation: The train will arrive at its destination in ten minutes.

examples.example_chinese: 导航显示目的地距离这里还有五公里。
examples.example_pinyin: dǎoháng xiǎnshì mùdìdì lí zhèlǐ hái yǒu wǔ gōnglǐ.
examples.example_translation: The navigation system shows that the destination is still five kilometers away.

examples.example_chinese: 请确认包裹的目的地地址是否正确。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng quèrèn bāoguǒ de mùdìdì dìzhǐ shìfǒu zhèngquè.
examples.example_translation: Please confirm whether the package’s destination address is correct.

meaning: n.一种球类运动项目，也指这种运动使用的球 · table tennis

examples.example_chinese: 我最喜欢打乒乓球。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan dǎ pīngpāngqiú.
examples.example_translation: I like playing table tennis the most.

examples.example_chinese: 他乒乓球打得很好。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā pīngpāngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
examples.example_translation: He plays table tennis very well.

examples.example_chinese: 下午我们有一场乒乓球比赛。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen yǒu yì chǎng pīngpāngqiú bǐsài.
examples.example_translation: We have a table tennis match this afternoon.

examples.example_chinese: 他是校乒乓球队的成员之一。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā shì xiào pīngpāngqiúduì de chéngyuán zhī yī.
examples.example_translation: He is one of the members of the school table tennis team.

examples.example_chinese: 我获得过两次乒乓球冠军。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ huòdéguo liǎng cì pīngpāngqiú guànjūn.
examples.example_translation: I have won the table tennis championship twice.

examples.example_chinese: 我们用黄色的乒乓球吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen yòng huángsè de pīngpāngqiú ba.
examples.example_translation: Let’s use the yellow table tennis ball.

meaning: n.与自己家庭有婚姻关系或血缘关系的家庭及其成员 · relative

examples.example_chinese: 我在北京没有亲戚。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng méiyǒu qīnqi.
examples.example_translation: I have no relatives in Beijing.

examples.example_chinese: 他家亲戚很多，我给他们带了很多礼物。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā jiā qīnqi hěn duō, wǒ gěi tāmen dàile hěn duō lǐwù.
examples.example_translation: He has many relatives, and I brought them a lot of gifts.

examples.example_chinese: 我结婚的时候，亲戚们都来了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiéhūn de shíhou, qīnqimen dōu lái le.
examples.example_translation: When I got married, all my relatives came.

examples.example_chinese: 那天，我家来了几个亲戚。
examples.example_pinyin: Nà tiān, wǒ jiā láile jǐ ge qīnqi.
examples.example_translation: That day, several relatives came to my home.

examples.example_chinese: 小时候，我经常到亲戚家里去。
examples.example_pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, wǒ jīngcháng dào qīnqi jiāli qù.
examples.example_translation: When I was a child, I often went to my relatives’ homes.

meaning: adj.很少出现或很少能见到 · rare, uncommon

examples.example_chinese: 这种鸟在北方城市里十分少见。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè zhǒng niǎo zài běifāng chéngshì lǐ shífēn shǎojiàn.
examples.example_translation: This kind of bird is very rare in northern cities.

examples.example_chinese: 这样勇敢的孩子现在真的很少见。
examples.example_pinyin: zhèyàng yǒnggǎn de háizi xiànzài zhēn de hěn shǎojiàn.
examples.example_translation: Children this brave are truly uncommon nowadays.

examples.example_chinese: 这件瓷器造型独特，在市场上很少见。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiàn cíqì zàochéng dú特, zài shìchǎng shàng hěn shǎojiàn.
examples.example_translation: This porcelain piece has a unique shape and is rarely seen on the market.

meaning: adj.数量或分量较少 · a small amount, a small quantity

examples.example_chinese: 实验时只需加入少量清水并搅拌均匀。
examples.example_pinyin: shíyàn shí zhǐ xū jiārù shǎoliàng qīngshuǐ bìng jiǎobàn jūnyún.
examples.example_translation: During the experiment, only add a small amount of water and stir well.

examples.example_chinese: 医生建议她每天只摄入少量的糖和盐。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān zhǐ shèrù shǎoliàng de táng hé yán.
examples.example_translation: The doctor advised her to consume only a small amount of sugar and salt each day.

examples.example_chinese: 瓶中还剩少量药液，请不要随意倒掉。
examples.example_pinyin: píng zhōng hái shèng shǎoliàng yàoyè, qǐng bú yào suíyì dàodiào.
examples.example_translation: A small amount of the medicine remains in the bottle, so please do not pour it away.

meaning: n.温度的一种说法, 用符号“℃”表示 · degrees Celsius

examples.example_chinese: 今天的气温是30摄氏度。
examples.example_pinyin: jīntiān de qìwēn shì 30 shèshìdù.
examples.example_translation: Today's temperature is 30 degrees Celsius.

examples.example_chinese: 夜晚温度会降低到12摄氏度。
examples.example_pinyin: yèwǎn wēndù huì jiàngdī dào 12 shèshìdù.
examples.example_translation: The temperature will drop to 12 degrees Celsius at night.

examples.example_chinese: 水开时可以达到100摄氏度。
examples.example_pinyin: shuǐ kāi shí kěyǐ dádào 100 shèshìdù.
examples.example_translation: Water can reach 100 degrees Celsius when it boils.

examples.example_chinese: 明天气温下降, 最低温度在零下9摄氏度。
examples.example_pinyin: míngtiān qìwēn xiàjiàng, zuìdī wēndù zài língxià 9 shèshìdù.
examples.example_translation: The temperature will drop tomorrow, with the lowest temperature at minus 9 degrees Celsius.

meaning: n.两条或多条道路交叉的地方 · crossroads, intersection

examples.example_chinese: 我们在前面的十字路口向左转。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zài qiánmiàn de shízìlùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.
examples.example_translation: We turn left at the intersection ahead.

examples.example_chinese: 下班时间这个十字路口特别拥堵。
examples.example_pinyin: xiàbān shíjiān zhège shízìlùkǒu tèbié yōngdǔ.
examples.example_translation: This intersection is especially congested during rush hour.

examples.example_chinese: 警察正在十字路口指挥车辆通行。
examples.example_pinyin: jǐngchá zhèngzài shízìlùkǒu zhǐhuī chēliàng tōngxíng.
examples.example_translation: The police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.

examples.example_chinese: 走到十字路口以后请继续直行。
examples.example_pinyin: zǒu dào shízìlùkǒu yǐhòu qǐng jìxù zhíxíng.
examples.example_translation: Please continue straight after reaching the intersection.

meaning: n.按时间排列的工作、活动等的具体安排 · timetable, schedule

examples.example_chinese: 老师把新时间表发给了大家。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī bǎ xīn shíjiānbiǎo fā gěi le dàjiā.
examples.example_translation: The teacher sent the new timetable to everyone.

examples.example_chinese: 请按时间表安排明天的工作。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng àn shíjiānbiǎo ānpái míngtiān de gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: Please arrange tomorrow’s work according to the schedule.

examples.example_chinese: 火车的时间表最近有了变化。
examples.example_pinyin: huǒchē de shíjiānbiǎo zuìjìn yǒu le biànhuà.
examples.example_translation: The train timetable has changed recently.

meaning: adv.借着做某事的方便, 顺带着做另一件事 · (do something) in addition to what one is doing, without much extra effort

examples.example_chinese: 你下班的时候，顺便买点儿菜回来吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ xiàbān de shíhou, shùnbiàn mǎi diǎnr cài huílai ba.
examples.example_translation: When you get off work, buy some vegetables on your way back.

examples.example_chinese: 上个月我去上海开会，顺便玩儿了两天。
examples.example_pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Shànghǎi kāihuì, shùnbiàn wánle liǎng tiān.
examples.example_translation: Last month I went to Shanghai for a meeting and also took the opportunity to have fun for two days.

examples.example_chinese: 如果你来北京，就顺便到我家坐坐吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ lái Běijīng, jiù shùnbiàn dào wǒ jiā zuòzuo ba.
examples.example_translation: If you come to Beijing, drop by my place as well.

examples.example_chinese: 你见到我弟弟以后，顺便问问他什么时候回来。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ jiàndào wǒ dìdi yǐhòu, shùnbiàn wènwen tā shénme shíhou huílai.
examples.example_translation: After you see my younger brother, ask him when he will come back.

examples.example_chinese: 你那回去的时候顺便在东海边上溜达一趟
examples.example_pinyin: nǐ nà huí qù de shí hou shùn biàn zài dōng hǎi biān shàng liū dá yī tàng

meaning: n.人或动物身体内部的温度 · body temperature

examples.example_chinese: 护士每天早晚给病人测量体温。
examples.example_pinyin: hùshi měitiān zǎowǎn gěi bìngrén cèliáng tǐwēn.
examples.example_translation: The nurse measures the patient's body temperature every morning and evening.

examples.example_chinese: 孩子发烧了，体温已经升到三十九度。
examples.example_pinyin: háizi fāshāo le, tǐwēn yǐjīng shēng dào sānshíjiǔ dù.
examples.example_translation: The child has a fever, and their temperature has risen to thirty-nine degrees.

examples.example_chinese: 运动以后，人的体温通常会暂时升高。
examples.example_pinyin: yùndòng yǐhòu, rén de tǐwēn tōngcháng huì zànshí shēnggāo.
examples.example_translation: After exercise, a person's body temperature usually rises temporarily.

examples.example_chinese: 如果体温持续异常，应该及时去医院。
examples.example_pinyin: rúguǒ tǐwēn chíxù yìcháng, yīnggāi jíshí qù yīyuàn.
examples.example_translation: If your body temperature remains abnormal, you should go to the hospital promptly.

meaning: v.在表格、单据等指定位置写上文字或数字 · fill in, complete (a form or document)

examples.example_chinese: 请在申请表上填写真实的个人信息。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng zài shēnqǐngbiǎo shàng tiánxiě zhēnshí de gèrén xìnxī.
examples.example_translation: Please fill in your real personal information on the application form.

examples.example_chinese: 请填写您的姓名、电话和联系地址。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng tiánxiě nín de xìngmíng, diànhuà hé liánxì dìzhǐ.
examples.example_translation: Please fill in your name, phone number, and contact address.

examples.example_chinese: 填写完成后，请仔细检查所有内容。
examples.example_pinyin: tiánxiě wánchéng hòu, qǐng zǐxì jiǎnchá suǒyǒu nèiróng.
examples.example_translation: After completing the form, please check all the information carefully.

examples.example_chinese: 他正在网上填写学校的报名表。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zhèngzài wǎngshàng tiánxiě xuéxiào de bàomíngbiǎo.
examples.example_translation: He is filling in the school registration form online.

examples.example_chinese: 如果填写有误，可以点击这里修改。
examples.example_pinyin: rúguǒ tiánxiě yǒuwù, kěyǐ diǎnjī zhèlǐ xiūgǎi.
examples.example_translation: If you entered something incorrectly, you can click here to correct it.

meaning: n.圆筒形的盛器，多用木、金属或塑料制成 · bucket, barrel

examples.example_chinese: 妈妈把刚洗好的衣服全放进塑料桶里。
examples.example_pinyin: māma bǎ gāng xǐ hǎo de yīfu quán fàng jìn sùliào tǒng lǐ.
examples.example_translation: Mom put all the freshly washed clothes into a plastic bucket.

examples.example_chinese: 工人把清水一桶桶地搬到施工现场。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngrén bǎ qīngshuǐ yì tǒng tǒng de bān dào shīgōng xiànchǎng.
examples.example_translation: The workers carried buckets of clean water to the construction site.

examples.example_chinese: 又有人挑来一桶开水，上面漂着一个瓢，一个个红光满面围着桶舀水吃。
examples.example_pinyin: yòu yǒu rén tiāo lái yī tǒng kāi shuǐ shàng miàn piào zhe yī gè yī gè gè hóng guāng mǎn miàn wéi zhe tǒng shuǐ chī

meaning: adj.做事认真、周密，注意细节 · careful, attentive

examples.example_chinese: 她做事一直很细心，很少出现差错。
examples.example_pinyin: tā zuòshì yìzhí hěn xìxīn, hěn shǎo chūxiàn chācuò.
examples.example_translation: She is always very careful in her work and rarely makes mistakes.

examples.example_chinese: 细心的护士认真核对每位病人的药物。
examples.example_pinyin: xìxīn de hùshi rènzhēn héduì měi wèi bìngrén de yàowù.
examples.example_translation: The attentive nurse carefully checks each patient’s medication.

examples.example_chinese: 请细心检查合同里的数字和日期。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng xìxīn jiǎnchá hétong lǐ de shùzì hé rìqī.
examples.example_translation: Please carefully check the numbers and dates in the contract.

examples.example_chinese: 他细心地记下了老师讲的每个重点。
examples.example_pinyin: tā xìxīn de jìxià le lǎoshī jiǎng de měi ge zhòngdiǎn.
examples.example_translation: He carefully wrote down every key point explained by the teacher.

meaning: v.希望自己也有别人的好处，有利条件等 · admire, envy

examples.example_chinese: 他考试得了第一名，大家都很羡慕他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā kǎoshì déle dì-yī míng, dàjiā dōu hěn xiànmù tā.
examples.example_translation: He got first place in the exam, and everyone admires him.

examples.example_chinese: 我羡慕他能说一口流利的汉语。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiànmù tā néng shuō yì kǒu liúlì de Hànyǔ.
examples.example_translation: I envy him for being able to speak fluent Chinese.

examples.example_chinese: 他钢琴弹得特别好，很让人羡慕。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā gāngqín tán de tèbié hǎo, hěn ràng rén xiànmù.
examples.example_translation: He plays the piano very well, which makes people admire him.

examples.example_chinese: 他的技术让人羡慕得不得了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de jìshù ràng rén xiànmù de bùdéliǎo.
examples.example_translation: His skills make people extremely envious.

examples.example_chinese: 他的这辆汽车引起了大家的羡慕。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā de zhè liàng qìchē yǐnqǐle dàjiā de xiànmù.
examples.example_translation: His car aroused everyone's envy.

examples.example_chinese: 我从来不羡慕那些有钱人，觉得幸福跟金钱无关。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ cónglái bú xiànmù nàxiē yǒu qián rén, juéde xìngfú gēn jīnqián wúguān.
examples.example_translation: I never envy those who are rich; I think happiness has nothing to do with money.

meaning: n.刷牙用的一种东西 · toothpaste

examples.example_chinese: 这种牙膏有保护牙齿的作用。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yágāo yǒu bǎohù yáchǐ de zuòyòng.
examples.example_translation: This toothpaste has a protective effect on teeth.

examples.example_chinese: 他每次出差时都要带上牙膏。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā měi cì chūchāi shí dōu yào dàishàng yágāo.
examples.example_translation: He always takes toothpaste with him on business trips.

examples.example_chinese: 我喜欢用水果味儿的牙膏。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yòng shuǐguǒwèir de yágāo.
examples.example_translation: I like to use fruit-flavored toothpaste.

examples.example_chinese: 我平均一个月用一盒牙膏。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ píngjūn yí ge yuè yòng yì hé yágāo.
examples.example_translation: I use one tube of toothpaste per month on average.

examples.example_chinese: 我刷牙的时候，才发现牙膏用完了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ shuā yá de shíhou, cái fāxiàn yágāo yòngwán le.
examples.example_translation: I only realized the toothpaste was finished when I was brushing my teeth.

meaning: n.打开锁的工具 · key

examples.example_chinese: 这是房间的钥匙，你收好。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè shì fángjiān de yàoshi, nǐ shōuhǎo.
examples.example_translation: This is the room key, keep it safe.

examples.example_chinese: 我的钥匙丢了，进不了屋了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi diū le, jìn bu liǎo wū le.
examples.example_translation: I lost my key and can't get into the room.

examples.example_chinese: 我想再配一把门钥匙。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài pèi yì bǎ ményàoshi.
examples.example_translation: I want to make another door key.

examples.example_chinese: 我捡到了一串钥匙，不知道是谁的。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ jiǎndàole yí chuàn yàoshi, bù zhīdào shì shéi de.
examples.example_translation: I found a bunch of keys, but I don't know whose they are.

examples.example_chinese: 这把钥匙打不开那个锁。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè bǎ yàoshi dǎ bu kāi nàge suǒ.
examples.example_translation: This key can't open that lock.

meaning: n.从天黑到天亮之间的一段时间 · night, nighttime

examples.example_chinese: 夜晚的海边很安静，只有浪声陪着我。
examples.example_pinyin: yèwǎn de hǎibiān hěn ānjìng, zhǐyǒu làngshēng péizhe wǒ.
examples.example_translation: The seaside is very quiet at night, with only the sound of the waves keeping me company.

examples.example_chinese: 我们常在夏天的夜晚坐在院子里聊天。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen cháng zài xiàtiān de yèwǎn zuò zài yuànzi lǐ liáotiān.
examples.example_translation: On summer nights, we often sit in the courtyard and chat.

examples.example_chinese: 夜晚气温下降，出门时记得多穿一件衣服。
examples.example_pinyin: yèwǎn qìwēn xiàjiàng, chūmén shí jìde duō chuān yí jiàn yīfu.
examples.example_translation: The temperature drops at night, so remember to wear an extra layer when going out.

examples.example_chinese: 城市的夜晚灯火明亮，街上依然很热闹。
examples.example_pinyin: chéngshì de yèwǎn dēnghuǒ míngliàng, jiēshang yīrán hěn rènao.
examples.example_translation: The city is brightly lit at night, and the streets are still lively.

examples.example_chinese: 他习惯在安静的夜晚阅读和整理笔记。
examples.example_pinyin: tā xíguàn zài ānjìng de yèwǎn yuèdú hé zhěnglǐ bǐjì.
examples.example_translation: He is used to reading and organizing his notes during quiet nights.

examples.example_chinese: 山村的夜晚没有车声，只能听见虫鸣。
examples.example_pinyin: shāncūn de yèwǎn méiyǒu chēshēng, zhǐ néng tīngjiàn chóngmíng.
examples.example_translation: There is no traffic noise in the mountain village at night, only the sound of insects.

meaning: v.参加招聘 · accept an offer of employment

examples.example_chinese: 公司要招一位办公人员，我就去应聘了。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngsī yào zhāo yī wèi bàngōng rényuán, wǒ jiù qù yìngpìn le.
examples.example_translation: The company wanted to hire an office worker, so I went to apply for the job.

examples.example_chinese: 听说招演员，大家纷纷去应聘。
examples.example_pinyin: tīngshuō zhāo yǎnyuán, dàjiā dōu gǎn qù yìngpìn.
examples.example_translation: I heard they were recruiting actors, so everyone went to apply.

examples.example_chinese: 每次应聘失败后，他就站在大街上不敢回家。
examples.example_pinyin: měi cì yìngpìn shībài hòu, tā jiù zhàn zài dàjiē shàng bù gǎn huí jiā.
examples.example_translation: Every time he failed a job application, he would stand on the street, not daring to go home.

examples.example_chinese: 四天后，她顺利应聘成为一家超市的员工。
examples.example_pinyin: sì tiān hòu, tā shùnlì yìngpìn chéngwéi yī jiā chāoshì de yuángōng.
examples.example_translation: Four days later, she successfully got a job at a supermarket.

examples.example_chinese: 他们对应聘者提出了具体的要求。
examples.example_pinyin: tāmen duì yìngpìn zhě tíchū le jùtǐ de yāoqiú.
examples.example_translation: They put forward specific requirements for the applicants.

meaning: n.朋友之间真挚而亲密的感情 · friendship

examples.example_chinese: 真正的友情经得起时间的考验。
examples.example_pinyin: zhēnzhèng de yǒuqíng jīngdeqǐ shíjiān de kǎoyàn.
examples.example_translation: True friendship can stand the test of time.

examples.example_chinese: 我们在共同学习中建立了深厚的友情。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen zài gòngtóng xuéxí zhōng jiànlì le shēnhòu de yǒuqíng.
examples.example_translation: We developed a deep friendship while studying together.

examples.example_chinese: 她一直珍惜和老同学之间的友情。
examples.example_pinyin: tā yìzhí zhēnxī hé lǎo tóngxué zhījiān de yǒuqíng.
examples.example_translation: She has always treasured her friendship with her old classmate.

meaning: part.用在定语与中心语之间，表示领属或修饰关系 · used between an attribute and the word it modifies, to indicate that one thing belongs to or modifies another

examples.example_chinese: 我们的报纸要成为读者之友。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen de bàozhǐ yào chéngwéi dúzhě zhī yǒu.
examples.example_translation: Our newspaper should become a friend of the readers.

examples.example_chinese: 明年将是希望之年、胜利之年。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngnián jiāng shì xīwàng zhī nián, shènglì zhī nián.
examples.example_translation: Next year will be a year of hope and a year of victory.

examples.example_chinese: 成功之道在于勤奋。
examples.example_pinyin: Chénggōng zhī dào zàiyú qínfèn.
examples.example_translation: The way to success lies in diligence.

examples.example_chinese: 这里历来是鱼米之乡。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli lìlái shì yúmǐzhīxiāng.
examples.example_translation: This place has always been a land of fish and rice.

examples.example_chinese: 因为平常连这一点点渺小之感都不会有的！
examples.example_pinyin: yīn wèi píng lián zhè yī diǎn diǎn xiǎo zhī dōu bù huì yǒu de

meaning: n.事情由坏向好发展的机会 · a favorable turn, a turning point

examples.example_chinese: 事情终于出现了新的转机。
examples.example_pinyin: shìqing zhōngyú chūxiàn le xīn de zhuǎnjī.
examples.example_translation: A new turning point has finally emerged.

examples.example_chinese: 这次谈判给双方带来了转机。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè cì tánpàn gěi shuāngfāng dài lái le zhuǎnjī.
examples.example_translation: The negotiations brought both sides a favorable turn.

examples.example_chinese: 医生说他的病情还有转机。
examples.example_pinyin: yīshēng shuō tā de bìngqíng hái yǒu zhuǎnjī.
examples.example_translation: The doctor said his condition could still improve.

meaning: v.用言语、行动、表情等显出 · to express, show, indicate

examples.example_chinese: 她不说话就是表示不同意。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā bù shuōhuà jiù shì biǎoshì bù tóngyì.
examples.example_translation: She kept silent to express her disagreement.

examples.example_chinese: 他送你花儿就是表示喜欢你。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā sòng nǐ huār jiù shì biǎoshì xǐhuān nǐ.
examples.example_translation: He sent you some flowers to show he likes you.

examples.example_chinese: 他表示以后会按时完成作业。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā biǎoshì yǐhòu huì ànshí wánchéng zuòyè.
examples.example_translation: He made up his mind to finish his homework on time in future.

examples.example_chinese: 大家对这位新同学的到来表示欢迎。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhè wèi xīn tóngxué de dàolái biǎoshì huānyíng.
examples.example_translation: Everyone welcomed the new student.

examples.example_chinese: 我已经向他表示过多次了。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xiàng tā biǎoshiguo duō cì le.
examples.example_translation: I’ve told him again and again.

examples.example_chinese: 我送了他一个礼物，表示感谢。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ sòngle tā yī gè lǐwù, biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
examples.example_translation: I gave him a present to express my gratitude.

examples.example_chinese: 他点头了，表示已经同意了。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā diǎntóu le, biǎoshì yǐjīng tóngyì le.
examples.example_translation: He nodded to show his agreement.

meaning: n.通常指大面积的树木 · forest

examples.example_chinese: 这片森林有好几百年了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín yǒu hǎojǐ bǎi nián le.
examples.example_translation: This forest has been here for hundreds of years.

examples.example_chinese: 在森林中很容易迷路。
examples.example_pinyin: Zài sēnlín zhōng hěn róngyì mílù.
examples.example_translation: It's easy to get lost in the forest.

examples.example_chinese: 这场森林大火终于被扑灭了。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng sēnlín dà huǒ zhōngyú bèi pūmiè le.
examples.example_translation: The forest fire was finally put out.

examples.example_chinese: 人类已经意识到要保护好森林，不能再破坏自然环境了。
examples.example_pinyin: Rénlèi yǐjīng yìshi dào yào bǎohù hǎo sēnlín, bù néng zài pòhuài zìrán huánjìng le.
examples.example_translation: Humans have realized the need to protect forests and not to destroy the natural environment anymore.

examples.example_chinese: 这里是一片原始森林，树木非常茂密。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèli shì yí piàn yuánshǐ sēnlín, shùmù fēicháng màomì.
examples.example_translation: This is a primeval forest, and the trees are very dense.

meaning: n.表示百分比的符号，相当于“%” · percent

examples.example_chinese: 我们完成了百分之八十的工作。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒmen wánchéngle bǎifēnzhī bāshí de gōngzuò.
examples.example_translation: We have completed eighty percent of the work.

examples.example_chinese: 今年游客数量增加了百分之十。
examples.example_pinyin: Jīnnián yóukè shùliàng zēngjiāle bǎifēnzhī shí.
examples.example_translation: The number of tourists increased by ten percent this year.

examples.example_chinese: 我百分之百相信他。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bǎifēnzhī bǎi xiāngxìn tā.
examples.example_translation: I believe him one hundred percent.

examples.example_chinese: 调查显示，百分之九十五的人对这项新政策感到满意。
examples.example_pinyin: Diàochá xiǎnshì, bǎifēnzhī jiǔshíwǔ de rén duì zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè gǎndào mǎnyì.
examples.example_translation: The survey shows that ninety-five percent of people are satisfied with this new policy.

meaning: n.中国最长的河 · the Yangtze River

examples.example_chinese: 长江从这里流过。
examples.example_pinyin: Cháng Jiāng cóng zhèli liúguò.
examples.example_translation: The Yangtze River flows past here.

examples.example_chinese: 这座大桥连接长江两岸。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zuò dà qiáo liánjiē Cháng Jiāng liǎng'àn.
examples.example_translation: This bridge connects both banks of the Yangtze River.

examples.example_chinese: 明天长江以南地区有雨。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān Cháng Jiāng yǐ nán dìqū yǒu yǔ.
examples.example_translation: Tomorrow, there will be rain in the areas south of the Yangtze River.

examples.example_chinese: 长江发源于青海省。
examples.example_pinyin: Cháng Jiāng fāyuán yú Qīnghǎi Shěng.
examples.example_translation: The Yangtze River originates in Qinghai Province.

examples.example_chinese: 明天我想去长江三峡旅游。
examples.example_pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ xiǎng qù Cháng Jiāng Sānxiá lǚyóu.
examples.example_translation: Tomorrow I want to travel to the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River.

examples.example_chinese: 长江发源于青海省。
examples.example_pinyin: Cháng Jiāng fāyuán yú Qīnghǎi Shěng.
examples.example_translation: The Yangtze River originates in Qinghai Province.

meaning: cl.用于事物集体,指成套的事物,相当于“套” · set, group (measure word)

examples.example_chinese: 这组图片是去年在长城照的。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zǔ túpiàn shì qùnián zài chángchéng zhào de.
examples.example_translation: This set of pictures was taken at the Great Wall last year.

examples.example_chinese: 这组汉字的读音都相同。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè zǔ hànzì de dúyīn dōu xiāngtóng.
examples.example_translation: The pronunciation of this group of Chinese characters is the same.

examples.example_chinese: 这几组数字说明经济在好转。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhè jǐ zǔ shùzì shuōmíng jīngjì zài hǎozhuǎn.
examples.example_translation: These few sets of numbers indicate that the economy is improving.

examples.example_chinese: 我昨天买了一组书柜。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎile yī zǔ shūguì.
examples.example_translation: I bought a set of bookcases yesterday.

meaning: v.拼在一起 · form, organize, compose

examples.example_chinese: 这些东西组合在一起就是一幅画。
examples.example_pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxī zǔhé zài yīqǐ jiùshì yī fú huà.
examples.example_translation: When these things are combined, they form a painting.

examples.example_chinese: 请大家用这些词语组句子。
examples.example_pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā yòng zhèxiē cíyǔ zǔ jùzi.
examples.example_translation: Everyone, please use these words to form sentences.

examples.example_chinese: 你把拆下来的零件再组起来就不容易了。
examples.example_pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chāi xiàlái de língjiàn zài zǔ qǐlái jiù bù róngyìle.
examples.example_translation: It's not easy to reassemble the parts you've taken apart.

examples.example_chinese: 大家按照规定,四个人组成了一队。
examples.example_pinyin: Dàjiā ànzhào guīdìng, sì gè rén zǔchéngle yī duì.
examples.example_translation: Everyone formed a team of four according to the regulations.

meaning: v.控制，支配 · to control, to influence

examples.example_chinese: 他左右了这个公司很多年。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā zuǒyòu le zhège gōngsī hěnduō nián.
examples.example_translation: He controlled this company for many years.

examples.example_chinese: 我不想左右你们，你们自己做判断吧。
examples.example_pinyin: Wǒ bùxiǎng zuǒyòu nǐmen, nǐmen zìjǐ zuò pànduàn ba.
examples.example_translation: I don't want to influence you, you can make your own judgment.

examples.example_chinese: 他完全能够左右局势，我们不用担心。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā wánquán nénggòu zuǒyòu júshì, wǒmen bùyòng dānxīn.
examples.example_translation: He is fully capable of controlling the situation, we don't need to worry.

examples.example_chinese: 他很有主意，谁都左右不了他。
examples.example_pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu zhǔyì, shéi dōu zuǒyòu bùliǎo tā.
examples.example_translation: He has his own opinions, and no one can influence him.

examples.example_chinese: 五点左右，艳丽的蔷薇绽开了笑脸；
examples.example_pinyin: wǔ diǎn zuǒ yòu yànlì de qiáng wēi zhàn kāi le xiàoliǎn

meaning: adv.有些, 不完全 · partly, not completely

examples.example_chinese: 他半信半疑地看着我。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bàn xìn bàn yí dì kànzhe wǒ.
examples.example_translation: He looked at me half-believing and half-doubting.

examples.example_chinese: 他说话半开玩笑半认真。
examples.example_pinyin: tā shuōhuà bàn kāiwánxiào bàn rènzhēn.
examples.example_translation: He spoke half-jokingly and half-seriously.

examples.example_chinese: 他半醉半醒的样子让人担心。
examples.example_pinyin: tā bàn zuì bàn xǐng de yàngzi ràng rén dānxīn.
examples.example_translation: His half-drunk, half-awake state made people worry.

examples.example_chinese: 窗户半开着，凉风轻轻吹进房间。
examples.example_pinyin: chuānghu bàn kāizhe, liángfēng qīngqīng chuī jìn fángjiān.
examples.example_translation: The window was partly open, and a cool breeze blew gently into the room.

examples.example_chinese: 这道菜还是半生的，需要再煮一会儿。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè dào cài háishi bàn shēng de, xūyào zài zhǔ yíhuìr.
examples.example_translation: This dish is still partly raw and needs to be cooked a little longer.

meaning: v.烦劳, 打扰别人做事时的客气说法 · to trouble someone, to bother someone politely

examples.example_chinese: 烦你帮我把这份文件交给老师。
examples.example_pinyin: fán nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
examples.example_translation: Could I trouble you to help me give this document to the teacher?

examples.example_chinese: 烦请您在这里签个名。
examples.example_pinyin: fán qǐng nín zài zhèlǐ qiān gè míng.
examples.example_translation: May I trouble you to sign your name here?

meaning: adv.逐个，一次一个地 · one by one, separately

examples.example_chinese: 老师把学生的名字各个念了一遍。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng de míngzi gè gè niàn le yí biàn.
examples.example_translation: The teacher read each student’s name one by one.

examples.example_chinese: 我们把问题各个解决了。
examples.example_pinyin: wǒmen bǎ wèntí gè gè jiějué le.
examples.example_translation: We solved the problems one by one.

examples.example_chinese: 警察对线索进行各个排查。
examples.example_pinyin: jǐngchá duì xiànsuǒ jìnxíng gè gè páichá.
examples.example_translation: The police investigated the clues one by one.

meaning: v.一个一个地写出或说出 · to list, to arrange item by item

examples.example_chinese: 请把你的问题列出来。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng bǎ nǐ de wèntí liè chūlái.
examples.example_translation: Please list your questions.

examples.example_chinese: 老师在黑板上列了几个例子。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng liè le jǐ gè lìzi.
examples.example_translation: The teacher listed several examples on the blackboard.

meaning: prep.就人的某种身份或事物的某种性质来说 · as, in the capacity of, in terms of

examples.example_chinese: 作为一名教师,就应该为人师表。
examples.example_pinyin: zuòwéi yī míng jiàoshī, jiù yīnggāi wéi rén shībiǎo.
examples.example_translation: As a teacher, one should be a role model.

examples.example_chinese: 作为一名公务人员,她是尽职尽责的。
examples.example_pinyin: zuòwéi yī míng gōngwù rényuán, tā shì jìnzhí jìnzé de.
examples.example_translation: As a civil servant, she is conscientious and responsible.

examples.example_chinese: 作为一名著名学者,他受到了大家的尊敬。
examples.example_pinyin: zuòwéi yī míng zhùmíng xuézhě, tā shòudào le dàjiā de zūnjìng.
examples.example_translation: As a famous scholar, he is respected by everyone.

meaning: prep.用在名词或代词前，表示把某物或某人作为处置对象 · used before an object, similar to “把”

examples.example_chinese: 请将这份表格填写完整后再交给办公室。
examples.example_pinyin: qǐng jiāng zhè fèn biǎogé tiánxiě wánzhěng hòu zài jiāo gěi bàngōngshì.
examples.example_translation: Please fill out this form completely before submitting it to the office.

examples.example_chinese: 工作人员将所有申请材料分类整理后存入系统。
examples.example_pinyin: gōngzuò rényuán jiāng suǒyǒu shēnqǐng cáiliào fēnlèi zhěnglǐ hòu cúnrù xìtǒng.
examples.example_translation: The staff sorted all the application materials by category and entered them into the system.

examples.example_chinese: 老师将重点内容写在黑板上，方便学生课后复习。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī jiāng zhòngdiǎn nèiróng xiě zài hēibǎn shàng, fāngbiàn xuéshēng kèhòu fùxí.
examples.example_translation: The teacher wrote the key points on the blackboard to make it easier for students to review after class.

meaning: v.不适宜，不方便做某事 · not suitable, not convenient to do something

examples.example_chinese: 这件事涉及别人的隐私，我现在不便多说。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiàn shì shèjí biérén de yǐnsī, wǒ xiànzài búbiàn duō shuō.
examples.example_translation: This matter involves someone else’s privacy, so it is not appropriate for me to say more now.

examples.example_chinese: 老师正在开会，可能不便马上回复你的消息。
examples.example_pinyin: lǎoshī zhèngzài kāihuì, kěnéng búbiàn mǎshàng huífù nǐ de xiāoxi.
examples.example_translation: The teacher is in a meeting and may not be able to reply to your message right away.

meaning: conj.表示进一步补充理由或说明 · besides, moreover

examples.example_chinese: 这家店离公司很近，再说价格也不贵。
examples.example_pinyin: zhè jiā diàn lí gōngsī hěn jìn, zài shuō jiàgé yě bú guì.
examples.example_translation: This shop is close to the company, and besides, it is not expensive.

examples.example_chinese: 外面雨下得很大，再说我也没带伞。
examples.example_pinyin: wàimiàn yǔ xià de hěn dà, zài shuō wǒ yě méi dài sǎn.
examples.example_translation: It is raining heavily outside, and besides, I did not bring an umbrella.

examples.example_chinese: 他工作认真负责，再说经验也很丰富。
examples.example_pinyin: tā gōngzuò rènzhēn fùzé, zài shuō jīngyàn yě hěn fēngfù.
examples.example_translation: He is conscientious and responsible, and moreover, he has extensive experience.
